paragraphs: Currently, Zhang Fei was accompanying Shen Yu to soak in the small artificial lake, but they did not engage in sexual activities. Instead, they talked about various topics and laughed happily, especially after he revealed his actions toward Shen Shixi and the Du Clan.
"Why don't you use Shen Shixi as your slave, husband? Her face and appearance are not bad, right?" Shen Yu posed this question as she turned to face Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei did not deny Shen Yu's words. "She is indeed not bad, but I have no intention of taking her as my personal slave. As you already know, some of my women have indeed slept with other men, such as Liu Qingyu, my mother, Zhong Yan, Ru Xue, and Tang Ziyu. Mei Xiang and Qiao Ran are also the same, but they have never slept with more than one man, so I don't mind it.

Others might think that I'm a hypocrite, especially since I myself have slept with many women, and my two clones also have their own women. However, I have no interest in bringing women like Tang Rou (Yin-Yang Pavilion Elder) and Shen Shixi, who have slept with more than one man, to my side, so I will let your mother and the others decide his fate."
Shen Yu nodded in understanding before facing Zhang Fei and hugging him. "I can't wait until the day after tomorrow, and then I can be your wife completely."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and briefly kissed Shen Yu's lips. "Why are you so impatient? We'll only need two days to make you mine forever. Your mother and I have discussed something, but I don't know if you'll agree."

"Are you thinking of dual-cultivating with the two of us at the same time?" Zhang Fei responded to Shen Yu by nodding. "Sigh! In fact, I already guessed that you wanted to do it, and I have no problem with that, especially after I witnessed you doing it with my other sisters."
Zhang Fei smiled in satisfaction at Shen Yu's answer. "However, we won't do it on our wedding night, and I will give you a first night that you will never forget for the rest of your life."

"Haha." Shen Yu softly laughed, determined not to let the presence of other women, including her mother, disrupt their wedding night. She suddenly remembered something and summoned her contract beast immediately, and Lan Zhen immediately changed into her human form. "Did you notice anything different about her?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows as he observed Lan Zhen closely, and his expression turned to surprise after he realized it. "Hah! I didn't expect that she would turn back into a virgin after I turned her into a frost lynx, and I hadn't even realized it before."

"That's right." Shen Yu nodded to Zhang Fei. "Back then, I also didn't notice it when you turned Lan Zhen into a frost lynx for the first time, and I only realized it a few days ago. If my guess is correct, You Han should also return to being a virgin after you turned her into a dryad, and I think you can do the same to Shao Shixi.

Moreover, her cultivation is already at the 5-Star Heaven Realm, so I think it would be a waste if you let her die in my mother's hands. Even if you don't want to touch him directly, you can use one of your clones to dual-cultivate with him, right?"

"Yeah, you're right about that." Zhang Fei replied with a nod before smiling faintly, causing Shen Yu to raise her eyebrows as she realized that he had a crazy idea for Shao Shixi. "Hahaha! Since her cultivation is at the 5-Star Heaven Realm, she would be more useful to me if I turned her into a demon cultivator, so I could get a lot of yin qi and female essence from her."
"Do you really want to turn Shen Shixi into a demon cultivator?" Shen Yu asked in surprise.

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Shen Yu. However, I will not use my science capsule to transform Shao Shixi into a demon cultivator; instead, I will send her to the Diyu Realm. That way, she will gradually turn into a demon, and she will be desperate because of it. Moreover, Feltia would be facing the Amaris Twins soon, and her strength would be enough to help her face them."

Shen Yu could understand Zhang Fei's intention to make Shen Shixi suffer, but she thought that it would be in vain. "If you do that, Shen Shixi won't return to being a virgin, and it will be a waste, right?"

"Not really." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head. "Although I naturally transformed Shen Shixi into a demon cultivator, I can still turn her into a beast in the future, so it won't be wasted. However, I haven't made a decision yet, so I'll send her to Feltia's side and transform her into a demon cultivator first, especially considering she will return to the Amaris Twins' sub-realm soon."
"I see." Shen Yu nodded in understanding and inquired. "Do you want to dual-cultivate with Lan Zhen right now? That way, you can take her second virgin qi, and you will also get her beast essence."

"No." Zhang Fei rejected Shen Yu's idea immediately. "I just want to accompany you until our wedding day, so I won't dual-cultivate with Lan Zhen now. Moreover, her cultivation is still at the 2-Star Core Realm now, so her second virgin qi will be wasted. Therefore, it would be better if I waited for her cultivation to increase further, which would make her second virgin qi stronger.
Even so, I will continue to supply her with my yang qi, so her cultivation will increase faster."

Zhang Fei then called Lan Zhen over, imparting the Yin-Yang Flawless Art to her. He also took out a few bottles, immediately filling them with his cum before handing them to her. "Yu'er will send you back to her medallion, where you can learn the technique directly. After you finish learning it, you can use my yang qi to cultivate, and I will give you more later."
Lan Zhen looked delighted as she received the bottles. "Thank you, Master."

After that, Shen Yu sent Lan Zhen back into the beast medallion, but she then spoke to Zhang Fei. "Husband, I know your thoughts about Shi Xi and Shi Wu, but they have never done anything truly evil to Guo Lan except for kidnapping her, and you have locked them up in your portable mansion for so long.
Since both of them have cultivation veins and seem loyal to you, I think you should teach them cultivation."

Zhang Fei himself had actually been thinking about it for a long time, but he had always been hesitant to make a decision, especially since he was afraid that they would betray him in the future. In fact, he could use his demon slave mark to control them, but he didn't want to use it on them either.

Since Zhang Fei continued to hesitate, Shen Yu tried to persuade him again. "You shouldn't have to be afraid that they will betray you, right? Even if they cultivate now, their strength is still at rock bottom, so you are stronger than them, and you also have several wives who are even stronger.
That way, if they really betray you one day, we can kill them directly, so you don't have to worry about it."

"Sigh, you're right about that, and I was indeed worrying too much about them." Zhang Fei then took out the portable mansion and enlarged it, and he immediately asked the Shi Sisters to come out from inside it.

Soon, Shi Wu and Shi Xi walked out, but they were stunned for a moment after seeing the surrounding area. However, they already knew that Zhang Fei and the others were cultivators and had knowledge of the other worlds, especially because he had frequently shared this information with them.

In fact, Shi Wu and Shi Xi had always harbored hopes of being able to be like them, but they had never conveyed their desires for Zhang Fei, especially since they realized that he only considered them as servants.
"Come here, Wu'er and Xi'er."

Zhang Fei's call brought the Shi Sisters back to their senses, and they immediately went over to him. But as soon as they arrived at the side of the artificial lake, their faces turned red because she could clearly see his dick.
"Why did you call us here, Master?" Shi Wu was the first to ask, and her sister also looked at Zhang Fei in confusion.

"You two can sit cross-legged, and I will teach you to become cultivators like us." Zhang Fei's order took the Shi Sisters aback for a moment, but they immediately followed it with looks of joy, especially since the opportunity they had been waiting for a long time had finally arrived.

Zhang Fei then began to explain to them the method of absorbing Qi from the air, and the two women listened to his every explanation with serious expressions, as this would be their first experience that would bring significant changes to their lives.

After they fully understood everything, Shi Wu and Shi Xi immediately closed their eyes and began to try to absorb Qi from the air according to Zhang Fei's instructions. However, Shen Yu immediately came out of the water and moved behind them, pressing both palms on their backs as she channeled her own qi into their bodies to help them become cultivators faster.

Feeling the flow of Shen Yu's qi within their bodies, Shi Wu and Shi Xi could more easily understand how to absorb qi from the air. About half an hour later, Zhang Fei could feel that qi was starting to flow into their bodies, so he just needed to wait for them to become full cultivators.

Shen Yu herself immediately withdrew her qi before joining Zhang Fei again in the artificial lake, and she looked at the Shi Sisters with a smile. "For people who are just starting to cultivate like them, their comprehension is not bad, and they can utilize my qi flow to absorb qi from the air."
"That's true." Zhang Fei replied with an affirmative nod. "For now, we just need to wait for them to become cultivators, then we can see their true cultivation talent."

After they waited for an hour, Zhang Fei and Shen Yu felt a small wave of qi coming out of the Shi Sisters's bodies, signifying that they had officially become cultivators like them. 'Scan their status, Mei.'

Zhang Fei and Mei screamed at the same time as soon as they read the Shi Sisters' status, confusing Shen Yu, so he asked her. "What happened? Why did you suddenly scream like that?"
Zhang Fei took a deep breath before telling Shen Yu. "You will also be surprised if you know their elements, Yu'er. Wu'er awakened the wood element, and Xi'er awakened the metal element."

Shen Yu was instantly stunned after hearing Zhang Fei's answer, and she looked at the Shi Sisters with a shocked gaze, especially since wood and metal elements were quite rare, even though they were not as rare as space.

"In my entire life, I have only met a few people who possess both wood and metal elements, and they are among the strongest cultivators in this realm, even stronger than my great-grandmother. If I remember correctly, Elder Mu Zhiwu and Elder Hao Yingmu of the Blazing Phoenix Sect had the wood element, and they joined the sect because their element was useful for alchemy.
Besides, Elder Gang Jinshu of the Desolate Sect has the metal element, and he is the vice-sect master of the sect."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding after hearing that. "The wood element is indeed highly beneficial for alchemy, particularly in the development of herbs and other related items. As for the metal element, I think it will definitely be useful for blacksmithing, but I doubt that Shi Xi can do that with her small build.
Even if she wants to be a blacksmith, she would at least have to train for a very long time to become one."

"Haha." Shen Yu laughed upon hearing that. "Husband, metal element possessors don't have to be blacksmiths, you know? A blacksmith is indeed their most suitable profession, just like Elder Gang Jinshu. However, metal elements are not limited to that, and they can use their elements to do many things, especially since they can manipulate any metal if their cultivation and elements have increased."
"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei then asked Mei to look for the right technique for them in the system shop. "Anyway, the Desolate Sect is in the eastern region, right?"

After all, a daughter will leave us and follow her husband after she gets married, and I would feel lonely if that happened."
Instead, Zhang Fei reversed their positions and leaned Shen Yu towards the side of the artificial lake, but his strange gaze caused her to shudder.
"If you are afraid that our future daughter will leave you, then the best thing to do is to have many children.
That way, you will never feel lonely, right?"
"Do you think getting pregnant and giving birth is easy?" Shen Yu responded with a tone of protest.
"I don't want to have too many children!
At most, I only want to have two children and no more, so I want both to be boys."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at that.
"You are a beast and a cultivator, remember?
Even my mother gave birth to four children when she wasn't yet a cultivator, so you should be stronger than her, and you can give birth to many for me—at least a dozen."
Shen Yu glared at Zhang Fei before pushing him away.
"I don't want to give birth to a dozen children!
You can ask Boitata to give birth to them for you!
She's stronger than me, and she's also a divine beast, so she should be strong enough for that."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei burst into laughter at Shen Yu's reactions, and he swiftly embraced her before planting a kiss on her lips.
"All right, I won't force you to give birth to a bunch of children, but I still want one of our future children to be a girl.
I'm certain that when she grows up, she will be as beautiful as her mother, and I will always protect her for the rest of her life, so you don't need to worry about her."
Shen Yu let out a helpless sigh because Zhang Fei clearly wanted a daughter so badly, and she finally nodded in agreement.
"It doesn't matter if we have a daughter in the future, but you better not forget your words today, and you must protect her forever."

"Your wish is my command, little princess." Shen Yu smiled upon hearing that and invited Zhang Fei to make out, so he immediately carried her out of the artificial lake and started their intimate activities.
Early in the morning, Shen Shixi was in another area of the tower, but she looked anxious and tense.

She also kept monitoring the surrounding area using her senses, especially since that place was a special supply warehouse for Shen Haoran and his loyalists, and she was about to carry out Zhang Fei's orders.
After she made sure everything was safe, Shen Shixi immediately used her qi to spread the powder Zhang Fei had given her all over the place, which mixed into all the supplies available inside.
'Sigh!
I hope no one will realize what I did, or my brother will kill me if he finds out about it.' Shen Shixi muttered to herself before leaving the room, and she hurriedly returned to her room.
Shortly after Shen Shixi left the room, a man walked in and checked the supplies inside, and he found the powder she had scattered earlier.
He then rubbed the powder before licking it to taste it, but he didn't feel anything strange about it.
"What exactly is the purpose of this powder?

Why did Shen Shixi spread it to our supplies?" The man muttered as he rubbed another powder and licked it again, but he still didn't feel anything in his body, so he immediately contacted Shen Haoran and asked him to come to that place.

chapters.title: Chapter 305: Eastern Desert
paragraphs: After receiving the news from one of his loyalists, Shen Haoran immediately went to the warehouse and tasted the powder for himself. Similar to his loyalists, he did not experience unusual sensations from the powder, but rather, he tasted a sweet flavor.

Zhang Fei himself had expected that someone might notice Shen Shixi's actions, especially with the tight surveillance in the tower. That's why he selectively selected the poison seed, and its effect will not work immediately. In fact, without a trigger, the effect will never work, so they will never realize that it is poison.
"Do you feel anything different in your body after tasting it?"

"No." Shen Haoran's subordinate responded by shaking his head. "It's been a few minutes since I tasted it, but I still don't feel anything in my body, so I'm confused about the effects and purpose of your sister sprinkling it into our supplies."

"Did you see anyone coming to see Shixi, or did she meet anyone else before she came here?" Once again, the man shook his head at Shen Haoran, especially since Zhang Fei used his invisibility when meeting Shen Shixi, so no one noticed his presence in her room.
"That's weird! There are only two people who can escape your surveillance, but I'm sure that they'll never do such a thing."
"Are you referring to Shen Huang and Shen Xinya?"

"Yes." Shen Haoran nodded to the man. "They have powerful concealment artifacts, so nobody can detect their presence, and they may be in this sect by now. However, they are not the type of people who would use underhanded methods, so I am sure that they would not have ordered Shixi to do this. Experience new tales on мѵʟ
Shen Xueyi and her loyalists cannot divert your surveillance unless they are in their respective rooms, as the formations protecting them effectively block our senses."
"Have you contacted Zhiyu Fengzhi to check this powder?"

"We both know that Zhiyu Fengzhi is one of Shen Xueyi's loyalists, so there's no point in inviting him if he won't tell us the truth." Shen Haoran then used his qi to get rid of all the powder, but unfortunately, he did not realize that he had fallen into Zhang Fei's trap as soon as he touched it. "I will go see Shixi now."
"Should we replace all these supplies?"

"Not now." Shen Haoran responded by shaking his head. "Their wedding will start early in the morning in two days, so we will focus on that matter now, especially because it concerns our future. However, you can ask the others to get rid of these supplies, and we will replace everything after their wedding is over."

Immediately after Shen Haoran's departure, the man summoned several individuals to meet him, who promptly disposed of the supplies. Regrettably, they failed to recognize that the powder's effect had not entirely dissipated, leaving them vulnerable to its effects the moment they came into contact with those supplies.
*Bam*

Shao Shixi's heart tightened as she saw her brother standing up with an angry look after kicking the door, but she still managed to maintain her composure and asked, "What did you do? Why did you barge into my room like this?"

"Don't play dumb with me!" Shen Haoran shouted as he released his aura, pressing Shen Shixi down on her bed. He immediately moved over to his sister and strangled her neck. "What is your purpose for sprinkling that powder on our supplies? Who ordered you to do it?"
Shen Shixi shook her head vigorously. "No one ordered me! I- Ugh!"

"Don't lie to me!" Shen Haoran shouted as he strangled Shao Shixi's neck even tighter, causing her face to turn extremely red and have difficulty breathing. "Tell me! Who ordered you to do that? Otherwise, I'll cripple your cultivation and feed you to the beasts."

Shen Shixi trembled upon hearing Shen Haoran's threat, particularly because her brother was known for his unwavering commitment to his word. However, she was also afraid of Zhang Fei's devil slave mark in her soul, and she did not want to die because of it. 'Damn it! Both options will kill me!
Rather than having my cultivation crippled and being eaten alive by beasts, it would be better if I died because of his slave mark!'
Shen Haoran became increasingly impatient and furious, and he pressed his palm against Shen Shixi's chest. "Don't test my patience! Speak now!"

"That person is—Argh!" Shen Shixi's desire to reveal Zhang Fei's identity to her brother triggered the demon slave mark within her soul instantaneously, inflicting immense pain and causing her internal organs to ache intensely. "Help! Argh!"

Shen Haoran immediately jumped back, but his eyes never looked away from Shen Shixi, who continued to writhe and scream due to the excruciating pain all over her body. 'What the hell happened to her? Why did she suddenly become like this?'

"Argh! Brother! Please help me!" Shen Shixi kept screaming as she tried to use her qi to ease the pain, but the pain only got worse as she did so, and her face quickly turned pale. "Argh! No! This pain is killing me, brother!"

Shen Shixi's reaction made Shen Haoran frown as he realized something. 'It appears that someone has managed to trick my people's surveillance and infiltrate this tower, but who is the real culprit? How did the culprit manage to sneak in here? I'm sure that whoever did this to her is the same person who did those things to my son before.'

After she was in pain for a few minutes, Shen Shixi's screams finally stopped because she had fallen unconscious, especially since Zhang Fei's devil slave mark would not kill her but torture her, and he said all that before just to scare her.

Shen Haoran took a deep breath and approached Shen Shixi to check on her condition; he found that his sister was still alive. However, he did not want to risk that the culprit would use her to do terrible things to them again, so he sealed her cultivation and ordered one of his loyalists to lock her up.
Unfortunately, Shen Haoran didn't realize that Zhang Fei had been watching their movements from his map, even though he was having fun with Shen Yu on the ground floor.

In addition, Shen Haoran also ordered his loyalists to search for the culprit, which was naturally in vain, especially since they would never be able to find Zhang Fei. "Damn it! The day after tomorrow will be an important day for me, so I can't let the culprit ruin my plans!"

Meanwhile, Liu Hua and the Wen Twins are visiting the Ying Clan to explain Chu Yaoqian's situation to the clan's people, which makes Ying Feng angry because he can't avenge his son's death. "Your anger is unnecessary, as that little girl's fate has already been determined, and I assure you that she will soon follow your son.

Although you can't kill her directly, I think it is the best solution for everyone. Otherwise, killing her yourself will result in bloodshed, and the number of victims from both clans will be excessive."

"Husband, second miss Liu is right." Sun Mei'er uttered these words as she caressed her husband's shoulder. "Although we cannot avenge our son's death with our own hands, I do not doubt her words, and I believe that Chu Youqian will follow our son into the afterlife, so you can forget your anger towards her."
Ying Feng sighed heavily, nodded to his wife, and then posed a question to Liu Hua. "Who will kill Chu Youqian, second miss Liu?"

"My husband." Not only were Ying Feng and Sun Mei'er shocked by Liu Hua's answer, but even Ying Sha and Hong Xuan, who were also present in the room, were shocked. "To tell you the truth, my husband is a vengeful person, and he will never spare anyone who chooses to be his enemy.
He had already heard that Chu Youqian planned all that against him, and he also knew about her jealousy towards Zhang Lin, so he was heading to the Northern Region to catch up with them."

"Zhang Fei's cultivation is still in the soul realm, right, second miss Liu? Why did he do such a crazy thing by going to the northern region?" Liu Hua immediately turned to Ying Sha, who asked her the question.

"Moreover, we all know that the northern region is extremely dangerous because of the presence of the Pang Clan, and their people have full control over the entire area, so Zhang Fei will face great danger if he goes there." Hong Xuan added to her lover's words as she looked at Liu Hua with a serious expression.

"Haha." Instead, Liu Hua laughed after listening to them. "As I said before, my husband is a vengeful person, and he is indeed a little crazy, so he will do whatever it takes to eliminate his enemies, including venturing into the northern region by himself.

Moreover, you guys already know about his relationship with Shen Yu; even Shen Haoran and his loyalists are no less strong than the members of the Pang Clan, but he still dares to snatch her from his son. Anyway, you guys will witness his true strength and abilities in two days, so you don't need to worry about him."

"Does that mean Zhang Fei will appear at Shen Yu and Shen Tianyu's wedding?" Hong Xuan posed this question with a puzzled expression, especially since his cultivation was still too weak to perform such a feat.
"Yes." Liu Hua nodded to Hong Xuan. "In two days, the Ying-Yang Pavilion will be very chaotic, so the four of you should be careful when attending the wedding."
"Can Zhang Fei really fight them?" Ying Sha doubtfully asked.

Liu Hua smiled and stood up from her seat. "If all of you are curious whether my husband is able to do it or not, then you guys can witness it directly in two days, and you all will realize that he is not an ordinary cultivator."

After the three women left, Ying Sha asked her lover directly. "Why do I think that she has overestimated Zhang Fei's abilities? I know that he is indeed different, especially since he can advance from outer disciple to inner disciple in less than a month, and he will also advance to core disciple soon.
However, Shen Haoran and the others are powerful, and they are stronger than the Liu Clan; I do not believe that they can help him snatch Shen Yu from Shen Tianyu's hands."

Hong Xuan nodded in agreement to Ying Sha, but then she sighed softly. "However, if Shen Yu really turns away from Shen Tianyu and goes to Zhang Fei, I think it is possible that Mistress Shen will also side with him, especially since it is an open secret that the two sides have always been enemies.
If they and the Liu Clan join forces to support him, then I am sure that Shen Haoran and his loyalists will not be able to fight him."

"Your opinion is correct, Xuan'er." Sun Mei'er replied with a nod. "Mistress Shen loves her daughter very much, but she also has to think about her clan's situation, and her decision to betroth her daughter to Shen Tianyu was only to maintain clan stability.

Furthermore, second miss Liu exuded confidence in Zhang Fei's ability to handle Shen Haoran, suggesting that she has already approved of his relationship with her daughter and that she and her loyalists will undoubtedly support him."

Unlike them, Ying Feng did not care much about Zhang Fei and the others' affairs, and he was still frustrated that he could not kill Chu Youqian with his own hands. "Forget it! We are just a small clan, so we don't need to interfere in the affairs of major clans like them. Otherwise, we will be the ones who lose, and we will just have to wait to find out the outcome."
Two people were already standing on the edge of the eastern desert, and Yi Na asked Zhang Fei [1]. "Isn't this the location of the desolate sect? Why did you bring me here?"

"I heard Gang Jinshu is a possessor of the metal element, and one of my women has the same element as him." Yi Na was really surprised. heard Zhang Fei [1]'s answer. "Since I myself do not have the metal element, I cannot teach her about it. That's why I came here to see him, and I want to ask for his guidance on the element so I can help her master it."

After hearing that, Yi Na nodded in understanding. "I've heard about Elder Jinshu and his metal element, but he's a man who's always busy with his personal affairs, so I'm not sure that we can meet him directly."

"At least, I should give it a try first, right?" Zhang Fei [1] was about to take Yi Na to the desolate sect when suddenly, several men and women landed nearby, led by a middle-aged woman whose body exuded high confidence and dignity.
However, Zhang Fei [1]'s gaze was not on the middle-aged woman, and he smiled as he looked at one of the young women standing among the group.
Noticing his gaze, the woman turned to Zhang Fei [1], and her expression turned joyful before running towards him. "Fei! I didn't expect to meet you here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 306: Heavenly Sword Sect Disciples
paragraphs: "Hey! Who is that guy? Why is Ye Lian so excited to see him?" A male disciple from the Heavenly Sword Sect inquired while glaring fiercely at Zhang Fei [1], and the other disciples could hear the jealousy in his tone.

They were not surprised by that, especially since they already knew that the male disciple had tried to court Ye Lian after the news of her broken engagement spread in their sect, and Gu Zhan had also been missing for some time. However, none of them knew that he was dead, especially since Xing Mei had yet to reveal his death to the public.

A female disciple then told the man. "I don't know for sure the identity of that man, Ba Yongshan. However, Ye Lian once told me that she was already engaged to another man not long after her engagement with Gu Zhan was broken, so I thought that man was her new fiancé."

After he heard that, Ba Yongshan's expression turned serious, and his right hand gripped his sword so tightly that even a glimmer of killing intent flashed in his eyes as he continued to glare at Zhang Fei [1].
"Does that mean Ye Lian cheated on Gu Zhan, Jing Qiu?" Another female disciple abruptly questioned the first one.

"No." Jing Qiu denied her question by shaking her head. "You're wrong about that, Qian He. Instead, Gu Zhan cheated on Ye Lian over and over again, and she had reminded him to stop many times. Unfortunately, he was too arrogant after he became a core disciple, and our sect master also paid a lot of attention to him, so he was never willing to listen to her and kept doing it."

"Jing Qiu is right, Qian He." A male disciple said it with a nod. "I have long known about Gu Zhan's affair with several of our sect sisters, and I feel sorry for Ye Lian because of that, especially since she is a kind and loyal woman; I even had some interest in her in the past.
Unfortunately, she only had that guy in mind and never gave me a chance to approach her, so I decided to step back and get engaged to my current fiancée."

Ba Yongshan, who heard that, stole a glance at his sect brother, but he didn't say anything and returned his gaze to Zhang Fei [1] again. 'Tch! Where did that bastard come from? Back then, I lost to Gu Zhan, and I don't want to lose to another man again, so I will do anything to get Ye Lian, even if I have to kill that bastard.'

The third male disciple suddenly patted the second male disciple's shoulder and said to him, "Hey, Luo Feng! Even though you didn't manage to win Ye Lian's heart, you've already gotten a good woman, like junior sister Li Fefei, so you don't need to regret it anymore."

"I don't regret it at all, Chao Qing." Luo Feng denied it as he pushed the man's hand off his shoulder. "I love Feifei very much, and my relationship with Ye Lian is better now that I've let go of my feelings for her."

Unlike them, the middle-aged woman who led them didn't care about Ye Lian's relationship with Zhang Fei [1], but she continued to observe him seriously as she covered her sensitive nose with a handkerchief. 'Judging from his bone age, he should still be under 20 years old, but his cultivation has already reached the 2-Star Soul Realm.

Moreover, the blood stench in his body is extremely strong, indicating that he has killed countless people before. However, I don't understand how a man as young as him could commit such a feat, and his expression also didn't indicate that he was a cold-blooded killer.'

"Fei!" Ye Lian exclaimed as she was about to hug Zhang Fei [1], but he immediately reached out and grabbed her shoulders, making her complain in an annoyed tone. "Hey! I haven't seen you for a month and a half, so I wanted to hug you now, but you stopped me instead!"

"I know you miss me, but this is not my true self, so you can't hug me." Ye Lian raised her eyebrows for a moment after hearing that, and she finally realized that the Zhang Fei in front of her was his clone, especially since the real him almost never left the Chu Clan. "At first, I thought you would only be gone for a short while, but you ended up being gone for so long."

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Zhang Fei's Arrogance
paragraphs: After hearing Ba Yongshan's words, Qin Zheng and the other four disciples frowned, especially since Zhang Fei [1] was clearly Ye Lian's fiancé, but he was acting that way towards him out of jealousy.
Ye Lian was also furious about that. "You-"
"All right, you don't have to be angry with a spoiled brat like him, Lian'er." Zhang Fei [1] stopped Ye Lian immediately, which caused Ba Yongshan to frown.

"You may be able to act arrogantly within the Heavenly Sword Sect thanks to Ba Jiawen's status as sect master, but your status as his nephew is useless outside your sect, especially since your Ba Clan is just a minor clan in the western region."

"Pfft! Hahaha!" Jing Qiu, Qian He, Luo Feng, and Chao Qing burst out laughing after hearing Zhang Fei [1]'s reply to Ba Yongshan, especially since not a single disciple from their sect dared to say such a thing to him, mainly because Ba Jiawen is always protective of his clan members, and he will punish them if they insult his clan members.
Even Qin Zheng, who had been serious until now, could barely hold back her laughter. 'This kid is really bold! Ba Yongshan has never met an opponent like him, so let's see his reaction first.'

"Hahaha!" Ye Lian laughed out loud as she repeatedly slapped Zhang Fei [1]'s shoulders. "Hahaha! You are right, Fei. That's why I chose Gu Zhan in the past, especially since Ba Yongshan has never been aware of his status, and he always uses the name of our sect master to do as he pleases."

After hearing Ye Lian's words, Ba Yongshan's face darkened, and his entire body's muscles bulged out, causing his killing intent to leak out of his body. However, he instantly froze in place as soon as Zhang Fei [1] unleashed his own killing intent, and cold sweat began to wash over his body.

Even the two gatekeepers, Qin Zheng, and the other four disciples instinctively took a few steps back to get away from them, as they gulped hard after they sensed Zhang Fei [1]'s killing intent. Only Ye Lian and Yi Na, who looked relaxed, stood beside him.
After all, Zhang Fei [1] had killed far more humans, beasts, or demon beasts, which made his killing intent much sharper and more intense than Ba Yongshan's.

Even so, Zhang Fei [1] had no intention of causing a scene in the desolate sect, so he immediately retracted his killing intent before speaking to Ba Yongshan. "You're lucky, you know? If you had dared to make a move to hurt Lian'er, I would have killed you on the spot, and I would have also sent my people to destroy your Ba Clan today.
Anyway, you don't need to show me your meager arrogance, and I'll show you what real arrogance is."
After he said that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately took out four plaques.

One was the plaque from the Liu Clan that Liu Hua had given him when his clone was about to join the Yin-Yang Pavilion; one was a plaque from the Chu Clan given by Liu Qingyu after he married the Chu Sisters; one was a plaque from the Zhang Clan given by Zhang Lingxue after their first night; and the last was a plaque from the Shen Clan that he borrowed from Shen Yu just now.

When she saw the four plaques, Ye Lian immediately took out her Ye Clan plaque and gave it to Zhang Fei [1]. "You are my fiancé, and we're getting married soon, so you can keep it along with the four plaques."

Not only was Ba Yongshan shocked to see the five plaques in Zhang Fei's hands [1], but even Qin Zheng and the others were shocked looking at all five of them, especially since all of those plaques belonged to the five major powerful clans in three different regions.

Unlike them, Yi Na was only curious about the plaque belonging to the Shen Clan, especially since Zhang Fei [1] had never told her about his relationship with the clan, and she also knew that Shen Yu would marry Shen Tianhu soon. 'This guy is really insane! He has gotten many women from the four clans, and he is also a member of the Shen Clan now.'

"See these five plaques?" Zhang Fei [1] asked as he showed the five to Ba Yongshan. "Do you think your minor Ba Clan can match any of these five clans? Oh! You don't need to doubt their authenticity, especially since Liu Hua, Chu Ying, Chu Qing, and Zhang Lingxue are my wives. Ye Lian and Shen Yu are my fiancées, and I will marry them both soon."
Zhang Fei [1]'s revelation of his relationship with the six women stunned Qin Zheng and the others, and they glanced at Ye Lian, who immediately confirmed it with a nod.

"Next time, think carefully before you go looking for trouble with others, lest your actions bring ruin to your Ba Clan." Zhang Fei [1] then stored the other four plaques in his inventory before giving the Zhang Clan plaque to the two gatekeepers. "Brothers, I am indeed not one of their entourage, and I came here specifically to see Elder Gang Jinshu.
So please inform him of my arrival, and please tell him that I only wish to speak to him regarding the metal element, so I will not waste too much of his time."
"Yes... yes... I will inform Elder Gang Jinshu right away." After the guard took the Zhang Clan plaque from Zhang Fei [1]'s hand, he immediately ran into his sect.

As they waited for the guard to return, Ye Lian chose to introduce Zhang Fei [1] to Qin Zheng and the four disciples, and he did not mind it, especially since he could see for himself that they were decent people.

As for Yi Na, she had always positioned herself as Zhang Fei [1]'s dual cultivation partner, and she herself was another man's wife, so she did not want to interact with them because she was afraid that they would realize her identity.

"Haha." Chao Qing suddenly laughed as he spoke to Zhang Fei [1]. "Brother, I don't know how you managed to win the hearts of your wives, but I really admire you for managing to get the women from those major clans. Even Ye Lian seems to be willing to accept your relationship with them, even though she used to oppose Gu Zhan's relationship."

Luo Feng nodded in agreement with Chao Qing before speaking to Zhang Fei [1]. "Brother, Ye Lian is a good woman, and we have been good friends for a long time, so I hope you will continue to protect her and not hurt her feelings like Gu Zhan did to her in the past."

"That's for sure, brother. Not only Lian'er, but I will also always protect all my wives, and I will kill anyone who dares to hurt them." Zhang Fei [1] replied to Long Feng as he glanced sharply at Ba Yongshan, who immediately rushed into the Desolate Sect out of fear and shame at the same time. He then replied to Chao Qing.

"Unlike Gu Zhan, I didn't want to deceive her with sweet promises, so I never hid my relationship with my other wives from her, and she was willing to accept me even though she had known about our relationship from the start."
"You're a real man, brother!" Chao Qing then stretched out his hand towards Zhang Fei [1]. "I'm glad to know you, and I hope we can have a good relationship in the future."

"Sure!" Zhang Fei [1] replied as he grabbed Chao Qing's hand. "You guys are Lian'er's friends, so you guys are also my friends, and we might be able to go on adventures together to get to know each other. Unfortunately, I still have a lot of problems on hand, so I have to clear them one by one to make the situation more under control."
Chao Qing nodded in understanding and separated their hands. "If you have a lot of free time, you can visit us at the Heavenly Sword Sect, Brother."
"All right." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a nod of agreement.
Unlike the two male disciples, Jing Qiu and Qian He repeatedly stole glances at Zhang Fei [1], especially since his handsome face and strong charm captivated them.

Ye Lian observed the actions of the two female disciples and let out a soft sigh, muttering quietly in her heart. 'Although Fei did not use his demon charm on them, his natural charm is deadly to them, and they would surely submit completely to him if he used it on them.'
After they had waited for some time, the gatekeeper returned to them with a middle-aged man wearing a shabby blacksmith's clothes, and he immediately returned the Zhang Clan plaque to Zhang Fei [1].

The middle-aged man was none other than Gang Jinshu, and the heat from the fire during the forging process, combined with the remnants of the materials he used, had left his entire body black. Even so, his expression was one of joy, and he immediately asked Zhang Fei [1]. "Are you the one who wanted to meet with me to discuss the metal element? Could you please show me your element?"

"I'm sorry to disappoint you, Elder." Zhang Fei [1]'s reply made Gang Jinshu frown. "I don't have the metal element, but one of my women does. Since I don't have any knowledge about the metal element, I decided to come here to see you because you are the owner of the metal element, and I want to discuss that element with you so I can teach her about it."

Gang Jinshu nodded in understanding before speaking. "Please come to my private quarters; we'll talk there. Actually, it would be better if you brought your woman here so I can explain everything to her directly, and she'll definitely be able to understand it easier than through a third party."
"Well, that's true." Zhang Fei [1] agreed with that and nodded. "In that case, elder, we can go to your private quarters now, and I'll show you something later, which will surely please you."

Gang Jinshu swiftly departed to guide Zhang Fei [1] to his private quarters, while simultaneously ordering the two gatekeepers. "One of you can lead our guests to the guest area, and Chi Zhiqiang will meet them there."
"Yes, Elder Jinshu."

After that, one of the gatekeepers led Qin Zheng and the other disciples to the guest hall, and Ye Lian also went with them to meet with Chi Zhiqiang. Meanwhile, Yi Na decides to follow Zhang Fei [1] to Gang Jinshu's private quarters.

Sometime later, Zhang Fei [1] and Yi Na had arrived at Gang Jinshu's private place, but it was more like a blacksmith's workshop, and the place was filled with various kinds of forging equipment, including two large forges located in the north of the room. "So what do you want to show me, kid?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed upon hearing that, especially since he originally didn't want to introduce Shi Xi to Gang Jinshu, but he changed his mind after thinking about his previous words. 'Mei, open the portal to the training space.'
Gang Jinshu looked at Zhang Fei [1] in shock after the portal appeared, which made him think that he had the void element, or else he wouldn't have done such a thing.
Unfortunately, Gang Jinshu misunderstood the portal, especially since it had nothing to do with the void element, and it was thanks to the system.
Even so, Gang Jinshu was not a nosy person, and he himself did not like it when others pry into his personal affairs, so he did not ask Zhang Fei [1] about it.
Soon, it was not only Shi Xi who walked out of the training space, but Shi Wu followed behind her sister, especially since they had never seen the Sky Jade Realm in person.

"Oh?" Gang Jinshu raised his eyebrows in surprise after he saw the two women, but his eyes immediately fell on Shi Xi, and he nodded repeatedly with a serious face. "One has the wood element, and the other has the metal element. Both elements are quite rare, so you are lucky to have them both by your side. Unfortunately, they haven't been cultivated for long, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] nodded to Gang Jinshu. "Actually, they both became cultivators today, and I heard about you from Shen Yu, so I came straight to this sect to meet you."

"I see." Given that the gatekeeper had informed him about Zhang Fei [1]'s relationship with the five clans, Gang Jinshu was no longer surprised to hear this and asked Shi Xi. "Do you want to be my personal disciple, little girl? You may not know me, but I'm this realm's top metal cultivator. Although there are other metal element cultivators in this realm, none can teach you as well as I can.
If you are willing to be my disciple, I will pass on all my knowledge of metal elements to you, and I will also teach you to become one of the best blacksmiths in this realm."
Shi Xi felt at a loss to give Gang Jinshu an answer, especially since she did not know him, and she was also still a beginner in the cultivation world, so she was afraid that he would hurt her later.

Zhang Fei [1] immediately spoke to Gang Jinshu. "Elder, how about you explain the basics of the metal element to Xi'er for now? That way, she can study the metal element while thinking about your offer first."
"All right." Gang Jinshu immediately agreed with Zhang Fei, and he asked Shi Xi to sit in front of him before he began to explain to her about the metal element.

sentences.text: After hearing Ba Yongshan's words, Qin Zheng and the other four disciples frowned, especially since Zhang Fei [1] was clearly Ye Lian's fiancé, but he was acting that way towards him out of jealousy.
Ye Lian was also furious about that.
"You-"
"All right, you don't have to be angry with a spoiled brat like him, Lian'er." Zhang Fei [1] stopped Ye Lian immediately, which caused Ba Yongshan to frown.

"You may be able to act arrogantly within the Heavenly Sword Sect thanks to Ba Jiawen's status as sect master, but your status as his nephew is useless outside your sect, especially since your Ba Clan is just a minor clan in the western region."
"Pfft!

Hahaha!" Jing Qiu, Qian He, Luo Feng, and Chao Qing burst out laughing after hearing Zhang Fei [1]'s reply to Ba Yongshan, especially since not a single disciple from their sect dared to say such a thing to him, mainly because Ba Jiawen is always protective of his clan members, and he will punish them if they insult his clan members.
Even Qin Zheng, who had been serious until now, could barely hold back her laughter. 'This kid is really bold!
Ba Yongshan has never met an opponent like him, so let's see his reaction first.'
"Hahaha!" Ye Lian laughed out loud as she repeatedly slapped Zhang Fei [1]'s shoulders.
"Hahaha!
You are right, Fei.
That's why I chose Gu Zhan in the past, especially since Ba Yongshan has never been aware of his status, and he always uses the name of our sect master to do as he pleases."
After hearing Ye Lian's words, Ba Yongshan's face darkened, and his entire body's muscles bulged out, causing his killing intent to leak out of his body.
However, he instantly froze in place as soon as Zhang Fei [1] unleashed his own killing intent, and cold sweat began to wash over his body.
Even the two gatekeepers, Qin Zheng, and the other four disciples instinctively took a few steps back to get away from them, as they gulped hard after they sensed Zhang Fei [1]'s killing intent.
Only Ye Lian and Yi Na, who looked relaxed, stood beside him.
After all, Zhang Fei [1] had killed far more humans, beasts, or demon beasts, which made his killing intent much sharper and more intense than Ba Yongshan's.
Even so, Zhang Fei [1] had no intention of causing a scene in the desolate sect, so he immediately retracted his killing intent before speaking to Ba Yongshan.
"You're lucky, you know?
If you had dared to make a move to hurt Lian'er, I would have killed you on the spot, and I would have also sent my people to destroy your Ba Clan today.
Anyway, you don't need to show me your meager arrogance, and I'll show you what real arrogance is."
After he said that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately took out four plaques.

One was the plaque from the Liu Clan that Liu Hua had given him when his clone was about to join the Yin-Yang Pavilion; one was a plaque from the Chu Clan given by Liu Qingyu after he married the Chu Sisters; one was a plaque from the Zhang Clan given by Zhang Lingxue after their first night; and the last was a plaque from the Shen Clan that he borrowed from Shen Yu just now.
When she saw the four plaques, Ye Lian immediately took out her Ye Clan plaque and gave it to Zhang Fei [1].
"You are my fiancé, and we're getting married soon, so you can keep it along with the four plaques."

Not only was Ba Yongshan shocked to see the five plaques in Zhang Fei's hands [1], but even Qin Zheng and the others were shocked looking at all five of them, especially since all of those plaques belonged to the five major powerful clans in three different regions.

Unlike them, Yi Na was only curious about the plaque belonging to the Shen Clan, especially since Zhang Fei [1] had never told her about his relationship with the clan, and she also knew that Shen Yu would marry Shen Tianhu soon. 'This guy is really insane!
He has gotten many women from the four clans, and he is also a member of the Shen Clan now.'
"See these five plaques?" Zhang Fei [1] asked as he showed the five to Ba Yongshan.
"Do you think your minor Ba Clan can match any of these five clans?
Oh!
You don't need to doubt their authenticity, especially since Liu Hua, Chu Ying, Chu Qing, and Zhang Lingxue are my wives.
Ye Lian and Shen Yu are my fiancées, and I will marry them both soon."
Zhang Fei [1]'s revelation of his relationship with the six women stunned Qin Zheng and the others, and they glanced at Ye Lian, who immediately confirmed it with a nod.

"Next time, think carefully before you go looking for trouble with others, lest your actions bring ruin to your Ba Clan." Zhang Fei [1] then stored the other four plaques in his inventory before giving the Zhang Clan plaque to the two gatekeepers.
"Brothers, I am indeed not one of their entourage, and I came here specifically to see Elder Gang Jinshu.
So please inform him of my arrival, and please tell him that I only wish to speak to him regarding the metal element, so I will not waste too much of his time."
"Yes... yes...
I will inform Elder Gang Jinshu right away." After the guard took the Zhang Clan plaque from Zhang Fei [1]'s hand, he immediately ran into his sect.

As they waited for the guard to return, Ye Lian chose to introduce Zhang Fei [1] to Qin Zheng and the four disciples, and he did not mind it, especially since he could see for himself that they were decent people.

As for Yi Na, she had always positioned herself as Zhang Fei [1]'s dual cultivation partner, and she herself was another man's wife, so she did not want to interact with them because she was afraid that they would realize her identity.
"Haha." Chao Qing suddenly laughed as he spoke to Zhang Fei [1].
"Brother, I don't know how you managed to win the hearts of your wives, but I really admire you for managing to get the women from those major clans.
Even Ye Lian seems to be willing to accept your relationship with them, even though she used to oppose Gu Zhan's relationship."
Luo Feng nodded in agreement with Chao Qing before speaking to Zhang Fei [1].
"Brother, Ye Lian is a good woman, and we have been good friends for a long time, so I hope you will continue to protect her and not hurt her feelings like Gu Zhan did to her in the past."
"That's for sure, brother.

Not only Lian'er, but I will also always protect all my wives, and I will kill anyone who dares to hurt them." Zhang Fei [1] replied to Long Feng as he glanced sharply at Ba Yongshan, who immediately rushed into the Desolate Sect out of fear and shame at the same time.
He then replied to Chao Qing.

"You're a real man, brother!" Chao Qing then stretched out his hand towards Zhang Fei [1].
"I'm glad to know you, and I hope we can have a good relationship in the future."
"Sure!" Zhang Fei [1] replied as he grabbed Chao Qing's hand.
"You guys are Lian'er's friends, so you guys are also my friends, and we might be able to go on adventures together to get to know each other.
Unfortunately, I still have a lot of problems on hand, so I have to clear them one by one to make the situation more under control."
Chao Qing nodded in understanding and separated their hands.
"If you have a lot of free time, you can visit us at the Heavenly Sword Sect, Brother."
"All right." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a nod of agreement.
Unlike the two male disciples, Jing Qiu and Qian He repeatedly stole glances at Zhang Fei [1], especially since his handsome face and strong charm captivated them.

Ye Lian observed the actions of the two female disciples and let out a soft sigh, muttering quietly in her heart. 'Although Fei did not use his demon charm on them, his natural charm is deadly to them, and they would surely submit completely to him if he used it on them.'
After they had waited for some time, the gatekeeper returned to them with a middle-aged man wearing a shabby blacksmith's clothes, and he immediately returned the Zhang Clan plaque to Zhang Fei [1].
The middle-aged man was none other than Gang Jinshu, and the heat from the fire during the forging process, combined with the remnants of the materials he used, had left his entire body black.

Could you please show me your element?"

Actually, it would be better if you brought your woman here so I can explain everything to her directly, and she'll definitely be able to understand it easier than through a third party."

Gang Jinshu swiftly departed to guide Zhang Fei [1] to his private quarters, while simultaneously ordering the two gatekeepers.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: Desert Nightshade Herbs
paragraphs: *Drap... Drap...*

Ba Yongshan was rushing towards an area in the Desolate Sect, which was an area reserved for special disciples of the sect, whose status was higher than that of core disciples, but two male disciples immediately stopped him as soon as he wanted to enter the area.
However, Ba Yongshan immediately took out his Ba Clan plaque and showed it to them. "I came here to see my elder sister, Ba Shuxiang, and my brother-in-law, Chi Zhongguo."
Upon hearing the two names and seeing the Ba Clan plaque in his hands, the two disciples immediately allowed Ba Yongshan to enter, prompting him to rush to the building at the very back.
In that place, Ba Yongshan saw a man in his early forties beating up some wooden dummies that he had deliberately arranged to be his training targets, and he was none other than Chi Zhongguo.

Chi Zhongguo had a tall and sturdy body, and all his muscles were clearly visible under his dark skin, especially since he lived in such a hot desert. Furthermore, his body was adorned with a variety of scars, including sword scars. "Oh? When did you get here? Did you come with your sect members? I heard from Aunt Zhiqiang that people from your sect came here to spar."

"I just arrived at this sect, so I came straight here to see you and my sister, brother-in-law." Ba Yongshan replied as he approached Chi Zhongguo. "Anyway, I did come with some of them, and you must be happy to hear this news, especially since Qin Zheng led us on our journey this time."

"Qin Zheng, huh?" Chi Zhongguo muttered softly as he rubbed one of the sword scars on his chest. "She was the first person to injure me, and she gave me this wound during our last spar, so I considered her my rival. However, her life turned upside down after she got married and gave birth, and she even had to take a leave from the sect to take care of her only daughter.
As a result, her cultivation has not progressed over the past few years, leaving me truly disappointed in her. She is no longer a worthy opponent for me, so I have no interest in meeting her again."

Ba Yongshan nodded in understanding. "Qin Zheng's cultivation is still stuck at the 10-Star Soul Realm, whereas yours has already reached the 3-Star Earth Realm, so she is not your opponent. Anyway, where is my sister? Why isn't she accompanying you?"

"Shuxiang is meeting Elder Li Xintong now, but she will be back soon." Chi Zhongguo then questioned Ba Yongshan, particularly after noticing his peculiar facial expression. "What's wrong with you? Is something bothering you?"

Ba Yongshan nodded and explained to Chi Zhongguo his desire to get Ye Lian. He also informed his brother-in-law about Zhang Fei [1], but he did not tell his brother-in-law about his relationship with the five clans, especially since he thought that his brother-in-law would not be willing to help him if he knew about their relationship.

"Ye Lian, huh?" Chi Zhongguo muttered as he nodded. "I met her once, when we came to the Heavenly Sword Sect, and she was indeed a beautiful and talented woman. Her sword skills were on par with Qin Zheng's, earning her the title of one of the best of her generation, so I'm not surprised if you have an interest in her.
However, I did not expect that her relationship with Gu Zhan would fail, especially since the two of them looked good together, and she even chose a younger man as his replacement."

"Are you willing to help me defeat Zhang Fei [1], brother-in-law?" Chi Zhongguo looked at Ba Yongshan with a frown. "I don't know how he trained, but his killing intent is truly terrifying, even though his cultivation is still far below mine. That's why I'm not confident that I can defeat him, so I need your help to do so, and I hope Ye Lian will reconsider her decision to choose such a weak man."

"All right, I'll help you, or Shuxiang will keep nagging at me." Chi Zhongguo immediately went back into his room and got dressed, but he came out again a short time later and led his brother-in-law away from the area.
However, they bumped into Ba Shuxiang, who immediately asked them. "When did you arrive, Yongshan? Where are you two going now? Why didn't you wait for me?"

Ba Shuxiang was not beautiful, but she was not ugly either, and she was slightly above average. She had shoulder-length brunette hair and a slightly tall figure, but her body was a little plump, and her C-Cup breasts also looked round. What was most intriguing about her were her unusual eyes, especially since both were reddish-light brown.

"I arrived not too long ago, Big Sis. Anyway, I asked my brother-in-law to help me with something, so we will go to the sect's training ground now." Hearing Ba Yonghsna's answer, Ba Shuxiang immediately glanced at Chi Zhongguo, who nodded at her. "Are you joining us, Big Sis?"

"I have nothing else to do right now, so I'll go with you guys." Ba Shuxiang then followed the two men. "Moreover, I heard that Qin Zheng is leading you guys this time, and I haven't seen her for a long time. Besides, I still haven't avenged my defeat to her, so I want to have a rematch with her today, and I will definitely defeat her this time."

"Haha." Ba Yongshan laughed upon hearing that. "Hey, Big Sis! Your cultivation is already at the 3-Star Earth Realm, like that of my brother-in-law, so you should be able to defeat Qin Zheng easily, and you might even force him to give up being a sword master."

"You underestimate Qin Zheng too much." Ba Shuxiang replied to her younger brother with a shake of her head. "In swordsmanship, cultivation does not determine the outcome of a fight, but our mastery of swordsmanship will determine victory or defeat. Despite my reluctance to acknowledge it, her proficiency in swordsmanship surpasses mine, a fact that led to my defeat a few years ago.
Anyway, why do you need help from my husband? Is there anyone who dares to oppose you in our sect?"
"No." Ba Yongshan shook his head at Ba Shuxiang. "I don't have any problems in our sect, but I have problems with someone from outside the sect, and he even insulted our Ba Clan as a weak clan."

"Hmm?" Ba Shuxiang turned to Ba Yongshan with a frown. "Who is that person? Our Ba Clan is indeed a minor clan and not as strong as the Chu Clan and the others, but our clan is one of the founders of the Heavenly Sword Sect, and Uncle Jiawen is no less powerful than Chu Hong or Ye Yuan, so our clan is not weak."

"His name is Zhang Fei [1], and I don't know where he came from, but Ye Lian chose him to be her new fiancé." Ba Shuxiang was surprised by that, especially since she hadn't been following the developments in the Heavenly Sword Sect after she married Chi Zhongguo, and Ba Yongshan told her something else. "In fact, Gu Zhan had disappeared for a very long time, and no one knew his whereabouts.
Even some elders had asked Xing Mei about his whereabouts, but she didn't tell them clearly."

"Huh?" Ba Shuxiang was even more surprised after hearing that. "Do you think Zhang Fei [1] was involved in Gu Zhan's disappearance? Otherwise, Ye Lian wouldn't possibly choose him as her new fiancé, right?"

"That might happen." Ba Yongshan replied with a nod. "Honestly, I had been courting Ye Lian for some time after Gu Zhan disappeared, but she kept rejecting me because she had already chosen Zhang Fei as her new fiancé, and I only found out about his identity today because we accidentally met him on the edge of the desert."

"Does that mean you are asking my husband to fight Zhang Fei [1] for you?" Ba Yongshan smiled bitterly before nodding to Ba Shuxiang. "Is he strong? Your cultivation is already at the 10-Star Soul Realm, and you will break through to the 1-Star Earth Realm soon, so you should be able to fight him on your own, right?"

Ba Yongshan sighed heavily at that. "Big Sis, I know you will laugh at me, but Zhang Fei [1]'s cultivation is only at the 2-Star Soul Realm. However, he seems to be a cold-blooded killer, especially since his killing intent is so terrifying, which is no less terrifying than yours or my brother-in-law's.
Moreover, I don't know for sure about his abilities, so I chose the safe route by asking for help from my brother-in-law."
*Smack*
"Ouch!" Ba Shuxiang suddenly smacked Ba Yongshan's head, causing him to scream loudly and rub his head. "Why did you do that, Big Sis?"

"Somehow, I feel that you are very cowardly." Bai Shuxiang replied with a shake of her head. "Your cultivation is much higher than Zhang Fei's [1], but you don't dare to face him alone; you even asked my husband for help before trying to fight him first.
Moreover, it would be a shame if my husband, with his cultivation at 3-Star Earth Realm, had to fight him with his cultivation still at 2-Star Soul Realm."

'Tch!' Ba Yongshan gritted his teeth at that. "What if Zhang Fei [1] is really a cold-blooded killer? People like that usually use underhanded methods to fight others, and if that happened, I would definitely die.
Moreover, I am your only brother, and you will be sad if you lose me, so I asked my brother-in-law to help teach him a lesson because he dared to snatch Ye Lian from me and also insulted our clan."
"If you are not my brother, I will beat you up for your cowardice now." With a flash of cruelty in her eyes, Ba Shuxiang spoke those words, causing Ba Yonghsan to shudder.

"All right, you don't have to scold Yongshan like that, Shuxiang." Chi Zhongguo finally spoke. "He is your little brother, and he is also my little brother. Moreover, I am also a member of the Ba Clan, so I will not allow others to insult our clan."

Ba Shuxiang sighed softly before nodding to her husband, especially since she herself was angry because Zhang Fei [1] belittled and insulted her clan. She didn't care about Ba Yongshan's feelings for Ye Lian, but she wouldn't allow others to insult her clan.

Since Shi Xi and Gang Jinshu were having a serious discussion about the metal element, Zhang Fei [1] decided to take Shi Wu and Yi Na to look around the area around the sect, where all the buildings were built using sand mixed with some special materials, making the sect more like a sand castle, but its size was truly massive, especially since there were no other buildings in the desert.

However, Zhang Fei [1]'s eyes also kept on paying attention to the red dot that was running with the other two green dots on his map, especially since Ye Lian had previously told him that Ba Yongshan's elder sister and brother-in-law were staying in the sect. 'Hah! That brat is such an idiot!
I already gave him a chance to live once, but he still seems to want to look for trouble with me, so I'll see what they have planned for me.'
"Fei!"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] immediately looked up at the sky and saw Zefyr flying down towards him before landing on his shoulder. "Did you find the item you were looking for?"

"No." Zefyr replied with a disappointed expression. "At first, I thought the aura I sensed was that of the sunfire lotus herb, so I rushed to look for it, especially since it is very useful for alchemy. Unfortunately, I sensed it wrongly, and I found the desert nightshade herbs there instead, which are highly poisonous."
"Huh?" Zhang Fei [1] immediately turned to Zefyr. "Did you take those herbs?"
"Yes." Zefyr immediately took out the herbs and handed them to Zhang Fei [1]. "Be careful! These herbs are very poisonous."
"Hahaha!" Instead, Zhang Fei [1] laughed as he accepted the herbs. "Zefyr, I already told you that I have poison immunity, so the poison from these herbs is nothing to me."

Zefyr nodded slightly while letting out a soft sigh. "I had forgotten about that, especially after witnessing so many of your unusual abilities. Anyway, what are you going to do with them? A few drops of these herbs' poison can even kill a heaven-rank beast, and a human would die if he or she were to be exposed to one or two drops."
"Isn't that amazing?" Zhang Fei [1] asked with a smirk. "I will face Shen Haoran soon, so these herbs' poison will be useful against him and his loyalists, and we can deal with them more easily."
"Since when did you get into a relationship with Shen Yu?" Yi Na abruptly questioned Zhang Fei [1].

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled and turned to Yi Na. "Actually, not only has Shen Yu agreed to become a member of my harem, but Shen Xueyi is also a member of my harem now. That's why I will help them get rid of Shen Haoran and his loyalists, so the situation in the Shen Clan will be more stable, and she can continue to lead the clan. Anyway, your husband should also be attending the wedding, right?"
"No." Yi Na shook her head at Zhang Fei [1]. "My husband has more important matters, so he asked me to come to the wedding myself."

"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will bring you back to the southern region in two days, and you can attend the wedding, but I will be the one marrying Shen Yu on that day.'
Yi Na replied with a nod of agreement. "All right, I myself can't possibly leave the Wei Clan for too long."
