"Ye Lian, huh?" Chi Zhongguo muttered as he nodded.
"I met her once, when we came to the Heavenly Sword Sect, and she was indeed a beautiful and talented woman.
Her sword skills were on par with Qin Zheng's, earning her the title of one of the best of her generation, so I'm not surprised if you have an interest in her.
However, I did not expect that her relationship with Gu Zhan would fail, especially since the two of them looked good together, and she even chose a younger man as his replacement."
"Are you willing to help me defeat Zhang Fei [1], brother-in-law?" Chi Zhongguo looked at Ba Yongshan with a frown.
"I don't know how he trained, but his killing intent is truly terrifying, even though his cultivation is still far below mine.
That's why I'm not confident that I can defeat him, so I need your help to do so, and I hope Ye Lian will reconsider her decision to choose such a weak man."

"All right, I'll help you, or Shuxiang will keep nagging at me." Chi Zhongguo immediately went back into his room and got dressed, but he came out again a short time later and led his brother-in-law away from the area.
However, they bumped into Ba Shuxiang, who immediately asked them.
"When did you arrive, Yongshan?
Where are you two going now?
Why didn't you wait for me?"
Ba Shuxiang was not beautiful, but she was not ugly either, and she was slightly above average.
She had shoulder-length brunette hair and a slightly tall figure, but her body was a little plump, and her C-Cup breasts also looked round.
What was most intriguing about her were her unusual eyes, especially since both were reddish-light brown.
"I arrived not too long ago, Big Sis.

Anyway, I asked my brother-in-law to help me with something, so we will go to the sect's training ground now." Hearing Ba Yonghsna's answer, Ba Shuxiang immediately glanced at Chi Zhongguo, who nodded at her.
"Are you joining us, Big Sis?"
"I have nothing else to do right now, so I'll go with you guys." Ba Shuxiang then followed the two men.
"Moreover, I heard that Qin Zheng is leading you guys this time, and I haven't seen her for a long time.
Besides, I still haven't avenged my defeat to her, so I want to have a rematch with her today, and I will definitely defeat her this time."
"Haha." Ba Yongshan laughed upon hearing that.
"Hey, Big Sis!
Your cultivation is already at the 3-Star Earth Realm, like that of my brother-in-law, so you should be able to defeat Qin Zheng easily, and you might even force him to give up being a sword master."
"You underestimate Qin Zheng too much." Ba Shuxiang replied to her younger brother with a shake of her head.
"In swordsmanship, cultivation does not determine the outcome of a fight, but our mastery of swordsmanship will determine victory or defeat.
Despite my reluctance to acknowledge it, her proficiency in swordsmanship surpasses mine, a fact that led to my defeat a few years ago.
Anyway, why do you need help from my husband?
Is there anyone who dares to oppose you in our sect?"
"No." Ba Yongshan shook his head at Ba Shuxiang.
"I don't have any problems in our sect, but I have problems with someone from outside the sect, and he even insulted our Ba Clan as a weak clan."
"Hmm?" Ba Shuxiang turned to Ba Yongshan with a frown.
"Who is that person?

Our Ba Clan is indeed a minor clan and not as strong as the Chu Clan and the others, but our clan is one of the founders of the Heavenly Sword Sect, and Uncle Jiawen is no less powerful than Chu Hong or Ye Yuan, so our clan is not weak."

"His name is Zhang Fei [1], and I don't know where he came from, but Ye Lian chose him to be her new fiancé." Ba Shuxiang was surprised by that, especially since she hadn't been following the developments in the Heavenly Sword Sect after she married Chi Zhongguo, and Ba Yongshan told her something else.
"In fact, Gu Zhan had disappeared for a very long time, and no one knew his whereabouts.
Even some elders had asked Xing Mei about his whereabouts, but she didn't tell them clearly."
"Huh?" Ba Shuxiang was even more surprised after hearing that.
"Do you think Zhang Fei [1] was involved in Gu Zhan's disappearance?
Otherwise, Ye Lian wouldn't possibly choose him as her new fiancé, right?"
"That might happen." Ba Yongshan replied with a nod.

"Honestly, I had been courting Ye Lian for some time after Gu Zhan disappeared, but she kept rejecting me because she had already chosen Zhang Fei as her new fiancé, and I only found out about his identity today because we accidentally met him on the edge of the desert."
"Does that mean you are asking my husband to fight Zhang Fei [1] for you?" Ba Yongshan smiled bitterly before nodding to Ba Shuxiang.
"Is he strong?
Your cultivation is already at the 10-Star Soul Realm, and you will break through to the 1-Star Earth Realm soon, so you should be able to fight him on your own, right?"
Ba Yongshan sighed heavily at that.
"Big Sis, I know you will laugh at me, but Zhang Fei [1]'s cultivation is only at the 2-Star Soul Realm.
However, he seems to be a cold-blooded killer, especially since his killing intent is so terrifying, which is no less terrifying than yours or my brother-in-law's.
Moreover, I don't know for sure about his abilities, so I chose the safe route by asking for help from my brother-in-law."
*Smack*
"Ouch!" Ba Shuxiang suddenly smacked Ba Yongshan's head, causing him to scream loudly and rub his head.
"Why did you do that, Big Sis?"
"Somehow, I feel that you are very cowardly." Bai Shuxiang replied with a shake of her head.
"Your cultivation is much higher than Zhang Fei's [1], but you don't dare to face him alone; you even asked my husband for help before trying to fight him first.
Moreover, it would be a shame if my husband, with his cultivation at 3-Star Earth Realm, had to fight him with his cultivation still at 2-Star Soul Realm."
'Tch!' Ba Yongshan gritted his teeth at that.
"What if Zhang Fei [1] is really a cold-blooded killer?
People like that usually use underhanded methods to fight others, and if that happened, I would definitely die.
Moreover, I am your only brother, and you will be sad if you lose me, so I asked my brother-in-law to help teach him a lesson because he dared to snatch Ye Lian from me and also insulted our clan."
"If you are not my brother, I will beat you up for your cowardice now." With a flash of cruelty in her eyes, Ba Shuxiang spoke those words, causing Ba Yonghsan to shudder.
"All right, you don't have to scold Yongshan like that, Shuxiang." Chi Zhongguo finally spoke.
"He is your little brother, and he is also my little brother.
Moreover, I am also a member of the Ba Clan, so I will not allow others to insult our clan."
Ba Shuxiang sighed softly before nodding to her husband, especially since she herself was angry because Zhang Fei [1] belittled and insulted her clan.
She didn't care about Ba Yongshan's feelings for Ye Lian, but she wouldn't allow others to insult her clan.

Since Shi Xi and Gang Jinshu were having a serious discussion about the metal element, Zhang Fei [1] decided to take Shi Wu and Yi Na to look around the area around the sect, where all the buildings were built using sand mixed with some special materials, making the sect more like a sand castle, but its size was truly massive, especially since there were no other buildings in the desert.

However, Zhang Fei [1]'s eyes also kept on paying attention to the red dot that was running with the other two green dots on his map, especially since Ye Lian had previously told him that Ba Yongshan's elder sister and brother-in-law were staying in the sect. 'Hah!
That brat is such an idiot!
I already gave him a chance to live once, but he still seems to want to look for trouble with me, so I'll see what they have planned for me.'
"Fei!"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] immediately looked up at the sky and saw Zefyr flying down towards him before landing on his shoulder.
"Did you find the item you were looking for?"
"No." Zefyr replied with a disappointed expression.
"At first, I thought the aura I sensed was that of the sunfire lotus herb, so I rushed to look for it, especially since it is very useful for alchemy.
Unfortunately, I sensed it wrongly, and I found the desert nightshade herbs there instead, which are highly poisonous."
"Huh?" Zhang Fei [1] immediately turned to Zefyr.
"Did you take those herbs?"
"Yes." Zefyr immediately took out the herbs and handed them to Zhang Fei [1].
"Be careful!
These herbs are very poisonous."
"Hahaha!" Instead, Zhang Fei [1] laughed as he accepted the herbs.
"Zefyr, I already told you that I have poison immunity, so the poison from these herbs is nothing to me."
Zefyr nodded slightly while letting out a soft sigh.
"I had forgotten about that, especially after witnessing so many of your unusual abilities.
Anyway, what are you going to do with them?
A few drops of these herbs' poison can even kill a heaven-rank beast, and a human would die if he or she were to be exposed to one or two drops."
"Isn't that amazing?" Zhang Fei [1] asked with a smirk.
"I will face Shen Haoran soon, so these herbs' poison will be useful against him and his loyalists, and we can deal with them more easily."
"Since when did you get into a relationship with Shen Yu?" Yi Na abruptly questioned Zhang Fei [1].
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled and turned to Yi Na.
"Actually, not only has Shen Yu agreed to become a member of my harem, but Shen Xueyi is also a member of my harem now.
That's why I will help them get rid of Shen Haoran and his loyalists, so the situation in the Shen Clan will be more stable, and she can continue to lead the clan.
Anyway, your husband should also be attending the wedding, right?"
"No." Yi Na shook her head at Zhang Fei [1].
"My husband has more important matters, so he asked me to come to the wedding myself."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding.
"In that case, I will bring you back to the southern region in two days, and you can attend the wedding, but I will be the one marrying Shen Yu on that day.'
Yi Na replied with a nod of agreement.
"All right, I myself can't possibly leave the Wei Clan for too long."

chapters.title: Chapter 309: Act Against Ba Yongshan
paragraphs: When they arrived at the training ground, the people from the Heavenly Sword Sect were already there, and Chi Zhongguo's gaze fell on Qin Zheng, who was chatting with his aunt, Chi Zhiqiang.

However, Chi Zhongguo immediately averted his gaze, especially since he had already considered that Qin Zheng was no longer his rival due to their difference in cultivation. Instead, he turned his gaze towards Ye Lian, who was engaging in conversation with her sect members. "Which one is that man named Zhang Fei [1]?"
"None of them." Ba Yongshan responded by shaking his head. "Zhang Fei [1] came here to meet Gang Jinshu, and he is probably still in his private quarters now."

"Oh?" Ba Shuxiang was slightly surprised to hear Gang Jinshu permit a young disciple to see him. "Is there something you haven't told us about Zhang Fei [1]? Elder Jinshu was a busy and strict person, and he would not be willing to meet such a young disciple if he did not have a special status."

'Tch!' Ba Yongshan gritted his teeth a bit before telling Ba Shuxiang. "In fact, Zhang Fei [1] is not only Ye Lian's fiancé, but he is also the husband of Chu Ying and Chu Qing, and he used his status as the son-in-law of the Chu Clan to meet Gang Jinshu."

Ba Yonghsan's answer further surprised Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo. "Just like Ye Lian, Chu Ying is often considered one of the best in her generation, but Chu Hong does not allow her to join any sect, especially since her character was too soft, and he was afraid that she would not be able to adapt to life in the sect.
That's why I didn't expect that she would become one of Zhang Fei [1]'s wives, let alone that her youngest sister would also become his wife."

"I personally just heard about their relationship today, Big Sis." Ba Yongshan replied with a soft sigh. "I myself hardly ever go to town, let alone follow news about the other clans, especially since our uncle keeps forcing me to focus on my sword training."
Ba Shuxiang nodded in understanding before leaving the two men, and she immediately approached Qin Zheng while greeting him. "Long time no see, Zheng."
Qin Zheng immediately turned to Ba Shuxiang. "Yeah, it's been a while since we last met, Shuxiang."
Wasting no time, Ba Shuxiang directly issued a challenge to Qin Zheng. Since you returned to our sect and came all the way here, how about we spar today?"
"All right." Qin Zheng accepted Ba Shuxiang's challenge without hesitation. "However, I didn't practice for a long time, so you might be disappointed with my current abilities."

"Haha." Ba Shuxiang laughed when she heard that. "You don't have to be so modest with me, you know? Although you haven't practiced for a long time, you are one of the best swordsmen in our sect. Even my uncle always compares my abilities to yours, so I believe that your swordsmanship skills are not rusty yet."
Qin Zheng responded to Ba Shuxiang's words with a smile, and she then asked Chi Zhiqiang. "Where are your disciples, Elder Zhiqiang?"

"I have contacted them, and they will arrive soon." Just as Chi Zhiqiang was saying this, they noticed three male disciples and three female disciples entering the training ground, and all six of them immediately walked to them. "What do you think if Chi Yufeng spars with Ba Yongshan? Meanwhile, Hao Tian will fight Luo Feng, and Jiang Yifan will fight Chao Qing."

"Hmm?" Qin Zheng studied the three male disciples for a moment before nodding in agreement with Chi Zhiqiang. "All right, we'll arrange it that way, especially since their strengths are equal to each other."

"That's right." Chi Zhiqiang nodded in agreement with her, and she then turned towards the three female disciples from the Heavenly Sword Sect. "I think Tang Tang can spar with Ye Lian, Shangguan Yan will face Jing Qiu, and Gu Yuhe will face Qian He."
Qin Zheng immediately nodded in agreement with Chi Zhiqiang's arrangement. "Let's do it, and we can start with our male disciples first."
"You can go there and use your full strength to fight Ba Yongshan." Chi Zhiqiang immediately said this to Chi Yufeng.

"Yes, Aunt Zhiqiang." Chi Yufeng took out his iron staff as he walked into the arena, followed by Ba Yongshan, who was already holding his sword. He then pointed his staff at him as he spoke. "Hey! Our last spar ended in a draw, but I'll beat you this time."

"Haha." Ba Yongshan chuckled and drew his sword. "Back then, you were lucky because I hadn't fully mastered my sword technique, but I've managed to master it now. Moreover, my big sister watched our fight, and she will lecture me badly if I lose to you, so I will use my technique right from the start, and you will have no chance of defeating me."

"Humph!" Chi Yufeng snorted as he slammed the tip of his iron staff onto the ground, causing the other disciples to cheer for him as they saw dozens of earth pillars appear around him. "After our last spar, I have also polished my abilities, including my defense, and made it impenetrable, so your attacks won't be able to reach me."

"Is that so?" Ba Yongshan asked with a slight smirk on his face, and he immediately held his sword with both hands in front of his chest, the sharp blade facing Chi Yufeng. "Your defense is indeed far superior to our last spar, but my sword technique is much better, and I will destroy your defense in one strike."
*Boo... Boo...*
The disciples of the Desolate Sect shouted insults at Ba Yongshan after hearing his arrogant words.
"Haha." Chi Yufeng laughed upon hearing that. "In that case, we will determine the winner between us with one strike. If your attack can break my defense, then I will admit defeat, but vice versa."
"All right." Ba Yongshan nodded in agreement, then activated his technique. "Sword Domain: Sword Burial!"
Instantly, a transparent Qi dome enveloped the entire battle arena, and dozens of swords made of Ba Yongshan's sword energy appeared above them.

Seeing that, Chi Yufeng immediately looked up to the sky and got ready, and he also activated his other technique, causing his body to be quickly covered by earth armor up to his head. 'His sword domain is stronger than before! I'm confident in my defense, and his attacks won't penetrate it.
"Are you ready?" Ba Yongshan inquired as he flipped his sword with the blade's tip facing the ground. "Be careful, or my attack will seriously injure you."
"Heh!" Chi Yufeng snorted at Ba Yongshan. "Attack me! I will break your attacks!"

"Haha." Ba Yongshan chuckled before stabbing his sword into the ground, and the dozens of sword energies immediately swooped towards Chi Yufeng. However, he raised his eyebrows as soon as he saw the faint smile on his sparring opponent's face. 'Can he really break my attacks?'
*Bam*
When he thought about it, Chi Yufeng stomped his right foot on the ground, and all the earth pillars immediately extended into the sky before clashing with Ba Yongshan's dozens of sword energies.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
*Crack... Crack...*

Their clash of attacks produced a powerful wind wave that instantly swept across the entire area, but all the disciples could see that Ba Yongshan's dozens of swords and Chi Yufeng's earth pillars began to crack rapidly, indicating that their strengths were evenly matched.
'Tch!' The two men gritted their teeth after they saw the cracks in their attacks and defenses, and they immediately used their qi to strengthen them.

However, Chi Yufeng's defense was clearly superior, especially since those pillars automatically repaired themselves and became whole again, unlike Ba Yongshan's sword energies, which kept cracking, and the transparent dome above them also cracked.

'Damn it!' Ba Yongshan cursed in his heart after seeing that. 'I forgot that the earth element in this desert is extremely strong, and it enhanced his abilities! If I don't do something to destroy those earth pillars, I will definitely lose to him!'
Since he couldn't afford to lose, Ba Yongshan intended to use an underhanded method to defeat his opponent, but he and the people present did not realize that there was another person in the arena.

Zhang Fei [1], who had already arrived at the training ground earlier, stood invisible behind Ba Yongshan. 'Heh! I warned you not to trouble me anymore, but you asked your elder sister and brother-in-law to help you fight me. I won't kill you right away; I'll make you suffer until eventually you die.'

When Zhang Fei [1] touched his back, Ba Yongshan was startled, and he looked back without being able to find anyone. That's why he immediately returned his gaze to Chi Yufeng with a puzzled look, but he suddenly felt some parts of his body harden. 'What the hell! What happened to my body?'
*Gasp*
Everyone in the arena gasped in shock as soon as they saw the sudden change in Ba Yongshan's body, including Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo, especially since his body started to turn to stone.
"Help me!" Ba Yongshan immediately shouted for help, realizing his situation. "Elder sister! Brother-in-law! Aunt Zhiqiang! Please help me!"

"Yongshan!" Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo shouted as they moved into the arena, as did Chi Zhiqiang, and all three tried to channel their Qi into Bai Yongshan's body to prevent him from turning into stone. Unfortunately, their efforts were in vain, and almost his entire body quickly turned to stone except for his head.

In addition to using his petrification ability on Ba Yongshan, Zhang Fei [1] also injected something into his body, causing his qi to become chaotic, and his technique immediately disappeared by itself.
*Splurt*
Instantly, Ba Yongshan's blood sprayed onto Ba Shuxiang's face, who was standing in front of him, shocking the three of them, but he immediately lost consciousness after that.
"Yongshan!" Ba Shuxiang shouted in panic at the condition of her little brother before turning to her husband.

Chi Zhongguo nodded to his wife and immediately lifted Ba Yongshan using his aura, carrying him on his shoulders before swiftly escorting him away from the training ground. Ba Shuxiang herself immediately followed her husband, especially since she was so worried about her little brother's condition.

"We will have to postpone the sparring practice between our disciples, and I will have someone prepare some guest rooms for all of you." After receiving a nod from Qin Zheng, Chi Zhiqiang swiftly departed from the training ground and trailed behind the three, leaving the people in attendance perplexed by the strange incident involving Ba Yongshan.

Chi Yufeng, who was his opponent, looked upset and disappointed by it, especially since he had almost succeeded in defeating Ba Yongshan, and the incident snatched away the victory that was already before his eyes. 'Sigh! Forget it! I will defeat him another time.'
Since Chi Zhiqiang decided to postpone their sparring, the disciples of the Desolate Sect immediately dispersed, and someone led the disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect to the guest area.
However, Ye Lian continued to smile to herself, especially since she realized that it was Zhang Fei [1] who did all that to Ba Yongshan. Her attitude did not escape Qin Zheng's observation.
Even so, Qin Zheng did not immediately ask Ye Lian the truth, and she chose to wait until they were in a quiet place.

Zhang Fei [1] himself immediately left the training ground and joined the three women who were waiting for him in another area before continuing their tour of the sect, especially since there were still many areas they had not visited, and the one that interested them the most was the desert oasis located a little bit further behind the sect.
Upon their arrival at the guest residence, Qin Zheng immediately asked Ye Lian to accompany her to the room. "Was Zhang Fei [1] the one who did all that to Ba Yongshan?"
"Haha." Ye Lian laughed softly and nodded to Qin Zheng. "Sister Zheng, you yourself could have heard Ba Yongshan's conversation with his elder sister and brother-in-law earlier, right?"
"Well, that's true." Qin Zheng nodded in agreement with Ye Lian.
"Fei had already let Ba Yongshan go once, but he intended to do something to him with their help instead.

Moreover, he is not a forgiving person, so you should not be surprised if he does such things to him, and he is still lucky that he did not kill him outright." Qin Zheng let out a heavy sigh after hearing that, but she was surprised by Ye Lian, who gave her several pills, and all of them were of high quality.

"Hehe, he asked me to give them to you, and they will be useful for you and your family, especially these healing pills. After she swallows them, Qianzhi will not get sick easily anymore, and she can live comfortably like a little girl her age, so you don't have to keep worrying about her."

Naturally, Qin Zheng really wanted her daughter to live comfortably and healthily, but she was confused about the reason Zhang Fei [1] gave her such precious pills, especially since they did not know each other. "Why does he want to help us?"

Ye Lian smiled and hugged Qin Zheng's arm. "Sister Zheng, you may not know it yet, but your sister-in-law, Zhu Yan, helped him manage his restaurant, which is already successful. This is the reason he gave these pills to you, particularly since you are her family."

'Damn it!' Ba Yongshan cursed in his heart after seeing that. 'I forgot that the earth element in this desert is extremely strong, and it enhanced his abilities!
If I don't do something to destroy those earth pillars, I will definitely lose to him!'
Since he couldn't afford to lose, Ba Yongshan intended to use an underhanded method to defeat his opponent, but he and the people present did not realize that there was another person in the arena.
Zhang Fei [1], who had already arrived at the training ground earlier, stood invisible behind Ba Yongshan. 'Heh!
I warned you not to trouble me anymore, but you asked your elder sister and brother-in-law to help you fight me.
I won't kill you right away; I'll make you suffer until eventually you die.'
When Zhang Fei [1] touched his back, Ba Yongshan was startled, and he looked back without being able to find anyone.
That's why he immediately returned his gaze to Chi Yufeng with a puzzled look, but he suddenly felt some parts of his body harden. 'What the hell!
What happened to my body?'
*Gasp*
Everyone in the arena gasped in shock as soon as they saw the sudden change in Ba Yongshan's body, including Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo, especially since his body started to turn to stone.
"Help me!" Ba Yongshan immediately shouted for help, realizing his situation.
"Elder sister!
Brother-in-law!
Aunt Zhiqiang!
Please help me!"

"Yongshan!" Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo shouted as they moved into the arena, as did Chi Zhiqiang, and all three tried to channel their Qi into Bai Yongshan's body to prevent him from turning into stone.
Unfortunately, their efforts were in vain, and almost his entire body quickly turned to stone except for his head.

In addition to using his petrification ability on Ba Yongshan, Zhang Fei [1] also injected something into his body, causing his qi to become chaotic, and his technique immediately disappeared by itself.
*Splurt*
Instantly, Ba Yongshan's blood sprayed onto Ba Shuxiang's face, who was standing in front of him, shocking the three of them, but he immediately lost consciousness after that.
"Yongshan!" Ba Shuxiang shouted in panic at the condition of her little brother before turning to her husband.
Chi Zhongguo nodded to his wife and immediately lifted Ba Yongshan using his aura, carrying him on his shoulders before swiftly escorting him away from the training ground.
Ba Shuxiang herself immediately followed her husband, especially since she was so worried about her little brother's condition.

"We will have to postpone the sparring practice between our disciples, and I will have someone prepare some guest rooms for all of you." After receiving a nod from Qin Zheng, Chi Zhiqiang swiftly departed from the training ground and trailed behind the three, leaving the people in attendance perplexed by the strange incident involving Ba Yongshan.

Chi Yufeng, who was his opponent, looked upset and disappointed by it, especially since he had almost succeeded in defeating Ba Yongshan, and the incident snatched away the victory that was already before his eyes. 'Sigh!
Forget it!
I will defeat him another time.'
Since Chi Zhiqiang decided to postpone their sparring, the disciples of the Desolate Sect immediately dispersed, and someone led the disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect to the guest area.
However, Ye Lian continued to smile to herself, especially since she realized that it was Zhang Fei [1] who did all that to Ba Yongshan.
Her attitude did not escape Qin Zheng's observation.
Even so, Qin Zheng did not immediately ask Ye Lian the truth, and she chose to wait until they were in a quiet place.

Zhang Fei [1] himself immediately left the training ground and joined the three women who were waiting for him in another area before continuing their tour of the sect, especially since there were still many areas they had not visited, and the one that interested them the most was the desert oasis located a little bit further behind the sect.
Upon their arrival at the guest residence, Qin Zheng immediately asked Ye Lian to accompany her to the room.
"Was Zhang Fei [1] the one who did all that to Ba Yongshan?"
"Haha." Ye Lian laughed softly and nodded to Qin Zheng.
"Sister Zheng, you yourself could have heard Ba Yongshan's conversation with his elder sister and brother-in-law earlier, right?"
"Well, that's true." Qin Zheng nodded in agreement with Ye Lian.
"Fei had already let Ba Yongshan go once, but he intended to do something to him with their help instead.

Moreover, he is not a forgiving person, so you should not be surprised if he does such things to him, and he is still lucky that he did not kill him outright." Qin Zheng let out a heavy sigh after hearing that, but she was surprised by Ye Lian, who gave her several pills, and all of them were of high quality.
"Hehe, he asked me to give them to you, and they will be useful for you and your family, especially these healing pills.
After she swallows them, Qianzhi will not get sick easily anymore, and she can live comfortably like a little girl her age, so you don't have to keep worrying about her."

Naturally, Qin Zheng really wanted her daughter to live comfortably and healthily, but she was confused about the reason Zhang Fei [1] gave her such precious pills, especially since they did not know each other.
"Why does he want to help us?"
Ye Lian smiled and hugged Qin Zheng's arm.
"Sister Zheng, you may not know it yet, but your sister-in-law, Zhu Yan, helped him manage his restaurant, which is already successful.
This is the reason he gave these pills to you, particularly since you are her family."

chapters.title: Chapter 310: Commotion In Desolate Sect
paragraphs: After she explained the effects of each pill, Ye Lian spoke directly to Qin Zheng. "All right, you don't need to think about anything anymore; start swallowing these pills, and I will join the others, Sister Zheng."

After Ye Lian left, Qin Zheng immediately sat cross-legged on the bed, gazing at the five pills in her hand. She then placed the remaining pills in her storage ring while pondering. "Who exactly is Zhang Fei [1]? Where did he come from?

Despite his youth, his cultivation has already advanced to the soul realm, and his unique abilities have enabled him to perform actions on Ba Yongshan without anyone noticing, including the vice sect master and the elders of this sect. Furthermore, he has connections with the five powerful clans, a feat no one else has ever accomplished before.
If I'm not mistaken, Zhang Lingxue is an elder of the Blazing Phoenix Sect who is also an alchemist, and he probably got these pills from her."
Qin Zheng let out a soft sigh before closing his eyes, and he began to swallow the pills one by one in their order, starting with the Essence Qi Pill.
"Do you know what happened to Yongshan, Lian?" Jing Qiu asked Ye Lian as soon as she entered their room.
"Why do you think I know something about that, Qiu?" Ye Lian returned the question as she sat down between her two sect sisters.
Jing Qiu shook her head at Ye Lian. "It's just my hunch that your fiancé did that to Yongshan, especially after the previous altercation between them."
Qian He also tried to persuade Ye Lian to tell them. "Come on, Lian! Tell us the truth: Was it really your fiancé who did that to Yongshan?"

"Haha." Ye Lian laughed softly, then put her arms around their shoulders. "Fei's character isn't that petty, okay? He could do something to Yongshan, but he wouldn't do anything just for a little fuss, like before. However, the situation becomes different if that idiot is unable to accept his own mistakes and invites others to harm him, and he will kill him if he does such a thing."

"Does that mean Zhang Fei [1] really did that to Yongshan?" Both women inquired simultaneously. "Earlier, we saw him with Senior Shuxiang and Senior Zhongguo, and they appeared to be looking for him."

Ye Lian nodded to Jing Qiu and Qian He. "Yongshan must have complained to Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo, but he definitely didn't tell them the real matter, especially since he had always been like that and would do anything to achieve his goals, including using other people. Moreover, we all know that his elder sister always pampers him, and she will definitely help him no matter the reason.
As for her husband, he is too timid to defy her; he will do anything to please her."

Jing Qiu and Qian He nodded in agreement, especially since they were both familiar with Ba Shuxiang's character, and she would do anything to protect her little brother. As for Chi Zhongguo, they were not familiar with him, but they had seen his behavior many times when he approached his wife in the past.

"Do you think your fiancé will do something to them?" Jing Qiu asked Ye Lian with a serious look. "After all, Chi Zhongguo is the second son of Sect Master Chi Yang, so his status is quite high in this sect. Besides, Sect Master Jiawen is always protective of his clan members, so if that happened, the people from the two sects would become Zhang Fei [1]'s enemies."

"The Chi clan is indeed powerful, especially since they are one of the major clans in the eastern region, but the Ba clan is too weak." Both women agreed with Ye Lian's evaluation of the two clans. "Fei even dared to go against the Shen Haoran just to snatch Shen Yu from Shen Tianhu, and he will ruin their wedding ceremony in two days.
Moreover, they still have to face my Ye Clan along with the Shen, Liu, Chu, and Zhang Clans if they choose to be his enemies, so they will be the ones who lose if they take such a decision."

Both women smiled wryly after Ye Lian mentioned Zhang Fei [1]'s relationship with the five clans, but Qian He then asked her again. "Anyway, what made you willing to accept Zhang Fei [1]? You hate Gu Zhan because he cheated on you repeatedly, but you chose a man with many wives as his replacement."

Naturally, Ye Lian felt embarrassed to tell them about her initial encounter with Zhang Fei, especially since she immediately fell for his charm upon meeting him for the first time, and they even did intimate things right away. "Actually, I first heard about him from my brother, and he beat Ye Hang badly after he challenged him to a fight for Chu Ying."

"Oh!" Qian Ye nodded repeatedly after hearing that. "I remember that! Ye Hang and Zhao Yun are infatuated with Chu Ying, and they repeatedly came to the Chu Clan to court her, but she never had any interest in them."

"That's right." Ye Lian nodded in reply. "After my little brother told me about Fei, I immediately went to see Chu Ying to confirm their relationship, which led to my first encounter with him. Even though we had just met for the first time, he approached me directly, which confused me, as I was still Gu Zhan's fiancée at the time.
Furthermore, he already had many women, which made it difficult for me to accept him.
"Ha a." Jing Qiu laughed and grabbed Ye Lian's hand. "At least, Zhang Fei [1] is honest in revealing his polygamous relationship, and he is not like Gu Zhan, who cheated on you repeatedly."

"Yes." Ye Lian gave Jing Qiu a nod of agreement. "Actually, Fei's honesty about his relationship is what attracted me to him, but I didn't accept him right away, and I chose to spend some time with him first. Once I was certain about him, I brought my mother to break up my engagement with Gu Zhan, and I also took him to see her before we left for our practice."
"Did Zhang Fei [1]'s other wives accept and treat you well?" Qian Ye curiously asked Ye Lian.
Ye Lian smiled upon hearing that. "Do you think I'll accept Fei if they don't accept me? Furthermore, he treats us all equally and fairly, so we all get along well and spend a lot of time together."

"Sigh." Jing Qiu sighed heavily and laid down on the bed. "I would be happy if I could find an honest man like your fiancé, but I still won't accept it if my future husband has many wives, and I want him to only love me."
"Me too!" Qian He said this while lying on the bed. "No matter how fair and honest a man is, I am sure that he will still have favoritism, so I also do not want to have a husband who has many wives."
"Haha." Ye Lian chuckled before lying down in the middle of them before hugging them. "You two are my best friends, so I will always pray that you guys will find a good man to be your husband."

Jing Qiu and Qian He laughed happily after hearing that, and they then talked about other things, especially about their next plans after completing their sparring practice with the disciples of the Desolate Sect. .
Meanwhile, an elderly woman in her early seventies gazed intently at Ba Yongshan's petrified state, while several others stood behind her, observing him with a mixture of confusion and astonishment.
Chi Zhiqiang then asked the old woman. "Aunt Lian Xiang, what do you think caused his body to turn to stone like this?"

Lian Xiang did not answer Chi Zhiqiang's question directly, and she first touched Ba Yongshan's head before flowing her qi into his body, especially since only his head did not turn to stone. However, after checking his internal body condition, her expression changed immediately, and she promptly informed them.
"This brat's condition is really bad, especially since his internal organs are also starting to petrify gradually, and he will eventually die if everything petrifies."
"What?" Ba Shuxiang screamed in shock and moved to Lian Xiang's side. "Vice Sect Master, can't you do something to reverse my little brother's condition?"

"I've tried using my earth element to reverse this brat's condition, but it didn't work." Lian Xiang replied with a disappointed expression. "Throughout my life, I've studied and tried many things about the earth element, but I've never found anything like this before. Moreover, I feel that his body became like this not because of a cultivation technique but because of a curse."

"A curse?" Before Chi Zhiqiang posed the question, everyone turned to Lian Xiang. "Does that mean someone from the Pang Clan did this to Yongshan, Aunt? As far as I can remember, there were people from that clan who had this kind of ability, but they haven't been seen anywhere for a long time."

"You know that's impossible, right? The people from the Pang Clan do have such an ability to do this, but they would never be able to sneak into our sect, so I am absolutely certain that the perpetrator is someone else." Lian Xiang then turned into Ba Shuxiang. "Did your little brother have problems with other people?
For now, we have no choice but to look for those people, and they are our hope in saving him."

Upon hearing that, Chi Zhongguo promptly informed Lian Xiang. "Grandma, Yongshan had previously met a man named Zhang Fei [1] when he arrived in our sect, and my brother-in-law asked me to help teach him a lesson because he insulted the Ba Clan as a weak clan.
Furthermore, my brother-in-law informed me that, despite his cultivation at the 2-Star Soul Realm, he had a terrifying intent to kill, leading us to suspect him of being a cold-blooded killer."
Chi Zhongguo's information actually made Lian Xiang and the others look at him with frowns, and their expressions became very serious, confusing him and Ba Shuxiang.
"Are you two sure that the man's name is really Zhang Fei [1]?" An old man with a serious look asked Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang.

They nodded to the old man, and Chi Zhongguo told them something else. "Anyway, my brother-in-law also told me that Zhang Fei [1] came to our clan specifically to meet Elder Gang Jinshu, and he should still be in his private quarters now."

Wasting no time, Lian Xiang immediately contacted Gang Jinshu and asked him to come meet them, and she also asked him to bring Zhang Fei [1] along, especially since time was ticking or Ba Yongshan would die if all his internal organs turned to stone.

Although Gang Jinshu didn't want to see them, he couldn't refuse Lian Xiang's orders, so he hurried to meet them. In just a few minutes, he had arrived at the room, but he didn't bring Zhang Fei [1] with him, and he brought Shi Xi instead. "What happened, old Lian? Why did you call me in such a hurry? Moreover, why did you ask me to bring that kid? Did he cause trouble in our sect?"
"Is Zhang Fei [1] a member of the Zhang Clan?" Lian Xiang was immediately asked him to confirm their guess.

"That's right." Their expressions became even more serious after Gang Jinshu confirmed their guess about Zhang Fei [1]. "That kid isn't a direct member of that clan, but Zhang Lingxue is one of his wives, and I've confirmed this matter with her directly. In addition, he is a member of the Chu, Ye, and Liu Clans."
"Are you kidding us? How could he possibly be a member of all four clans at the same time?" Another old man inquired with a slight shriek.

"That kid brought this girl to me because she had the metal element, and he wanted her to learn from me about it." They immediately turned to Shi Xi, which frightened her, prompting her to quickly hide behind Gang Jinshu. "She confirmed for me that Liu Hua, Chu Qing, and Chu Ying are his wives. Ye Lian is his fiancee, so he is really a member of their clans, right?
Furthermore, he presented another clan plaque to our gatekeepers, belonging to the Shen Clan, and he himself was a disciple of the Yin-Yang Pavilion."

Gang Jinshu's revelation of Zhang Fei's relationship [1] shocked them all, including Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang, especially since Ba Yongshan did not tell them the truth. "Anyway, you guys haven't answered my previous questions; what really happened? Did he cause trouble in our sect?"
"You can see for yourself, Old Gang." Lian Xiang replied as she pointed at Ba Yongshan.

"Eh?" Gang Jinshu gasped for a moment before moving in front of Ba Yongshan and examining his condition. "Do you guys think that kid did this to him? If you really think that, then you can forget about it, especially since he doesn't have the earth element, so there's no way he could do such a thing to him."

However, Chi Zhongguo immediately spoke to Gang Jinshu. "Elder Jinshu, regardless of whether Zhang Fei [1] did this to my brother-in-law or not, we must find him right now, especially since he was the last one to have a dispute with him, and we can interrogate him to ascertain the truth."

chapters.title: Chapter 311: Facing The Sect Members
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [1], who was enjoying his time with the three women in the desert oasis, immediately asked Mei to open the portal to the training space, especially after he noticed numerous dots moving towards them. As soon as Zhang Fei [1] approached her, particularly with the evil smile on his face, Ba Shuxiang panicked. "Stop! Don't come near me!"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed as he ignored Ba Shuxiang's screams before standing in front of her, and he grabbed her cheeks as he asked. "Didn't you say that you wanted to torture me before killing me? Honestly, I don't like to find trouble with others, but I seem to be a magnet for trouble, and troubles keeps coming to me.
Since you planned such things for me, I must take action against you, right?"
"You-Mhmm!" Ba Shuxiang wanted to curse at him, but Zhang Fei [1] immediately gagged her mouth with a cloth.
"Unfortunately, you and your husband are no less stupid than Ba Yongshan, and you two even asked Pang Liyuan to control me.

Since both of you chose to be my enemies, and I am not a forgiving person either, you guys have to bear the consequences of your schemes against me." After that, Zhang Fei [1] enslaved and manipulated Ba Shuxiang's memories, but he did not manipulate all of them, and he only manipulated her memories of their relationship with Pang Liyuan. "We only have to wait for your husband and little brother."

sentences.text: When Zhang Fei [1] arrived at his room, he immediately sent the sleeping Yi Na into the training space before lying down on the bed.
However, his eyes remained fixed on the person spying on him through his map. 'Show his status, Mei.'
[Yes.]
[Status]
Name: Pang Liyuan
Age: 40
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation: 2-Star Earth Realm
Element: Darkness [Intermediate-Stage]
Core: Lower-Rank Darkness Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique:-
Special Bloodline:-
Partner: Xie Jingxian
Parents: Pang De, Mo Xuanqing
Likes: Pang De, Mo Xuanqing
Dislikes: All righteous cultivators
'Hmm?' Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows in surprise, as he did not expect that person to be a member of the Pang Clan, and he was also Pang De's son. 'Hahaha!
What a fortunate coincidence!
Since he is that guy's son, I must capture him.
Hmm?
I don't have any information about the Mo and Xie Clans, but I think they must be the other two major clans in the northern region, or they might just be subordinates of the Pang Clan.
Tch!
Why should I bother thinking about that?
That guy is also a member of both clans, so I just need to capture him to get information about them.'
Since he couldn't possibly face Pang Liyuan and the other two by himself, Zhang Fei [1] decided to contact Zhang Lingxue and ask her to go to the location where he saved the Blazing Moon Sect.
After she arrived at the location, he immediately used the warp portal to pick her up, but he first hid her in the training room. 'Hmm?
If I think about it, Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo might not know about his true identity, or they might have been controlled by him.
Otherwise, he wouldn't have been able to infiltrate this sect so easily, or he could have used an artifact to conceal his dark element, which allowed him to deceive everyone in this sect.
Forget it; I just need to pretend to sleep for now, and I will get the answers to my questions later.'
After he waited for some time, Pang Liyuan finally entered his room, but Zhang Fei [1] was a little surprised by his sneaking ability, especially since he turned into a shadow. 'Oh?
What good ability!
I have to steal that ability from him!'
Pang Liyuan, still unaware that he had fallen into Zhang Fei [1]'s trap, approached him slowly.
He then moved his fingers, causing several shadows to immediately appear and bind him, which startled him a bit.
After that, Pang Liyuan pressed his palm against Zhang Fei [1]'s chest and used his slavery technique on him, but his actions caused notifications to appear in his mind.
[Ding]
[Someone is trying to enslave the host.]
[Activating the self-protection system.]
As soon as the notification appeared, a white light shot out of Zhang Fei [1]'s chest, striking Pang Liyuan directly, throwing him backwards, and slamming him into the wall.
*Bam*
"Cough...
Cough..." Pang Liyuan coughed hard as he squeezed his painful chest. 'What the hell is that?
I didn't feel any qi movement in his body, but he was able to attack me all of a sudden.
Furthermore, it was clearly a light Qi attack; otherwise, I wouldn't be in this much pain.'
Pang Liyuan then wiped the blood from the corner of his lips before standing up.
Dissatisfied that he had not succeeded in enslaving Zhang Fei [1], he approached him once more. 'Tch!
If I can't use that on you, I'll use something else to enslave you.'
Pang Liyuan immediately took out a bamboo tube before opening the lid, and an invisible smoke came out from inside it, heading straight for Zhang Fei [1], which he inhaled directly.
However, Pang Liyuan was unaware that Lan Zhen had used the same thing against Zhang Fei [1], and the system instantly neutralized the effect.
[Ding]
[Heart-controlling gas enters the host's body.]
[Heart-controlling gas has been neutralized.]
Zhang Fei [1] sighed in his heart as he received the notification. 'Somehow, I feel that this guy is an idiot when compared to his father.'
Since Zhang Fei [1] had clearly inhaled it, Pang Liyuan smiled triumphantly and immediately carried him on his shoulders before taking him away from the room.

In a few moments, Pang Liyuan had already arrived at Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo's residence, and the two men's expressions turned to joy as soon as they saw Zhang Fei [1], not realizing that he had been pretending from the start.
After Pang Liyuan laid Zhang Fei [1] on the floor, Ba Shuxiang immediately inquired.
"Has he fallen under your control, Li Yuan?"
Zhang Fei [1] was a little surprised after hearing Ba Shuxiang's question. 'Oh?
So this guy wasn't controlling them, huh?

This implies that he concealed his darkness element with an artifact, which prevented the formation in this sect from reacting, thereby preventing them from realizing he was a member of the Pang Clan.'
"Yeah, I've used something to control this guy, so he's under my control now." Pang Liyuan replied confidently as he sat down on an empty chair.
"What do you two want to do to him?"

"This guy petrified my little brother's body, so I need him to revert his condition to normal again, or he will die." After hearing Ba Shuxiang's response, Pang Liyuan raised his eyebrows and observed Zhang Fei [1], but his confusion stemmed from the absence of any earth element in his body.
"Husband, you can bring Yongshan here, so Li Yuan can order this bastard to reverse his condition."
"All right." Chi Zhongguo immediately rushed to leave their residence.
Ba Shuxiang then squatted down beside Zhang Fei [1] and observed his face.
"If I look closely, this guy is indeed handsome, so it's no wonder that he can capture the hearts of the young misses from those five powerful clans."
"Which clans are you referring to?" Pang Liyuan asked with a raised eyebrow.
Ba Shuxiang immediately turned to Pang Liyuan before sharing the information.
"Chu Ying and Chu Qing from the western Chu Clan, Ye Lian from the Ye Clan, Liu Hua from the Liu Clan, Shen Yu from the Shen Clan, and Zhang Lingxue from the Zhang Clan."
'No wonder I'm familiar with his name; this guy is actually the one who released Liu Hua from Uncle Hong's control, and he has also stolen two of the five tree blood demons.
Since he has fallen under my control, I will let these two idiots use him first.
After that, I will take him to my father, who will undoubtedly be delighted to receive him.' Then, Pang Liyuan asked Ba Shuxiang.
"Does he really have a relationship with the women of those five clans?"
"Why would I lie to you?" Ba Shuxiang asked back as she stood up.
"This guy has already admitted his relationship, and Ye Lian has confirmed it, so it can't be wrong.
Anyway, can you transfer your control over him to me?
Since he dared to do such a thing to my little brother, and he repeatedly insulted my Ba Clan, I wanted to torture him before killing him."
"No." Pang Liyuan immediately rejected her request, making Ba Shuxiang frown.
"I will help you restore your little brother's condition, but I need him to do something, so I can't.
Moreover, he has become my puppet now, which is much more miserable than death, so you can forget about your intentions."
Ba Shuxiang sighed softly and nodded to Pang Liyuan.
"All right, you better not let him die too soon, so he will continue to suffer life as a puppet."
"That's for sure." Pang Liyuan responded with a faint smile.
Zhang Fei [1], who was listening to their conversation, was truly furious.
He was eager to take action against them. 'May!
Open the portal now!'
[Alrighty!]
Suddenly, Pang Liyuan's expression turned shocked as he saw a portal open before his eyes, prompting Ba Shuxiang to immediately turn her head back.
However, she too became shocked as soon as she saw the portal.
Before they could react, a powerful aura had already pressed down on them, causing the two of them to fall to the floor instantly.
"Ugh!"
'What the hell is that portal?
How could it appear suddenly?
Where does this strong pressure come from?' Ba Shuxiang and Pang Liyuan stared at the portal, their hearts filled with shock and wonder.
As soon as Zhang Lingxue walked out of the portal, their expressions turned full of fear, and she looked at them with her fiery red eyes.
'Crap!'
'Shit!'
Ba Shuxiang and Pang Liyuan cursed simultaneously in their hearts, and their bodies trembled as they could feel Zhang Lingxue's anger.
Moreover, her cultivation was several minor levels above theirs, rendering them powerless under the pressure of her aura.
Zhang Lingxue immediately sealed their cultivation and turned to Zhang Fei [1].
"Are you going to keep pretending like that, husband?"

Hearing Zhang Lingxue's question, the two of them glanced at Zhang Fei [1], and their eyes widened in disbelief when they saw him stand up, especially Pang Liyuan, who had previously been so confident that he had fallen under his control.
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed before using his aura to lift the two people to their feet.
"Are you surprised to see that I didn't fall under your control, Li Yuan?
Or should I call you Pang Liyuan?"

After hearing Zhang Fei [1]'s questions, Ba Shuxiang immediately turned to Pang Liyuan, especially since she and her husband never knew that he was a member of the Pang Clan, and he registered in their sect using the name Li Yuan.
"Are you surprised that I know your real name?" Zhang Fei [1] then strangled Pang Liyuan's neck before he turned to Ba Shuxiang.
"What will happen if the people in this sect find out that you and Chi Zhongguo are in cahoots with people from the Pang Clan?
Will they expel you two from this sect?
Or will they kill you two outright?"
"No!" Ba Shuxiang screamed as she shook her head vigorously.
"We didn't know he was a member of the Pang Clan!
All this time, we only knew he was Li Yuan from the Li Clan."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled before looking at Pang Liyuan again.
"Honestly, I didn't expect to meet Pang De's son in this sect, so I'm really lucky this time."
Pang Liyuan was truly shocked to hear Zhang Fei [1] know his identity in such detail.
"How... how did you know my identity?"

"For your information, Pang Hong and Pang Gui are my slaves now, so I learned quite a lot about your Pang Clan from them." After hearing that, Pang Liyuan's eyes widened in shock, especially since his two uncles were powerful, particularly the second.
"Oh!
About a month ago, Lan Zhen of the Lan Clan tried to use the heart-controlling gas on me, but she failed to do so, and you foolishly tried to use it on me today.
Since you are Pang De's son, then I will use you to do something for me.

I had already ordered one of my slaves to ask your father about the location of the fourth blood tree demon that he hid in the central region, but he kept that information tightly sealed from everyone."
'Shit!
I'm really unlucky this time!
I didn't expect this bastard to know so much about my clan!' Pang Liyuan muttered inwardly as his body trembled and cold sweat soaked his body, especially when Zhang Fei [1] touched his chest.
"What... what are you going to do?"
"Isn't that obvious?" Zhang Fei [1] turned around to ask with a smirk on his face.
"Since you want to make me your puppet, I have to repay you, right?
After today, you will be my slave, like Pang Hong and Pang Gui, and you will be my source of information, including information about the Xie and Mo Clans."
No...
No..." Pang Liuyan screamed in panic.
However, Pang Liyuan's expression quickly changed once Zhang Fei [1] implanted the devil slave mark into his soul, and he also manipulated his memories.
That way, he'll be completely loyal to him, just like Pang Hong and Pang Gui.

After he finished, Zhang Lingxue immediately released the man from her suppression and unsealed his cultivation, and Pang Liyuan immediately kneeled down in front of Zhang Fei [1], making Ba Shuxiang anxious about her own situation.

"Stop!

"Unfortunately, you and your husband are no less stupid than Ba Yongshan, and you two even asked Pang Liyuan to control me.

Since both of you chose to be my enemies, and I am not a forgiving person either, you guys have to bear the consequences of your schemes against me." After that, Zhang Fei [1] enslaved and manipulated Ba Shuxiang's memories, but he did not manipulate all of them, and he only manipulated her memories of their relationship with Pang Liyuan.
"We only have to wait for your husband and little brother."

chapters.title: Chapter 314: A Big Commotion
paragraphs: *Bam*

Chi Zhongguo dropped Ba Yongshan to the floor as soon as he entered his residence, especially after he saw Ba Shuxiang in Zhang Fei [1]'s lap, and his hands kept groping her body from under her dress.
"Husband! Please don't look at me! I can't refuse his order!" Ba Shuxiang spoke with a trembling voice, tears rolling down her cheeks.

"Bastard! Let go of my wife!" Instantly, Chi Zhongguo released his cultivation and killing intent, and he dashed towards Zhang Fei with both his fists already covered in earth qi. "I'm gonna kill you!"
"Husband! Stop! Don't do it! You must run away now!"
*Thrust*

Before he could reach Zhang Fei [1], Chi Zhongguo was shocked by a red sword piercing through his chest from behind, but it did not stab his vital part, and he immediately turned his head back with wide eyes. "Zhang... Zhang Lingxue...!"

"Do you think I will let you hurt my husband?" Zhang Lingxue inquired as she quickly sealed Chi Zhongguo's cultivation, and she immediately pulled her sword out of his body, causing blood to gush out from his chest and back.
"Ugh!" Chi Zhongguo immediately fell to his knees while clutching his painful chest. "How... how did you get here?"

"I don't need to explain it to you, right?" Zhang Lingxue then moved behind Zhang Fei [1]. "Do you think my sisters and I would be willing to be his wives if our husband was an ordinary person? Despite the fact that you are already aware of his relationship with us, you continue to look for trouble with him, even collaborating with a member of the Pang Clan to enslave him.
Doesn't that mean you look down on us? Your Chi clan is indeed strong in the eastern region, but my Zhang clan is the second strongest in this realm, and we can easily crush your clan."

Chi Zhongguo did not deny Zhang Lingxue's words about the difference in their clans' strengths, but he immediately denied her accusations about them colluding with the heretic clan. "What do you mean by that? You are indeed strong, but you cannot slander us; we have never collided with any member of the Pang Clan!"
"See that guy?" Zhang Fei said [1] as he pointed to his new puppet, who was still kneeling on the floor. "His real name is Pang Liyuan, and he is the son of Pang De, the patriarch of the Pang Clan."
"What? " Chi Zhongguo shouted in shock as he turned to look at Pang Liyuan, but he could see that his gaze was blank, leading him to believe that they had already taken control of him.

Zhang Fei [1] then lowered Ba Shuxiang from his lap before walking over to Chi Zhongguo, and he immediately pulled his hair up. "You may not know his true identity, but you know for sure about his ability to control other people. Otherwise, you wouldn't ask him to control me, right? Have you ever questioned your stupidity in trusting him?

Do you think the cultivators of the righteous path would do such a thing to others? Unfortunately, it is too late to regret your foolishness, and you have made a fatal mistake by becoming my enemy, so you will follow them both by becoming my slave for life."
"No... No...! I don't want to be your slave!"

However, Zhang Fei [1] immediately restricted Chi Zhongguo's movements, implanted his demon slave mark into his soul, and manipulated some of his memories about his relationship with Pang Liyuan, similar to what he had previously done to Ba Shuxiang.
"Husband!" Ba Shuxiang screamed as she ran to her husband's side as soon as Zhang Fei [1] let go of him, and Chi Zhongguo looked at him in horror, realizing that he had become his slave.

"Are you really going to do that, husband?" Zhang Lingxue asked Zhang Fei [1] as she looked at Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo with pity, especially since they had messed with the wrong people, and her husband naturally would not be merciful to them.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] replied to his wife with a nod before ordering the three to stand, and they immediately followed his orders against their will. "We will bring them to this sect training ground, and I will contact the higher-ups of this sect to meet us there."

Hearing that, Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo's faces turned pale, especially since Zhang Fei [1] manipulated their memories, which made them know from the start that Pang Liyuan was a member of the Pang Clan, and they chose to collude with him of their own accord.
Zhang Fei immediately escorted Zhang Lingxue out of the house. "Pang Liyuan, pick Ba Yongshan up, and you guys will follow us to the training ground."
Without saying a word, Pang Liyuan immediately picked Ba Yongshan up and carried him to follow his master.

Ba Shuxiang, who could not refuse Zhang Fei [1]'s order, immediately helped Chi Zhongguo walk. In addition, she assisted her husband in stopping his bleeding. However, his idea of disclosing their relationship with Pang Liyuan frightened them both, as they genuinely feared that the Desolate Sect would condemn them to death if they discovered it.

Zhang Fei [1] himself sent a voice transmission to Lian Xiang and Gan Jinshu to inform them of the incident, which shocked both of them, and they moved towards the training ground while contacting the other elders to gather there.
The two disciples guarding the area were confused after they saw Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue walking side by side, especially since they didn't recognize either of them.

"You guys don't need to interfere with this matter, especially since the guy in black is a member of the Pang Clan, and these two people conspired with him to harm my husband." The two disciples were shocked to hear Zhang Lingxue's words, causing them to glare at Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo with hatred, especially since the clan members had done such traumatizing things to their sect in the past.

While they were on their way to the sect's training area, all the disciples who saw them kept asking about the situation faced by Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo, but Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue did not explain anything to them, so they decided to follow them to the training ground.
The disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect also heard the incident, and Qin Zheng hurriedly led them towards the training ground because the situation had become chaotic.

When they arrived there, Zhang Fei [1] immediately ordered the three people to kneel in the middle arena with Ba Yongshan lying in front of them. He, along with Zhang Lingxue, stood behind them, waiting for Lian Xiang and the others to arrive.

The disciples quickly filled the training ground, and they jostled in anticipation of what would happen next. However, their curiosity about why Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue treated their seniors in such a manner led them to start whispering to each other. After all, Chi Zhongguo was the second son of their sect master, and their Chi Clan has been leading their sect for so long.

The disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect had also arrived at the training ground, and they asked Ye Lian about the reason Zhang Fei [1] did that to Chi Zhongguo and the others, but she only responded to them by shaking her head, especially since he hadn't explained anything to her.
Sometime later, Lian Xiang, Gang Jinshu, and all the elders arrived at the training ground.
"Zhongguo! Shuxiang!" Chi Zhiqiang was the first to scream, and she wanted to run towards them, especially since Chi Zhongguo was her nephew.
However, Lian Xiang immediately stopped Chi Zhiqiang and asked Zhang Lingxue. "Since when have you been in our sect? Why didn't we know about your arrival?"

"That matter is not important for now, okay?" Zhang Lingxue then pointed to the three people in front of her. "The most important thing now is that we have to solve these three people's problems, especially since Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo conspired with Pang Liyuan to control my husband, so he summoned me here to help him."

"Impossible!" Chi Zhiqiang shouted, refuting Zhang Lingxue. "He is not Pang Liyuan! He is Li Yuan of the Li Clan! Moreover, my nephew clearly knows about our clan's traumatic history, so he would never collude with that heretic clan!"
"You're so naive, huh?" Zhang Lingxue turned to Zhang Fei [1], who immediately ordered Pang Liyuan to remove his concealment artifact and release his darkness element.
As soon as Pang Liyuan followed Zhang Fei [1]'s order and released his darkness element, a black aura immediately enveloped his body, causing everyone present at the training ground to gasp in shock.

After seeing that, Chi Zhiqiang looked trembling and staggered backward, especially since she was the one who accepted Pang Liyuan into their sect, but she never knew that he had the darkness element. "How... how could this be?"

Lian Xiang and the others also looked shocked after seeing Pang Liyuan's darkness element, and a glimmer of killing intent flashed across their eyes, especially after they remembered the heartbreaking history of their sect.

"See? I didn't lie to you, right?" Zhang Lingxue casually told them, "My husband has already explained everything to me, and he did not do anything to Ba Yongshan. However, Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo continued to accuse him of being the culprit, and they even ordered Pang Liyuan to use his clan technique to turn him into a puppet.

Fortunately, he has me and the others, and we have provided him with some protection. Otherwise, he would have become his puppet by now, and we would have suffered if we lost him. Furthermore, they are already aware that he is my husband and a member of my Zhang clan. Therefore, I considered their actions an open challenge to my clan, and I will not tolerate them."

Zhang Lingxue's words made Chi Zhiqiang freeze in her spot, but she then glanced at Chi Zhongguo before trying to beg her. "Lingxue, I beg you! Please give my nephew a chance, and I will make sure that he will never get involved with them again."

"No." Zhang Lingxue fiercely rejected Chi Zhiqiang's request. "Although Zhongguo is Chi Yang's second son, and my brother also has a good relationship with his father, this matter is too serious and concerns the reputation of my Zhang Clan, so I will not spare your nephew."
Chapter Enjoy:

Zhang Fei [1], who had been silent all this time, finally spoke up. "Elder, if you insist on begging for Chi Zhongguo, then I will announce his involvement with the Pang Clan to all regions, and you should already understand the risks if they hear about this matter, right?"

Zhang Fei [1]'s threat caused Chi Zhiqiang to clench her fists tightly, putting her in a dilemma. She wanted to protect Chi Zhongguo from them because he was her nephew, but she also knew that if he spread the news of her nephew's involvement to all the clans in Sky Jade Realm, they would immediately turn against her Chi Clan, putting her clan members across the regions in danger.

Lian Xiang sighed softly before attempting to mediate the situation by persuading Zhang Fei [1]. "I know that Zhongguo and Shuxiang have made a mistake by conspiring with the Pang Clan to harm you, but the two of them have never done anything wrong before, so I hope you can give them a chance."

"Have you forgotten how the Pang Clan slaughtered so many members of this sect in the past?" Zhang Fei [1]'s question pierced Lian Xiang and the others' hearts like a knife, and his subsequent words deepened their sorrow, recalling the past events. "Your husband died in their hands, right?

Elder Jinshu's wife and daughter also died because of their actions, and the rest of you must have experienced the same thing when that incident happened, right? Are you really going to spare these two traitors after what those people did to all of you in the past?"
None of them had any intention of refuting Zhang Fei [1], especially since that incident had caused them all to lose their loved ones, leaving them completely traumatized.

Then Zhang Fei [1] spoke to them again. "If I were in your place, I would never have any intention of forgiving those who have betrayed me by working together with those who destroyed my family, and I would definitely kill them with my own hands, even if they were my family."

Upon hearing Zhang Fei's words, the disciples, disappointed by Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo's actions, immediately shouted for their expulsion from the sect. Many of them even asked for the two to be executed directly, especially the older disciples, whose families were also victims of the incident in the past.
"Anyway, they targeted me with their evil scheme, so the decision regarding the fate of both of them is mine. Even if all of you become my enemies later, I still won't be merciful to them.

However, you should think carefully before deciding to become my enemies, and I dare to guarantee that all of you will suffer if you make such a decision." After saying that, Zhang Fei [1] asked Mei to open a portal to the training ground, shocking everyone. He then immediately threw Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo into it.

"As for Pang Liyuan, he is now my slave due to the effect of an artifact that Lingxue gave me. However, I will not kill him for now because he is Pang De's son, and I need him to do something about his father."
