"Are you really going to do that, husband?" Zhang Lingxue asked Zhang Fei [1] as she looked at Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo with pity, especially since they had messed with the wrong people, and her husband naturally would not be merciful to them.
"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] replied to his wife with a nod before ordering the three to stand, and they immediately followed his orders against their will.
"We will bring them to this sect training ground, and I will contact the higher-ups of this sect to meet us there."

Hearing that, Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo's faces turned pale, especially since Zhang Fei [1] manipulated their memories, which made them know from the start that Pang Liyuan was a member of the Pang Clan, and they chose to collude with him of their own accord.
Zhang Fei immediately escorted Zhang Lingxue out of the house.
"Pang Liyuan, pick Ba Yongshan up, and you guys will follow us to the training ground."
Without saying a word, Pang Liyuan immediately picked Ba Yongshan up and carried him to follow his master.
Ba Shuxiang, who could not refuse Zhang Fei [1]'s order, immediately helped Chi Zhongguo walk.
In addition, she assisted her husband in stopping his bleeding.
However, his idea of disclosing their relationship with Pang Liyuan frightened them both, as they genuinely feared that the Desolate Sect would condemn them to death if they discovered it.

Zhang Fei [1] himself sent a voice transmission to Lian Xiang and Gan Jinshu to inform them of the incident, which shocked both of them, and they moved towards the training ground while contacting the other elders to gather there.
The two disciples guarding the area were confused after they saw Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue walking side by side, especially since they didn't recognize either of them.

"You guys don't need to interfere with this matter, especially since the guy in black is a member of the Pang Clan, and these two people conspired with him to harm my husband." The two disciples were shocked to hear Zhang Lingxue's words, causing them to glare at Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo with hatred, especially since the clan members had done such traumatizing things to their sect in the past.

While they were on their way to the sect's training area, all the disciples who saw them kept asking about the situation faced by Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo, but Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue did not explain anything to them, so they decided to follow them to the training ground.
The disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect also heard the incident, and Qin Zheng hurriedly led them towards the training ground because the situation had become chaotic.
When they arrived there, Zhang Fei [1] immediately ordered the three people to kneel in the middle arena with Ba Yongshan lying in front of them.
He, along with Zhang Lingxue, stood behind them, waiting for Lian Xiang and the others to arrive.
The disciples quickly filled the training ground, and they jostled in anticipation of what would happen next.
However, their curiosity about why Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue treated their seniors in such a manner led them to start whispering to each other.
After all, Chi Zhongguo was the second son of their sect master, and their Chi Clan has been leading their sect for so long.

The disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect had also arrived at the training ground, and they asked Ye Lian about the reason Zhang Fei [1] did that to Chi Zhongguo and the others, but she only responded to them by shaking her head, especially since he hadn't explained anything to her.
Sometime later, Lian Xiang, Gang Jinshu, and all the elders arrived at the training ground.
"Zhongguo!
Shuxiang!" Chi Zhiqiang was the first to scream, and she wanted to run towards them, especially since Chi Zhongguo was her nephew.
However, Lian Xiang immediately stopped Chi Zhiqiang and asked Zhang Lingxue.
"Since when have you been in our sect?
Why didn't we know about your arrival?"
"That matter is not important for now, okay?" Zhang Lingxue then pointed to the three people in front of her.

"The most important thing now is that we have to solve these three people's problems, especially since Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo conspired with Pang Liyuan to control my husband, so he summoned me here to help him."
"Impossible!" Chi Zhiqiang shouted, refuting Zhang Lingxue.
"He is not Pang Liyuan!
He is Li Yuan of the Li Clan!
Moreover, my nephew clearly knows about our clan's traumatic history, so he would never collude with that heretic clan!"
"You're so naive, huh?" Zhang Lingxue turned to Zhang Fei [1], who immediately ordered Pang Liyuan to remove his concealment artifact and release his darkness element.
As soon as Pang Liyuan followed Zhang Fei [1]'s order and released his darkness element, a black aura immediately enveloped his body, causing everyone present at the training ground to gasp in shock.

After seeing that, Chi Zhiqiang looked trembling and staggered backward, especially since she was the one who accepted Pang Liyuan into their sect, but she never knew that he had the darkness element.
"How... how could this be?"

Lian Xiang and the others also looked shocked after seeing Pang Liyuan's darkness element, and a glimmer of killing intent flashed across their eyes, especially after they remembered the heartbreaking history of their sect.
"See?
I didn't lie to you, right?" Zhang Lingxue casually told them, "My husband has already explained everything to me, and he did not do anything to Ba Yongshan.
However, Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo continued to accuse him of being the culprit, and they even ordered Pang Liyuan to use his clan technique to turn him into a puppet.
Fortunately, he has me and the others, and we have provided him with some protection.
Otherwise, he would have become his puppet by now, and we would have suffered if we lost him.
Furthermore, they are already aware that he is my husband and a member of my Zhang clan.
Therefore, I considered their actions an open challenge to my clan, and I will not tolerate them."
Zhang Lingxue's words made Chi Zhiqiang freeze in her spot, but she then glanced at Chi Zhongguo before trying to beg her.
"Lingxue, I beg you!
Please give my nephew a chance, and I will make sure that he will never get involved with them again."
"No." Zhang Lingxue fiercely rejected Chi Zhiqiang's request.

"Although Zhongguo is Chi Yang's second son, and my brother also has a good relationship with his father, this matter is too serious and concerns the reputation of my Zhang Clan, so I will not spare your nephew."
Chapter Enjoy:
Zhang Fei [1], who had been silent all this time, finally spoke up.

"Elder, if you insist on begging for Chi Zhongguo, then I will announce his involvement with the Pang Clan to all regions, and you should already understand the risks if they hear about this matter, right?"
Zhang Fei [1]'s threat caused Chi Zhiqiang to clench her fists tightly, putting her in a dilemma.

She wanted to protect Chi Zhongguo from them because he was her nephew, but she also knew that if he spread the news of her nephew's involvement to all the clans in Sky Jade Realm, they would immediately turn against her Chi Clan, putting her clan members across the regions in danger.
Lian Xiang sighed softly before attempting to mediate the situation by persuading Zhang Fei [1].
"I know that Zhongguo and Shuxiang have made a mistake by conspiring with the Pang Clan to harm you, but the two of them have never done anything wrong before, so I hope you can give them a chance."

"Have you forgotten how the Pang Clan slaughtered so many members of this sect in the past?" Zhang Fei [1]'s question pierced Lian Xiang and the others' hearts like a knife, and his subsequent words deepened their sorrow, recalling the past events.
"Your husband died in their hands, right?
Elder Jinshu's wife and daughter also died because of their actions, and the rest of you must have experienced the same thing when that incident happened, right?
Are you really going to spare these two traitors after what those people did to all of you in the past?"
None of them had any intention of refuting Zhang Fei [1], especially since that incident had caused them all to lose their loved ones, leaving them completely traumatized.
Then Zhang Fei [1] spoke to them again.

"If I were in your place, I would never have any intention of forgiving those who have betrayed me by working together with those who destroyed my family, and I would definitely kill them with my own hands, even if they were my family."
Upon hearing Zhang Fei's words, the disciples, disappointed by Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo's actions, immediately shouted for their expulsion from the sect.
Many of them even asked for the two to be executed directly, especially the older disciples, whose families were also victims of the incident in the past.
"Anyway, they targeted me with their evil scheme, so the decision regarding the fate of both of them is mine.
Even if all of you become my enemies later, I still won't be merciful to them.

However, you should think carefully before deciding to become my enemies, and I dare to guarantee that all of you will suffer if you make such a decision." After saying that, Zhang Fei [1] asked Mei to open a portal to the training ground, shocking everyone.
He then immediately threw Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo into it.
"As for Pang Liyuan, he is now my slave due to the effect of an artifact that Lingxue gave me.
However, I will not kill him for now because he is Pang De's son, and I need him to do something about his father."

chapters.title: Chapter 315: Zhang Lingxue's Revelations
paragraphs: "All right, you guys can disperse now!"

When they heard Lian Xiang, the disciples immediately left the training ground. Many of them were thrilled by Zhang Fei [1]'s decision regarding Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo, but many of them were disappointed that he did not kill them.
Unlike them, the disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect did not leave the place, and Ye Lian ran over to Zhang Fei [1] before standing by Zhang Lingxue's side.
Lian Xiang then glanced at Ba Yongshan before saying to Chi Zhiqiang. "Take Ba Yongshan back to the medical hall, and..."

"I don't think you need to do that." Lian Xiang and the others turned to Zhang Fei [1]. "Since the situation is like this, you guys won't be able to continue sparring with the disciples from the Heavenly Sword Sect, right? If that's the case, I'll send them back to the western region directly, and they can bring this guy with them, so the Ba Clan can take care of him themselves."
"Can you really send them back to the western region directly? Does that mean you have the space element?" Li Xintong, a female elder, questioned Zhang Fei [1] with a curious look.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately turned to Li Xintong, but he smiled in amusement at her appearance, especially since she looked so much like a nerd, and she was also wearing an object resembling glasses.

Li Xintong herself had short and curly red hair, and her face was like a woman in her early sixties. According to the system's information, Zhang Fei [1] knew that her cultivation was quite high at 1-Star Heaven Realm, and she did not yet have a husband or children. Although she was not pretty, her facial features were quite unique, and her serious expression showed her high curiosity.

She has glassy red eyes, flat-nosed, pale-thick lips, and her chin is quite sharp. She had a figure that was neither too tall nor too chubby, and her skin tone was slightly pale. Behind her long red dress were her E-Cup chests, which appeared round and firm.

"Elder, you should be able to feel that I don't have the space element, right?" Li Xintong replied to Zhang Fei [1] with a nod. "However, I have something that allows me to do that, but I won't tell you, especially since you are a stranger to me."
Li Xintong nodded in understanding as she sighed softly. You can still show me how you'll send them to the western region, right?

"Yeah, I'll show you in a minute." Zhang Fei [1] then turned to Qin Zheng and the others. "Are you guys ready to go back? However, Lian'er won't be going back with you guys, and I will be sending her to my private training ground so she can catch up with her other sisters."

Qin Zheng nodded directly at Zhang Fei [1]. "We've been away from the sect for a month and a half, so it would be great if we could return there right away. As for Lian'er's absence, I'll explain it to our vice sect master later."
"Hehe! Thank you, Sister Zheng!" Ye Lian softly laughed as she spoke. Chapter Your:

After Qin Zheng agreed, Zhang Fei [1] immediately used his warp portal. However, he had already replaced the save point in the Heavenly Sword Sect with the Easterm region, so he decided to send them back to the Chu Clan.
"Huh!?" When the portal appeared, Li Xintong and the people from the desolate sect were shocked, and they all crowded around it like country bumpkins who had just seen something new.
Even Gang Jinshu, who usually had no interest in anything other than blacksmithing, looked enthusiastic after seeing the portal. "Is this portal really connected to the western region, Kid?"
"I don't need to lie to you, right, Elder Gang?" Zhang Fei [1] returned the question with a smile. "However, I can't take you there, or you'll have to fly back here yourself."

Li Xintong immediately looked at Zhang Fei [1] and said to him. "I want to test this portal to uncover the truth, so I'll accompany them there. It doesn't matter if I have to come back here by myself. Furthermore, we need someone to explain Ba Yongshan's situation to the Ba Clan, so I will go to that clan at once to explain everything."

Before answering Li Xintong, Zhang Fei [1] first contacted Chu Ying and the others to greet those people, especially since Liu Hua and Liu Qingyu were still in the southern region, in preparation to fight Shen Haoran. "If you want that, you can enter now, and you will arrive directly at the Chu Clan."

Without thinking twice, Li Xintong lifted Ba Yongshan from the ground and entered the portal directly, and her actions caused Lian Xiang and the others to sigh helplessly, especially since she had always had a high interest in new things.

Qin Zheng then led Jing Qiu and Qian He into the portal, and the two male disciples followed behind them. However, they stopped for a moment, and Chao Qing spoke to Zhang Fei [1]. "We will wait for you at our sect and possibly spar there, brother."

"Chao Qing is right, brother." Luo Feng nodded and spoke to Zhang Fei [1] as well. "Ye Lian told us that you also practice swordmanship, and I hope you can visit our sect soon, so we can spar and exchange experiences about the sword."

"Sure." Zhang Fei [1] himself liked the two men's characters, so he did not refuse their wishes. "After I settle all the matters at hand, I will have a lot of free time, and I will take the time to go to your sect."
"That's great! We'll be waiting for you, brother." Both men answered at the same time before entering the portal.

After Zhang Fei [1] closed the portal, Lian Xiang immediately questioned him, pointing at Pang Liyuan. "Can you tell us what your real plans are for this guy? I'm so eager to kill him, especially since he's Pang De's son, but I'm sure you have other plans for him, so I want to hear them first."

Zhang Fei [1] was not surprised to hear the hatred in Lian Xiang's tone, and the other elders also acted like wild beasts eager to pounce on Pang Liyuan. "A month and a half ago, I accidentally discovered a blood tree demon in the southern region, which continuously produced demon miasma.
The demons who once invaded this realm intentionally left it behind, and the demon miasma has the power to drive people insane before their deaths.

"What?" Upon hearing that, they all erupted in shock, particularly considering that the demon invasion marked the darkest chapter in the Sky Jade Realm's history, leading to a significant decrease in their population. "Then, what did you do to the demon tree?"

Before proceeding further, Zhang Fei [1] immediately activated his light qi, surprising those around him. "As you can see, my light qi is much stronger than that of other cultivators. Since no one could approach the tree, I decided to give it a try. When I succeeded, I came across a purposefully planted remnant of a demon's soul within the tree.
From the demon, I learned that there were four other trees hidden in other regions."
"Do you know the location of the demon tree in this region?" Ou Yeming, a male elder, abruptly inquired.

"You don't need to worry about that tree, especially since I've already cleared out both the trees in the eastern and western regions and moved all three to a place that humans cannot reach." Zhang Fei [1] then lifted Pang Liyuan to his feet.

"Unfortunately, I have no information about the blood tree demon in the central region, especially since Pang De hid it neatly and never told his other clan members about its location. That's why I want to use his son to investigate, as the demon miasma's continued spread in that region could result in more victims.
As for the last tree, it is located in the Pang Clan, or more precisely, in their ancestors' cultivation cave, and they use it to improve themselves."

Although they were eager to kill Pang Liyuan, they could understand the urgency of the situation, so they decided to forget about him. However, their curiosity about how Zhang Fei [1] could have known all this led Lian Xiang to question him once more. "How did you get all that information?

I understand your relationship with the five clans, but none of them have ever been able to obtain such detailed information about the Pang Clan, and we ourselves have tried for many years to no avail."

Instead, Zhang Lingxue answered Lian Xiang's questions, especially since she didn't want them to know too much about her husband's secrets. "Sometime after my husband discovered the first tree demon, Pang Hong infiltrated the western region, intending to attack the Chu Clan.
Fortunately, the Liu Sisters and I were aware of his presence, so we immediately captured him, and we got lots of information from him."
"What kind of information did you get from Pang Hong?" Chi Zhiqiang asked.

Zhang Lingxue faintly smiled before informing them about all the clans from various regions that had chosen to become vassals of the Pang Clan, a revelation that left them completely shocked, particularly considering that some of these clans originated from their own region, with three of them being major clans. "You guys must have heard about the destruction of the Huan Clan, right?"
"Don't tell us that you guys were the ones who destroyed the Huan Clan."

"Ha ha." Zhang Lingxue chuckled at their reaction. "You are correct; we secretly used the combined power of our clans to destroy the Huan Clan. However, we did not destroy the Qiao clan; instead, we took control of it, and Qiao Ran is our prisoner now. Aside from the two clans, we've also taken over the Guan Clan and those minor clans, so there are no more Pang Clan vassals in this region."

After hearing Zhang Lingxue's confession, Lian Xiang and the others immediately held their breath. They themselves are aware that the Zhang Clan is powerful, and there are still four other powerful clans in their group.

However, they did not anticipate that they could accomplish such feats in such a short period, and not a single cultivator in the eastern region knew the situation of those major and minor clans, particularly since the Huan Clan's destruction was the sole major event.
Another male elder abruptly questioned Zhang Lingxue. "Does that mean you guys have also destroyed clans from other regions?"

"My husband has eradicated the Li and Mei Clans from the western clans, specifically due to their intention to poison the Chu Clan." Zhang Lingxue's response prompted them to turn to Zhang Fei [1], but he simply responded to their stares with a faint smile. "From the southern region, only the Du Clan has been destroyed, but those minor clans will soon follow them.

As for the Cai Clan, my father is still discussing this matter with Aunt Wuhen, especially since that clan is her in-laws. Even so, I'm sure that she wouldn't mind if the clan disappeared, especially since she herself has a deep hatred for the Pang Clan. After hearing all this, you should have realized our combined strength, right?
Anyway, we did all that before the Shen Clan joined our group, and they've joined us now, which has increased our total strength even more."

After hearing all that, Chi Zhiqiang was the first to let out a heavy sigh. She didn't dare doubt their strength, with five powerful clans uniting as one group. This further exacerbated her sense of helplessness in rescuing her nephew, as she was certain that opposing them would lead to the destruction of her own Chi clan.
Without saying anything, she immediately flew away from the training ground, her heart truly heavy and sad, imagining the fate of Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo.

Zhang Fei [1] then said this to Lian Xiang and the other elders. "At first, I came here to see Elder Gang because I needed a master for one of my women, but I didn't expect the situation to turn out like this, so I have to apologize to all of you about the disturbance we caused in the sect."

"Forget it." Lian Xiang replied with a heavy sigh. "Everything has happened, and we can't turn back time. Regarding this matter, I will personally explain everything to Chi Yang, especially about the fate of his second son and daughter-in-law. Although he will be sad, I am sure that he will surely be able to accept their fate."

"All right, I'll leave that matter to you." Zhang Fei [1] then turned to Gang Jinshu. "Elder Gang, I have to return to the southern region now, but I will come here often to visit Xi'er, so I entrust her to you for the time being, and I hope you will protect her from all harm. If anyone dares to harm even a hair on her, I will immediately come here to kill that person, along with their family."
Gang Jinshu nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. "Don't worry, I will protect Xi'er like my own daughter."

After that, Zhang Fei [1] opened a portal to an area not far from the Yin-Yang Pavilion, bringing Zhang Lingxue and Ye Lian with him. He also brought Pang Liyuan along, particularly because he still had a lot of questions for him. Zefyr, who had been circling above the sky, immediately rushed to follow them before the portal closed.

They themselves are aware that the Zhang Clan is powerful, and there are still four other powerful clans in their group.

However, they did not anticipate that they could accomplish such feats in such a short period, and not a single cultivator in the eastern region knew the situation of those major and minor clans, particularly since the Huan Clan's destruction was the sole major event.
Another male elder abruptly questioned Zhang Lingxue.
"Does that mean you guys have also destroyed clans from other regions?"

"My husband has eradicated the Li and Mei Clans from the western clans, specifically due to their intention to poison the Chu Clan." Zhang Lingxue's response prompted them to turn to Zhang Fei [1], but he simply responded to their stares with a faint smile.
"From the southern region, only the Du Clan has been destroyed, but those minor clans will soon follow them.
As for the Cai Clan, my father is still discussing this matter with Aunt Wuhen, especially since that clan is her in-laws.
Even so, I'm sure that she wouldn't mind if the clan disappeared, especially since she herself has a deep hatred for the Pang Clan.
After hearing all this, you should have realized our combined strength, right?
Anyway, we did all that before the Shen Clan joined our group, and they've joined us now, which has increased our total strength even more."
After hearing all that, Chi Zhiqiang was the first to let out a heavy sigh.
She didn't dare doubt their strength, with five powerful clans uniting as one group.
This further exacerbated her sense of helplessness in rescuing her nephew, as she was certain that opposing them would lead to the destruction of her own Chi clan.
Without saying anything, she immediately flew away from the training ground, her heart truly heavy and sad, imagining the fate of Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo.
Zhang Fei [1] then said this to Lian Xiang and the other elders.

"At first, I came here to see Elder Gang because I needed a master for one of my women, but I didn't expect the situation to turn out like this, so I have to apologize to all of you about the disturbance we caused in the sect."
"Forget it." Lian Xiang replied with a heavy sigh.
"Everything has happened, and we can't turn back time.
Regarding this matter, I will personally explain everything to Chi Yang, especially about the fate of his second son and daughter-in-law.
Although he will be sad, I am sure that he will surely be able to accept their fate."
"All right, I'll leave that matter to you." Zhang Fei [1] then turned to Gang Jinshu.
"Elder Gang, I have to return to the southern region now, but I will come here often to visit Xi'er, so I entrust her to you for the time being, and I hope you will protect her from all harm.
If anyone dares to harm even a hair on her, I will immediately come here to kill that person, along with their family."
Gang Jinshu nodded to Zhang Fei [1].
"Don't worry, I will protect Xi'er like my own daughter."
After that, Zhang Fei [1] opened a portal to an area not far from the Yin-Yang Pavilion, bringing Zhang Lingxue and Ye Lian with him.
He also brought Pang Liyuan along, particularly because he still had a lot of questions for him.
Zefyr, who had been circling above the sky, immediately rushed to follow them before the portal closed.

chapters.title: Chapter 316: Shadow-Demon Scriptures
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [1] asked Mei to open a portal to the training space as soon as they arrived at the Yin-Yang Pavilion area, then asked the two women to come out. Yi Na immediately returned to the Wei Clan after a week away.

"Wu'er, I left Xi'er in the desolate sect to learn the metal element from Gang Jinshu." Shi Wu was surprised to hear Zhang Fei [1], especially since she had never been separated from her sister before. "Anyway, I've asked Lingxue to take you to the Blazing Moon Sect, and there are two elders there who have the wood element like you.

I can't teach you anything about that element, so I want you to train under their guidance. Moreover, she and Ziqin will accompany you in the sect, ensuring you won't feel lonely, and I will also visit frequently to see you all."
"Alright then, I will go with her to the sect, Master."
"That's good." Zhang Fei [1] then activated the portal to the Blazing Phoenix Sect, and Zhang Lingxue promptly took Shi Wu with her.

After that, he was about to bring Ye Lian, Zefyr, and Pang Liyuan into the training space, but he saw several disciples running hurriedly towards the Yin-Yang Pavilion, making him smile widely because they were his partners and friends who had just returned from their mission. "Let's go in, Lian'er."
"Yeah."

After entering the training space, Ye Lian was momentarily stunned by the sight of a large bed on the side, prompting her to ask Zhang Fei [1] in a teasing tone. "What are you all doing here? Are you guys training or dual-cultivating?"

"Haha." That made Zhang Fei [1] laugh softly. "Naturally, we all practice diligently, and we often dual-cultivate to improve our cultivation. Otherwise, my cultivation would have not yet reached the soul realm, right?"

"Yes." Ye Lian nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. "Somehow, I envy you, you know? Your cultivation was still in the elementary realm when we first met, but you've now reached the soul realm, and you've achieved it in just a little over two months. As for me, I'm already 30 years old now, but my cultivation is still at the 7-Star Soul Realm."
"You don't have to worry about that, okay?" Zhang Fei [1] said this while holding Ye Lian's hand. "Your cultivation is slow now, but I will help you make it faster after we marry."

"I know." In fact, Ye Lian herself was also impatient to dual-cultivate with him, but she was different from the Chu Sisters, and she only wanted to marry him after her father returned, especially since Ye Yuan's presence at her wedding was important to her.
'Mei, buy the beauty retaining pill and the teleportation device.'
[Yes, Master.]
{You got Beauty Retaining Pill x1}
{250,000 green jewels have been deducted from your balance.}
{You got Teleportation Device x1}
{10,000,000 has been deducted from your balance}

After that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately took both of them and gave them to Ye Lian, which excited her after he explained the effects of the pill. "I knew you would be overexcited about this pill, and you would definitely swallow it directly, which would cause a commotion in the desolate sect, so I haven't given it to you before.
As for the teleportation device, you can install one in your room at the Heavenly Sword Sect, so we can meet whenever we want."
"Haha." Ye Lian laughed and swallowed the pill immediately, and she sat cross-legged while waiting for it to take effect, making Zhang Fei [1] shake his head helplessly with her impatience.

Zhang Fei [1] then glanced at Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang, who were hugging each other on the floor nearby, but he ignored them and ordered Peng Liyuan instead. "Give me the shadow technique you used to sneak into my room before. Besides, I also want to learn all the techniques from your clan that you have learned."
"Yes, Master." Pang Liyuan immediately touched his forehead, and he shared all his techniques with Zhang Fei [1].
{Ding}
{You obtained the Shadow Abyss Scripture.}
{You obtained the Netherworld Demon Scripture.}

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows, surprised to learn that Pang Liyuan had only learned two techniques, but he proceeded to read the Shadow Abyss scripture anyway. To his surprise, there were ten sub-techniques in the scripture, and he read them one by one.
[Shadow Mastery: Achieves mastery over all aspects of shadows, enhancing perception, manipulation, and combat abilities.]
[Shadow Step: Allows the user to move swiftly and silently through shadows, teleporting from one shadow to another.]
[Shadow Binding: Manipulates shadows to restrain or immobilize opponents; often used defensively.]
[Shadow Devouring: Consumes shadows to gain energy or power, draining opponents' life forces or abilities.]
[Shadow Veil: Cloaks the user in shadows, granting invisibility or enhancing stealth abilities.]
[Shadow Clone: Creates illusions or copies of oneself from shadows, which can confuse enemies or multiply the user's attacks.]
[Shadow Weave: Manipulates shadows to create intricate patterns or barriers for offense or defense.]
[Shadow Blade: Conjures weapons made of shadow energy, which can cut through almost anything and are controlled by the user's will.]
[Shadow Puppeteer: Controls other people's shadows, manipulating them like puppets to attack or defend.]
[Shadow Emperor: Channels the power of shadows to command lesser shadows or creatures, becoming a ruler over the darkness.]

"Hmm? All of these techniques are great, but some are similar to mine." Zhang Fei [1] muttered, nodding in satisfaction, before reading the Netherworld Demon Scripture, which also included several sub-techniques.

[Demon Absorbing: It is a cruel and overbearing cultivation method to consume the souls or life force of opponents to gain power or regenerate wounds. It can also absorb even the comprehensions and cultivation attainments of others.]
[Demon Corruption: Taints the environment with darkness energy, weakening enemies and bolstering the user's own power.]
[Demon Body: Harnesses the power of darkness to enhance strength, speed, and vitality.]
[Demon King's Roar: Unleashes a terrifying roar infused with demon power, instilling fear and confusion among enemies.]
[Demon Claw: Conjures ethereal claws infused with demon energy, capable of shredding through defenses.]
[Hellflame Incantation: Conjures hellish flames that burn with darkness element, consuming all in their path.]

"What an evil technique!" After reading all those sub-techniques, Zhang Fei [1] exclaimed in shock and asked Pang Liyuan a question. "Have you managed to perfectly master the netherworld demon scripture?"

"Not yet, master." Pang Liyuan answered with a shake of his head. "Our ancestors passed on the technique to several people, but not all of us were able to master those sub-techniques completely, including my father. For now, I can only use the demon corruption art, the demon body art, and the demon claw.
As for the demon absorbing art, only our ancestors can use it, especially since they have a strong demon bloodline in their bodies."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows in surprise. "Did the demon invaders give them those bloodlines?"
Pang Liyuan nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. "However, I don't know for sure what kind of bloodlines they gave them, especially since our ancestors have never shown them to us."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding before asking Pang Liyuan again. "Then where did you get the Shadow Abyss scripture?"

"Master, I received the shadow abyss scripture from my wife's grandfather, Xie Yingzi, as a gift for our relationship." Zhang Fei [1] then asked Pang Liyuan to explain the situation in the northern region, especially regarding the clans. "My Pang clan is the strongest, followed by my mother's Mo clan, and my wife's Xie clan is the third strongest.

Even so, the three clans have a very close relationship, and the ancestors of both clans are also in seclusion with my ancestors. As for the minor clans, you don't need to care too much about them, especially since they are just puppets of our three clans."
"Puppets, huh?" Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding. "All right, I'll send you out of this place now, and you can return directly to the northern region, where you'll meet my third clone."
"Yes, Master." After Zhang Fei [1] sent him out, Pang Liyuan immediately returned to the Pang Clan using the returning jade, but he left his clan again to meet Zhang Xiaolong.

Suddenly, Ye Lian opened her eyes and took out a mirror, but she saw no changes to her face, and Zhang Fei [1] immediately told her. "You don't need to be confused by that, especially since that pill only serves to maintain your youth, and you will never grow old because of it."
"I see." Ye Lian nodded in understanding and stood up. "I think it's okay because I'm still very young and beautiful, and I'm satisfied with my current beauty."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] then pinched Ye Lian's nose. "You are really narcissistic, you know? However, you are right—you are one of the most beautiful women in this realm, and I am lucky that you chose me as your husband."
Ye Lian stuck out her tongue at Zhang Fei [1] before pulling him towards the device in the middle of the room. "What is the use of this device? How can it help us become stronger?"
Zhang Fei [1] then explained to Ye Lian about each feature in the training space, starting with comprehension, gravity, and battle simulation.

Ye Lian's jaw dropped as she felt that those features were too extraordinary; even Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang, who were listening, were shocked after Zhang Fei [1] explained everything, which made them regret their actions towards him even more.

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed as he lifted Ye Lian's chin. If you can't understand a few things, use the comprehension feature to learn them faster. However, it would be better if you focused on practicing using the gravity feature first, especially since almost all of us have perfectly adapted to level three gravity, which is eight times heavier than the outside world.
Once you adapt to it, no disciple of your sect will be able to match your speed, including Ba Jiawen."
Zhang Fei [1] then shared the Yin-Yang refining art with Ye Lian, surprising her. "A soul technique?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "You can learn it first, but cultivating your soul will be difficult if you do it manually." That's why I will use my real body to visit you in your sect later, and I will help you cultivate your soul by dual-cultivating with mine."

Ye Lian was filled with joy, eagerly anticipating the opportunity to do dual soul cultivation with her future husband. "You said it yourself, so you have to keep your words! Anyway, you can activate the gravity feature now, so I can catch up with Chu Ying and the others by adapting to level three."

"You should prepare yourself first, especially since two times gravity is already quite heavy, and you will have a difficult time at first. However, you are one of the best talents in this realm, so I believe you can adapt to it in no time." Upon hearing that, Ye Lian smiled and prepared herself.

However, as soon as Zhang Fei [1] activated the gravity feature, she immediately fell to the ground, finding it difficult to even move a finger, let alone stand under the intense pressure. "You don't need to rush and get your body used to this gravitational pressure first; you can start moving your body once you feel used to it."

"Ugh! This gravity is really heavy, Fei!" Ye Lian complained as she tried to move her finger to no avail. "Don't worry, I'll adapt to this gravity soon, so you can take care of your other business now."

Zhang Fei [1] then walked towards the bed, asking Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang to come to him. This made both of them tense and afraid as they imagined his plans for them, especially since they would not be able to refuse his orders with his slave mark in their souls.

As they expected, Zhang Fei [1] immediately ordered Ba Shuxiang to strip naked, and she reluctantly followed his orders as tears flowed from her eyes because she was unwilling to show her body to other men.

Chi Zhongguo wanted to plead with Zhang Fei [1], but he immediately activated his demon slave mark to control him, making him unable to speak at all, and he could only watch his wife standing naked in front of another man.

"Not bad." Zhang Fei [1] stated this while examining Ba Shuxiang's bare body from top to bottom. "Your face and body pale in comparison to all my wives', but you are not undesirable either. The Chi Clan must have given you a ton of cultivation resources, right? Otherwise, you wouldn't be able to cultivate this fast, and your cultivation is already quite high at the 3-Star Earth Realm.
At first, I never thought I would do this to you, but you two chose to be my enemies, so you guys can blame yourselves for your fate."

However, they were surprised when Zhang Fei [1] asked Ba Shuxiang to get dressed again because he didn't want to touch her yet, especially since he still had other matters to attend to, which made both of them feel a sense of relief.
"Do you think I'll let you go that easily?" As Zhang Fei [1] stood up and asked, he immediately pulled Ba Shuxiang into his embrace and gave her a deep kiss.
Even though she didn't want it, Ba Shuxiang still closed her eyes and returned Zhang Fei [1]'s kiss with her tears flowing continuously, and Chi Zhongguo could do nothing to stop them.
A while later, Zhang Fei [1] separated their lips and said to Chi Zhongguo. "Your wife's lips are quite tasty, you know? Unfortunately, she is no longer yours, and she will be mine soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Learning New Techniques
paragraphs: The atmosphere in the Ba Clan, especially in Ba Yongshan's room, became gloomy after Li Xintong brought him back to their clan, and she explained the incident in which he became petrified during his spar with Chi Yufeng.

However, Li Xingtong did not explain to them about the incident that happened to Ba Shuxiang, nor did she tell them about her relationship with the Pang Clan, especially since she was fully aware that they would try to free her from Zhang Fei [1]'s hands if they knew that he had taken her captive, which would only be detrimental to the Ba clan.

Li Xintong then spoke to Ba Yongshan's parents. "Ba Zhongtan and Ye Mingchen, if you have healer acquaintances with better healing abilities, you could ask them to try to reverse his condition. Our healers have tried to restore your son's condition, but they were unable to do so, so I purposely sent him back here, and you two can accompany him before all his internal organs petrify."
Ba Zhongtan nodded to Li Xintong. "I have called some healers from our sect, and they will be here soon, but I doubt that they will be able to reverse my son's condition."

"How about we take Yongshan to the southern region right now, husband?" Ba Zhongtan immediately turned to Ye Mingchen. "Compared to our healers, Zhiyu Fengzhi's medical ability is superior, and he may be able to help us reverse our son's condition."

Li Xingtong's eyebrows lifted momentarily upon hearing the latter name. As an elder in the desolate sect, she naturally knows Zhiyu Fengzhi. However, she refrained from commenting, keeping her thoughts to herself. 'It would be better if you two did not bring Ba Yongshan to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, especially since that place will be chaotic soon, and you guys will also meet that monster there.'
"You're right." Ba Zhongtan immediately agreed with his wife's idea. In that case, we'll wait for our healers to arrive and bring some to the Yin-Yang Pavilion to care for him during our sect trip."

Ye Mingchen felt relieved after hearing her husband agree with her idea, and she immediately left her son's room to pack up, especially since she felt that their departure this time would be quite long.

Since they had already made this decision, Li Xingtong immediately left the Ba Clan and wandered around the heavenly sword city. She was a little surprised to find Zhang Fei's shop and restaurant nearby.

Li Xingtong was more interested in visiting Zhang Fei's shop, the Diqiu Shop, also known as the Earth Shop, especially after noticing a large number of people carrying items she had never seen before, particularly the mattresses, which piqued her interest.

When she entered the shop, Li Xintong was once again surprised after she saw the four women who were running the shop, especially since she could sense Zhang Fei's yang qi within their bodies. 'These four women are also his wives, huh? Despite being in the foundation and core realms, they seem stronger than other cultivators at their level, which must be due to his yang qi.'
"What can I do for you, elder?" Cheng Yu respectfully asked Li Xingtong because she could feel that her cultivation was far superior to hers.

"I just came to this city after a few years, and this is the first time I've seen your shop. Since I don't know anything about the items you guys are selling, I want to see them all first, and I hope you can explain each of their benefits to me." Cheng Yu nodded and took her to look at the items available in the shop, and Li Xingtong listened to her explanation for a while before making a decision.
"I want to buy some of these mattresses, and I also want to buy every type of item in this store."
"All right, I will prepare everything now, and you can bring them using your storage ring, Elder." Cheng Yu then asked Tang Rou to help him prepare Li Xintong's order.

As she waited for her order, Li Xintong kept watching Zhong Yan and Ru Xue discussing something, and she intended to ask them about Zhang Fei, but she eventually gave up on her intention because she was too creepy and didn't like others digging into her personal affairs.

After Cheng Yu and Tang Rou prepared all her orders, Li Xintong immediately paid them and went to Zhang Fei's restaurant. However, the five women present once again astonished her, especially when she sensed the presence of his yang qi in two of them.
Although Li Xintong was curious about Zhang Chen and the others, she didn't ask them anything and preferred to enjoy the dishes from Earth that they were selling.

After she got the dishes, Li Xintong wasted no time in tasting any of them. Her eyes immediately lit up after she tasted the richness of the spices contained in them, and she voraciously devoured those dishes. 'How can they cook such delicious dishes? These dishes make all of the dishes I've ever eaten taste bad, and I really want to enjoy them over and over again.

Unfortunately, they seem to only be open in this city, and this city is too far from the eastern region. Hmm? Perhaps I can talk to Zhang Fei and ask him to open a branch restaurant in my region, so I can enjoy these dishes again without having to waste a lot of time coming to this region.'

After she finished enjoying the dishes and paid for everything, Li Xintong immediately left the restaurant and went to visit the Heavenly Sword Sect, and she planned to go to the Chu Clan again later.
"Husband, I-"

"All right, you don't need to say anything, as I know that you don't want to do that, and you did it because of the slave mark in your soul." Chi Zhongguo said this to his wife as he watched Zhang Fei [1], who was learning the Shadow Abyss Scripture and the Netherworld Demon Scripture by utilizing the comprehension feature of the training ground.
"I don't know what he's going to do to me, but I'm aware that he's already prepared a plan for me, and it's probably not a good one."
Hearing that, Ba Shuxiang immediately hugged her husband. "Husband, I really don't want to lose you."

"I know, I don't want to lose you either, but there's nothing we can do now." Chi Zhongguo responded with a heavy sigh, hugging Ba Shuxiang back. "Even though I don't like it, I hope you don't fight against him. Moreover, his slave mark is in your soul, and you yourself will suffer if you do so; therefore, it would be better if you followed his orders."
Unfortunately, Chi Zhongguo is still unaware of Zhang Fei [1]'s plan for them, and he will undoubtedly be terrified once he discovers it.

After they waited for several hours, Zhang Fei [1] finally opened his eyes and tried every sub-technique of the Shadow Abyss Scripture, starting with shadow steps, shadow veil, shadow clones, and shadow blade.

Although they were only effective at night, Zhang Fei [1] was still satisfied with them. He then summoned Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang to him, unsealed their cultivations, and immediately used the shadow binding on them, rendering them both immobile.

Zhang Fei [1] was a little disappointed that the shadow binding effect did not last long due to the difference in their cultivation, so he used shadow devouring to weaken them, causing their faces to turn slightly pale. 'The effect is more similar to my life-force absorption ability, but it's much weaker and slower, so it won't be very useful.'

Zhang Fei [1] then used Shadow Weave to create a protective barrier, and he ordered Chi Zhongguo to attack him with all his strength. Unfortunately, he was also disappointed because his shadow barrier was immediately destroyed by his attack, and he was even pushed back a few steps. 'Hmm?
The shadow barrier's effect seems to depend on my cultivation, but it is still somewhat useful to protect myself from my enemies' attacks.'
Zhang Fei [1] immediately tried to use the shadow puppeter on them, which allowed him to control Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang to do things according to his wishes.

Zhang Fei's [1] sudden transformation into an incubus startled Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang, causing them to instinctively take a few steps back with trembling bodies and a strange smile. "Are you surprised to see me? As you both can see, I am both human and demon, and I still have other identities. However, no one knows my three identities, except for my families, partners, and slaves.
Furthermore, I intentionally revealed my demon identity to you two because you guys wouldn't be able to tell anyone else.

At first, Zhang Fei [1] wanted to use demon absorption on them, but he immediately canceled his intention. Instead, he released his darkness element and used the demon corruption on them, which made him satisfied after seeing the two become even more fearful, and his own strength increased in return by exploiting their fear. 'Not bad!
However, with my current strength, I'm not sure that this will be useful against a strong cultivator like Shen Haoran, so I need to increase my strength even further as soon as possible.'

Zhang Fei [1] then activated the demon body to enhance his strength, speed, and vitality. After that, he tried to attack Chi Zhongguo with a tiny bit of his strength, but he had already felt enough pain from his attack, and Ba Shuxiang immediately supported her husband.
Zhang Fei [1] then tested his speed, which the demon body's effects had boosted, using his two primary movement techniques.

Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang looked shocked after Zhang Fei [1] disappeared from their sight, so they tried to follow his movements with their eyes and senses. However, his current speed was too fast for both of them, especially after he adapted to eight times gravity. 'What a monster!
His cultivation was still in the soul realm, but his movements were even faster than cultivators in the heaven realm.'
[Ding]
[The clone illusion steps have advanced to level three.]
[Ding]
[The nine cloud steps have advanced to level three.]

'Oh?' Zhang Fei [1] immediately stopped after the two notifications appeared. 'Haha! At first, I was confused because they hadn't upgraded after I finished my seclusion, but it turned out that they both needed a trigger to upgrade.
Now that the nine cloud steps have reached level three, I can travel 200 km quickly, allowing me to explore all regions with greater freedom and reducing my reliance on Qi recovery pills.'

Zhang Fei [1] then turned to Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang again, and the strange smile on his face made them shiver in fear. Before they could respond, he had already unleashed the demon king's roar, escalating their fear and making their heads dizzy to the point of vomiting.
Zhang Fei [1] then tested the demon claws on Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang, and two black claws instantly appeared from behind him before grabbing their bodies and lifting them high into the air.

Zhang Fei [1] nodded repeatedly as he was satisfied with the technique, and he immediately released both of them. 'If I combine these demon claws and my strength, I think I can tear through other people's defenses.'

Suddenly, Zhang Fei [1] opened both of his palms, and black flames immediately appeared above them after he used the hellflame incantation, which was much hotter than when he used his normal flames. 'Do you think these black flames can kill cultivators like Shen Haoran and the others, Mei?'

[It might be possible, master. However, you likely won't be able to use these black flames in your human or fox form, and you'll have to use your demon form to use them. Anyway, wouldn't it be better if you used the demon absorbing technique on them, master? That way, you can absorb their comprehensions and cultivation attainments.'

'Yeah, you're right about that. I'll tell Shen Xueyi about it, so I won't order her loyalists to kill them right away.' Zhang Fei [1] then said to Ye Lian. "Lian'er, I can't train with you right now, but don't worry, I'll monitor your situation and accompany you once my business with Shen Haoran concludes.
For now, I will take these two people to another place, and they will definitely enjoy their lives there."
"All right, you can focus on your own business first, and I will focus on overcoming this gravity pressure."

After that, Zhang Fei [1] makes the decision to once again seal Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang's cultivation, leaving them perplexed about his intentions. However, their eyes widened as a gate appeared before them, and he immediately led the two of them into it.

In an instant, they had arrived at the Diyu Realm, and Zhang Fei [1] led the two of them directly to the Dryad Forest, which made Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang even more shocked when they saw the Dryards.

Zhang Fei [1] then took them to Lillea's private quarters, as he explained to them. "As you can see, we are in the lower demon realm now, but this realm is different from the realm of the demons who invaded the Sky Jade Realm in the past.
Anyway, all the humans who live here will slowly turn into demons, so you can forget about your life there, especially since you won't ever be able to go back there again."

chapters.title: Chapter 318: Night Before Wedding
paragraphs: "Hmm?" Lillea, who was lying down and relaxing in her wooden bed, was a little surprised by Zhang Fei [1]'s arrival. Her surprise intensified upon seeing Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang. "Why did you bring those two humans here? Did you forget that exposing them to the demon energy in this realm will gradually turn them into demons?"

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled at that. "They are my enemies, and they intend to torture me for the rest of my life. That's why I should retaliate and torture them for the rest of their lives, right? However, I don't like torturing them directly; they will feel tortured by themselves as they go through the process of becoming a demon."
'This guy is really evil!' Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang screamed in their hearts.

Lillea remembered about the science capsule, and Zhang Fei [1] could turn the two people into demons faster. However, she already knew him a little bit, and he was indeed a vengeful person. She immediately got out of bed and approached the two people.
"Anyway, the process of them turning into demons won't happen so quickly if you want them to transform naturally, but you can use external help to speed up the process."
"Demon or demon beast flesh, right?"

"Yes." Lillea nodded when she answered Zhang Fei [1]. "Their demon form will depend on the demon or demon beast flesh they consume, so it would be best if you first think about what kind of demon you want to use on them, especially for this woman."

Zhang Fei [1] agreed with that and nodded. "In fact, I still want to bring one woman here, but I'll do that later after I finish my business. Anyway, I don't have an idea for their demon forms yet, so I want you to imprison them for the time being, but you have to lock them up in a separate place."

Their conversation about their future left Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang speechless, and they would rather commit suicide than become demons. Unfortunately, they were Zhang Fei [1]'s slaves, and his demon slave mark would immediately stop them if they had such thoughts.

"Okay, I will imprison them in separate places, but it would be better if you decide on this matter as soon as possible." Lillea then summoned two people from her race to meet her and immediately ordered them to take Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang to their prison, and Zhang Fei [1] ordered the two to follow the dryads. "Fei-"

"We can't do that for now." Zhang Fei [1] stopped Lillea immediately because he knew her wishes. "This is my clone, so I don't want to be intimate with you, and I will meet you using my real body soon."

Lillea was momentarily stunned, unable to distinguish the real Zhang Fei from his clones due to their complete resemblance, with the exception of Feltia, who disguised herself as a succubus. "All right, I will wait for you to come see me again."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [1] then asked her. "Did Oz come to see you again?"

"Not yet." Lillea answered with a shake of her head. "Oz is probably still busy trying to persuade some other demon lords to side with him, but I will definitely let you know if he comes to me again."
"All right.".
Moments later, Zhang Fei [1] had already arrived at the Sky Jade Realm, but the sun was about to set, and he immediately took Zefyr out of the training space.

After that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately returned to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, but the situation within the sect was extremely lively with the presence of many guests. Moreover, the people from the sect have started preparing everything necessary for the wedding ceremony tomorrow morning, such as the altar, tables, chairs, and so on.

Since Zefyr didn't like meeting humans, Zhang Fei [1] immediately used his teleportation to return to his room in the inner disciples area. However, he couldn't find his partners, and they were all busy helping the elders.

Zhang Fei [1] then laid down on his bed with Zeyfr lying on his chest, and he immediately opened his map to check the guests' identities. There, he found some names he recognized, such as the Hai Twins, who were present along with some elders and disciples, some of whom were Ye Qianyu and Yue Lanxin.

Zhang Fei [1] also found representatives from the Heavenly Sword Sect, the Desolate Sect, and the Blazing Phoenix Sect, all of whom were male elders from the three sects and their families. In addition to them, he also discovered that many people from various clans from all regions were present, except for the northern region.

'Hmm?' When he saw the names of the Cai and You clans, Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows, especially since both clans were vassals of the Pang clan. 'They dare to come to the wedding, huh? However, Chang Wuhen still hasn't made a decision about the Cai Clan, so I'll hold back for the time being.
However, I have to be careful of them, especially since I don't know whether Pang De ordered them to do something or not.'
"Hey! Are you going into seclusion again?" Zefyr suddenly questioned Zhang Fei [1].

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] nodded to Zefyr. "After I finish dealing with Shen Haoran and the others, my original body will enter seclusion again with my wives, and this clone will also enter seclusion with my partners."

"I see." Zefyr nodded in understanding before speaking to him again. "In that case, I will join your original body inside the training space, and I want to practice using that gravity feature, so I can catch up with your wives."

"It's no big deal, and you can join my real body later." Zhang Fei [1] rubbed Zefyr's cheeks. "We met by chance, but we've been together for over a month, and I'm glad to have you by my side. Moreover, you're so eager to protect me, and our souls are connected to each other thanks to our contract, so how about you start using my yang qi to cultivate?
Besides, I will also impart my dual cultivation technique to you, so your cultivation will improve rapidly."
Zefyr immediately grabbed Zhang Fei [1]'s index finger with both her small hands and stared at him seriously. "Are you thinking of having me as your partner?"

"No." Zhang Fei [1] shook his head at Zefyr. "I don't want you to be my partner, but rather my wife. However, I know that you won't give yourself to me just like this, and I want to spend more time with you first so we can get to know and understand each other better. Even so, there's no harm in you learning my dual cultivation technique and swallowing my yang qi for now, right?"

"Yeah." Zephyr nodded at Zhang Fei. "Even though you are the heavenly fox, and I personally decided to make a contract with you, I have no thoughts of becoming your wife. I don't know what will happen in the future, but I might fall in love with you someday, especially if we've spent so much time together.
Anyway, I agree with you to learn your dual cultivation technique, and I will also use your yang qi to increase my cultivation, so I can become stronger faster to protect you."

Upon hearing that, Zhang Fei [1] smiled and imparted the Yin-Yang Flawless Art to Zefyr. However, he did not directly give his yang qi to Zefyr; instead, he would give it to her using his original self. "Do you want to join Lian'er now?"
"Yes." As soon as Mei opened the portal to the training space, Zefyr immediately flew into it, and he began training with Ye Lian at the one gravity level.
After Zefyr left, Zhang Fei [1] immediately closed his eyes and decided to rest, but he asked Mei to continue to monitor those people, especially Shen Haoran and his group.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 260 Demons.]
[Reward: 26,000 female essences are added to the balance.]
"Phew." Feltia let out a sigh of relief after she killed the last demon beast, and she immediately used her qi to collect their demon cores.
[You obtained 100 normal demon cores.]

"Not bad." At the last notification, Feltia murmured happily, then turned her gaze toward the three female demons, who were still sleeping in the distance after their sexual session. As for Tessa, she was fighting at a distance, as she didn't dare approach her. 'Hey, Mei! Is there something I can use to keep them sleeping long enough?'

[Master, you can use the shuizhe powder to put them to sleep, and they might sleep for one to two days because of its effects because they have no qi in their bodies. That way, you can go to the Sky Jade Realm, and you can also bring them back to the Shire Demon City faster.]
'Buy it then.'
[Alrighty.]
{You obtained shuizhe powder.}
{100 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.}

Following Mei's purchase, Feltia swiftly retrieved the shuizhe powder from the system inventory. Using her wind qi, she dispersed the powder towards the four demons, causing them to immediately inhale it.

Tessa tried to fight her sleepiness by fighting the demon beasts for a few minutes, but her sleepiness gradually became worse. She finally decided to take a little break a bit far from them, and she quickly closed her eyes before falling into a deep sleep.
Seeing that, Feltia immediately moved to Tessa's side to make sure that she was really asleep, and she then sent the four female demons into the training space. 'Open the gate, Mei.'

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was in Shen Xueyi's room, but they were not dual-cultivating as usual. Instead, she helped him put on his wedding dress and did his makeup as best she could.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: Chaos In The Sect I
paragraphs: When Zhang Fei arrived at the substitute's room, he found Shen Haoran there and handed him a bottle of green liquid. In addition, he also gave him an artifact to disguise his cultivation, as Shen Xueyi had previously guessed. "You must drink this liquid tomorrow morning; it will transform your face into my son's face.
However, the effect is only temporary, and you must leave this sect immediately once the wedding ceremony is over. Do you understand?"
"Yes... yes... I understand, Elder Shen."

"That's good." Shen Haoran then looked around the room using his senses, but unfortunately, he could not detect Zhang Fei's presence in the invisible state, and he immediately sealed the room before leaving.

"Phew." The man exhaled as he wiped the cold sweat on his forehead. "I don't understand why he did such a thing, but the reward he gave me is quite large, and I can take my father for treatment after this wedding ceremony is over."

Hearing that, Zhang Fei immediately used his demon eyes to examine the man's soul, and he nodded in understanding. 'This guy isn't bad, and he was willing to accept Shen Haoran's offer because he was in urgent need of money, so I won't kill him.'

After he made sure that there was no one else present in the surrounding area, Zhang Fei immediately showed himself to the substitute, startling him, especially since they were wearing the same wedding dress. "Who... who are you?"

"All right, you are a man, so don't act like a coward." Zhang Fei said to the substitute. "Moreover, I won't do anything to you, and I will help you get out of this place right now, so you can take your father away from this city right away. You may think that Shen Haoran will let you go, but your thoughts are wrong.
Instead, he will kill you after the wedding is over, so no one will know that he used a substitute for his son."

After hearing that, the substitute raised his eyebrows. He wanted to ask Zhang Fei, but he had already opened the portal out of the Yin-Yang Pavilion. "Trust me, you will die if you continue to stay here, so you should leave now. This portal will connect you to the outside area, so you can return to your home and take your father away from this city as soon as possible."
"But-"
"Leave!" As he activated his demon eyes, Zhang Fei interrupted the substitute. "If you don't leave now, I'll kill you myself."

Hearing Zhang Fei's threat, the substitute entered the portal without thinking twice, and he felt relieved that he had arrived right outside the sect, so he immediately took off the wedding dress and hurriedly left the area.
After he closed the portal, Zhang Fei immediately transformed himself into the substitute and lay on the bed, waiting for the auspicious hour to arrive.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 5,800 Qi]
[Reward: 58 green jewels.]

Zhang Fei sighed slightly after the notification appeared, but he immediately opened his map and used the nature awareness ability at the same time, making countless Qi threads appear before his eyes, and he started to check the Qi of the guests one by one.

"This ability, which I acquired through a contract with Zefyr, is truly exceptional, enabling me to discern the strength of each guest's Qi and elements with ease. Anyway, Mei, what do you think will happen if I cut these Qi threads? Do you think it will affect those people?"
[I don't have a definitive answer for that, master. It would be better if you tried cutting one of them, and you can see the results for yourself.]

Zhang Fei nodded slightly before reaching for a green qi thread, which belonged to the patriarch of the Cai Clan, Cai Shangjun. He then used his fire qi to create a dagger before cutting it, but he was disappointed because it immediately reconnected. "Sigh! Unfortunately, it doesn't have any effect."

[Ha ha! If it had any effect, Master, you would be overpowered, and you could easily cripple all living beings in this universe. However, it wouldn't be fun, right? That way, you won't have any opponents, so you'll have a hard time finding opponents and motivation to get stronger.]

"Well, you're right." Zhang Fei replied with a nod of agreement. "Even though there are so many cultivators, beasts, or demons who can kill me easily now, I still don't want my life to be that easy. Moreover, defeating and killing them with my own hands is much more enjoyable, and I also have a goal to continue improving myself."
[Are you really going into seclusion again after this, Master?]
"Yeah." Zhang Fei then opened the system and read his status. "My cultivation is nearly at the 3-Star Soul Realm, but it is still not enough, and I need to reach the Earth Realm as soon as possible.

If I have reached that stage and I use the soul connect to borrow fifty percent of Boitata's power, then it won't be difficult for me to fight against cultivators in the Heaven Realm like Shen Haoran, so I can take care of them without wasting too much time. My demon rank has also almost risen to the Earl rank, and it might increase even faster if I manage to get Ashreth.

Even more so, if I manage to obtain the Amaris Twins, I plan to use them to accelerate my rank increase. Unfortunately, I'm still having trouble upgrading my beast rank, and I'm sure that the amount of beast essence I need to evolve to the six tails will increase several times more than to the five tails, so I need more female beasts to help me."

[You are right, Master. I estimate that you will probably need around eight to ten million beast essences to evolve to six tails. For now, the Shen Ancestors are your best choice, but Shen Xinya is currently the most feasible option, as she has expressed her desire to dual-cultivate with you, and she has peeked at your dual-cultivation several times.
As for Shen Huang, you might still need to put in a lot of effort to win her over, particularly given her complete disinterest in pursuing romantic relationships.]

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei, and he himself had already planned to target Shen Xinya first. However, he didn't want to make a move on her right away, and he preferred to wait for her to give herself to him.

"Shen Huang, huh? I think I'll visit her later in her cultivation cave, and I'll definitely make her accept me." Zhang Fei then monitored those guests again using his map, and he discovered that Chu Liuxiang had just arrived with his third wife. "Fortunately, the last time I dual-cultivated with Qingyu was a few days ago, and she must have already purged my yang qi from her body.
That way, Yuan Manqiu shouldn't be able to detect it, or she would have reported it to Chu Hong, which would make the situation complicated."

Zhang Fei suddenly received a voice transmission from Liu Hua, who told him that everything was ready, and they could move whenever he wanted. In addition, she also told him that Chu Ying and Chu Qing were already at the Liu Clan, and Liu Qingyu would take them to the Yin-Yang Pavilion.

As for herself, she had no intention of going in, and she was on standby with her other clan members outside the sect. "Now everything is ready, and I just need to wait for the wedding hour to arrive."

Meanwhile, Shen Haoran is holding a meeting with his loyalists, during which he is providing them with final instructions regarding the long-planned plan. "Once their marriage ends, I will immediately capture Shen Yu, and I will use her to force Shen Xueyi to surrender to me, including handing over our clan seal to me.

That way, I will become our next clan leader, and we will start to get rid of her loyalists one by one. Even so, we will retain some of those who are willing to submit to me, and one of the main ones is Zhiyu Fengzhi, especially since we need his medical skills."
All of them nodded in agreement with Shen Haoran, but an elderly man abruptly spoke to him. "Haoran, I somehow feel that we have overlooked some things, and I think today will not be easy for us."
"What do you mean by that, Shen Ye?" Shen Haoran inquired with a raised eyebrow.

Shen Ye asked Shen Ye back. "Do you think Shen Xueyi will just stand by and do nothing? Indeed, we haven't seen her make any moves in recent times, but I'm sure that she has prepared a lot of things to counter our plans without us knowing, so it would be better if we were more careful and not overconfident in our plans."

"Moreover, the situation that Tianyu and Shixi are facing is unusual, and we have still not managed to find the perpetrator who did those things to them." Shen Haoran immediately turned his head toward an old woman named Shen Yuan. "If my guess is correct, the perpetrator must have some connection with Shen Xueyi, but the person is unlikely to be one of her loyalists.
Instead, she used the help of people from outside our sect, especially since none of her loyalists have the ability to deceive our guards, except for Shen Huang and Shen Xinya."

Another old man also spoke to Shen Haoran. "Also, Shen Shixi's condition makes me think that the perpetrator has enslaved her, especially since she became so painful as soon as he wanted to answer us.

However, I don't understand how Shen Xueyi could find someone with such an ability, especially since she never left our sect, and slavery techniques are typically associated with the darkness element, a common trait among people from the Pang Clan.
Shen Haoran fell into thought for a while before asking the old man, "Do you suspect that Shen Xueyi is affiliated with that heretic clan, Shen Ge?"

"No." Shen Ge denied it by shaking his head. "We all know that Shen Xueyi hates the Pang Clan as much as the other cultivators, so I'm sure that she won't form any relationship with them. However, it is important to note that the darkness cultivators are not limited to the people of the Pang Clan. There are numerous other darkness cultivators in our realm.

Therefore, I believe that she may have a connection with one of these individuals, who may have assisted her in enslaving Shen Shixi. Even so, I can't say for sure about this matter, especially since I don't have any evidence to support my suspicion."

"Forget it; we don't have time to find out that person's identity, especially since the wedding is only a few hours away. For now, we just need to focus on successfully executing our plan, or we will be the ones to suffer the worst." Shen Haoran then stood up and walked away, but he stopped in front of the door and said something to one of them.
"Shen Xiu, your abilities are different from ours, so I want you to stay by Shen Yu's side when the wedding begins, and you must not take your eyes off her for even a second.
"Yes, Uncle Haoran." Despite her youthful appearance, Shen Xiu was actually the same age as Shen Yu, and the two were also cousins because their fathers were blood siblings.

Unfortunately, Shen Xiu had a high level of jealousy, and she always felt jealous of Shen Yu because she got more special treatment just because she was Shen Xueyi's daughter, so she decided to join Shen Haoran because he was willing to provide more resources for her.
After that, Shen Xiu immediately followed Shen Haoran to leave the room, as did his other loyalists, and all of them immediately moved to their positions to get ready.

Shen Xiu proceeded directly to Shen Yu's room, but Shen Xueyi and the others prevented her from entering, particularly because they knew which side she had chosen, forcing her to wait in front of his room. 'Tch! You can be arrogant now! However, after you guys fall into Uncle Haoran's hands, the situation will change completely, and I won't have to live in that little bitch's shadow anymore.'
A few hours later, the sun began to shine on the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and Shen Xueyi immediately led Shen Yu to go to the wedding ceremony location, followed by Shen Huang and Shen Xinya behind them.
Shen Haoran himself had gone to the substitute's room and brought him to that place, but unfortunately, he still did not realize that Zhang Fei had replaced that person.
In addition, the artifact that Shen Xueyi gave to Zhang Fei made Shen Haoran not suspect him at all, especially since the artifact hid his true cultivation, and his disguise was absolutely perfect.

While they were on their way to the place, Zhang Fei secretly used the plant generation ability to create something, which he immediately spread out using his wind qi, and it was immediately inhaled by Shen Haoran.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 5,800 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 58 green jewels sent to inventory.]
