Hearing Zhang Fei's threat, the substitute entered the portal without thinking twice, and he felt relieved that he had arrived right outside the sect, so he immediately took off the wedding dress and hurriedly left the area.
After he closed the portal, Zhang Fei immediately transformed himself into the substitute and lay on the bed, waiting for the auspicious hour to arrive.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 5,800 Qi]
[Reward: 58 green jewels.]

Zhang Fei sighed slightly after the notification appeared, but he immediately opened his map and used the nature awareness ability at the same time, making countless Qi threads appear before his eyes, and he started to check the Qi of the guests one by one.
"This ability, which I acquired through a contract with Zefyr, is truly exceptional, enabling me to discern the strength of each guest's Qi and elements with ease.
Anyway, Mei, what do you think will happen if I cut these Qi threads?
Do you think it will affect those people?"
[I don't have a definitive answer for that, master.
It would be better if you tried cutting one of them, and you can see the results for yourself.]
Zhang Fei nodded slightly before reaching for a green qi thread, which belonged to the patriarch of the Cai Clan, Cai Shangjun.
He then used his fire qi to create a dagger before cutting it, but he was disappointed because it immediately reconnected.
"Sigh!
Unfortunately, it doesn't have any effect."
[Ha ha!
If it had any effect, Master, you would be overpowered, and you could easily cripple all living beings in this universe.
However, it wouldn't be fun, right?
That way, you won't have any opponents, so you'll have a hard time finding opponents and motivation to get stronger.]
"Well, you're right." Zhang Fei replied with a nod of agreement.
"Even though there are so many cultivators, beasts, or demons who can kill me easily now, I still don't want my life to be that easy.
Moreover, defeating and killing them with my own hands is much more enjoyable, and I also have a goal to continue improving myself."
[Are you really going into seclusion again after this, Master?]
"Yeah." Zhang Fei then opened the system and read his status.
"My cultivation is nearly at the 3-Star Soul Realm, but it is still not enough, and I need to reach the Earth Realm as soon as possible.

If I have reached that stage and I use the soul connect to borrow fifty percent of Boitata's power, then it won't be difficult for me to fight against cultivators in the Heaven Realm like Shen Haoran, so I can take care of them without wasting too much time.
My demon rank has also almost risen to the Earl rank, and it might increase even faster if I manage to get Ashreth.
Even more so, if I manage to obtain the Amaris Twins, I plan to use them to accelerate my rank increase.

Unfortunately, I'm still having trouble upgrading my beast rank, and I'm sure that the amount of beast essence I need to evolve to the six tails will increase several times more than to the five tails, so I need more female beasts to help me."
[You are right, Master.
I estimate that you will probably need around eight to ten million beast essences to evolve to six tails.

For now, the Shen Ancestors are your best choice, but Shen Xinya is currently the most feasible option, as she has expressed her desire to dual-cultivate with you, and she has peeked at your dual-cultivation several times.
As for Shen Huang, you might still need to put in a lot of effort to win her over, particularly given her complete disinterest in pursuing romantic relationships.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei, and he himself had already planned to target Shen Xinya first.
However, he didn't want to make a move on her right away, and he preferred to wait for her to give herself to him.
"Shen Huang, huh?

I think I'll visit her later in her cultivation cave, and I'll definitely make her accept me." Zhang Fei then monitored those guests again using his map, and he discovered that Chu Liuxiang had just arrived with his third wife.
"Fortunately, the last time I dual-cultivated with Qingyu was a few days ago, and she must have already purged my yang qi from her body.
That way, Yuan Manqiu shouldn't be able to detect it, or she would have reported it to Chu Hong, which would make the situation complicated."
Zhang Fei suddenly received a voice transmission from Liu Hua, who told him that everything was ready, and they could move whenever he wanted.
In addition, she also told him that Chu Ying and Chu Qing were already at the Liu Clan, and Liu Qingyu would take them to the Yin-Yang Pavilion.
As for herself, she had no intention of going in, and she was on standby with her other clan members outside the sect.
"Now everything is ready, and I just need to wait for the wedding hour to arrive."
Meanwhile, Shen Haoran is holding a meeting with his loyalists, during which he is providing them with final instructions regarding the long-planned plan.
"Once their marriage ends, I will immediately capture Shen Yu, and I will use her to force Shen Xueyi to surrender to me, including handing over our clan seal to me.
That way, I will become our next clan leader, and we will start to get rid of her loyalists one by one.
Even so, we will retain some of those who are willing to submit to me, and one of the main ones is Zhiyu Fengzhi, especially since we need his medical skills."
All of them nodded in agreement with Shen Haoran, but an elderly man abruptly spoke to him.
"Haoran, I somehow feel that we have overlooked some things, and I think today will not be easy for us."
"What do you mean by that, Shen Ye?" Shen Haoran inquired with a raised eyebrow.
Shen Ye asked Shen Ye back.
"Do you think Shen Xueyi will just stand by and do nothing?

Indeed, we haven't seen her make any moves in recent times, but I'm sure that she has prepared a lot of things to counter our plans without us knowing, so it would be better if we were more careful and not overconfident in our plans."

"Moreover, the situation that Tianyu and Shixi are facing is unusual, and we have still not managed to find the perpetrator who did those things to them." Shen Haoran immediately turned his head toward an old woman named Shen Yuan.
"If my guess is correct, the perpetrator must have some connection with Shen Xueyi, but the person is unlikely to be one of her loyalists.
Instead, she used the help of people from outside our sect, especially since none of her loyalists have the ability to deceive our guards, except for Shen Huang and Shen Xinya."
Another old man also spoke to Shen Haoran.
"Also, Shen Shixi's condition makes me think that the perpetrator has enslaved her, especially since she became so painful as soon as he wanted to answer us.

However, I don't understand how Shen Xueyi could find someone with such an ability, especially since she never left our sect, and slavery techniques are typically associated with the darkness element, a common trait among people from the Pang Clan.
Shen Haoran fell into thought for a while before asking the old man, "Do you suspect that Shen Xueyi is affiliated with that heretic clan, Shen Ge?"
"No." Shen Ge denied it by shaking his head.
"We all know that Shen Xueyi hates the Pang Clan as much as the other cultivators, so I'm sure that she won't form any relationship with them.
However, it is important to note that the darkness cultivators are not limited to the people of the Pang Clan.
There are numerous other darkness cultivators in our realm.
Therefore, I believe that she may have a connection with one of these individuals, who may have assisted her in enslaving Shen Shixi.
Even so, I can't say for sure about this matter, especially since I don't have any evidence to support my suspicion."
"Forget it; we don't have time to find out that person's identity, especially since the wedding is only a few hours away.

For now, we just need to focus on successfully executing our plan, or we will be the ones to suffer the worst." Shen Haoran then stood up and walked away, but he stopped in front of the door and said something to one of them.
"Shen Xiu, your abilities are different from ours, so I want you to stay by Shen Yu's side when the wedding begins, and you must not take your eyes off her for even a second.
"Yes, Uncle Haoran." Despite her youthful appearance, Shen Xiu was actually the same age as Shen Yu, and the two were also cousins because their fathers were blood siblings.

Unfortunately, Shen Xiu had a high level of jealousy, and she always felt jealous of Shen Yu because she got more special treatment just because she was Shen Xueyi's daughter, so she decided to join Shen Haoran because he was willing to provide more resources for her.
After that, Shen Xiu immediately followed Shen Haoran to leave the room, as did his other loyalists, and all of them immediately moved to their positions to get ready.

Shen Xiu proceeded directly to Shen Yu's room, but Shen Xueyi and the others prevented her from entering, particularly because they knew which side she had chosen, forcing her to wait in front of his room. 'Tch!
You can be arrogant now!
However, after you guys fall into Uncle Haoran's hands, the situation will change completely, and I won't have to live in that little bitch's shadow anymore.'
A few hours later, the sun began to shine on the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and Shen Xueyi immediately led Shen Yu to go to the wedding ceremony location, followed by Shen Huang and Shen Xinya behind them.
Shen Haoran himself had gone to the substitute's room and brought him to that place, but unfortunately, he still did not realize that Zhang Fei had replaced that person.
In addition, the artifact that Shen Xueyi gave to Zhang Fei made Shen Haoran not suspect him at all, especially since the artifact hid his true cultivation, and his disguise was absolutely perfect.

While they were on their way to the place, Zhang Fei secretly used the plant generation ability to create something, which he immediately spread out using his wind qi, and it was immediately inhaled by Shen Haoran.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 5,800 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 58 green jewels sent to inventory.]

After he completed the daily quest, Zhang Fei [1] immediately left his room and went to another area, where he met up with Feltia, and the two of them got ready to move once the wedding ceremony was over.
"Now we just have to wait, and the situation will be so lively once the ceremony is over.

chapters.title: Chapter 320: Chaos In The Sect II
paragraphs: *Gong... Gong...*

The gong continued to resound in the wedding area, accompanied by melodious music. In addition, multiple groups of people showcased various performances, including sword dances and lion dances. Several female dancers also performed their dances, showcasing their beautiful bodies.

Meanwhile, the guests had already filled all the tables and seats prepared by the people from the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and there were already several jugs of wine and light dishes on each table. As for the main dishes, Shen Xueyi ordered them to wait until the wedding ceremony was over.
Six women gathered in an area not far from the wedding venue, looking around, but they appeared confused when they couldn't find the person they were looking for.

"Hey, guys, is Brother Fei still not back?" Xia Qianqian then pointed to the crowd in the distance, indicating that the bride and groom would soon arrive at the altar. "Look at them! Senior Sister Shen Yu is going to marry Shen Tianhu soon, and he will definitely be late if he still doesn't return."
"Ha ha." Gu Yan laughed upon hearing that. "Qianqian, you still don't understand Fei's character, huh?"
Du Yuan also spoke with Xia Xianqian. "Fei has already claimed that Shen Yu is his, and he is actually quite possessive, so it is impossible for him to let her marry Shen Tianyu."

"That's right." Ning Xiang nodded in agreement with the two women. "In fact, Fei is probably in the sect right now, but he intentionally hid his presence from everyone, including not contacting us, especially since Shen Haoran tried to kill him a month ago."

"Hey! I feel something familiar about Shen Tianyu." They immediately turned to Luo Yu with raised eyebrows. "Unlike you guys, I'm a beast, and I'm very familiar with Fei's body odor, and I smell his scent on him."

"Do you believe Brother Fei intentionally disguised himself as that man, Sister Yu?" How could he do that? Wouldn't that put him in danger?" Yun Kexin inquired as she observed Shen Tianyu's group moving at a slow pace.

Luo Yu turned to Yun Kexin and rubbed her head. "Have you forgotten what he did to Yin Tong and Ni Weiwei? Shen Haoran and the others are indeed strong, but Fei has all sorts of tricks up his sleeve. Moreover, you already know that he is a fox beast, and I can tell that his bloodline is far superior to theirs.

So there is no need to worry that he will be in danger, especially since he can suppress them using his bloodline. However, he will not be able to suppress them all at once, so he may have prepared some other things to deal with them, and we will surely see the results soon."

After all, Yun Kexin had not been Zhang Fei [1]'s partner for very long, and he had gone wandering in the eastern region after they got together, so her knowledge about him came from Luo Yu and the others. "I hope that Shen Tianyu is really fake, so Brother Fei will marry Senior Sister Yu today."
*Clap... Clap... Clap...*
A thunderous applause immediately greeted the bride and groom as they arrived at the area, and both of them immediately walked up to the pulpit to begin their wedding ceremony procession.
Her mother and grandmother accompanied Shen Xueyi, who sat on the left side with a relaxed expression and continued to smile at the guests.

Shen Haoran, along with his wife, Shen Xiwu, were seated on the right side. Unlike Shen Xueyi, both of them seemed impatient to wait for the wedding to be over, and they could immediately carry out their plans to take over the Shen Clan from her hands.
Regrettably, Shen Haoran and Shen Xiwu remain unaware of the unraveling of their plan and the fate that awaits them after the wedding.
As Shen Haoran ordered, Shen Xiu kept standing near Shen Yu without taking her eyes off her cousin for even a second, and she was also ready to do something to her.
After the auspicious hour arrived, Shen Haoran immediately ordered the wedding host to start the event, especially since he was too impatient to execute his plans.
The majority of the guests seemed excited about their wedding; they were eager to give the bride and groom the gifts they had prepared in hopes of improving their relationship with the Shen Clan.

However, there were some guests who seemed to dislike their wedding, and their eyes showed that they had prepared unpleasant surprises for the bride and groom. Even their eyes were constantly moving to monitor the surrounding area as they looked for a way to execute their surprise.
After receiving orders from Shen Haoran, the wedding host immediately spoke to the guests, explaining about Shen Tianyu and Shen Yu's relationship from the beginning to the decision to get married.
Following that, similar to other weddings, the bride and groom share a cup of tea and then pour it while requesting their parents' blessing.

Even though Shen Haoran and Shen Xiwu were not his parents, Zhang Fei could not care about that. He kept glancing at Shen Yu, who also glanced at him repeatedly, and a beaming smile spread perfectly, showing their happiness.
In front of all the guests, the master of ceremonies was doing his best to lead them, and the bow-exchanging ceremony began.
"Bow to heaven and earth!"
"Bow to the ancestors!"
"Bow to the parents!"
"Husband and wife exchange bows!"

As soon as the master of ceremonies announced that their wedding ceremony was over, Shen Haoran and Shen Xiwu intended to capture Shen Yu immediately, and Shen Xiu was also ready to move to help them.

Before they could move, Zhang Fei had already grabbed Shen Yu's hand and taken his new wife out of their sight using his teleportation ability, shocking not only Shen Haoran's group but also the guests.
Shen Xueyi and the Shen Ancestors only smiled as they watched them disappear, but Shen Haoran and Shen Xiwu immediately spread their senses to search for the bride and groom.

Unfortunately, their search was futile, as Zhang Fei took Shen Yu into an invisible state, making it impossible for their senses to locate the two. Immediately, Shen Haoran unleashed a thunderous roar that deafened the guests. "Tianyu! Bastard! Get back here right now!"

When he received no response, Shen Haoran immediately ordered his loyalists to move. Simultaneously, Shen Xueyi ordered her loyalists to stop them, causing the guests to hear their fight from a distance and wonder what exactly transpired between them.
Unlike cultivators who came from other regions, the people from the southern region knew more or less about the power struggle within the Shen Clan, so they were not too surprised by it.

The incident caused the people, who had previously prepared unpleasant surprises for the Shen Clan, to immediately cancel their intention, as they felt that the situation would not be suitable for carrying out their plan.

"Haha." Shen Xueyi suddenly laughed as she stood up, causing Shen Haoran and Shen Xiwu to turn to her with darkened faces. She then casually questions them. "Are you guys surprised by this situation? Do you think that I don't know anything about your plans?"
"You bitch!" Shen Haoran cursed angrily as he released his strength, and Shen Xiwu also followed her husband by releasing her full strength.

However, Shen Xueyi and the Shen Ancestors responded to their actions by releasing their strengths, making Shen Haoran and Shen Xiwu think twice about attacking, especially since the three of them were one minor stage above their cultivation, so the position was not favorable for them.

Shen Xueyi then spoke to Shen Haoran again. "At first, I did intend to hand over the leadership of our clan to you, but I changed my mind after Yu'er found a husband based on her heart's desire. Since then, I have decided to maintain the leadership of this clan, and I will also get rid of you all once and for all."
Most of the guests were even more shocked by Shen Xueyi's words, but some were also relieved, particularly because the Shen Clan would be weak if she truly eliminated Shen Haoran and his loyalists.

Suddenly, a sweet and intoxicating scent filled the air, but the guests didn't feel strange about themselves. Instead, after inhaling it, they experienced a slight dizziness similar to that of a drunk person.
"Ugh!" After the powder's effect became active, Shen Haoran suddenly groaned in pain, and all of his nerves began to breakdown, making it difficult for him to control his body.

Not only did the scent affect him, but it also affected some of Shen Haoran's loyalists who were moving their supplies out of the room, causing them to have nervous breakdowns. As a result, Shen Xueyi's loyalists, who were fighting with them, killed them directly.
Shen Xiwu panicked after seeing her husband, and she tried to support Shen Haoran. "What happened to you? Why did you suddenly become like this?"
"You... you ordered Shixi to give us the powder, right?" Shen Haoran asked as he pointed his finger at Shen Xueyi.

Before Shen Xueyi answered him, Shen Haoran and others suddenly heard a voice from a distance. "Unfortunately, you are wrong about that, Old Man. My mother-in-law did nothing because I was the one who arranged everything, and I only asked her to prepare her people to stop your loyalists."

Upon hearing that, Shen Haoran and everyone present at the scene immediately turned to look at Zhang Fei, who was hugging Shen Yu in the distance. However, when they saw his two clones, they were momentarily stunned, particularly because all three of them were identical, including in their cultivation.
Among the guests, only Yi Na and the Hai Twins were not surprised to see his two clones, especially since they already knew that Zhang Fei had such an amazing clone technique.

Zhang Fei [1]'s six partners, who were watching his actions from a distance, also smiled happily at his appearance. However, they were aware that his actions this time would change many things within their sect, and they were certain that the previously passive female disciples would start approaching him after he demonstrated his abilities today.
"Fei!"
The screams of the two women immediately brought them back to their senses, and they could see the Chu Sisters flying towards Zhang Fei, and they then stood behind the real him.

A few seconds later, Liu Hua floated down from the sky and landed beside her husband, and she immediately shot her Qi into the air, signaling the people from the Liu Clan to charge into the Yin-Yang Pavilion.
*Drap... Drap... Drap...*

Quickly, the sound of dozens of people running was heard in their ears, and the powerful cultivators from the Liu Clan immediately surrounded the altar to block their path from the ground and air, causing Shen Haoran and Shen Xiwu's expressions to turn completely ugly.

Chu Liuxiang and Yuan Manqiu immediately turned to look at Liu Qingyu, who was sitting beside them, and she responded to their gazes with a smile. "You two don't need to be surprised by this, father and mother-in-law. Zhang Fei has been planning everything for a long time, and he is the son-in-law of our Liu and Chu Clans, so we will naturally help him deal with them."
After saying that, Liu Qingyu immediately flew towards Zhang Fei, landed beside him, and then looked at him with a questioning expression.
Zhang Fei nodded at Liu Qingyu before soaring into the sky, and his two clones also spread out in two different directions, leaving Shen Haoran and the guests wondering about their next move.
Zhang Fei then took a deep breath before using his qi to shout to the people fighting in the distance. "Stop this useless fight now!"

Hearing that, the rest of Shen Haoran's loyalists immediately stopped fighting with Shen Xueyi's loyalists, but they did not immediately surrender and gathered behind their leader to protect him and Shen Xiwu.

Shen Xueyi's loyalists did the same, and they all gathered behind her and the Shen Ancestors. However, Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, and Shi Yue repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei, but their expressions were a little annoyed because he didn't tell them he was back.

Upon their gathering, Zhang Fei and his two clones immediately unleashed their heavenly fox aura, suppresing Shen Haoran and his loyalists to the ground. However, they controlled their aura well, so Shen Xueyi and her loyalists, who were mostly beasts, were not affected by the pressure of their aura.

Zhang Fei then sharpened his eyes and spoke to Shen Haoran. "Hey, Old Man! Have you realized how I killed the ten people you sent to kill me a month ago? You guys are indeed stronger than me in cultivation, but your bloodline is just a puny bloodline in front of mine."
"Bastard!" Shen Haoran shouted angrily after hearing that. "You are just a weakling who used despicable means to defeat us!"

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed when he heard that. "Aren't you a hypocrite? My cultivation is only in the Soul Realm, but you sent ten cultivators in the Earth Realm to kill me. Since you did such a thing against me, I should return it to you several times over, right? Unfortunately, it is too late for you to regret it, because you and your loyalists will go to the afterlife soon."

Shen Haoran was really furious after hearing that, but he also couldn't put up any resistance under the pressure of the aura from Zhang Fei and his two clones. Moreover, almost all of his nerves had already broken down, and he was still lucky to be alive.

Seeing them like that, Shen Xueyi immediately ordered her loyalists to seal the cultivation of Shen Haoran and the others, and Yan Luan'er was the first to move, especially since he hated them so much. Xi Zihua and the others also moved to help her, and they then took them all to the prison to await their punishment.

After they disappeared, Shen Xueyi immediately spoke to the guests. "I apologize for the disturbance, but I was forced to do this because Shen Haoran and the others never let down their guard, so today is the best opportunity for us."

Among the guests, only Yi Na and the Hai Twins were not surprised to see his two clones, especially since they already knew that Zhang Fei had such an amazing clone technique.
Zhang Fei [1]'s six partners, who were watching his actions from a distance, also smiled happily at his appearance.

However, they were aware that his actions this time would change many things within their sect, and they were certain that the previously passive female disciples would start approaching him after he demonstrated his abilities today.
"Fei!"
The screams of the two women immediately brought them back to their senses, and they could see the Chu Sisters flying towards Zhang Fei, and they then stood behind the real him.

A few seconds later, Liu Hua floated down from the sky and landed beside her husband, and she immediately shot her Qi into the air, signaling the people from the Liu Clan to charge into the Yin-Yang Pavilion.
*Drap...
Drap...
Drap...*

Quickly, the sound of dozens of people running was heard in their ears, and the powerful cultivators from the Liu Clan immediately surrounded the altar to block their path from the ground and air, causing Shen Haoran and Shen Xiwu's expressions to turn completely ugly.
Chu Liuxiang and Yuan Manqiu immediately turned to look at Liu Qingyu, who was sitting beside them, and she responded to their gazes with a smile.
"You two don't need to be surprised by this, father and mother-in-law.
Zhang Fei has been planning everything for a long time, and he is the son-in-law of our Liu and Chu Clans, so we will naturally help him deal with them."
After saying that, Liu Qingyu immediately flew towards Zhang Fei, landed beside him, and then looked at him with a questioning expression.
Zhang Fei nodded at Liu Qingyu before soaring into the sky, and his two clones also spread out in two different directions, leaving Shen Haoran and the guests wondering about their next move.
Zhang Fei then took a deep breath before using his qi to shout to the people fighting in the distance.
"Stop this useless fight now!"

Hearing that, the rest of Shen Haoran's loyalists immediately stopped fighting with Shen Xueyi's loyalists, but they did not immediately surrender and gathered behind their leader to protect him and Shen Xiwu.
Shen Xueyi's loyalists did the same, and they all gathered behind her and the Shen Ancestors.
However, Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, and Shi Yue repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei, but their expressions were a little annoyed because he didn't tell them he was back.
Upon their gathering, Zhang Fei and his two clones immediately unleashed their heavenly fox aura, suppresing Shen Haoran and his loyalists to the ground.
However, they controlled their aura well, so Shen Xueyi and her loyalists, who were mostly beasts, were not affected by the pressure of their aura.
Zhang Fei then sharpened his eyes and spoke to Shen Haoran.
"Hey, Old Man!
Have you realized how I killed the ten people you sent to kill me a month ago?
You guys are indeed stronger than me in cultivation, but your bloodline is just a puny bloodline in front of mine."
"Bastard!" Shen Haoran shouted angrily after hearing that.
"You are just a weakling who used despicable means to defeat us!"
"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed when he heard that.
"Aren't you a hypocrite?
My cultivation is only in the Soul Realm, but you sent ten cultivators in the Earth Realm to kill me.
Since you did such a thing against me, I should return it to you several times over, right?
Unfortunately, it is too late for you to regret it, because you and your loyalists will go to the afterlife soon."
Shen Haoran was really furious after hearing that, but he also couldn't put up any resistance under the pressure of the aura from Zhang Fei and his two clones.
Moreover, almost all of his nerves had already broken down, and he was still lucky to be alive.

Seeing them like that, Shen Xueyi immediately ordered her loyalists to seal the cultivation of Shen Haoran and the others, and Yan Luan'er was the first to move, especially since he hated them so much.
Xi Zihua and the others also moved to help her, and they then took them all to the prison to await their punishment.
After they disappeared, Shen Xueyi immediately spoke to the guests.
"I apologize for the disturbance, but I was forced to do this because Shen Haoran and the others never let down their guard, so today is the best opportunity for us."

chapters.title: Chapter 321: Zhang Fei's Revelation
paragraphs: "Mistress Shen, can you introduce your son-in-law to us?" An old man, who was the Cai Clan's ancestor, suddenly asked Shen Xueyi.

Shen Xueyi turned to her son-in-law first because she didn't know whether he wanted to reveal his identity to the public or not, but Zhang Fei immediately told the old man himself. "Cai Shangjun, my name is Zhang Fei, and I am a disciple of the Yin-Yang Pavilion."

After Zhang Fei told them his name, Cai Shangjun and the guests present looked at him with doubt and confusion, especially since most of them knew about the Zhang Clan but had never heard of his name in the clan before.

As if understanding their thoughts, Zhang Fei spoke to them again. "You shouldn't be confused about my identity because I'm not a main Zhang Clan member in the Central Region, but Zhang Lingxue is one of my wives."

Zhang Fei's confession caused the atmosphere among the guests to become silent, but their expressions clearly showed that they did not believe him, especially Cai Shangjun. After all, his Cai Clan was the in-law of the Chang Clan, so he knew that Zhang Long only had a son and a daughter. However, he had never heard that Zhang Lingxue was married, and only Zhang Wuji was married to Zi'er.

Some representatives from the Blazing Phoenix Sect also did not believe Zhang Fei, especially since Zhang Lingxue had not announced their relationship to the people from her sect, and Feng Yao was the only one who knew about their relationship.

"Since you guys don't believe me, I'll prove it to you." Zhang Fei then sent a voice transmission to Zhang Lingxue and asked her to prepare to go to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, but she told him that Zhao Ziqin had just come out of her seclusion, so he asked her to bring her along.
The guests were surprised by the portal that suddenly opened in front of them, but they were even more surprised when Zhang Lingxue walked out, followed by two other women.

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows when he saw the third woman, and he certainly recognized her identity, which was none other than Chang Wenjie. She was the same woman who had forcibly kissed him when they first met at the Blazing Volcano Mountain two months ago, and she had also forced him into accompanying her to the Central Region to marry her, which he had rejected at the time.

Cai Shangjun naturally recognized his granddaughter's identity, but he did not recognize Zhao Ziqin, especially since she had never left the Zhao Clan in the past and had always locked herself up in her clan.

The representatives of the Heavenly Sword Sect and the clans from the western region certainly knew about Zhao Ziqin, but they did not expect that she would go to the Central Region and become a disciple of the Blazing Phoenix Sect, especially since she was also wearing the disciple uniform of that sect.

Noticing Zhang Fei's glance at her, Chang Wenjie became awkward, and red hues adorned her cheeks, especially after she remembered her boldness to kiss him and show him her naked body two months ago. 'Sigh! It seems he still doesn't like me, and I heard from my master that his women are also increasing now.'
"Fei." Zhao Ziqin called out to Zhang Fei softly before approaching him, but she immediately hugged and kissed his lips in front of dozens of guests.

Zhang Fei realized Zhao Ziqin's longing for him, so he immediately hugged his waist and returned his kiss, regardless of the guests' shocked gazes. The two kissed for quite a while before he separated their lips. "How are you? Do you know that I miss you? Unfortunately, Lingxue told me that you were still immersed in your seclusion, so I didn't disturb you."
"Hehe." Zhao Ziqin giggled and rubbed her face against Zhang Fei's chest. "I missed you too, so I asked Big Sister Lingxue to bring me here, and I have decided to stay with you for a while."

"That's good! I'll be going into seclusion again in a few days, so you can join us, and I'll help you catch up with your other sisters." Zhao Ziqin responded with a nod, and Zhang Fei then looked at the guests again. "If you guys still have doubts about my relationship with Lingxue, then you can ask her directly."

Before they had the chance to question her, Zhang Lingxue had already approached Zhang Fei and briefly kissed his lips, shocking everyone, particularly the representatives of the Blazing Phoenix Sect, with the truth of their relationship. "As you can see, I am indeed one of his wives, and I am not ashamed to share a husband with several women."

The guests began to murmur in shock as they kept looking at Zhang Fei and the others, but Zhang Lingxue's next revelation caused them to be even more shocked by his relationships. "As you have witnessed before, my husband has married Shen Yu today, so he is a member of the Shen Clan now.
Aside from the three of us, he is also the husband of Liu Hua, Chu Ying, Chu Xing, and Ye Lian, so he is also a member of their three clans."
Hearing Zhang Lingxue mention their names, Liu Hua and the Chu Sisters moved to their side and stood behind Zhang Fei, proving that their relationship was real.

Zhang Fei was observing the guests' expressions, but he noticed that some of them seemed upset about his relationships with the six clans, so he used his demon eyes to examine them, especially the people from the Cai and You clans. 'Cai Shangjun! You guys can still live freely now, but I'll make my move once Chang Wuhen decides on your clan.
As for the You Clan, I will take action against you soon, so you can just await your fate.'

"I think it's enough about my son-in-law's identity, and you guys don't need to doubt his identity and relationship anymore with all the evidence already before your eyes." Shen Xueyi suddenly said this to the guests. "Despite the recent changes to this wedding, Yu'er has officially become Zhang Fei's wife, and you have traveled from various regions specifically to attend this wedding.
Let's forget about the incident and continue with this wedding banquet, and you can enjoy the dishes we have prepared for you all."

Although they still had many questions about Zhang Fei's identity and relationships, as well as the fate of Shen Haoran and his loyalists, the guests agreed with Shen Xueyi, and the people from Yin-Yang Pavilion began to serve the dishes they had previously prepared.
The guests began to hand over the gifts they had prepared for the bride and groom to them, but Zhang Fei asked Shen Yu to keep them all.

The wedding reception went smoothly and lively, and most of the guests seemed to have forgotten about the previous incident, but that was not the case for the people from the Cai and You Clans, as their plans were completely foiled by that incident, which forced them to rethink their plans, so they immediately reported the incident to Pang Zhen and Pang De.

When night fell, the wedding banquet finally ended, and Liu Hua brought the people from the Liu Clan back to their clan. Liu Qingyu and the Chu Sisters chose to accompany Chu Liuxiang and Yuan Manqiu, and they talked in the Yin-Yang Pavilion Sect's guest area.

Zhang Lingxue brought Zhao Ziqin to accompany Chang Wenjie to the Cai Clan with the clan members, particularly because she was still searching for her other disciple, Chang Wenhao, who they had hidden.

The representatives of the clans living in the southern region immediately left the Yin-Yang Pavilion Sect, except for those from the Hidden Sea Palace, because the Hai Twins wanted to talk to Zhang Fei. On the other hand, the representatives from other regions decided to stay overnight in the sect before returning to their respective regions the next morning.

Zhang Fei [1] then went to his private room in the inner disciples area, followed by all his partners, including Shi Yue, Yan Luan'er, and Xi Zihua. Yi Na initially intended to follow them, but she quickly changed her mind, particularly because she didn't want anyone to find out about her affair with him.

Feltia did not stay in the Sky Jade Realm for long, and she immediately returned to the Diyu Realm. After she arrived at the Amaris Twins' sub-realm, she immediately brought out the four female demons who were still in deep sleep, but she did not wake them up immediately and waited for them to wake up on their own.

After they left, Shen Yu took Zhang Fei away to the tower, making him smile, amused by her impatience. However, she did not take him to their bridal chamber, and instead she took her husband to the prison to determine Shen Haoran's fate as quickly as possible, as she could only feel at ease when they were all gone.

Shen Xueyi and the Shen Ancestors also followed, but they were curious about Zhang Fei's plans for Shen Haoran and the others. At first, they thought of executing them directly, but he asked them to abandon that intention because he had other plans for them.
Before that, Zhang Fei decided to release Shen Shixi first, which made her relieved and scared at the same time, and she thought that he wanted to execute her along with the others.

Zhang Fei also decided to bring the still unconscious Shen Tianyu with them, but he first sealed his cultivation before removing the effects of the demon pheromone from his body, and he immediately woke him up afterward.
Since he had slept for so long, Shen Tianyu's mind was in a mess when he opened his eyes, but he was immediately shocked when he saw Zhang Fei and Shen Yu, who were still wearing their wedding gowns.
Instantly, Shen Tianyu's anger overflowed, and he wanted to attack Zhang Fei, but he found that his cultivation had been sealed, leaving him unable to exert any strength.

"Are you surprised by your situation?" Zhang Fei asked Shen Tianhu as he hugged Shen Yu's waist. Today should have been your wedding day with Yu'er, but I married her, so she's my wife. Anyway, your father and his loyalists have fallen into our hands, and we'll take you to see them now."
"Damn it! Why are you siding with them, Aunt?" Shen Tianyu asked angrily as soon as Zhang Fei ordered Shen Shixi to bring him with them.

As she brought her nephew to follow them, Shen Shixi explained her situation to Shen Tianyu. "Do you think I want to do this? That guy is far more terrifying than we previously thought, and he has the ability to infiltrate this tower without the slightest hindrance. Moreover, he has planted his slave mark in my soul, so I can do nothing but follow his orders."

Shen Shixi's answer shocked Shen Tianyu, and he thought that Zhang Fei had some connection with the Pang Clan, especially since only people from that clan often enslaved others, including Liu Hua in the past. However, he quickly set all that aside due to his dire situation and his genuine fear of Zhang Fei killing him. "Do you know what he wants to do for us? Is he going to kill us all?"

"I don't know." Shen Shixi responded by shaking her head. "Previously, your father knew I had done something on Zhang Fei's orders, but I couldn't tell him anything because of the effects of his slave mark, and he locked me in prison for two days, so I don't know about his plans yet.
However, I am completely certain that he will kill my brother and the others, but I do not know what plans he has for the two of us."

After hearing that, Shen Tianhu became even more desperate, and he wanted to ask Shen Shixi for help to escape from Zhang Fei. However, he was fully aware that his aunt would not be able to assist him, particularly because his slave mark would prevent him from doing so, leaving him with no other option than to follow them helplessly. 'Damn it!
If only my father had not delayed my marriage with Shen Yu, then none of us would have suffered this fate today.'

After arriving at the prison, Zhang Fei faintly smiled at Shen Haoran, who was already helpless due to his shattered nerves, but he continued to gaze at him with hatred. "You don't need to look at me like that, Old Man. Fortunately, you are a cultivator with a high level of cultivation; otherwise, you would have died by now.
However, I want you to witness something before you die, and you can remember this incident until you arrive in the afterlife."
After he said that, Zhang Fei transformed into his incubus form immediately, which shocked Shen Haoran, his family members, and loyalists.

Zhang Fei then activated his demon eyes, positioning Shen Tianyu in front of him. He immediately grabbed the back of his head before speaking to Shen Haoran. "I have just acquired some new abilities, but I need to make a sacrifice to try one of them, so I will use your son as my first sacrifice, and you can witness his death with your own eyes."

chapters.title: Chapter 322: Killing People
paragraphs: "Argh!"

Shen Tianyu immediately let out a scream of pain as Zhang Fei activated the demon absorption technique and essence absorption technique simultaneously, which horrified Shen Haoran and the others, especially since his skin began to turn pale and wrinkled.

"Stop! Please! Don't torture my son like that!" Shen Xiwu screamed as she tried to stand up, but Zhang Fei immediately activated his heavenly fox aura to suppress her to the ground. "Please! Kill us if you want, but don't torture my son!"
Naturally, Zhang Fei did not listen to Shen Xiwu's pleas and continued his actions, but he felt something starting to enter his mind, which was Shen Tianyu's understanding of many things.

In addition, Zhang Fei could feel that his cultivation was starting to increase, especially since the demon absorption technique allowed him to absorb not only other people's life force but also their cultivation. 'This feeling is absolutely amazing, Mei.
My cultivation will definitely increase rapidly if I absorb all of their cultivation, which might allow me to reach the earth realm faster than our estimation.'

However, Mei immediately warned Zhang Fei. [Master, the demon absorption technique can indeed help you with that, but it is too vile. However, taking a shortcut like this to improve your cultivation is not beneficial for you, as it could lead to instability in your cultivation, potentially crumbling your foundation and leaving you crippled.]

"Fei 'er! Stop it!" Shen Xueyi abruptly uttered these words as she sensed Zhang Fei's cultivation accelerating. "I know that you can't wait to become strong and free Hu Yue from their hands, but you shouldn't take shortcuts like this because it will only harm you. Furthermore, you already have numerous wives, all of whom would be devastated if something bad happened to you."

Shen Yu also joined in to persuade Zhang Fei. "Please stop this, husband. You have us by your side, and we will always help you improve your cultivation, so you don't need to use such an evil technique to do it."

"You should listen to them, Zhang Fei." Shen Huang also spoke to him. "Don't you yourself hate the people from the Pang Clan? If you use their techniques to strengthen yourself, then what is the difference between you and them?

Such techniques will only make you addicted to taking shortcuts, which will slowly turn you into a heretic cultivator like them, and you may become even more vicious than they are. Furthermore, you possess numerous advantages that others lack, so it would be beneficial to stop this and utilize your other advantages to strengthen yourself."

Unlike them, Shen Xinya chose not to say anything to Zhang Fei, and she hoped that he would not stop using his vicious techniques. That way, he would become stronger faster, and he could help her reach a higher level of cultivation.

Although Zhang Fei was stubborn and ambitious enough to become strong, he was already aware of the risks. In response, he ceased using the demon absorption technique, which halted his cultivation, but he continued to use his essence absorption technique on Shen Tianyu.

Instead, Zhang Fei accelerated the absorption of his technique, causing Shen Tianyu to continuously scream in pain. As his beast essence continued to absorb him, his body began to dry up even more quickly.

Although they felt that Zhang Fei's Essence Absorption Technique was still too evil, Shen Xueyi and the others did not stop him from using it on Shen Tianyu, especially since they knew that he needed a lot of beast essence to evolve.
After a few minutes, Shen Tianyu's screams were no longer heard because he had died with his body completely dried up, and Zhang Fei smiled in satisfaction as a notification appeared in his mind.
[You gained 20,000 beast essences.]

Anyway, my slaves are Pang Hong and Pang Liyuan, so do you two still think that I'm cruel?"

"No." Both women immediately shook their heads at Zhang Fei, especially since they were the same as cultivators in general, who always hated the Pang Clan, and Ye Qianyu threw a question at him. "How did you manage to enslave them? Pang Hong is very strong, but I don't know Pang Liyuan."

"Shouldn't you already understand how I enslaved Pang Hong?" Zhang Fei turned the question around. "That old man is indeed strong, but Lingxue is stronger than him, and she also has the Liu Sisters helping her, so it's easy for them to capture him, right?"
"I see." Ye Qianyu nodded in understanding.

Zhang Fei then told them again. "Pang Lianyu is Pang De's son, and my clone met him by chance in the Desolate Sect. Additionally, you must have heard about the Blood Demon Tree, right? Since his father hid the fourth tree in the Central Region and my other slave, Pang Gui, couldn't get any information out of him, I decided to capture him and enslave him."

"The Blood Demon Tree, particularly the demon miasma it releases, is indeed terrifying." Ye Qianyu said that as she nodded. "Back then, we tried to get rid of it, but we had no protection against it, and it made us feel so painful, so we abandoned our intentions and returned directly to the sect.
However, I didn't expect that you would be able to get rid of it with your strong light element, and life in that area is safe again now."

Zhang Fei smiled upon hearing Ye Qianyu know about his light element, and he was sure that it was the Hai Twins who told her about it. "I have already removed the other two trees in the eastern and western regions, but I have yet to locate the one hidden in the central region by Pang De.
As for the tree in the northern region, the ancestors of the Pang, Xie, and Mo Clans used it to strengthen themselves, so I can't do anything about it."
"Did you get that information from Pang Liyuan?" At the same time, the Hai Twins asked this question.

"Pang Liyuan's mother is a member of the Mo Clan, and his wife is a member of the Xie Clan, so he has more information than Pang Hong and Pang Gui." Zhang Fei suddenly remembered someone and opened his map to search for the person, but he was unable to locate him in the southern region. However, he found him on his way from the northern region, and he was sure that he was heading to his region.
"Anyway, Pang Zhen is on a journey to this region, and he will probably arrive in five days."
"Pang Zhen?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei then told them. "For now, there are only two vassals of the Pang Clans left in this region: the Cai and You Clans, and I'm sure they've already informed Pang De about my appearance in this sect, so he probably sent Pang Zhen here.

Even so, I'm not too worried about him, especially since Qingyu and Hua'er have already ordered members of the Liu Clan to watch over them, and I'll also ask Shen Xueyi to send her people. That way, they can capture him once he arrives at one of those clans, and they can immediately clean up that clan."

The three senior women nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei, but on the other hand, Yue Lanxin looked at him with amazement. After all, he was much younger than her, but she felt that his mindset was better than hers, and he could even plan everything so neatly, including when he captured Shen Haoran and the others.
Noticing her expression, Zhang Fei immediately teased Yue Lanxin. "You better not keep looking at me like that, Sister Lanxin. Otherwise, you'll fall for me."
"Eh?" Yue Lanxin was taken aback for a moment. "How do you know my name? My three elders and I haven't even introduced my name to you."

Zhang Fei responded to Yue Lanxin's question with a wink, causing her to frown, but she didn't ask further, especially since everyone had their own secrets and she was not a nosy woman. "Anyway, thanks to the information you gave Lin'er, I was able to prevent Chu Youqian's actions and stop her without causing a bigger commotion."

"No need." Yue Lanxin shook her head in response. "Yuqian is indeed my sect sister, but I've never liked her attitude or jealousy, and she often bullies her juniors. I don't know what plans you have for her, but I still hope that you won't kill her. After all, forgiving people is better than killing them, right?"

"You are right that giving people would be better than killing them." Zhang Fei replied with a nod of approval. "However, you forget that we live in such a cruel world, and forgiving someone will not necessarily make the situation better. Instead, forgiving someone may lead us to bigger and more complicated problems, so we have to be selective when forgiving someone.

As for Chu Youqian, you yourself said that she bullied her junior sisters too often, and she also tried to bully my little sister. Moreover, I'm sure that you guys have often warned her to change, but she still never changes and continues to do such a thing, right? Since she doesn't want to change herself in trivial matters, do you think she will change in big matters?
That's why I won't forgive her, but I won't kill her either, and I already have other plans for her."

Yue Lanxin still wanted to ask Zhang Fei something else about Chu Youqian, but she immediately swallowed her words back, especially after the Hai Twins sent her a voice transmission not to speak further.
After they talked about some other things, especially about Chu Xing and Zhang Lin, the Hai Twins immediately led the people of their sect to leave the Yin-Yang Pavilion.
Zhang Fei himself immediately went to Shen Xueyi and told her about Shen Xinya, which surprised her quite a bit, but she chose not to comment on the matter and left the decision in his hands.

In addition, Zhang Fei also told Shen Xueyi about Pang Zhen, who was on his way to the southern region, including the estimated date of his arrival, and she immediately ordered Shen Yang to send some people to monitor the Cai and Yao clans.

Besides, Zhang Fei also informed Zhang Lingxue, who was still in the Cai Clan, of that matter, and he asked her to be wary of that clan's people. Ultimately, he was certain that Cai Shangjun was plotting a sinister scheme at the wedding, and he feared he might harm her.

After settling everything, Zhang Fei immediately returned to Shen Yu's room and accompanied her to sleep, but his mind was preoccupied with numerous thoughts, particularly about Feltia, who was traveling with Ashreth to the Twin Amaris's tower. 'Hmm? Do you think I can implant my demon slave mark into the twins, Mei?'

[Master, it's possible, but the souls of the Amaris Twins should be powerful, considering their high demon rank. That's why you must first weaken them before using your demon slave mark on them, but I'm sure it won't be easy, especially against the black Amaris.

Anyway, it would be better if you think about the white Amaris first, especially since you also have the light element, so her abilities definitely won't work on you, raising her suspicions about you.]

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with that. 'Since I can't possibly fight both of them at once, I have to separate the twins from each other first. I think I should contact Oz and discuss this matter with him, so he can do something to help me with that.'

Zhang Fei's third clone, Zhang Xiaolong, opened his eyes after receiving the notification. He then looked at the one man and three women, who were standing not far from him, and asked Pang Liyuan. "How is your wife's cultivation? Where is she now?"
"Master, Jingxian's cultivation is two minor stages ahead of mine, and she should be in the Xie Clan right now, especially since tomorrow is my father-in-law's birthday."

"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong raised his eyebrows for a moment. "In that case, I want you to return to the Xie Clan so they won't be suspicious of you, and I want you to think of a way to bring Xie Jingxian to me, so I can use her to do something against her clan."
"Yes, Master."

After Pang Liyuan left, Zhang Xiaolong spoke to Pang Hong. "I'm going somewhere else first, so you have to stay here and wait for Boitata. Moreover, she will bring two women here, and I want you to take care of them before I come back."
"Do you want me to turn them into puppets, Master?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong immediately rejected Pang Hong's idea. "It would be too good for them if you turned them into puppets, so I don't want you to do that. Instead, I want them to suffer because one of them has plotted against me, and the other one attacked one of my women."
"Yes, Master. I'll wait for Madam Boitata and the two women to arrive."

Since Liu Hua had connected the Liu and Chu clans, Zhang Xiaolong no longer needed a portal to access the Yin-Yang Pavilion. Therefore, he decided to remove the sect location from his warp portal and replace it with his current location, allowing him to easily travel to all five regions. After that, he asked Mei to open the gate to the Diyu Realm, and he immediately entered it to meet Oz.

As soon as he arrived there, Zhang Xiaolong immediately took out the medallion that Oz gave him before he went to the Amaris Twins's sub-realm, and he immediately injected his demon power into it, making it glow black.
In just a few minutes, Oz appeared in front of Zhang Xiaolong. "Why did you suddenly contact me? Does it have anything to do with your other clone?"

"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong nodded towards Oz. "Ashreth is taking my succubus clone to the Amaris Twins' tower right now, but I'm not sure that my demon abilities will be useful against them, especially the white Amaris.

Moreover, both of them are much stronger than my current self, and I won't be able to face them all at once, so I want you to separate them for the time being, and I'll have more freedom to carry out my plans."
Oz nodded in understanding at that. "So which one of them do you want me to take away?"

"The white Amaris." Oz was surprised by his choice, but Zhang Xiaolong immediately explained to the second demon lord about his plan. "That way, she wouldn't suspect me, and the black Amaris wouldn't realize that I have the light element."
"I see." Oz then asked him. "Are you sure you can do something about the black Amaris?"

Zhang Xiaolong shrugged his shoulders. "I'm not sure about that, and I can only try it first to see the results. However, I've already inserted something into the body of the fake Janette, and the black Amaris should have absorbed it many times by now, so my plan might work smoother on her.
The white Amaris might have also absorbed it, but her light element could neutralize it, so I decided to target her sister first."
After hearing Zhang Xiaolong's explanation, Oz immediately agreed with him. "All right, I'm going to meet someone now and take her to see the white Amaris, so she can take her away with her."

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong raised his eyebrows for a moment before realizing the identity of the woman Oz was referring to. "Virgil the Virgo, right? After all, she is the demon ruler who has the light element besides the white Amaris."

"Ha ha ha." Oz laughed at Zhang Xiaolong's conjecture. "You're right; that person is Virgil. Actually, the white Amaris is quite afraid of her, especially since she has known her secret for a long time, and she fears that she will reveal it to her twin sister, so she will not refuse her wishes."

"Does that mean you've succeeded in persuading Virgil to help you?" Oz answered Zhang Xiaolong with a nod, and he also informed him that another demon ruler had agreed to join them, which was Angela the Pisces. "Can you arrange a meeting for me with those two women?"

"Do you intend to take them as partners?" Oz's teasing question made Zhang Xiaolong laugh wryly, but he didn't deny it, especially since the two female demon rulers were very strong, and their female essences were clearly much stronger than Lillea's. "Virgil may be interested in meeting you if she knows your three identities, particularly since you also have the light element.

However, I don't know about Angela, especially since she's very reclusive, and she will get angry if other people disturb her solitude. Anyway, you can go to the northern sea if you want to meet her, but you'd better be careful and don't make her angry, or you'll be the one who suffers."

Hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong's eyes brightened with anticipation, as he had been eager to meet Angela for a long time, particularly because she possessed a teleportation ability similar to his. "All right, you can go see Virgil, and I will go to the northern sea to meet the pisces."
Once Zhang Xiaolong used the Nine Cloud Steps and vanished from his sight, Oz shook his head and immediately flew towards Virgil's sub-realm.

A while later, Zhang Xiaolong arrived at the northern sea and discovered Angela the Pisces, who was swimming in it. However, he didn't immediately approach her because she was enjoying her time with the aquatic beasts, who were so excited by her presence. Instead, he used his invisibility to watch her from a distance, pondering how to approach her.

Angela herself has an appearance that is almost identical to that of a mermaid or siren, with her upper body resembling a human and her lower body resembling a rainbow-colored fish. Even so, her upper body looked slender and captivating, and her skin was white but not pale like Eve's.
Her breasts, neither small nor big, contribute to her body's proportions, and a rainbow-colored cloth covers them both.

Angela's oval face looks adorable and pretty, and her long pink hair shimmers in the light. She has serene pink eyes, a long and sharp nose, and her small lips look thick at the bottom, making Zhang Xiaolong so eager to kiss and suck her lips.
Suddenly, Zhang Xiaolong heard Angela singing a song that was unfamiliar to him, and the aquatic demon beasts around her jumped with joy as they listened to her mellodious voice.

After pondering for some time, Zhang Xiaolong devised a plan to approach Angela. He combined his two bloodlines and transformed into his fox form, which differed from his usual one with white fur and blue eyes. Instead, his current fox form has black fur, blood-red eyes, four tails floating behind him, and two black wings on his back. 'Ha ha ha!
This way, she won't suspect me, and she'll probably think that I'm a demon fox.'

Even Mei was amused by Zhang Xiaolong's decision to use such a form to get close to Angela. [Master, you always have strange ideas about approaching women, but you're probably right that she won't suspect you. Even so, you should be careful with her, especially since she has the abilities of telekinesis, teleportation, lightning, and water.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Xiaolong replied with a slight nod. 'Show her status, Mei.'
[Alrighty!]
Name: Angela
Age: 2500+ years old
Gender: Female
Race: Rainbow Demon Fish
Rank: Duchess
Elements: Water + Lightning
Physique: Demon Fish Physique

Abilities: shapeshifting, teleportation, enhanced speed (in water), beast control (aquatic), camouflage, water-lightning manipulation, electrokinesis, hibernation, alternate respiration, electroreception, and so on.
Strong: Water, Lightning
Weak: Ice, Earth

Zhang Xaiolong nodded repeatedly as he muttered to himself. 'I didn't expect that she also possessed camouflage, but it's useless as I already possess invisibility, and her beast control is useless as I can use my fox bloodline to subdue them. Furthermore, she is the second demon I have encountered in this realm who does not possess the darkness element.'
[Master, I think you can mimic her hibernation or alternate respiration abilities, and both might be useful to you later.]

'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong naturally knew about the effects of hibernation, but he didn't know about the effects of Angela's other abilities. 'Show me the benefits of her alternate respiration ability, Mei.'
[Yes.]
[Alternate respiration: The user can breathe through means other than their mouth or nostrils, such as through their skin or ears.]

'Oh?' Zhang Xiaolong was a bit surprised after reading that. 'Hey, Mei! You're right about that! Angela's alternate respiration ability is really useful, especially if I'm in a desperate situation, and I can use it to hide anywhere.'
[Aren't you interested in her hibernation ability, Master?]

'No.' Zhang Xiaolong refused by shaking his head. 'I already mimicked Ashreth's regenerative healing factor, remember? I think that's enough to help me, and I can enter hibernation without having to rely on such an ability, so I will mimic her alternate respiration ability.'
After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately walked over to Angela, who had already come out of the sea and was sitting by the seaside.
"Hmm?" Angela immediately turned towards Zhang Xiaolong with a raised eyebrow, but her expression turned confused and amazed at the same time as soon as she saw his weird fox form.

Angela then stretched out her hand towards Zhang Xiaolong and used her telekinesis to bring him in front of her, and she then carressed his head while observing his form. "What kind of demon beast are you? I often see demon foxes, but I've never seen one like you. Furthermore, your wings are similar to those of succubi and incubus, which makes your appearance truly unique."

'Janette is right; this woman is indeed gentle and kind, even though she is one of the demon rulers in this realm, and her soul is also quite interesting.' Zhang Xiaolong mumbled as he moved closer to Angela, licking her face without delay.

"Ha ha." Angela laughed and hugged Zhang Xiaolong's neck as she continued to stroke his smooth, black fur. "Usually, I don't like other demon beasts besides aquatic demon beasts, but you are really special, and I really want to take you away to my sub-realm. Unfortunately, I can't take you with me because there is only sea in it, so you can't stay there."

"Hmm?" Angela raised her eyebrows for a moment as soon as Huang Xiaolong freed himself from her embrace, but she was shocked by his action of jumping into the sea, and she immediately jumped in to save him.

"Hey! Are you crazy? You are a demon fox, and your habitat is land, so you can't go into the sea, or you will drown to death!" Instead, Zhang Xiaolong dove into the sea in response to Angela's scolding, but he immediately lifted her onto his back before carrying her to swim further to the center, surprising her. "Eh? How can you dive and swim like this?"
Zhang Xiaolong wanted to say something to Angela, but he decided against it, and he preferred to accompany her in his fox form, which kept him safer from her.

Angela let out a soft sigh because Zhang Xiaolong didn't respond to her, and she once again rubbed her head. "Somehow, I forgot that some demon beasts can talk and turn into their humanoid form a bit late, and I thought you might be one of them."

Many aquatic beasts followed behind them, but they looked furious at Zhang Xiaoling because he was carrying Angela on his back. However, she immediately ordered them to stay away from him, and none of them dared to contradict her, especially since she was their ruler, so they immediately rushed away.
After a while, Zhang Xiaolong flew Angela into the sky and landed on the seaside, immediately drying himself as soon as she got off his back.
Angela then looked far away before asking Zhang Xiaolong. "Do you want to visit my sub-realm? I have some business there, so I have to go back now."

However, Zhang Xiaolong rejected Angela by running away from her, which made her look disappointed, but she immediately shouted at him. "Hey! Foxie! I'll be coming to this sea often, so I hope you'll come here to see me again."
When Zhang Xiaolong heard that, he immediately responded to Angela by wagging his four tails at the same time. His response made her smile happily, and she immediately left the northern sea.

After he arrived at a quiet place, Zhang Xiaolong immediately returned to his human form and asked Mei to open a portal to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since he was sure that Boitata and the two women should have almost arrived at the northern realm with the speed of Wang Xiaoyi's flying artifact.

Upon arriving at the realm, Zhang Xiaolong immediately opened his map to find their location, and they were indeed almost entering the northern region. However, they were still quite far from their location, so he immediately left the place and used the Nine Cloud Steps to head towards their location.
Even so, Huang Xiaolong did not show himself to Boitata, but he asked her to immediately act against Wang Xiaoyi and Chu Youqian.

[Daily Quest: Absorb 5,900 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 59 green jewels sent to inventory.]
Zhang Fei's third clone, Zhang Xiaolong, opened his eyes after receiving the notification.
He then looked at the one man and three women, who were standing not far from him, and asked Pang Liyuan.
"How is your wife's cultivation?
Where is she now?"
"Master, Jingxian's cultivation is two minor stages ahead of mine, and she should be in the Xie Clan right now, especially since tomorrow is my father-in-law's birthday."
"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong raised his eyebrows for a moment.

"In that case, I want you to return to the Xie Clan so they won't be suspicious of you, and I want you to think of a way to bring Xie Jingxian to me, so I can use her to do something against her clan."
"Yes, Master."
After Pang Liyuan left, Zhang Xiaolong spoke to Pang Hong.
"I'm going somewhere else first, so you have to stay here and wait for Boitata.
Moreover, she will bring two women here, and I want you to take care of them before I come back."
"Do you want me to turn them into puppets, Master?"
"No." Zhang Xiaolong immediately rejected Pang Hong's idea.
"It would be too good for them if you turned them into puppets, so I don't want you to do that.
Instead, I want them to suffer because one of them has plotted against me, and the other one attacked one of my women."
"Yes, Master.
I'll wait for Madam Boitata and the two women to arrive."
Since Liu Hua had connected the Liu and Chu clans, Zhang Xiaolong no longer needed a portal to access the Yin-Yang Pavilion.
Therefore, he decided to remove the sect location from his warp portal and replace it with his current location, allowing him to easily travel to all five regions.
After that, he asked Mei to open the gate to the Diyu Realm, and he immediately entered it to meet Oz.

As soon as he arrived there, Zhang Xiaolong immediately took out the medallion that Oz gave him before he went to the Amaris Twins's sub-realm, and he immediately injected his demon power into it, making it glow black.
In just a few minutes, Oz appeared in front of Zhang Xiaolong.
"Why did you suddenly contact me?
Does it have anything to do with your other clone?"
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong nodded towards Oz.
"Ashreth is taking my succubus clone to the Amaris Twins' tower right now, but I'm not sure that my demon abilities will be useful against them, especially the white Amaris.

Moreover, both of them are much stronger than my current self, and I won't be able to face them all at once, so I want you to separate them for the time being, and I'll have more freedom to carry out my plans."
Oz nodded in understanding at that.
"So which one of them do you want me to take away?"
"The white Amaris." Oz was surprised by his choice, but Zhang Xiaolong immediately explained to the second demon lord about his plan.
"That way, she wouldn't suspect me, and the black Amaris wouldn't realize that I have the light element."
"I see." Oz then asked him.
"Are you sure you can do something about the black Amaris?"
Zhang Xiaolong shrugged his shoulders.
"I'm not sure about that, and I can only try it first to see the results.
However, I've already inserted something into the body of the fake Janette, and the black Amaris should have absorbed it many times by now, so my plan might work smoother on her.
The white Amaris might have also absorbed it, but her light element could neutralize it, so I decided to target her sister first."
After hearing Zhang Xiaolong's explanation, Oz immediately agreed with him.
"All right, I'm going to meet someone now and take her to see the white Amaris, so she can take her away with her."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong raised his eyebrows for a moment before realizing the identity of the woman Oz was referring to.
"Virgil the Virgo, right?
After all, she is the demon ruler who has the light element besides the white Amaris."
"Ha ha ha." Oz laughed at Zhang Xiaolong's conjecture.
"You're right; that person is Virgil.

Actually, the white Amaris is quite afraid of her, especially since she has known her secret for a long time, and she fears that she will reveal it to her twin sister, so she will not refuse her wishes."

"Does that mean you've succeeded in persuading Virgil to help you?" Oz answered Zhang Xiaolong with a nod, and he also informed him that another demon ruler had agreed to join them, which was Angela the Pisces.
"Can you arrange a meeting for me with those two women?"

"Do you intend to take them as partners?" Oz's teasing question made Zhang Xiaolong laugh wryly, but he didn't deny it, especially since the two female demon rulers were very strong, and their female essences were clearly much stronger than Lillea's.
"Virgil may be interested in meeting you if she knows your three identities, particularly since you also have the light element.
However, I don't know about Angela, especially since she's very reclusive, and she will get angry if other people disturb her solitude.
Anyway, you can go to the northern sea if you want to meet her, but you'd better be careful and don't make her angry, or you'll be the one who suffers."
Hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong's eyes brightened with anticipation, as he had been eager to meet Angela for a long time, particularly because she possessed a teleportation ability similar to his.
"All right, you can go see Virgil, and I will go to the northern sea to meet the pisces."
Once Zhang Xiaolong used the Nine Cloud Steps and vanished from his sight, Oz shook his head and immediately flew towards Virgil's sub-realm.
A while later, Zhang Xiaolong arrived at the northern sea and discovered Angela the Pisces, who was swimming in it.
However, he didn't immediately approach her because she was enjoying her time with the aquatic beasts, who were so excited by her presence.
Instead, he used his invisibility to watch her from a distance, pondering how to approach her.
Angela herself has an appearance that is almost identical to that of a mermaid or siren, with her upper body resembling a human and her lower body resembling a rainbow-colored fish.
Even so, her upper body looked slender and captivating, and her skin was white but not pale like Eve's.
Her breasts, neither small nor big, contribute to her body's proportions, and a rainbow-colored cloth covers them both.
Angela's oval face looks adorable and pretty, and her long pink hair shimmers in the light.
She has serene pink eyes, a long and sharp nose, and her small lips look thick at the bottom, making Zhang Xiaolong so eager to kiss and suck her lips.
Suddenly, Zhang Xiaolong heard Angela singing a song that was unfamiliar to him, and the aquatic demon beasts around her jumped with joy as they listened to her mellodious voice.
After pondering for some time, Zhang Xiaolong devised a plan to approach Angela.
He combined his two bloodlines and transformed into his fox form, which differed from his usual one with white fur and blue eyes.
Instead, his current fox form has black fur, blood-red eyes, four tails floating behind him, and two black wings on his back. 'Ha ha ha!
This way, she won't suspect me, and she'll probably think that I'm a demon fox.'
Even Mei was amused by Zhang Xiaolong's decision to use such a form to get close to Angela.
[Master, you always have strange ideas about approaching women, but you're probably right that she won't suspect you.
Even so, you should be careful with her, especially since she has the abilities of telekinesis, teleportation, lightning, and water.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Xiaolong replied with a slight nod. 'Show her status, Mei.'
[Alrighty!]
Name: Angela
Age: 2500+ years old
Gender: Female
Race: Rainbow Demon Fish
Rank: Duchess
Elements: Water + Lightning
Physique: Demon Fish Physique

Abilities: shapeshifting, teleportation, enhanced speed (in water), beast control (aquatic), camouflage, water-lightning manipulation, electrokinesis, hibernation, alternate respiration, electroreception, and so on.
Strong: Water, Lightning
Weak: Ice, Earth

Zhang Xaiolong nodded repeatedly as he muttered to himself. 'I didn't expect that she also possessed camouflage, but it's useless as I already possess invisibility, and her beast control is useless as I can use my fox bloodline to subdue them.
Furthermore, she is the second demon I have encountered in this realm who does not possess the darkness element.'
[Master, I think you can mimic her hibernation or alternate respiration abilities, and both might be useful to you later.]

'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong naturally knew about the effects of hibernation, but he didn't know about the effects of Angela's other abilities. 'Show me the benefits of her alternate respiration ability, Mei.'
[Yes.]
[Alternate respiration: The user can breathe through means other than their mouth or nostrils, such as through their skin or ears.]
'Oh?' Zhang Xiaolong was a bit surprised after reading that. 'Hey, Mei!
You're right about that!
Angela's alternate respiration ability is really useful, especially if I'm in a desperate situation, and I can use it to hide anywhere.'
[Aren't you interested in her hibernation ability, Master?]
'No.' Zhang Xiaolong refused by shaking his head. 'I already mimicked Ashreth's regenerative healing factor, remember?
I think that's enough to help me, and I can enter hibernation without having to rely on such an ability, so I will mimic her alternate respiration ability.'
After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately walked over to Angela, who had already come out of the sea and was sitting by the seaside.
"Hmm?" Angela immediately turned towards Zhang Xiaolong with a raised eyebrow, but her expression turned confused and amazed at the same time as soon as she saw his weird fox form.
Angela then stretched out her hand towards Zhang Xiaolong and used her telekinesis to bring him in front of her, and she then carressed his head while observing his form.
"What kind of demon beast are you?
I often see demon foxes, but I've never seen one like you.
Furthermore, your wings are similar to those of succubi and incubus, which makes your appearance truly unique."

'Janette is right; this woman is indeed gentle and kind, even though she is one of the demon rulers in this realm, and her soul is also quite interesting.' Zhang Xiaolong mumbled as he moved closer to Angela, licking her face without delay.
"Ha ha." Angela laughed and hugged Zhang Xiaolong's neck as she continued to stroke his smooth, black fur.
"Usually, I don't like other demon beasts besides aquatic demon beasts, but you are really special, and I really want to take you away to my sub-realm.
Unfortunately, I can't take you with me because there is only sea in it, so you can't stay there."

"Hmm?" Angela raised her eyebrows for a moment as soon as Huang Xiaolong freed himself from her embrace, but she was shocked by his action of jumping into the sea, and she immediately jumped in to save him.
"Hey!
Are you crazy?

You are a demon fox, and your habitat is land, so you can't go into the sea, or you will drown to death!" Instead, Zhang Xiaolong dove into the sea in response to Angela's scolding, but he immediately lifted her onto his back before carrying her to swim further to the center, surprising her.
"Eh?
How can you dive and swim like this?"
Zhang Xiaolong wanted to say something to Angela, but he decided against it, and he preferred to accompany her in his fox form, which kept him safer from her.
Angela let out a soft sigh because Zhang Xiaolong didn't respond to her, and she once again rubbed her head.
"Somehow, I forgot that some demon beasts can talk and turn into their humanoid form a bit late, and I thought you might be one of them."
Many aquatic beasts followed behind them, but they looked furious at Zhang Xiaoling because he was carrying Angela on his back.
However, she immediately ordered them to stay away from him, and none of them dared to contradict her, especially since she was their ruler, so they immediately rushed away.
After a while, Zhang Xiaolong flew Angela into the sky and landed on the seaside, immediately drying himself as soon as she got off his back.
Angela then looked far away before asking Zhang Xiaolong.
"Do you want to visit my sub-realm?
I have some business there, so I have to go back now."
However, Zhang Xiaolong rejected Angela by running away from her, which made her look disappointed, but she immediately shouted at him.
"Hey!
Foxie!
I'll be coming to this sea often, so I hope you'll come here to see me again."
When Zhang Xiaolong heard that, he immediately responded to Angela by wagging his four tails at the same time.
His response made her smile happily, and she immediately left the northern sea.
