Even so, Huang Xiaolong did not show himself to Boitata, but he asked her to immediately act against Wang Xiaoyi and Chu Youqian.

chapters.title: Chapter 329: Yin-Yang Absorber Shackles
paragraphs: Wang Xiaoyi stood alone at the front end of her flying artifact, looking toward the northern region with complicated feelings. After all, that region was home to the heretics, and their numbers weren't small either. That's why she was hesitant to continue her journey into that region, particularly since she had come alone and her granddaughter was in a condition that required constant protection.

"Sigh." Wang Xiaoyi let out a soft sigh before turning towards the south. Her expression looked disappointed that Chu Liuxiang had not caught up with her, even though he should have known that she had taken their granddaughter away.

Wang Xiaoyi then looked north again, carefully spreading her senses to the outskirts of the region in order to find a safe place. After she searched for some time, she finally found an area that was quite remote, and almost no humans or beasts passed by, so she immediately directed her flying artifact towards that area.
*Bam*

A loud crash from behind started Wang Xiaoyi, so she immediately turned back and saw that the rest rooms had been split in two. Besides, she also saw a giant snake hovering behind her flying artifact, but she was horrified after she saw tens of fiery eyes all over the snake's body, and they were all staring at her.
However, Wang Xiaoyi was shocked as soon as she saw the snake's tail, especially since it was wrapped around her granddaughter, who was still unconscious.

"Youqian!" Wang Xiaoyi shouted loudly as she flew towards the giant snake, but it immediately spat two huge fireballs at her, so she immediately dodged them. Unfortunately, the two fireballs actually smashed her flying artifact, causing it to explode into pieces, and each piece immediately burst into flames as they fell from the sky. "Damn it! Who are you? Why did you attack us?"
"Ha ha." The giant snake laughed before returning to her human form, and Wang Xiaoyi's eyes widened once she saw that the beast was Boitata. "Do you remember me now, foolish old woman?"

"You!" Wang Xiaoyi glared fiercely at Boitata as she clenched her fists tightly, but she didn't dare move to attack her, especially after she remembered their first meeting a few days ago, and she was completely helpless under the pressure of her aura.

"It's useless for you to look at me like that, you know?" Boitata then strangled Chu Youqian's neck from behind as he spoke to Wang Xiaoyi. "At first, my husband didn't want to do anything to you, and he only wanted this little girl's life, especially since she had already hatched against an evil scheme for him, so he asked me to wait for you and your husband to hand her over to the Ying Clan.
Unfortunately, you made the wrong decision by attacking Liu Qingyu and taking your granddaughter to escape to this region, so he asked me to capture the two of you."

"Tch!" Wang Xiaoyi immediately released all her strength, causing her aura to increase several times. "I know that I am not your opponent, but I will still fight you to the end, even if I have to die!"
"What a fool." Boitata shook her head and waved her hand as soon as Wang Xiaoyi flew towards her.

Instantly, several water walls appeared around Wang Xiaoyi and confined her within them, which shocked her. After all, Boitata previously used her fire element to destroy her flying artifact, but she also used the water element, and the two elements always opposed each other.

"Damn it!" Wang Xiaoyi muttered curses under her breath before attempting to use her wind element to attack Boitata's water walls, only to find all her attacks absorbed and dispersed throughout them, rendering her attacks entirely ineffective. 'Shit! Not only is my wind element weaker than her water element, but my cultivation is also several minor levels below hers!'
"Haha." Boitata laughed at her expression before flicking her fingers, causing numerous water droplets to immediately emerge from the water walls and attack Wang Xiaoyi simultaneously.

"Argh!" Wang Xiaoyi screamed in pain from Boitata's attacks, and the dress covering her body began to have holes in many places. However, she tried to use her Qi to lessen the impact of Boitata's attacks, but the difference in their strength rendered her efforts futile.
Although those water droplets did not penetrate through her body, their attacks still left many red marks, and she also felt significant pain all over her body.

Even so, Boitata did not stop her attacks, instead channeling her fire elements into the water walls, causing them to quickly boil. Wang Xiaoyi felt increasingly painful as a result of all her attacks, and her screams kept resounding from inside; even her consciousness began to fade because of the pain and the heat.

After a few minutes, Wang Xiaoyi finally fell unconscious, so Boitata removed her water walls, supported her with his aura, and took the two women to the location that her husband had shown her before.

In a few minutes, Boitata had arrived at Zhang Xiaolong's place, and she immediately handed the two women over to him. "All right, you can enter the beast space now, especially since Feltia will be arriving at the Amaris Twins's tower soon, and she will need your help to deal with the black Amaris."
Without a word, Boitata immediately entered the beast space, and Zhang Xiaolong squatted beside Chu Youqian before stuffing the antidote powder into her mouth.

Zhang Xiaolong then channeled his light qi into Chu Youqian's body to cure her illness, and he also healed the wounds on Wang Xiaoyi's body resulting from Boitata's previous attack. Besides, he also stripped them naked, but he didn't seem interested in dual-cultivating with them, and he had already prepared another plan to torture them. "Mei, you can buy those artifacts now."
[Yes.]
{You got Earth-Grade Yin-Yang Absorber Shackles x2}
{1,000,000 green jewels have been deducted from your balance.}

Zhang Xiaolong could only smile bitterly at the prices of those artifacts, especially considering that their grade was only earth-grade but their prices were already exorbitant, let alone those of artifacts at heaven-grade and above.
He then took them out of the system inventory, and each artifact consisted of four black and white shackles connected by chains, which were also connected to a fairly large clear tube.

[Yin-Yang Absorber Shackle: This artifact absorbs the wearer's Qi, depositing it into the tube for the owner to absorb. In addition, it also absorbs their strength, preventing the person wearing it from exerting his or her power.]

"If I think about it again, these artifacts are truly vicious; their function is similar to life-force absorption or beast essence absorption, but they only absorb their Qi and strength." Zhang Xiaolong then put those shackles on the hands and feet of the two women, and he also removed the seal on their cultivation before waking them up.

Wang Xiaoyi was immediately shocked as soon as she opened her eyes and saw Zhang Xiaolong, but she was even more shocked to find her hands and feet in shackles. However, she discovered that her cultivation was not sealed, so she tried to use her power to attack him. "Bastard! I will kill you with my own hands!"
Unfortunately, the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackles directly absorbed Wang Xiaoyi's Qi and strength, causing her to fall to the ground again. She then tried to remove those shackles, but to no avail.

"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed at Wang Xiaoyi's behavior, and he pulled her hair up while smiling evilly. "Have you realized your situation, old granny? If only you had not attacked Qingyu, you would never have experienced this kind of fate. However, you don't need to worry because I won't kill you and Chu Youqian, and I'm not interested in touching your bodies either.
Instead, these shackles will make you guys my dairy cows, and they will absorb both of your qi, so I can use them to improve my cultivation."

Wang Xiaoyi's anger boiled after she heard that, and she didn't want to be used by Zhang Xiaolong as his cultivation furnace, so she tried to taunt him. "Heh! You are a cowardly brat who is reliant on the abilities of others to capture us. If you dare, release me and fight me with your own strength!"

"Is that so?" Zhang Xiaolong asked with a slight smirk. "You're too old and senile now. Aren't you a coward yourself, taunting me into letting go and fighting with you? Your cultivation is in the heaven realm, and mine is in the soul realm, remember? No matter what method, winning is still winning, and you two have fallen into my hands now, so you guys can enjoy your time as dairy cows.
Anyway, you two will live as long as you are useful to me; if you are no longer useful to me, you will die, but I won't let you die so easily."

Zhang Xiaolong lifted Wang Xiaoyi to her feet and stuck the chain in her hands on one of the walls, but she continued to struggle to break free as she glared at him. Unfortunately, each time she unleashed her power, the shackles instantly absorbed it, causing her power to fade once more.

Zhang Xiaolong ignored Wang Xiaoyi, and he did the same to Chu Youqian by hanging her opposite her grandmother. "Pang Hong, even though they won't be able to escape from this place, I still want you to keep a watch on them."
"Yes, Master."

Hearing that, Wang Xiaoyi looked at the slave in shock, especially since she knew for sure that Pang Hong was supposed to be a man, but the person standing before her was a woman. 'What the hell happened to him? How did he become a woman? Did this little bastard do that to him? How does he transform a man into a woman?'
Noticing her curiosity, Zhang Xiaolong approached Wang Xiaoyi again and touched her chest. "Are you curious about how I can turn Pang Hong into a woman? What if I show you by turning you into a man?"
"No!" Wang Xiaoyi immediately screamed at Zhang Xiaolong as her body shuddered at the thought of him turning her into a man.

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed softly and used the body modification ability on Wang Xiaoyi, and her expression became deathly pale when she looked down, especially since her breasts quickly shrank before disappearing completely. However, once her breasts returned to their original size, she was stunned and looked at him with horror.

"Actually, I still have many other abilities, but I don't have time to show them one by one, and you should know that I can do things against you without relying on them. However, I don't want to waste time with you two, so I asked Boitata to take care of you two."
"Mhmm."
They suddenly heard a low groan, so they immediately turned to Chu Youqian, who had just opened her eyes, and Zhang Xiaolong inquired. "Finally awake?"

Since she had been asleep for quite some time, Chu Youqian's mind was quite fuzzy when she opened her eyes, and it took her some time to return to full consciousness. However, her expression turned terrified as soon as she saw Zhang Xiaolong, and even more so when she saw the naked Wang Xiaoyi chained to the wall. She also immediately realized that she was in the same situation as her grandmother.
"You... You..."

Zhang Xiaolong smiled at hearing Chu Youqian stutter. "We didn't know each other before, but your jealousy of my little sister already clouded your judgment, making it difficult for you to distinguish between good and bad. You even wanted to inform Shen Haoran of my relationship with Yu'er. As a result, I killed Ying Xiao, so his death was your fault because you were the one who sent him to do that.
Besides, the two of you are also in this situation because of your fault, so you can only blame yourself for everything that happened to you guys."

Chu Youqian's mouth opened and closed several times as she wanted to say something to Zhang Xiaolong, but not a word came out of her mouth. She turned to her grandmother as tears flowed from her eyes. "Grandma... I..."
Wang Xiaoyi could only sigh at seeing her granddaughter like that, but she then spoke to Chu Youqian. "You are my dear granddaughter, so I never blame you, and this bastard is at fault."

"All right, you two can enjoy yourselves here, and I will go to take care of my other matters." After saying that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately left the area and used his invisibility to travel somewhere else, with the intention of visiting the Pang Clan. However, he quickly changed his mind, opting to investigate the Mo Clan first, particularly given the busy situation in the Xie Clan.

After his disappearance, Chu Youqian asked her grandmother a question. "What will happen to us, Grandma? I don't want that bastard to touch me, so you have to think of a way to free us from this place."
"Unfortunately, I can't do anything, Youqian." Wang Xiaoyi replied with a disappointed sigh. "These shackles absorb our strength and qi, so we will never be able to escape from this place."

Hearing that, Chu Youqian immediately tried to use her strength, but the result was just as Wang Xiaoyi had told her, and it made her look even more depressed; even her tears flowed more profusely as she lamented her fate.

"Anyway, that bastard already said that he won't touch us, and he just wants to utilize our qi through these shackles, so you don't need to think about that." Even though Wang Xiaoyi said that, Chu Youqian was not calm at all. "For now, we just need to be patient with our circumstances, and I will look for opportunities to bring you out of this place."

Zhang Xiaolong then channeled his light qi into Chu Youqian's body to cure her illness, and he also healed the wounds on Wang Xiaoyi's body resulting from Boitata's previous attack.
Besides, he also stripped them naked, but he didn't seem interested in dual-cultivating with them, and he had already prepared another plan to torture them.
"Mei, you can buy those artifacts now."
[Yes.]
{You got Earth-Grade Yin-Yang Absorber Shackles x2}
{1,000,000 green jewels have been deducted from your balance.}

Zhang Xiaolong could only smile bitterly at the prices of those artifacts, especially considering that their grade was only earth-grade but their prices were already exorbitant, let alone those of artifacts at heaven-grade and above.
He then took them out of the system inventory, and each artifact consisted of four black and white shackles connected by chains, which were also connected to a fairly large clear tube.
[Yin-Yang Absorber Shackle: This artifact absorbs the wearer's Qi, depositing it into the tube for the owner to absorb.
In addition, it also absorbs their strength, preventing the person wearing it from exerting his or her power.]

"If I think about it again, these artifacts are truly vicious; their function is similar to life-force absorption or beast essence absorption, but they only absorb their Qi and strength." Zhang Xiaolong then put those shackles on the hands and feet of the two women, and he also removed the seal on their cultivation before waking them up.
Wang Xiaoyi was immediately shocked as soon as she opened her eyes and saw Zhang Xiaolong, but she was even more shocked to find her hands and feet in shackles.
However, she discovered that her cultivation was not sealed, so she tried to use her power to attack him.
"Bastard!
I will kill you with my own hands!"
Unfortunately, the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackles directly absorbed Wang Xiaoyi's Qi and strength, causing her to fall to the ground again.
She then tried to remove those shackles, but to no avail.
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed at Wang Xiaoyi's behavior, and he pulled her hair up while smiling evilly.
"Have you realized your situation, old granny?
If only you had not attacked Qingyu, you would never have experienced this kind of fate.
However, you don't need to worry because I won't kill you and Chu Youqian, and I'm not interested in touching your bodies either.
Instead, these shackles will make you guys my dairy cows, and they will absorb both of your qi, so I can use them to improve my cultivation."
Wang Xiaoyi's anger boiled after she heard that, and she didn't want to be used by Zhang Xiaolong as his cultivation furnace, so she tried to taunt him.
"Heh!
You are a cowardly brat who is reliant on the abilities of others to capture us.
If you dare, release me and fight me with your own strength!"
"Is that so?" Zhang Xiaolong asked with a slight smirk.
"You're too old and senile now.
Aren't you a coward yourself, taunting me into letting go and fighting with you?
Your cultivation is in the heaven realm, and mine is in the soul realm, remember?
No matter what method, winning is still winning, and you two have fallen into my hands now, so you guys can enjoy your time as dairy cows.
Anyway, you two will live as long as you are useful to me; if you are no longer useful to me, you will die, but I won't let you die so easily."
Zhang Xiaolong lifted Wang Xiaoyi to her feet and stuck the chain in her hands on one of the walls, but she continued to struggle to break free as she glared at him.
Unfortunately, each time she unleashed her power, the shackles instantly absorbed it, causing her power to fade once more.
Zhang Xiaolong ignored Wang Xiaoyi, and he did the same to Chu Youqian by hanging her opposite her grandmother.
"Pang Hong, even though they won't be able to escape from this place, I still want you to keep a watch on them."
"Yes, Master."

Hearing that, Wang Xiaoyi looked at the slave in shock, especially since she knew for sure that Pang Hong was supposed to be a man, but the person standing before her was a woman. 'What the hell happened to him?
How did he become a woman?
Did this little bastard do that to him?
How does he transform a man into a woman?'
Noticing her curiosity, Zhang Xiaolong approached Wang Xiaoyi again and touched her chest.
"Are you curious about how I can turn Pang Hong into a woman?
What if I show you by turning you into a man?"
"No!" Wang Xiaoyi immediately screamed at Zhang Xiaolong as her body shuddered at the thought of him turning her into a man.

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed softly and used the body modification ability on Wang Xiaoyi, and her expression became deathly pale when she looked down, especially since her breasts quickly shrank before disappearing completely.
However, once her breasts returned to their original size, she was stunned and looked at him with horror.
"Actually, I still have many other abilities, but I don't have time to show them one by one, and you should know that I can do things against you without relying on them.
However, I don't want to waste time with you two, so I asked Boitata to take care of you two."
"Mhmm."
They suddenly heard a low groan, so they immediately turned to Chu Youqian, who had just opened her eyes, and Zhang Xiaolong inquired.
"Finally awake?"
Since she had been asleep for quite some time, Chu Youqian's mind was quite fuzzy when she opened her eyes, and it took her some time to return to full consciousness.
However, her expression turned terrified as soon as she saw Zhang Xiaolong, and even more so when she saw the naked Wang Xiaoyi chained to the wall.
She also immediately realized that she was in the same situation as her grandmother.
"You...
You..."
Zhang Xiaolong smiled at hearing Chu Youqian stutter.
"We didn't know each other before, but your jealousy of my little sister already clouded your judgment, making it difficult for you to distinguish between good and bad.
You even wanted to inform Shen Haoran of my relationship with Yu'er.
As a result, I killed Ying Xiao, so his death was your fault because you were the one who sent him to do that.
Besides, the two of you are also in this situation because of your fault, so you can only blame yourself for everything that happened to you guys."
Chu Youqian's mouth opened and closed several times as she wanted to say something to Zhang Xiaolong, but not a word came out of her mouth.
She turned to her grandmother as tears flowed from her eyes.
"Grandma...
Wang Xiaoyi could only sigh at seeing her granddaughter like that, but she then spoke to Chu Youqian.
"You are my dear granddaughter, so I never blame you, and this bastard is at fault."

"All right, you two can enjoy yourselves here, and I will go to take care of my other matters." After saying that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately left the area and used his invisibility to travel somewhere else, with the intention of visiting the Pang Clan.
However, he quickly changed his mind, opting to investigate the Mo Clan first, particularly given the busy situation in the Xie Clan.
After his disappearance, Chu Youqian asked her grandmother a question.
"What will happen to us, Grandma?
I don't want that bastard to touch me, so you have to think of a way to free us from this place."
"Unfortunately, I can't do anything, Youqian." Wang Xiaoyi replied with a disappointed sigh.
"These shackles absorb our strength and qi, so we will never be able to escape from this place."

Hearing that, Chu Youqian immediately tried to use her strength, but the result was just as Wang Xiaoyi had told her, and it made her look even more depressed; even her tears flowed more profusely as she lamented her fate.

"Anyway, that bastard already said that he won't touch us, and he just wants to utilize our qi through these shackles, so you don't need to think about that." Even though Wang Xiaoyi said that, Chu Youqian was not calm at all.
"For now, we just need to be patient with our circumstances, and I will look for opportunities to bring you out of this place."

chapters.title: Chapter 330: Virgil The Virgo
paragraphs: Oz has arrived in front of a slightly larger mansion, which has various flowering trees growing around it, and it looks more like the house of demons with lower ranks. However, the mansion was no ordinary mansion, especially since it was the residence of one of the twelve demon rulers, Virgil the Virgo.

Unlike the other demon rulers who choose to show their power by building their palaces or towers, Virgil doesn't like that kind of thing, and she prefers to live in a low-key and decent-looking mansion.

"Didn't you go to meet the other rulers?" Why did you suddenly come to see me again?" A soft and serene voice greeted Zygoz, who had walked into the mansion, so he immediately turned to Virgil, who was standing among the flowering plants.

Virgil herself deserves to be considered the prettiest woman among the other female demon lords, especially since her beauty is truly extraordinary and the aura that radiates from her body is very calming; even the second demon lord was amazed and enchanted by her beauty.

Virgil has blonde, wavy hair that flows down to his waist. Her heart-shaped face looks mature and enthralling, even though her face is devoid of make-up. Her eyes, with their gentle look and attractive golden pupils, captivate people's souls with their gentleness.

Apart from her beauty, Virgil also has a tall figure, with a height of around 6' 7", making her the same height as Oz. Her figure is not too slim or full, and a white silk long dress perfectly encases her body, with a golden flower belt wrapped around her perfectly defined waist.
Her smooth skin is not white but not dark either, and her perfectly round DD-Cup breasts hang beautifully on her chest, making her look like a perfect woman.

"Ha ha." Oz laughed before answering Virgil's question. "I met Angela earlier, and she agreed to join us. However, that human kid suddenly contacted me, especially since Ashreth was taking him to the Amaris Twins's tower. Unfortunately, he couldn't possibly face them on his own because they were much stronger than him, and their subordinates also overpowered him.
That's why he needed help to deal with them, and my best choice is you because he wants to separate the white Amaris from her twin sister."

"Oh?" Virgil was a bit surprised after hearing that. "The white Amaris, huh? It's just a trivial matter for me, and I have no problem helping that kid. However, the black Amaris's abilities are more terrifying than her twin sister's, so I'm not sure that he can handle her by himself."

"You're right, that kid might have a hard time handling the black Amaris." Oz answered with a nod of approval. "However, he was truly cunning, and he had prepared several things before facing them, including implanting something into the fake Janette's body.

Unfortunately, he didn't tell me what he actually implanted into her body, and he was sure the twins had already absorbed that thing, but he's worried that the white Amaris's light power can neutralize it, so he wants us to take him away."

"Let's go now; I'll take the white Amaris with me, so the kid can take care of the black Amaris." After he said that, two black wings immediately spread out behind Virgil's back, and she quickly flew into the air.

'In the past, Virgil was a member of the Tian Realm, but she felt that the place was boring and full of hypocrites. That's why she decided to leave and come to this realm, and she quickly established her position as one of the demon rulers.' Oz then immediately flew after her, and the two of them flew exceptionally fast.
In just a few minutes, they had left Virgil's sub-realm, which was not as large as the sub-realms of the other demon rulers, especially considering her dislike of crowds.

Virgil immediately released his demon power as they entered the Amaris Twins' sub-realm, specifically the bright area of the white Amaris. "This way, the little girl will definitely sense my aura, and she will come to us soon, so we don't need to bother picking her up there. Speaking of that human kid, you still haven't told me your real reason to trust him so much."

"Isn't my reason obvious? Have you ever met a living being with two real identities as him?" Virgil responded to Oz by shaking her head. "Actually, he still has another identity, and his third identity is as real as his other two identities."
Virgil was completely shocked to hear that. "Another identity? What's the third identity?"
"Yeah." Oz nodded to Virgil. "His third identity is a beast—a fox beast, to be precise. However, he is not a demon fox beast, and he has light power like you."

"Eh?" Virgil blinked repeatedly as she looked at Oz, especially since his revelation really shocked her. "How is that possible? How can a single living being have three identities? I've visited all four realms, but I've never met anyone like him before."

"Ha ha." Oz laughed at Virgil's questions. "Even I myself have never seen another living being like him, and I probably wouldn't know his three identities if I didn't constantly monitor our realm. He initially entered this realm in his human form, but later he showed his incubus and fox beast forms to the Dryards.

That's why I decided to approach him, especially since he was clearly a special living being, and I believed he could bring peace to this realm. Anyway, he's already met Angela, and he also asked me to arrange a meeting with you."

"All right, I will meet that kid, so you can take him to my sub-realm later." Without hesitation, Virgil immediately agreed, particularly intrigued by Zhang Fei's three identities and his ability to possess both darkness and light elements simultaneously. "She's finally arrived."
*Swoosh*

In a few seconds, the white Amaris had already appeared in front of them, but she clearly kept her distance from Virgil, and her body also trembled slightly after she saw his smile. "Why did you call me here?"

"Ha ha." Virgil chuckled and moved next to the white Amaris before embracing her shoulders. "I've got something to do with you, so I want you to come with me. If you dare to refuse me, I will tell your sister that you have the light element, and I will tell her that you also have relations with people of my race. You surely know what would happen if she knew all about that, right?
"Tch!" The white Amaris gritted her teeth in annoyance before agreeing to Virgil's wishes, but she then turned to Oz and inquired. "Why are you with this woman, Old Zygoz?"

"Didn't you already know my reason?" Oz turned her question around. "So far, I don't have any concrete evidence of your involvement in the disappearance of the two demon lords, but I will find out everything one day, and I will punish you with my own hands if you are truly involved in their disappearance."

After hearing that, the white Amaris frowned, but she was fully confident in her abilities, especially her illusions, so she was sure that Oz would never succeed in finding any evidence. "Humph! You're such a stubborn old man!
I do have light power, but that doesn't mean I have any relationships with the people of the Tian Realm, and I also don't know anything about the disappearance of the two demon lords."
Oz didn't respond to her and turned to Virgil, who forcefully took the white Amaris away with her, making her feel annoyed with her attitude.

After that, Oz searched the bright area for evidence that the white Amaris were hiding from him. Despite his status as the second demon lord, he was not omnipotent, and her ability to create illusions was truly extraordinary.

"Sigh, I can only hope that kid can help me uncover everything; otherwise, it will be too late if people from both realms invade my realm again." Oz then looked far away, and he found that Ashreth had arrived at the tower, bringing Feltia with her.
"I don't know what you plan to do with the black Amaris, but you better be careful with her, especially with her illusion ability, which is her main ability."

When Ashreth brought Feltia into the tower, the female demons, including Naeth and Nadea, whom the twin Amaris had chosen to reside there, looked at her questioningly, prompting her to explain the situation to them. "I understand your thoughts, particularly since her demon rank is still low. However, our two lords asked me to bring her here, and I couldn't possibly refute her orders, right?
Therefore, if you have any questions about her, it would be best if you directly asked them."

Naturally, none of them dared to do that, especially since their two lords' orders were absolute, and the two of them would definitely punish them if they dared to question their orders. Worst of all, they would throw them out of their tower, and their lives would be worse if that happened, so they immediately let Ashreth take Feltia away.

On the other hand, Feltia observed them, checking their identities one by one on the map, with Nadea catching her attention the most. After all, she has a pending mission to find a missing demon, and he suspects that the mission is about his daughter, Nauvia.
'For now, I will think of a way to deal with the black Amaris first, and after I succeed in bringing her under my control, I will meet that siren woman.'

Minutes later, they arrived at the top of the tower, and Ashreth briefly kissed Feltia's lips. "Honestly, I still want to enjoy time with you, but we have to part ways here. Moreover, my lords forbid me to enter, so you can enter that room by yourself, and I will go straight back to Shire Demon City."
After she said that, Ashreth immediately left the place, and Feltia continued to look at her back until she disappeared from her sight.

Feltia took a deep breath before entering the Amaris Twins' room, but she was a little surprised to see the interior, especially since black and white combined perfectly. When she saw the naked black Amaris absorb the fake Janette's demon power, she smiled faintly. 'Ha ha!

That woman still thought that the demon lord seed inside her body was real, but she didn't know that it was just a residue of that seed. Moreover, she still doesn't seem to be aware of the thing that I implanted in You Han's body, and she continues to absorb it non-stop.'

Feltia then thought about trying her lust demon abilities on her or activating the thing in You Han's body first, but she immediately dropped her intention as soon as the black Amaris glanced at her, especially since she was still too strong for her.

Suddenly, the black Amaris moved in front of her, causing Feltia to become slightly tense. She quickly pulled out a black collar and attached it to her neck. 'Fuck! Does she think I'm a dog? Why is she wearing this kind of collar on me?'

"Do you know what this collar is for?" Feltia shook her head at the black Amaris. "I obtained this demon sealing collar from the site of the ancient war between the first demon lord and the people of the Tian Realm, which they created to seal our demon power and abilities.
Initially, I never considered using it on you, but your uniqueness and the fact that your demon rank rose from Baron to Earl in just two weeks have compelled me to do so."

'Sigh! Unfortunately, there's no method to hide my demon rank, so this woman suspects me now.' Feltia muttered in her heart with a low sigh, and she then asked the black Amaris. "My lord, why did you ask Lady Ashreth to take me to this tower? Even though my demon rank has reached Earl Rank, my rank is still too low to enter this place, and your subordinates seem unhappy with your decision."

"Haha." The black Amaris laughed at Feltia's last sentence. "What could they do? Even though their demon rank is quite high, they are still low-class demons in my eyes, and I can dispose of them whenever I want, so they won't dare go against my decision."
"I see." Feltia nodded in understanding, but the black Amaris suddenly waved her hand, tearing her clothes to pieces and leaving her naked.
Before Feltia could protest, the black Amaris had already hugged and kissed her lips, and she intended to absorb her demon power.

However, the black Amaris immediately separated their lips and looked at Feltia in shock, especially since she couldn't absorb her demon power. 'How is this possible? Did she use something to prevent me from doing it? That's impossible! I'm one of the demon rulers, and my demon rank is much higher than hers, but this is the first time I can't absorb another demon's power.'
Dissatisfied with that, the black Amaris kissed Feltia's lips once again, but she still couldn't absorb her demon power, which confused her even more.
In fact, Feltia also felt confused about that, so she asked Mei. 'Is the system preventing this woman from absorbing my demon power?'

[No, master. If the system had done that, it would undoubtedly have sent you a notification, but it did not respond in any way. I don't have a definitive answer, but I think that the black Amaris is unable to absorb your demon power because your demon bloodline has merged with your other two bloodlines.]
Since neither she nor Mei had an answer for that, Feltia chose to ignore it and gave the black Amaris a direct embrace. "Do you want me to serve you, my lord?"

[Even so, you have to be careful, master. The black Amaris can maintain her consciousness even though her mind is filled with lust, and she will immediately attack you if she realizes your plans against her.]

Feltia nodded in agreement with that. 'I'm not too worried about the black Amaris, especially since my speed is much faster than hers. However, if I don't do it carefully, I'll have a difficult time getting close to her again, especially since she'll raise her guard if I fail to do so in one try.'

[Why don't you just activate that thing, master? If you activate it, the black Amaris's movement will become sluggish, and she might also fall under the control of her lust, so you can take advantage of the situation to put that collar around her neck.]

'Hehehe.' Feltia laughed evilly before putting on the collar again, and she deactivated her invisibility afterwards, especially since the black Amaris was probably watching her. 'Honestly, I wanted to activate it soon, but I thought it would be better if I subdued her naturally, and she might be obedient to me.
However, I will use it if I have difficulty subduing her, and I will force her to obey me by using that thing.'
After that, Feltia immediately got out of bed and left the room, heading to explore other areas of the tower. 'Anyway, have you saved the black Amaris' data?'
[Yes, I will display it now.]
Name: Amaris
Age: 5000+ years old
Gender: Female
Race: Illusion Demon
Rank: Duchess
Element: Darkness
Physique: Illusion Demon
Abilities: illusion creation, illusion negation, illusionary binding, absolute immortality (within illusion), illusion empowerment, possession, etc.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light

'Hmm? Most of her abilities are related to illusions, huh?' Feltia muttered as she nodded repeatedly. 'Moreover, her illusion negation makes her immune to illusions, so I think it's much better than her illusion creation, right?'

[I think so too, master. In the cultivation world, there were many cultivators who understood illusions, and they also had the ability to break illusions. There are also many illusion formation arrays, and many of them have the potent effect of confining other living beings, so I think the black Amaris's illusion negation is indeed better for you.
In this way, if you encounter such cultivators or formation arrays, you can negate their illusions, even if you find yourself trapped within them.]
Feltia had thought about it before, so she agreed with Mei. 'All right, I just need to be patient for now, and I will mimic that ability later, so the black Amaris won't be too suspicious of me.'
Feltia raised her eyebrows as darkness enveloped the surrounding area, and she felt a hand touch her shoulder from behind, alerting her immediately. "Haha! You don't need to be this tense, right?"
"Tch!" Feltia gritted her teeth before asking. "Why did you come here, Oz? Won't the black Amaris notice your presence?"

"Haha." Oz laughed in response. "If the black Amaris could notice my presence, I wouldn't be able to hide myself for so many years, right? Anyway, Virgil agreed to meet you, so you can arrange your time to come to her sub-realm. Besides, the White Amaris was in her hands now, and she should have sealed her demon power."

"I see." Feltia nodded in understanding. "All right, I will arrange a time as soon as possible to meet Virgil. As for the white Amaris, I already have plans for her, and I will use her as bait to lure Theo."
"Theo?"

"Oh! I forgot to tell you about that matter." Feltia then informed Oz about her meeting with Dou Luotian and Micah, and she also shared her conversation with them, which shocked the second demon lord. "According to them, Theo is the liaison between the white Amaris and his higher-ups, but they don't have much information about which higher-ups ordered him."

Oz nodded to Feltia. "I didn't expect the situation in the Tian Realm to be like that, but it's excellent for this realm. That way, they won't think about invading this realm anytime soon, and they'll focus on stabilizing the situation in their realm first.
Anyway, I want you to tell me if you managed to dig up information from the white Amaris, so I can capture Theo myself, and I will dig up information from him."

"All right." Feltia immediately agreed with that. "It would be better if you left now, or the black Amaris will find out if I disappear for too long, and I'll contact you when one of my clones comes to this realm."

Without another word, Oz disappeared from the tower, and the surrounding area became bright once again, so Feltia immediately continued looking around the tower area. However, the female demons residing in the tower continued to gaze at her with disapproval, but she ignored their stares and checked their status through the system scan.

Unfortunately, Feltia didn't find any of their abilities interesting, so she chose to ignore them. Suddenly, he sensed the hostile gazes of two female demons observing him from a distance. 'Naeth and Nadea, huh? I don't want to get into trouble with the black Amaris, so I won't do anything to you guys. It would be better if you didn't get into trouble with me, or I'd make you both regret it.'
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 270 Demons.]
[Reward: 27,000 female essences.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 6,000 Qi]
[Reward: 60 green jewels.]

The appearance of the two quest notifications made Feltia sigh softly, especially since it was impossible for her to leave the tower to fight the demon beasts. 'Let Zhang Xiaolong take care of the quest; he can also go meet Virgil.'

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong was standing on a large tree not far from the Mo Clan's residence, checking the strength of every clan member. 'Pang Liyuan told me that this clan is the second strongest in this realm, but their total strength is already above the Shen Clan, with so many cultivators at the Heaven Realm in this clan.
Not to mention, their ancestors are still in seclusion, and their cultivation has probably reached the sovereign realm now, so I have to be more careful of them.'
[Husband! My cultivation has already touched the final barrier, and I will try to break through to the sovereign realm now, so I will go to your original body's side.]

'All right.' Since the people of the Mo Clan were powerful and Zhang Xiaolong couldn't use his bloodline against them, he decided to abandon his intention of infiltrating the clan. Moreover, he didn't know whether the clan was protected by a powerful formation or not, so he didn't want to take that risk, and he immediately returned to his hiding place.

Zhang Xiaolong's decision to move Wang Xiaoyi and Chu Youqian into the training space upon his arrival shocked both women, and his decision instantly dashed their hopes of escaping from him. "Hey, Pang Hong! Do you know any members of the Mo Clan?"

"Yes, master." Pang Hong responded by nodding. "I know some of them, like Mo Zongzan and Mo Zhantao, but their status within that clan is not high. However, Pang Gui knows many of them, so you can ask him to help you if you want to face that clan."

"Pang Gui, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong muttered to himself before he contacted his other slave and ordered him to return to the northern region immediately, especially since the situation in the eastern region was under control.

After that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately sat cross-legged to complete the daily quest first, especially since he couldn't wait to meet Virgil, and he still had to complete the daily quest in the Diyu Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: Boitata's Breakthrough
paragraphs: *Thud*
Zhang Fei and Shen Yu suddenly landing in the Liu Clan's main garden shocked the people, but they had already recognized his identity, so they did not stop him.
However, they were once again shocked when Zhang Fei summoned Boitata out of the beast space, particularly since she was already in her beast form, and the fiery eyes on her body horrified them.

Before they could ask him, Liu Qingyu, Liu Hua, the Chu Sisters, Chu Liuxiang, and Yuan Manqiu had already arrived at their side. The Liu Sisters immediately ordered them to spread out and stand guard, especially since he had told them that Boitata was about to break through to the sovereign realm, and her breakthrough would probably arouse the curiosity of the cultivators in the southern regions.

After all, the strongest cultivators in the region were Shen Xueyi and the Shen Ancestors, and the cultivation of the three of them was only at the 10-Star Heaven Realm, so none of them had ever witnessed breaking through to the Sovereign Realm.

Like the people from the Liu Clan, Chu Liuxiang and Yuan Manqiu were also horrified by Boitata's true form, especially since those fiery eyes stared at them at the same time, but they were also relieved that she was not their enemy.
"Husband, I will start my breakthrough now."
Zhang Fei nodded to Boitata. "You can start your breakthrough without needing to think about anything else, and we will protect you."

Boitata immediately closed her fiery eyes, along with all the eyes throughout her body, and her Qi fluctuated before exploding, causing a wave of strong wind to sweep across the entire area of the Liu Clan.
*Swoosh*

The people from the Liu Clan, who were standing guard around their residence, looked excited as they looked at Boitata, especially since they were about to witness a cultivator break through to the Sovereign Realm.
"Fei! Will Big Sis Boitata be okay?" Chu Qing inquired as she hugged Zhang Fei's left arm, but her eyes continued to stare at the giant snake.

"Yeah." Zhang Fei then hugged Chu Qing's waist. "I've witnessed Hu Yue break through to the sovereign realm before, and her breakthrough was smooth. Moreover, Boitata is a divine beast like her, so I believe that she can pass her breakthrough smoothly."

Chu Qing still felt worried about Boitata, especially since breaking through to the sovereign realm was truly not an easy matter. Even the Shen Ancestors had been cultivating for a long time and made numerous attempts to reach that stage, but they were still unable to do so.

"Fei!" Chu Ying abruptly called out to her husband as she was bringing her grandmother to his side, and she introduced her to Zhang Fei. "She is our grandmother, Yuan Manqiu, and she lives in the eastern region. However, she does not live with Wang Xiaoyi and the others; she lives in a small village not far from the Desolate Sect."
'Buy those basic pills, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
{You got Essence Qi Pill x2}
{You got Meridian Cleansing Pill x2}
{You got Dantian Strengthening Pill x2}
{You got Soul Enhanced Pill x2}
{You got Yin Purifying Pill x1}
{You got Yang Purifying Pill x1}
{3,200,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance}

Zhang Fei immediately took those pills from the system inventory and gave them to Yuan Manqiu. "Grandma, consider these pills to be our meeting gift; they will be of great help to you and that old man."

Yuan Manqiu looked at Zhang Fei in shock after she recognized the grade of each pill, and she wanted to ask him where he got them from, but Chu Ying immediately signaled her not to ask anything and just accepted them.

"Thank you." Yuan Manqiu immediately put those pills in her storage ring, then took Zhang Fei's hand and spoke to him. "Honestly, I still find it strange that Ying'er and Qing'er chose to be your wives, but I can see that they are happy with you, and they have also told me many things about you, so I hope you will continue to look after and protect them."

Zhang Fei smiled and grabbed Yuan Manqiu's hand back. "Grandma, I promise that I will always protect them well, so you don't need to worry about them. Anyway, I intend to bring them back to the Chu Clan after Boitata completes her breakthrough, so I hope you can come with us, especially since they miss you so much."

"All right." Yuan Manqiu immediately agreed to Zhang Fei's request, especially since she herself also missed her two granddaughters. Besides, she was also curious about his families and other wives who lived in the Chu Clan. "Old man, you should tell Chu Chongzi and Yao Chi to return to the eastern Chu Clan, and we will spend some time in the western Chu Clan."

Chu Liuxiang nodded in agreement with his wife, and he immediately asked the two to return to their clan, especially since they had been away for quite some time. Since he was curious about the fate of Wang Xiaoyi and Chu Youqian, he immediately asked Zhang Fei about them. "Have you done anything to my wife and daughter?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei had no intention of hiding it from Chu Liuxiang, but he did not tell him the truth either. "Wang Xiaoyi brought Chu Youqian to the Northern Region, so I ordered Boitata to capture them, and they are now in my slaves' care. However, I have no intention of enslaving or torturing them, and I will only harvest their yin qi using a method that I believe is not harmful for them."

Chu Liuxiang himself had already guessed that Zhang Fei would not let go of his wife and granddaughter, especially after the Liu Sisters and the Chu Sisters told him and Yuan Manqiu quite a lot about him. Since he had already given up on both of them, he had no intention of begging him.

Even though Chu Liuxiang didn't say anything and his expression was still normal, Yuan Manqiu had accompanied him for decades, so she fully understood her husband's feelings and held his hand while rubbing it.

Suddenly, two groups of cultivators landed in the Liu Clan's main garden at the same time. The first group was Zhang Lingxue, Zhao Ziqin, and Chang Wenjie. The second group was Shen Xueyi, Xi Zihua, Yan Luan'er, Shi Yue, and several elders, such as Shen Xueyi's loyalists, Shen Hai, Zhiyu Fengzhi, Xuan Hao, and others.
All of them could feel Boitata's Qi fluctuating, indicating that she would break through soon, so they all rushed to the Liu Clan to watch her break through to the Sovereign Realm.

Many cultivators from Southern River City and other cities could feel it, but none of them dared to approach the Liu Clan, so they crowded the sky a little far from the clan's residence, including people from the Cai and You clans.
Zhang Fei didn't think much about other cultivators, but his gaze fell specifically on the people from the Cai and You clans, especially the two clan patriarchs, Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen.

Seeing so many cultivators coming, Liu Qingyu immediately activated a protective formation array in the Liu Clan to prevent unwanted things, and a transparent barrier immediately enveloped the entire clan area, including the outermost area.
'Did you manage to find Chang Wenhao?' Zhang Fei immediately asked Zhang Lingxue via telepathy.
Zhang Lingxue shook her head at her husband. 'Cai Shangjun has hidden Cai Wenhao somewhere else, so I haven't discovered his whereabouts to this day.'
Zhang Fei then opened the map to look for Chang Wenhao's locations throughout the southern region, but he had a hard time finding him, especially since there were countless green dots on the map.
Despite this, Zhang Fei finally managed to find Chang Wenhao's location, which was quite far west of the region and close to the western border.
Zhang Fei immediately gave Chang Wenhao's location to his wife, and Zhang Lingxue flew away from the Liu Clan without saying a word, confusing Zhao Ziqin and Chang Wenjie, who came with her.

'Lingxue is going somewhere to capture Chang Wenhao.' Zhao Ziqin was taken back for a moment when she heard that, and she immediately nodded to Zhang Fei without asking anything. 'Anyway, we will return to the Western Region today, but we will not immediately enter seclusion because I will return to my home realm for some time.'
Zhao Ziqin thought for a while before speaking to Zhang Fei. 'In that case, you can send me into your training space, and I will join Sister Lian to catch up with the others.'

Zhang Fei immediately asked Mei to open the portal to the training space, and she closed it again after Zhao Ziqin entered. Chang Wenjie, intrigued by this, promptly questioned him. "How did you manage to create a portal like that, Fei? Where did it take Ziqin?"

"You're not my family or my wife, so I don't need to tell you that, right?" Chen Wenjie felt a little irritated by Zhang Fei's answer, but she remembered that he didn't like emotional women, so she immediately swallowed her anger. "Anyway, I can see that you've changed quite a bit, but it's still not enough, so you still have a lot to work on, especially your emotions."

"I know." Chang Wenjie replied with a nod. "Changing someone's character is not as easy as turning the palm of our hand, and I've been used to acting like that since I was little. Even so, I will continue to change, and I will prove that I can be a better woman, not just to attract your interest in me but also for my own good."
"That's good."
Suddenly, they saw Boitata's body covered in a red and blue aura that came from her fire and water elements, and her body rose into the air by itself.

However, Zhang Fei frowned after he felt the changes not only in Boitata's body but also in the sky above the Liu Clan residence, so they all immediately looked up and saw a flash of lightning above the night sky.
"Fei'er, I think it was Boitata's lightning tribulation, but I don't understand how she managed to attract it."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding when Liu Hua spoke to him, especially since he himself had read about such a thing before. However, he felt strange about it, particularly because Hu Yue did not trigger a lightning tribulation when she broke through to the sovereign realm, and Hu Lili had never mentioned anything about it. 'What happened to her, Mei?
Why did her breakthrough trigger the lightning tribulation?'

[Master, a lightning tribulation can occur due to several factors, one of which is a person's karma, be it good or bad. Moreover, Boitata has been stuck in the Heaven Realm for too long, and she also used a lot of precious treasures to achieve her current cultivation before she met you.

Besides, you also gave her those pills and your yang qi, all of which might have caused her breakthrough, provoking the lightning tribulation, and the heavens wanted to test her. Even so, you shouldn't worry about her because her body has already become much stronger due to all of that, and her lightning tribulation isn't that strong either, so it won't hurt her and will instead strengthen her.]
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh after listening to Mei's explanation, but he couldn't do anything to help Boitata get through her breakthrough, so he could only wait anxiously.

After a few minutes, the lightning flashes in the sky became increasingly intense, and the other cultivators who were watching began to whisper. However, Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen looked excited when they saw that, and they hoped that Boitata's lightning tribulation would kill her so that there would be fewer strong cultivators beside Zhang Fei.
*Zap...Zap...Zap...*
Several lightning bolts quickly descended from the sky, striking Boitata's body and electrocuting her, causing her expression to look painful and her body to writhe in pain.
Unfortunately, Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen's wish for Boitata to die did not come true, and her body immediately absorbed the remaining lightning, which strengthened it even more.
*Boom*

A burst of Qi immediately erupted from Boitata's body as soon as she crossed the final threshold, and a wave of Qi that was much stronger than before swept across the entire area, both land and sky, causing those who were waiting for her to be pushed back several steps.

However, they were shocked to see that Boitata's already large beast form grew even larger, and the number of fiery eyes on her body also increased. Aside from that, her fire and water elements increased quite significantly, making them feel cool and hot at the same time.
After a few minutes, Boitata's beast form shrank rapidly, and she returned to her human form before releasing a loud cry. "I made it! I've reached the sovereign realm now!"

Zhang Fei was relieved to see that Boitata had successfully completed her breakthrough, and he immediately flew in front of her, hugging and briefly kissing her. "Congratulations! Your years of waiting are finally over, and you have reached this stage. However, our cultivation road is still long ahead, and we will continue to help each other reach higher levels."
"Haha." Boitata laughed before teasing Zhang Fei. "How about we dual-cultivate now, husband? I think your cultivation can reach the earth realm faster with the help of my current yin qi."
Zhang Fei smiled and squeezed Boitata's buttocks. "What a naughty serpent! I like your idea, but we'll do it later after I return from my home realm, and we'll go into seclusion for a few months."
"That's great!" Boitata then looked at the cultivators clustered in the distant sky. "What are you guys waiting for now? Disperse now! Otherwise, I will beat you all up at once!"

Upon hearing that, all of them, including Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen, hastily fled, particularly because Boitata, with her cultivation reaching the 1-Star Sovereign Realm, was now the strongest in the Southern Region.

sentences.text: *Thud*
Zhang Fei and Shen Yu suddenly landing in the Liu Clan's main garden shocked the people, but they had already recognized his identity, so they did not stop him.
However, they were once again shocked when Zhang Fei summoned Boitata out of the beast space, particularly since she was already in her beast form, and the fiery eyes on her body horrified them.
Before they could ask him, Liu Qingyu, Liu Hua, the Chu Sisters, Chu Liuxiang, and Yuan Manqiu had already arrived at their side.

The Liu Sisters immediately ordered them to spread out and stand guard, especially since he had told them that Boitata was about to break through to the sovereign realm, and her breakthrough would probably arouse the curiosity of the cultivators in the southern regions.

After all, the strongest cultivators in the region were Shen Xueyi and the Shen Ancestors, and the cultivation of the three of them was only at the 10-Star Heaven Realm, so none of them had ever witnessed breaking through to the Sovereign Realm.

Like the people from the Liu Clan, Chu Liuxiang and Yuan Manqiu were also horrified by Boitata's true form, especially since those fiery eyes stared at them at the same time, but they were also relieved that she was not their enemy.
"Husband, I will start my breakthrough now."
Zhang Fei nodded to Boitata.
"You can start your breakthrough without needing to think about anything else, and we will protect you."

Boitata immediately closed her fiery eyes, along with all the eyes throughout her body, and her Qi fluctuated before exploding, causing a wave of strong wind to sweep across the entire area of the Liu Clan.
*Swoosh*

The people from the Liu Clan, who were standing guard around their residence, looked excited as they looked at Boitata, especially since they were about to witness a cultivator break through to the Sovereign Realm.
"Fei!
Will Big Sis Boitata be okay?" Chu Qing inquired as she hugged Zhang Fei's left arm, but her eyes continued to stare at the giant snake.
"Yeah." Zhang Fei then hugged Chu Qing's waist.
"I've witnessed Hu Yue break through to the sovereign realm before, and her breakthrough was smooth.
Moreover, Boitata is a divine beast like her, so I believe that she can pass her breakthrough smoothly."
Chu Qing still felt worried about Boitata, especially since breaking through to the sovereign realm was truly not an easy matter.
Even the Shen Ancestors had been cultivating for a long time and made numerous attempts to reach that stage, but they were still unable to do so.
"Fei!" Chu Ying abruptly called out to her husband as she was bringing her grandmother to his side, and she introduced her to Zhang Fei.
"She is our grandmother, Yuan Manqiu, and she lives in the eastern region.
However, she does not live with Wang Xiaoyi and the others; she lives in a small village not far from the Desolate Sect."
'Buy those basic pills, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
{You got Essence Qi Pill x2}
{You got Meridian Cleansing Pill x2}
{You got Dantian Strengthening Pill x2}
{You got Soul Enhanced Pill x2}
{You got Yin Purifying Pill x1}
{You got Yang Purifying Pill x1}
{3,200,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance}
Zhang Fei immediately took those pills from the system inventory and gave them to Yuan Manqiu.
"Grandma, consider these pills to be our meeting gift; they will be of great help to you and that old man."

Yuan Manqiu looked at Zhang Fei in shock after she recognized the grade of each pill, and she wanted to ask him where he got them from, but Chu Ying immediately signaled her not to ask anything and just accepted them.
"Thank you." Yuan Manqiu immediately put those pills in her storage ring, then took Zhang Fei's hand and spoke to him.

"Honestly, I still find it strange that Ying'er and Qing'er chose to be your wives, but I can see that they are happy with you, and they have also told me many things about you, so I hope you will continue to look after and protect them."
Zhang Fei smiled and grabbed Yuan Manqiu's hand back.
"Grandma, I promise that I will always protect them well, so you don't need to worry about them.
Anyway, I intend to bring them back to the Chu Clan after Boitata completes her breakthrough, so I hope you can come with us, especially since they miss you so much."
"All right." Yuan Manqiu immediately agreed to Zhang Fei's request, especially since she herself also missed her two granddaughters.
Besides, she was also curious about his families and other wives who lived in the Chu Clan.
"Old man, you should tell Chu Chongzi and Yao Chi to return to the eastern Chu Clan, and we will spend some time in the western Chu Clan."
Chu Liuxiang nodded in agreement with his wife, and he immediately asked the two to return to their clan, especially since they had been away for quite some time.
Since he was curious about the fate of Wang Xiaoyi and Chu Youqian, he immediately asked Zhang Fei about them.
"Have you done anything to my wife and daughter?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei had no intention of hiding it from Chu Liuxiang, but he did not tell him the truth either.
"Wang Xiaoyi brought Chu Youqian to the Northern Region, so I ordered Boitata to capture them, and they are now in my slaves' care.
However, I have no intention of enslaving or torturing them, and I will only harvest their yin qi using a method that I believe is not harmful for them."

Chu Liuxiang himself had already guessed that Zhang Fei would not let go of his wife and granddaughter, especially after the Liu Sisters and the Chu Sisters told him and Yuan Manqiu quite a lot about him.
Since he had already given up on both of them, he had no intention of begging him.

Even though Chu Liuxiang didn't say anything and his expression was still normal, Yuan Manqiu had accompanied him for decades, so she fully understood her husband's feelings and held his hand while rubbing it.
Suddenly, two groups of cultivators landed in the Liu Clan's main garden at the same time.
The first group was Zhang Lingxue, Zhao Ziqin, and Chang Wenjie.
The second group was Shen Xueyi, Xi Zihua, Yan Luan'er, Shi Yue, and several elders, such as Shen Xueyi's loyalists, Shen Hai, Zhiyu Fengzhi, Xuan Hao, and others.
All of them could feel Boitata's Qi fluctuating, indicating that she would break through soon, so they all rushed to the Liu Clan to watch her break through to the Sovereign Realm.

Many cultivators from Southern River City and other cities could feel it, but none of them dared to approach the Liu Clan, so they crowded the sky a little far from the clan's residence, including people from the Cai and You clans.
Zhang Fei didn't think much about other cultivators, but his gaze fell specifically on the people from the Cai and You clans, especially the two clan patriarchs, Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen.

Seeing so many cultivators coming, Liu Qingyu immediately activated a protective formation array in the Liu Clan to prevent unwanted things, and a transparent barrier immediately enveloped the entire clan area, including the outermost area.
'Did you manage to find Chang Wenhao?' Zhang Fei immediately asked Zhang Lingxue via telepathy.
Zhang Lingxue shook her head at her husband. 'Cai Shangjun has hidden Cai Wenhao somewhere else, so I haven't discovered his whereabouts to this day.'
Zhang Fei then opened the map to look for Chang Wenhao's locations throughout the southern region, but he had a hard time finding him, especially since there were countless green dots on the map.
Despite this, Zhang Fei finally managed to find Chang Wenhao's location, which was quite far west of the region and close to the western border.
Zhang Fei immediately gave Chang Wenhao's location to his wife, and Zhang Lingxue flew away from the Liu Clan without saying a word, confusing Zhao Ziqin and Chang Wenjie, who came with her.

'Lingxue is going somewhere to capture Chang Wenhao.' Zhao Ziqin was taken back for a moment when she heard that, and she immediately nodded to Zhang Fei without asking anything. 'Anyway, we will return to the Western Region today, but we will not immediately enter seclusion because I will return to my home realm for some time.'
Zhao Ziqin thought for a while before speaking to Zhang Fei. 'In that case, you can send me into your training space, and I will join Sister Lian to catch up with the others.'
Zhang Fei immediately asked Mei to open the portal to the training space, and she closed it again after Zhao Ziqin entered.
Chang Wenjie, intrigued by this, promptly questioned him.
"How did you manage to create a portal like that, Fei?
Where did it take Ziqin?"

"You're not my family or my wife, so I don't need to tell you that, right?" Chen Wenjie felt a little irritated by Zhang Fei's answer, but she remembered that he didn't like emotional women, so she immediately swallowed her anger.
"Anyway, I can see that you've changed quite a bit, but it's still not enough, so you still have a lot to work on, especially your emotions."
"I know." Chang Wenjie replied with a nod.
"Changing someone's character is not as easy as turning the palm of our hand, and I've been used to acting like that since I was little.
Even so, I will continue to change, and I will prove that I can be a better woman, not just to attract your interest in me but also for my own good."
"That's good."
Suddenly, they saw Boitata's body covered in a red and blue aura that came from her fire and water elements, and her body rose into the air by itself.

However, Zhang Fei frowned after he felt the changes not only in Boitata's body but also in the sky above the Liu Clan residence, so they all immediately looked up and saw a flash of lightning above the night sky.
"Fei'er, I think it was Boitata's lightning tribulation, but I don't understand how she managed to attract it."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding when Liu Hua spoke to him, especially since he himself had read about such a thing before.

However, he felt strange about it, particularly because Hu Yue did not trigger a lightning tribulation when she broke through to the sovereign realm, and Hu Lili had never mentioned anything about it. 'What happened to her, Mei?
Why did her breakthrough trigger the lightning tribulation?'
[Master, a lightning tribulation can occur due to several factors, one of which is a person's karma, be it good or bad.
Moreover, Boitata has been stuck in the Heaven Realm for too long, and she also used a lot of precious treasures to achieve her current cultivation before she met you.
Besides, you also gave her those pills and your yang qi, all of which might have caused her breakthrough, provoking the lightning tribulation, and the heavens wanted to test her.

Even so, you shouldn't worry about her because her body has already become much stronger due to all of that, and her lightning tribulation isn't that strong either, so it won't hurt her and will instead strengthen her.]
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh after listening to Mei's explanation, but he couldn't do anything to help Boitata get through her breakthrough, so he could only wait anxiously.
After a few minutes, the lightning flashes in the sky became increasingly intense, and the other cultivators who were watching began to whisper.

However, Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen looked excited when they saw that, and they hoped that Boitata's lightning tribulation would kill her so that there would be fewer strong cultivators beside Zhang Fei.
*Zap...Zap...Zap...*
Several lightning bolts quickly descended from the sky, striking Boitata's body and electrocuting her, causing her expression to look painful and her body to writhe in pain.
Unfortunately, Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen's wish for Boitata to die did not come true, and her body immediately absorbed the remaining lightning, which strengthened it even more.

"Haha." Boitata laughed before teasing Zhang Fei.
