Zhang Fei smiled and squeezed Boitata's buttocks.
"What a naughty serpent!
I like your idea, but we'll do it later after I return from my home realm, and we'll go into seclusion for a few months."
"That's great!" Boitata then looked at the cultivators clustered in the distant sky.
"What are you guys waiting for now?
Disperse now!
Otherwise, I will beat you all up at once!"

Upon hearing that, all of them, including Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen, hastily fled, particularly because Boitata, with her cultivation reaching the 1-Star Sovereign Realm, was now the strongest in the Southern Region.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: Zhang Lingxue's Decisiveness
paragraphs: As he previously planned, Zhang Fei directly brought the Liu Sisters, Chu Sisters, Chu Liuxiang, and Yuan Manqiu back to the Chu Clan. As for Boitata, he sent her into beast space again because she had to protect Feltia.

Zhang Fei's clone, who lived in the Yin-Yang Pavilion, immediately went to Shen Shixi and Shen Xiwu, and he sent them into the training space after he put on the Yin-Yang Absorber Shackles on them. That way, he didn't need to bother to dual-cultivate with them to harvest their yin qi, and he could absorb their yin qi whenever he wanted.
Shen Yu also decided to go with them to the Chu Clan, especially since she was Zhang Fei's wife now, and she thought that a wife should always stay by her husband's side.

Chang Wenjie wanted to join them, but Zhang Fei refused and offered to send her back to the Blazing Phoenix Sect first, especially since Zhang Lingxue would join them later. She felt bored staying with the Cai clan, so she decided to agree, and he sent her back immediately.
As soon as they arrived at the Chu Clan, the Chu Sisters invited Zhang Fei's family members to the main hall, and they introduced their grandparents to Zhang Chen and the others.

However, Yuan Manqiu looked a little disappointed, especially since her two granddaughters had to share a husband with so many women. Additionally, she experienced a strange feeling upon discovering that Qing Yi was not only Zhang Fei's birth mother but also one of his wives.
She could see that Zhang Yue also had feelings for her little brother, and she was sure that she would become one of his wives sooner or later.
Even so, Yuan Manqiu was interested in the adorable and cheerful little girl, Xu Ling'er, especially since she loved children and all of her grandchildren had grown up.

Chu Liuxiang didn't think much about Zhang Fei's relationship, especially since one of his wives was his little sister. Instead, he was interested in the four beasts playing around in front of the main hall, especially the golden monkey, Jie Yuan, who was a quasi-divine beast.

Chu Liuxiang was taken aback by Shen Yu's decision to release Lan Zhen from her beast medallion, particularly because her cultivation was at the 2-Star Core Realm, but her beast rank had already reached the Heaven Rank, which was unusual for beasts. 'Where did that kid find all these beasts?

Even so, this is good for all of them, especially Qing'er, especially since her contract beast is a quasi-divine beast and she can become a divine beast in the future. Although the python-tailed tigre is currently weak, she is not an ordinary beast, and he will assist her in her improvement, enabling her to become a strong beast capable of protecting Ying'er.'
Shen Yu asked her contract beast to join You Bai and the other beasts, but Lan Zhen didn't seem to like them, and she preferred to lie on the floor next to her chair.

After he joined them for some time, Zhang Fei decided to leave the main hall and take Zhong Yan away with him. She needed to increase the stock of goods for his shop on Earth, which she had prepared a few days ago with the assistance of the Wen Twins.
Zhang Yue, Janette, and Guo Lan immediately chased after them, especially since they also wanted to return to earth.

Zhang Fei certainly didn't mind that, but he still hoped that his big sister could quickly decide upon her work on earth because he thought it was a waste of her time, and it would be better if she focused on her cultivation in the Sky Jade Realm.
Zhang Fei then took the three women to meet his aunt and cousin, but he sent Quan Xun to the Liu Clan, and his clone picked him up there before taking him to the Yin-Yang Pavilion.

Quan Xun's cultivation is still in the elementary realm, so he can only be an outer disciple. However, he didn't mind that, and he was determined to increase his strength faster by looking for partners in the sect, which of course would be assisted by Zhang Fei's clone.

Qing Tan herself decided to stay in the Sky Jade Realm, especially since she had no other family on earth, so she had to go back there first to hand over her companies to someone. Zhang Fei told her to leave everything to Huang Rong, which she immediately agreed to, especially since she had quite a strong influence, although not as strong as Wang Zetian's.

After that, Zhang Fei took them to see Wang Xiaofeng and Wang Zhuxian, but both of them looked disappointed because he wanted to bring them back to earth, especially since they still wanted to continue their cultivation. "You two don't need to react like this, okay?

I'll take you guys back to your home first, so you can discuss your future plans with your family, especially since I plan to enter seclusion for a long time. I will bring you both back to this realm again if it is okay for them for you guys to be away for too long, and you can continue your cultivation at that time."
Both of them looked excited after hearing that, and Wang Zhuxian asked Zhang Fei. "Brother Fei, can you bring them to this realm too?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned at that, especially since he hadn't planned to take Wang Zetian and the others to the Sky Jade Realm yet. However, he thought there was no problem if they became cultivators, and they would be able to help him protect the earth from the people from the other three realms. "I have no problem bringing our grandfather, your grandmother, and your mother into this realm.
However, I will not bring your father with us, and I will never change my decision about him."

The Wang siblings sighed in their hearts because Zhang Chen had also guessed that Zhang Fei would leave their father behind, especially after he threatened him at their first meeting. Although they didn't want that to happen, they couldn't persuade him, so they didn't say anything.

Zhang Fei frowned when he found several people waiting in front of Zhang Chen's house, and he knew they were Wang Zetian's subordinates, so he immediately spoke to the Wang siblings. "Your grandfather's subordinates are already waiting for you two outside; you guys can go back to Beijing with them first, and I will go there later."

"Yes, we will wait for you there, Brother Fei." Wang Zhuxian then asked Zhong Yan and Qing Tan. "Do you want to join us, Big Sis Yan and Aunt Tan? We can take you both to your destination before we return to Beijing."
"All right, I will join you." Zhong Yan then briefly kissed Zhang Fei's.
Qing Tan also agreed with Huang Zhuxian, so they immediately followed the Wang siblings and left Zhang Chen's house by helicopter.
Janette and Zhang Yue turned towards Guo Lan before exchanging glances, and the two went straight to their rooms, leaving her and Zhang Fei behind.

After all, Zhang Fei and Guo Lan have rarely spent time together since their relationship improved, particularly due to their busy training schedules over the past month and a half. Therefore, Janette and Zhang Yue wanted to provide them with some alone time.
Zhang Fei certainly understood their intentions, so he pulled Guo Lan into his room, which made her panic as she thought that she wanted to eat him, and she was still not ready for that.

Arriving at his room, Zhang Fei immediately faced Guo Lan and rubbed her cheeks. "Why are you tense like this, Lan? I told you that I wouldn't eat you before you were ready, and I always keep my word, so you can be more relaxed, okay?"

"En." Guo Lan nodded to Zhang Fei before hugging him. "Honestly, I feel jealous watching them get intimate with you, and I also want to do the same with you. However, there are still issues that linger in my heart, preventing me from mustering the courage to do it."

"It's okay; you don't need to force yourself." Zhang Fei then took Guo Lan to lie on the bed and hugged her. "We are still very young now, but our lifespan will continue to increase with our cultivation, so we will have a lot of time in the future. Once you feel truly ready, I will immediately take you to be my wife."
"Thank you, Fei." Guo Lan hesitated for a moment before lying on top of Zhang Fei's body, and she immediately placed a gentle kiss on his lips.
Zhang Fei immediately hugged Guo Lan's head and deepened their kiss. He separated her lips before inserting his tongue into her mouth, which she greeted by attaching her lips to his.
Despite this, Zhang Fei did not do anything else to Guo Lan. They simply kissed for so long that it became difficult for them to breathe, at which point they stopped their kiss.
"Haha." Guo Lan laughed softly before laying her head on Zhang Fei's shoulder.

After that, they reminisced about their initial meeting at Zhong Yan's food canning factory, during which Guo Lan actively assisted Zhang Fei in adjusting to the factory's environment, particularly since it was his first time working for someone else.

Moreover, he was still 17 years old at the time, and he was not used to such a situation because he was born into a rich family, so he did not understand many things and had difficulty adapting to his new situation.

Zhang Lingxue had reached the location Zhang Fei had previously indicated, a fairly large and bustling village, and she was floating in the air while concealing her aura to prevent Chang Wenhao from detecting her.

Zhang Lingxue then used her senses to search for her disciple, eventually finding Chang Wenhao in the village's largest house. However, her expression immediately darkened because he was having fun with two women from the village, so she immediately moved in there.
*Bam*

They were shocked as soon as Zhang Lingxue blasted the door, but Chang Wenhao's expression became so frightened when he saw his master; even his body was shaking intensely from her killing intent. 'Crap! How could my master find me here? No one should know my hiding place as well as my grandfather.'

Without thinking twice, Chang Wenhao tried to contact Cai Shangjun, but Zhang Lingxue immediately moved in front of him and snatched his communication device. Furthermore, she immediately sealed his cultivation before slamming him against the bedroom wall, leaving both women in a state of shock.
*Bam*
"Cough... Cough..." Chang Wenhao coughed hard as he looked at Zhang Lingxue. "Master... please... don't kill me."

"Leave!" Both women immediately grabbed their clothes and rushed out of the room, while Zhang Lingxue walked towards Chang Wenhao and stomped hard on his head, causing his face to look extremely painful. "I've looked for you for so long, and I finally found you, little bastard. I never liked your character, and I accepted you as my disciple because of Chang Wentian's request.

However, I didn't expect that behind your arrogance, you were actually a selfish coward, and you even sacrificed Wenjie and the two women to save themselves from that divine beast. Fortunately, my husband managed to save them from it, so they were able to avoid their deaths that day."

With a trembling body and a stuttering voice, Chang Wenhao tried to beg Zhang Lingxue for forgiveness. "Master... please... I was aware that I was wrong to do that, but I beg you to give me a second chance, and I promise I will never do something like that again."

"Do you think you deserve a second chance?" Zhang Lingxue inquired as she stepped harder on Chang Wenhao's head, causing blood to flow out of his mouth. "What were you thinking when you blasted Wenjie and the two women toward the divine beast's fireballs? Do you think they would survive if they were hit by two such powerful attacks?

You're a man, but your actions were truly shameful and a disgrace to men. Anyway, I've informed Chang Wuhen and Chang Wentian regarding this matter, and they've given me permission to kill you because you've tarnished the name of the Chang Clan with your cowardly actions. As for Cai Shangjun, he was in a faraway place now, so he won't be able to save you from me again."
Zhang Lingxue then moved her feet away from Chang Wenhao's head before lifting him to his feet, but she then strangled his neck tightly as she glared at him.
Chang Wenhao immediately grabbed Zhang Lingxue's hand and begged with tears. "Master... please... give.. me... a second chance."
"No." Zhang Lingxue touched Chang Wenhao's forehead as she spoke to him. "Since you are my disciple and my friend's son, I will not torture you, and I will give you an easy death."
"Master-" Zhang Lingxue didn't give Chang Wenhao a chance to speak further and killed him directly, causing the light in his eyes to disappear and his hands to hang down motionlessly.
Zhang Lingxue let out a soft sigh and released Chang Wenhao's corpse. She then walked out and snapped her fingers, causing several small flames to fly out and burn his corpse and the house.

After that, Zhang Lingxue immediately left the village and flew towards the Liu Clan, but she also sent a voice transmission to Chang Wuhen and Chang Wentian to inform them about Chang Wenhao's death.

However, he was a little surprised to see her sub-realm, especially since its size was much smaller compared to Aries or the Amaris Twins's sub-realms, and he immediately rushed to her mansion.

"At first, I thought I would have to wait a few days, so I didn't expect that you would come to see me so soon, kid." Virgo greeted Zhang Xiaolong as she walked out of her mansion, especially since she had already noticed his presence the moment he entered her sub-realm.
She quickly moved in front of him, starting him off.
"Zygoz is right; you are indeed interesting for a human."
'Scan her, Mei.'
[All right.]
Name: Virgil
Age: 10,000+ years old
Gender: Female
Race: Demonic Winged Race
Rank: Duchess
Elements: light + darkness
Physique: Winged Race
Abilities: angelic/demonic aura, angelic/demonic form, demonic infusion, light/darkness manipulation, enhanced senses, enhanced speed, blessing/curse inducement, corruption, healing, and so on.
Strong: light + darkness.
Weak: light + darkness.
'She has angelic and demonic powers, huh?
She also has two opposing elements.' Zhang Xiaolong then smiled at Virgil before replying to her.
"Time was ticking, and I didn't want to waste any time, so I came here immediately after Zygoz told me that you agreed to meet me.
Anyway, you are also more interesting than the other demon rulers, especially since you are a former member of the Tian Realm, and you have both light and darkness elements."
"Haha." Virgil laughed at that, then pointed her index finger at Zhang Xiaolong's chest.
"Unlike you, who were born with light and darkness elements, I gained my demonic power after I lived in this realm and turned into a demon, so I'm not as interesting as you said just now."

chapters.title: Chapter 336: Talk With Virgil
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong simply smiled at Virgil's words because he didn't want to tell her anything, but he immediately changed to his half-fox form, especially since she was interested in his light element.

"Oh?" Virgil then circled around Zhang Xiaolong, touching his four tails and ears to confirm their authenticity. "I've seen demon fox beasts or humanoid fox demons too many times, but this is the first time I've seen such a white fox, and I can feel that your light power is even stronger than mine. Anyway, are you a cultivator? If my guess is correct, your fox form is a cultivation beast, right?"

Virgil's question momentarily surprised Zhang Xiaolong, but he recalled that Dou Luotian and Micah were also familiar with cultivators, which piqued his curiosity about the extent of the winged race's understanding of cultivators. "How do you know about cultivators? Are there any records that mention us in the Tian Realm?
Even the demons in this realm don't know anything about us, so I'm curious about that."

"Yes." Virgil nodded to Zhang Xiaolong. "There is an ancient library, which is much older than the first demon lord in our realm, and there are countless records about cultivators and the likes in it, which were left behind by our ancestors, so we know quite a lot about them. In fact, people in the Xian Realm also knew about them, and they were always looking for ways to become like them.

Unfortunately, they didn't know how exactly to become like them, so their efforts always ended in vain. I'm unsure why the demons in this realm are unaware of them, particularly considering that their predecessors prior to the first demon lord's reign were also demon cultivators."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong nodded in understanding as he returned to his human form. "In the past, there were countless cultivators in these four realms, including human cultivators, winged races, and demon cultivators. However, I am unsure of the reason for their sudden disappearance, and my assumption is that they migrated to other realms because our realms lost the primary essence for cultivation.
Since then, there are no more cultivators in our realms, which is caused by the absence of Qi."
"Qi, huh?" Virgil muttered softly before asking Zhang Xiaolong. "Can you show me your elements?"

"Sure." Zhang Xiaolong immediately stretched out both palms and used all four elements at once, surprising Virgil with the appearance of four different elements. "As you can see, I have fire, wind, light, and darkness elements."

"Hmm?" Virgil observed Zhang Xiaolong's four elements with a serious gaze, and she looked amazed by them, especially since this was the first time she had met a living creature that had so many elements at once. "No wonder Zygoz believes that you can bring change to this realm, especially since you are truly special.
I initially doubted your abilities, but these elements reassured me, and I will also place my hope in you to change this realm and the other three."
"Ha ha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed as he retracted his elements. "Unfortunately, you are wrong if you place your hopes on me, especially since I don't really care about the fate of the four realms."

"Why is that? Aren't you a native of the human realm?" Virgil asked with a frown. "Moreover, those people not only have the ambition to take over this realm, but they also have the ambition to take over the human realm. You, as a human with extraordinary strength, can help us fix everything, right?"

"You're not wrong about that." Zhang Xiaolong did not deny that. "However, I am a cultivator now, and I live in another realm filled with countless cultivators who are much stronger and more vicious than everyone else in the four realms, so I have no interest in intervening with your problems.
Moreover, I still have a lot of problems in that realm, so I don't want to waste my time because I need to focus on my cultivation to solve them."

Virgil sighed in her heart after listening to Zhang Xiaolong's words, especially since almost all living beings were like him, and they only cared about themselves without caring about the fate of others.

"Even so, I will still act if they dare to mess up in the human realm, and I will kill anyone, be they humans, demons, winged races, or those who consider themselves gods." Virgil looked at Zhang Xiaolong in surprise, but he suddenly summoned Boitata, and he did so to prove to her that he had everything to back up his words.

When Boitata glared at her sharply, Virgil immediately stepped back away from Zhang Fei, and she could feel that her strength was superior to hers, even though her demon rank had already reached duchess rank.

"Hey! Husband! Do you want to take this female winged race as your wife?" Boitata's question caused Zhang Xiaolong to choke, and Virgil also looked at her with an incredulous look. "Look at her, husband. Her face is mature and enthralling, making her worthy of the title of the prettiest demon in this realm. Her flawlessly formed body and her massive breasts suit your taste.

Most importantly, she is still a virgin, so she deserves to be a member of your harem. If you really want her, I'll capture her now and take her to the Sky Jade Realm, and you can have fun with her later."

Boitata's words rendered Virgil speechless, but she chose not to protest, especially since she was truly afraid that she would kidnap her and take her to another realm. 'Sigh! How could he summon this woman out of thin air? Moreover, her strength clearly surpasses all demon rulers, including Zygoz.
If this kid wants, he can order her to defeat us at once, and he can become the next demon emperor without breaking a sweat.'
*Slap*

"Ouch!" Boitata let out a loud scream and jumped forward when Zhang Xiaolong slapped her butt really hard. She immediately turned to him and complained. "Why did you do that? Didn't you ask Zygos to arrange your meeting with him because you were interested in him? Moreover, she has cultivation veins, so you can teach her to become a demon cultivator.
That way, you can get her female essence and Yin Qi simultaneously, and she will also become stronger if she often drinks your yang qi."

"All right, stop talking nonsense, or I will punish you later." Instead, Boitata laughed joyfully at his answer, making Zhang Xiaolong sigh heavily before sending her back to the beast space. "You should already believe that I wasn't joking with my words, right?
Moreover, she is not my only wife, and I still have several wives who are no less powerful than her and who would be happy to help me clean up the troublemakers in the human realm."

Virgil released a soft sigh and nodded to Zhang Xiaolong. "The woman just now was clearly able to defeat me before I could make a move, so I naturally believe you. Anyway, are her words true that I can become a demon cultivator?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong answered Virgil with a nod. "You have cultivation veins, but the absence of Qi in the four realms and your ignorance about cultivation methods prevent you from cultivating. That's why I chose to live in another realm, especially since I could only cultivate there, and I had brought my whole family there.
However, I won't bring anyone from the four realms there; I will only bring those who have a direct relationship with me, like Lillea and Janette."
"Oh?" Virgil was surprised to hear the two names come out of Zhang Xiaolong's mouth. "Does that mean they are demon cultivators now?"

Zhang Xiaolong did not cover up the matter about the two Dryads from Virgil. "Even though they haven't become my official women, I already consider them to be my women, so I brought them to that realm and taught them cultivation. That's why they are now demon cultivators with fairly decent cultivation, and they will continue to grow stronger because I will continue to help them."

"I see." Virgil nodded in understanding, and he was very interested in becoming a cultivator like them. However, she had no interest in forming relationships with men, so she chose not to discuss the matter further. She quickly turned her gaze away before waving her hand.
Soon, the plant cage enclosing the white Amaris moved towards them, and she was truly shocked when she saw Zhang Xiaolong. "A human? How can a human withstand the demon aura in this realm?"

"Didn't I tell you that someone special was helping me and Zygos?" Virgil's question made the white Amaris' expression turn angry, and she glared at Zhang Xiaolong hatefully. "That's right; he and Feltia are the same person, and his true identity is a man. Unfortunately, you are in our hands now, so you won't be able to do anything to warn your twin sister about him."

Zhang Xiaolong then spoke to the white Amaris. "While you were imprisoned here, your sister had fun with me, and she was much more satisfied with my service than yours. For now, she still doesn't know that I'm a man, and I'll show her the real me sooner or later, but I will do it after she completely submits to me."

Upon hearing that, the white Amaris' anger erupted instantly, prompting her to shout at Zhang Xiaolong and launch a light-powered attack. "Bastard! You better not touch my sister! Otherwise, I will tear your body apart and feed you to my pet demon beast!"

"Ha ha." Zhang Xiaolong chuckled upon hearing the white Amaris's threat, promptly countering her light power with his own, a move that shocked her. "It's useless for you to be angry like this because your sister is already in my grasp. I will make her submit to me as soon as possible, and she won't reject me after spending so much time with me."

The white Amaris was not focused on Zhang Xiaolong's words, as she was still shocked after he used his light element. "How can you also have the light element? Moreover, I couldn't feel it when my sister and I examined you before."

"Perhaps because I am a special being?" Zhang Xiaolong then transformed into his incubus form as he approached the white Amaris, and he then displayed his light and darkness elements. In contrast to you, both of my elements are part of me, so don't be surprised if my light element is stronger than yours."
"What are you going to do to her?" Virgil inquired as she approached Zhang Xiaolong's side.
Instead, Zhang Xiaolong shook his head at Virgil. "Even though I'm a cultivator, my strength and soul power are still weaker than hers, so I can't do anything to her."
"Humph!" The white Amaris snorted before mocking Zhang Xiaolong. "A weak human like you can never match a demon ruler like me! You can only get close to my sister by using cunning methods."

"Hahaha." After hearing the laughter, the white Amaris frowned, and she immediately looked at Oz, who had just appeared. "He and Virgil can't do anything to you, but you certainly realize that I can do something to you, right?"

The white Amaris' expression turned ugly, especially since Zygoz was the strongest among them, and he also had many strange abilities that all demon rulers couldn't withstand. "You old bastard! You are a demon ruler like me, but you actually humbled yourself by plotting with this bastard male human!"

"For me, the safety of this realm and all its residents is the most important thing, and I will use all means to keep everything safe, including plotting with him to stop you and those people." Oz then turned to Zhang Xiaolong. "How about I also bind her soul with yours? That way, her life will be in your hands, and you can use her as you wish, including subduing the black Amaris."

Zhang Xiaolong took some time to consider Oz's offer, particularly since he couldn't use his demon slave mark on the white Amaris. His only viable option was to use his memory manipulation ability on her. However, he felt that it would be uninteresting if she used it on her, and he wanted to destroy her pride first before subduing her. "Can you do anything else about her?"
"No." Oz shook his head at Zhang Xiaolong. "I'm not an incubus like you, so I don't have your race's abilities, and that's the best solution I have."
Zhang Xiaolong sighed heavily before agreeing with Oz. "All right, I have no other solution, so do that now."
"No!" With panic filling her face, the white Amaris immediately shouted at Oz. "Old bastard! Don't do that to me! I don't want my soul to be bound to a weak male human like him!"

"Ha ha! You don't have any other choice, you know? If only you didn't conspire with those people, you wouldn't have a day like this." Oz immediately used his soul manipulation ability and pulled their souls out of their bodies, but they were shocked when they saw Zhang Xiaolong's soul, especially since his soul is a combination of all three forms.
However, Oz immediately executed his technique, causing part of Amaris' white soul to separate from her original soul, which he fused with Zhang Xiaolong's soul, making her expression pale.

After that, Oz returned their souls to their bodies, and he then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong. "This way, her life becomes one with yours, and you can know her memories from her soul, so we can find that place easily."

chapters.title: Chapter 337: Oz's Revelation
paragraphs: Instantly, the white Amaris's memories filled Zhang Xiaolong's mind, and he immediately knew the location of the portal connecting the Diyu Realm and the Tian Realm. 'Oz's soul manipulation ability is too terrifying.'
[Why don't you just mimic his ability, Master? If you use that ability, you will become even more overpowered, and almost no living being can match you.]

'Mei, he has lived for more than ten thousand years, and he is the second demon emperor, remember? As for me, I am still 19 years old, and my soul level is still at the early stage mortal level, so I will never be able to use it on those who are stronger than me.
Nevertheless, you're correct; there's no harm in mimicking his ability now, and it will be useful for me in the future.' Zhang Xiaolong immediately touched Oz's hand and mimicked his ability.
[Ding]
[You succeeded in mimicking the soul manipulation of a celestial demon named Oz.]
Oz raised his eyebrows for a moment as he felt something he didn't understand, but he immediately ignored it and asked Zhang Xiaolong. "How did it go? Have you found the place?"

"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong immediately informed Oz and Virgil. "The portal is located in the Death Valley, and it is protected by the sand demon snake, who lives in the desert before that place, so no one can find it."

After Zhang Xiaolong said that, the white Amaris' expression turned even paler, especially since her cover would be revealed if they went there, and she was really afraid that Oz would punish her harshly. 'Damn it! Why am I this unlucky?'
"The death valley, huh?" Oz muttered to himself as he looked at the white Amaris with sharpened eyes.
Virgil abruptly grasped Oz's hand and inquired with a serious expression. "Why are you disguised as Zygoz?"
"Oh?" Oz immediately turned to Virgil. "You noticed, huh?"

"Yes." Virgil nodded to him. "I am familiar with Zygoz's abilities, but he does not have the ability to manipulate souls like that. According to my memory, there is only one demon with such an ability, and he is the one who brought me to this realm. Isn't that right, Oz, the second demon emperor?"
"What?" After Virgil said that name, the white Amaris screamed loudly, and she glared at Oz with curiosity, fear, and other feelings.

"Hahaha!" Oz laughed out loud as he returned to his true form, making the white Amaris in the cage move backwards as her body trembled after learning the truth. "Actually, I had expected that you would recognize me, Virgil. Unfortunately, I have no other choice but to use my abilities, especially since this kid can't do it himself.

Regardless, Zygoz and I reached a consensus to do this after uncovering some clues linking the people from the Tian Realm to the disappearance of my predecessor, as well as discovering remnants of their light aura in our domain hundreds of years ago. That's why I faked my disappearance, and I sent him to the human realm."

Oz's response did not surprise Virgil, especially since she had long suspected that members of her race were responsible for the disappearance of the first demon emperor. Regrettably, their guesses were unsubstantiated due to the lack of concrete evidence.

Oz turned his attention to the white Amaris before continuing his conversation with Virgil. "Our suspicions proved correct; those people were indeed the masterminds behind my predecessor's disappearance, and she assisted them in doing so. Unfortunately, he was not in their hands, and she sent him to a place unknown to us."

"Hmm?" After Oz revealed the matter, Virgil immediately turned to the white Amaris, who looked frightened. "How could she do that? The first demon lord is much stronger than you, so he should be able to stop her easily, and he will definitely kill her."

Oz answered by shaking his head. "After all, my predecessor loved and pampered her and her sister, so I thought that he didn't have the heart to do something to her, even though he knew about her actions."

"Actually, you're right about that." Oz and Virgil immediately turned to Zhang Xiaolong. "At first, I was also confused about the matter after Dou Luotian and Micah told me about the white Amaris' involvement in the first demon emperor's disappearance, especially since she was too weak to be able to do that to him.

However, I finally found out the truth from her memories, and he didn't intend to do anything to her. Before the artifact sucked him in, he first released the ten seeds from his body, especially since they were the source of his power, and he wanted the other demons to inherit them. She tried to catch one of them, but she failed to do so."

"Does that mean the black Amaris also know about this matter? After all, the two of them were almost inseparable in the past, so I thought so." Virgil inquired as her gaze shifted back to the white Amaris.

"No." Zhang Xiaolong denied Virgil's guess. "Before she used the artifact on the first demon lord, she had already used something on the black Amaris, which caused her to fall into a deep sleep. You shouldn't be confused about her actions towards her sister, especially since she has a strong ambition to become the next demon emperor, and she doesn't want to share the position with her sister.
Moreover, the people of the Tian Realm promised her that she would be the sole ruler of this realm as long as she obeyed them, so she accepted their offer to conspire with them."

Virgil nodded in understanding as she muttered to herself. "Be it humans, demons, or winged races, none of them can escape the snare of worldly desires, especially greed. The black Amaris deeply cares for and loves her because they are twins, but the white Amaris treats her actually like that just for the sake of her ambition."

"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed at Virgil's words, especially since he himself had been in the same situation as the black Amaris, and his big brother framed him just because he always felt jealous of him. "Unlike the first demon lord, if I were in his position, I would kill this woman on the spot as soon as she tried to do such a thing to me."

"I agree with you." Oz said this as he nodded. Regrettably, my predecessor differed from us, particularly due to his kindness and gentle nature, which prevented him from doing any harm. Anyway, it would be better if we took her away to that place right now to contact them, so we can capture that winged race named Theo, and I will immediately destroy the portal."

"Are you thinking about killing the sand demon snake?" Oz suddenly asked Zhang Xiolong.
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong nodded toward Oz. "There's something I need to accomplish, and the sand demon snake is my target."
"I will help you with that." Oz immediately released a small amount of his demon aura in order to summon the sand demon snake.

In just a matter of seconds, the sand demon snake immediately came out of the pile of sand in the desert, especially since no demon could resist the aura of a demon emperor. However, its appearance left Zhang Xiaolong stunned for a moment, especially since it had four legs like a lizard and a comodo dragon head instead of a snake.

The sand demon snake instantly cowered in fear as it looked at Oz, but he then searched at the white Amaris for help, especially since she was its master. Unfortunately, she was in a tight situation and couldn't even save herself, let alone save it.
Oz then asked Zhang Xiaolong again. "Are you sure you can kill it? This sand demon snake has nearly reached duke rank, so it's stronger than you."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed and summoned Boitata again, making Oz shake his head helplessly, especially since he had seen her before in Virgil's sub-realm and knew that she was strong; not even he could defeat her. "I can't kill the snake, but my wife can do it easily."
Unlike Oz and Virgil, the white Amaris is completely shocked by the appearance of Boitata, which makes her realize that her fate is sealed.

The three demons were ignored by Boitata, who looked at the sand demon snake. "Husband, I've seen various kinds of snake beasts, but this is the first time I've seen a snake with four legs, and the shape of its head is also really weird."

"That snake head is the head of a comodo dragon, and it may not exist in cultivation worlds, but there are many of them in my home realm, especially on Comodo Island in Indonesia." Zhang Xiaolong then ordered Boitata. "You can kill the snake now so I can handle the other issues."
Boitata immediately returned to her dragon-serpent form, which not only frightened the sand demon snake, but her beast form also frightened the other three demons, including Oz.

Without wasting any time, Boitata immediately wrapped her tail around the sand demon snake, brought it to the front of her mouth, and swallowed it alive, causing two consecutive notifications to appear inside Zhang Xiaolong's head.

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong nodded in understanding. "I'm not in a rush with that, so I'll go to Tauri's sub-realm later, and it would be better if we settled matters in this sub-realm first."

Boitata quickly returned to her human form before speaking to Zhang Xiaolong. "Husband! The demon snake's taste is quite good, so I want to find and eat other demon beasts. Unfortunately, there are no more powerful demon beasts in this sub-realm, so you will have to take me to the sub-realms of the other demon rulers."
Zhang Xiaolong smiled bitterly at her words, especially since Boitata never liked demons, but she now wanted to eat other demon beasts. "All right, I will take you to the other sub-realms later."
After he sent Boitata into the beast space, Zhang Xiaolong immediately led Virgil and Oz to the location of the portal, and the second demon lord forced the white Amaris to open the seal there.

The white Amaris helplessly complied with Oz's orders, leading them to the deepest area of the place, and she immediately played the golden trumpet to summon Theo. 'Sigh! I've planned everything for hundreds of years, but all my plans went awry, and all this happened because of this bastard male human.'
After they waited for a while, the golden portal glowed brightly, and Theo unknowingly walked out of it only to fall into a trap.

As soon as he appeared, Oz immediately ambushed Theo and pressed him to the floor, which shocked him. He immediately looked at the white Amaris with a furious look, and she responded to his gaze with a helpless shake of her head. 'Damn it! This demon is stupid! How could these demons have discovered our plan?'

"Theo, right?" Virgil inquired as she squatted beside him, removing the golden-white helmet from his head. "I didn't expect that Heaven's guards would be involved in this matter, which means Moraes was the one who ordered you, right?"
"Virgil! You traitor!" Theo shouted angrily as he struggled to break free, but he was certainly no match for Oz, leaving him helpless under his pressure.

"Hehe." Virgil chuckled at that. "Unlike you guys, I have no interest or ambition to take over the other realms, and instead, I hope that all living beings in the four realms can coexist once again, like in the distant past. Unfortunately, our higher-ups have been blinded by their greed, and they were overly ambitious to become the sole ruler of all realms.
That's why I decided to leave our realm, and the second demon lord had the same hopes as me, so I decided to move to this realm and become a demon."

"You bitch!" Theo once again cursed at Virgil. "Do you think the disappearance of the second demon lord can stop us from taking over this realm? Soon! We will attack this realm and slaughter all of those disgusting creatures! As for you, the throne has prepared a harsh punishment for you, and you will definitely suffer until you die."
The white Amaris wanted to tell Theo the truth, but Oz immediately glared at her while pressing her, making her swallow back her words.
Virgil shook her head at Theo. "It would be better to think about your fate than mine, especially since you will suffer before me."

chapters.title: Chapter 338: The Tian Realm
paragraphs: "Do you need this guy, kid?" Hearing Oz's question, Theo immediately looked at Zhang Xiaolong, which shocked him even more to see a human among the demons. "If you don't need him, I will turn him into a demon, so he will suffer all his life."

"You shouldn't do that to him." Zhang Xiaolong then crouched down by Theo's side. "We don't have any spies in the Tian Realm, and he is their liaison with the white Amaris, so it would be better if we used him to spy on them, right? Moreover, his rank is only at the high order of the low level, so his soul is much weaker than mine, and I can use my demon slave mark to control him completely."

"No! Ugh!" Theo wanted to struggle again, but Oz immediately pressed his head to the floor. 'Damn it! All of this is that damn demon's fault! If she hadn't fallen into their hands, I wouldn't have experienced all this."

Zhang Xiaolong then touched Theo before implanting his demon slave mark into his soul, and he also used his memory manipulation to make him obey him, just like Pang Hong and Pang Gui did. "You can let him go, Oz."
"All right." Oz immediately let go of Theo and looked at the golden portal. "What about this portal? Should we destroy it?"

"You can destroy it, but only after I go there." Oz and Virgil abruptly looked at Zhang Xiaolong, but he just smiled at them and lifted Theo to his feet. "Did you guys forget that I can switch realms? However, I need to visit their realm first before revisiting it in the future, so I'll take this guy there now.

Moreover, I only intend to look around at their realm, and I don't want to look for trouble with them, so you don't have to worry about me. Anyway, the white Amaris won't be able to reveal my true identity to her sister, right?"
Oz nodded to Zhang Xiaolong. "I've restricted her, so she won't be able to say anything about you or us to the black Amaris."

"That's good!" Zhang Xiaolong exclaimed in satisfaction with that, but the white Amaris felt otherwise. "In that case, you can let her go back to the tower, so she can help me subdue the black Amaris faster."

After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong instantly used his invisibility to bring Theo into the golden portal, which Oz promptly destroyed as soon as it closed. "Are there any other portals in this sub-realm?"
"No." The white Amari responded by shaking her head. "However, there are still three other portals, which are respectively located in the Leo, Tauri, and Avros sub-realms."
Oz nodded in understanding at that. "All right, you can go back to your tower, or your sister will get suspicious if you disappear for too long."

The white Amaris immediately left the two of them without saying anything, but her feelings were still filled with anger, hatred, and shame, especially since Oz had fused her soul with Zhang Xiaolong's soul.
"Do you think it's okay if we let her go?" Virgil asked Oz as she looked towards the exit.

"Don't worry, she won't be able to do anything else." Oz then fell silent for a while as he thought about several things, especially about the other three demon rulers. "I think I should meet the rest of them quickly, and I hope they'll join us so we can take care of those three right away."
Virgil immediately agreed with Oz. "I think you should bring Zygoz back to this realm, and they won't refuse if you meet them as yourself."
Oz released a soft sigh before nodding to Virgil. "You can return to your sub-realm now, and I will go to the human realm to meet Zygoz."
After that, they immediately left that place, going straight to their respective destinations.
[Ding]
[The host has arrived in the winged race realm, and the system upgrade process begins.]
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded Xian Realm, and the host can access it through Gate in the future.]
[Ding]
[The training space has been upgraded to level two, and the fourth feature has been unlocked.]
[Ding]
[Quest: Challenge the winged race tower and reach the top.]
[Quest rank: Abyss]
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x 1]

'What the fuck! The system is completely crazy! It gave me a quest that exceeded my current abilities!' Zhang Xiaolong screamed in his heart after he read the fourth notification. 'I didn't expect that the system would be upgraded as soon as I set foot in this realm, and the quest levels made me think that the creator was a gamer addict, especially since those quests were like quests in a game.
Anyway, do you know the fourth feature of the training space, Mei?'
[Master, you will truly enjoy the fourth feature, particularly as it pertains to time.]
Zhang Xiaolong raised his eyebrows a moment after hearing that. 'You mean that the function of the fourth feature is to extend the time in the training space?'
[Yes! If you activate the fourth feature, the time flow in the training space will be two times faster depending on where your original body lives, and it will not affect your lifespan.]

Even though the two-times faster flow of time wasn't that much, Zhang Xiaolong was really satisfied with it, especially since it would help them a lot in understanding many things and deepening their mastery of techniques.

The most important thing was that he could dual-cultivate with his wife for longer, so their cultivation would improve faster than before, and he could also solve all the problems in his hands faster. 'That's good; you can activate it now, so Lian'er, Ziqin, and Zefyr can take advantage of the new feature.'
[Yes, Master.]

Zhang Xiaolong then looked at the realm's surroundings, but he saw nothing but a giant and wide tower in the middle. Moreover, the realm was devoid of any land, especially since clouds covered the entire area beneath it, and he could see numerous winged races circling the tower. However, there was a portal that caught his interest in the northern area, so he asked Theo.
'Where will the portal take us?'

'Master, that portal connects this realm with the Xian Realm.' Zhang Xiaolong turned to Theo in surprise. 'Unfortunately, not all members of my race can open it, and only those who have reached the third order of middle level and above can do so, such as Lord Moraes, who leads the heaven's guards.'

'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong immediately re-examined the tower and opened his map to identify the members of the winged race. However, he frowned upon the map's inability to display the top five floors of the tower. That's why he thought that the four floors were occupied by the top-level winged race, and the top floor was occupied by the throne. 'Tell me about the tower.'

Theo immediately explained to Zhang Xiaolong in detail about the tower, but his previous guess was wrong, especially since the top floor was the location of the ancient library, and they also used it for various purposes. Only one of them had reached the throne level, and he lived on the second floor from the top.
Meanwhile, those who have achieved dominance live on the third floor, those who have achieved virtue live on the fourth floor, and those who have achieved power live on the fifth floor.
Zhang Xiaolong then told Theo a few things. 'All right, you can go back and report to Moraes according to my instructions.'
'Yes, Master.'

After Theo left, Zhang Xiaolong looked at the tower for some time before asking Mei to open the gate to the Diyu Realm. He immediately returned to that realm to look for Angela in the northern sea again, especially since he wanted to mimic her ability.

When Zhang Xiaolong arrived in the northern sea, he could not find Angela there. However, he remembered that their previous meeting took place at night, so he chose to wait for her while fighting the demon beasts because he had to complete the daily quest in that realm.

The white Amaris had arrived at the tower, but she was shocked to find Feltia there, especially since she had personally witnessed Zhang Xiaolong go to the Tian Realm. "How did you get here? Didn't you go to that place?"

"Hehe." Feltia chuckled in response, and she immediately approached the white Amaris while speaking to her via telepathy, so the black Amaris wouldn't be able to eavesdrop on them. 'Since you can't reveal anything to your sister, I'll tell you the truth.
In fact, the two of us are just clones of my real body, and my real body is in another realm, so you don't need to be surprised if I can be in several places at the same time.'
Feltia's answer made the white Amaris even more shocked, especially since she had never known that there was a demon that had such an ability. Even Oz, as the second demon lord, also didn't have it.
Feltia then brought her face closer to the white Amaris's ear. 'Do you want to have fun with me? Thus, you can experience the same pleasure as your sister, which will make you addicted.'
"Don't you dare to touch me!" The white Amaris spoke angrily as she pushed Feltia away, especially since she also hated male demons like her sister. "I'll beat you up if you dare touch me!"

"Haha." Feltia chuckled at her threat. 'Did you forget that your soul was fused with mine? You can try to beat me up if you want, but you will feel the pain yourself. Anyway, I'm sure that you will surrender yourself to me soon, especially when I start having fun with your sister again later.'
After Feltia said that, the white Amaris glared at her, then angrily snorted at her before walking over to You Han, where she immediately absorbed her demon power again.
Since the white Amaris didn't want to have fun with her, and the black Amaris still hadn't returned, Feltia decided to relax in their room.

Upon arriving at Chang Wenhao's hiding village, the two old men found the house reduced to ashes, including his corpse. This discovery infuriated Cai Shangjun, who immediately massacred the entire village population to vent his anger. "That bitch, Zhang Lingxue, must have killed Wenhao! I will find him and kill him with my own hands!"

"Old Cai, I know you are furious now, but you better not act against Zhang Lingxue now." You Yuanwen immediately stopped his best friend. "You already know Zhang Fei's relationships with those clans, and she is one of his wives. If you go looking for her now and fight with her, you will die in vain."

Hearing that, Cai Shangjun immediately calmed himself by taking a deep breath and nodding in agreement with him. "You're right. With my current cultivation, I can indeed defeat Zhang Lingxue, but the Shen and Liu Clans will definitely protect her, and I won't possibly be able to face them by myself."

"That's good." You Yuanwen sighed in relief that Cai Shangjun was not stubborn and was willing to listen to him. "Additionally, Pang Zhen is on his way to this region, and he will arrive tomorrow. That's why it would be better if we waited for him, and we could ask for his help to help you take revenge on her."

"All right." Cai Shangjun immediately agreed, and he looked at the house's remaining ashes. "Let's go back; we will devise a new plan after Pang Zhen arrives, so I can avenge my grandson's death against Zhang Lingxue."

Unfortunately, Cai Shangjun's wish would never come true, especially since Zhang Fei had already ordered Shen Xueyi and Liu Qinggu to send members from both their clans to spy on him and You Yuanwen, and Pang Zhen's arrival would only bring disaster to them and their families.

sentences.text: "Do you need this guy, kid?" Hearing Oz's question, Theo immediately looked at Zhang Xiaolong, which shocked him even more to see a human among the demons.
"If you don't need him, I will turn him into a demon, so he will suffer all his life."
"You shouldn't do that to him." Zhang Xiaolong then crouched down by Theo's side.
"We don't have any spies in the Tian Realm, and he is their liaison with the white Amaris, so it would be better if we used him to spy on them, right?
Moreover, his rank is only at the high order of the low level, so his soul is much weaker than mine, and I can use my demon slave mark to control him completely."
"No!
Ugh!" Theo wanted to struggle again, but Oz immediately pressed his head to the floor. 'Damn it!
All of this is that damn demon's fault!
If she hadn't fallen into their hands, I wouldn't have experienced all this."
Zhang Xiaolong then touched Theo before implanting his demon slave mark into his soul, and he also used his memory manipulation to make him obey him, just like Pang Hong and Pang Gui did.
"You can let him go, Oz."
"All right." Oz immediately let go of Theo and looked at the golden portal.
"What about this portal?
Should we destroy it?"
"You can destroy it, but only after I go there." Oz and Virgil abruptly looked at Zhang Xiaolong, but he just smiled at them and lifted Theo to his feet.
"Did you guys forget that I can switch realms?
However, I need to visit their realm first before revisiting it in the future, so I'll take this guy there now.
Moreover, I only intend to look around at their realm, and I don't want to look for trouble with them, so you don't have to worry about me.
Anyway, the white Amaris won't be able to reveal my true identity to her sister, right?"
Oz nodded to Zhang Xiaolong.
"I've restricted her, so she won't be able to say anything about you or us to the black Amaris."
"That's good!" Zhang Xiaolong exclaimed in satisfaction with that, but the white Amaris felt otherwise.
"In that case, you can let her go back to the tower, so she can help me subdue the black Amaris faster."
After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong instantly used his invisibility to bring Theo into the golden portal, which Oz promptly destroyed as soon as it closed.
"Are there any other portals in this sub-realm?"
"No." The white Amari responded by shaking her head.
"However, there are still three other portals, which are respectively located in the Leo, Tauri, and Avros sub-realms."
Oz nodded in understanding at that.
"All right, you can go back to your tower, or your sister will get suspicious if you disappear for too long."

The white Amaris immediately left the two of them without saying anything, but her feelings were still filled with anger, hatred, and shame, especially since Oz had fused her soul with Zhang Xiaolong's soul.
"Do you think it's okay if we let her go?" Virgil asked Oz as she looked towards the exit.
"Don't worry, she won't be able to do anything else." Oz then fell silent for a while as he thought about several things, especially about the other three demon rulers.
"I think I should meet the rest of them quickly, and I hope they'll join us so we can take care of those three right away."
Virgil immediately agreed with Oz.
"I think you should bring Zygoz back to this realm, and they won't refuse if you meet them as yourself."
Oz released a soft sigh before nodding to Virgil.
"You can return to your sub-realm now, and I will go to the human realm to meet Zygoz."
After that, they immediately left that place, going straight to their respective destinations.
[Ding]
[The host has arrived in the winged race realm, and the system upgrade process begins.]
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded Xian Realm, and the host can access it through Gate in the future.]
[Ding]
[The training space has been upgraded to level two, and the fourth feature has been unlocked.]
[Ding]
[Quest: Challenge the winged race tower and reach the top.]
[Quest rank: Abyss]
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x 1]
'What the fuck!
The system is completely crazy!

It gave me a quest that exceeded my current abilities!' Zhang Xiaolong screamed in his heart after he read the fourth notification. 'I didn't expect that the system would be upgraded as soon as I set foot in this realm, and the quest levels made me think that the creator was a gamer addict, especially since those quests were like quests in a game.
Anyway, do you know the fourth feature of the training space, Mei?'
[Master, you will truly enjoy the fourth feature, particularly as it pertains to time.]
Zhang Xiaolong raised his eyebrows a moment after hearing that. 'You mean that the function of the fourth feature is to extend the time in the training space?'
[Yes!
If you activate the fourth feature, the time flow in the training space will be two times faster depending on where your original body lives, and it will not affect your lifespan.]

Even though the two-times faster flow of time wasn't that much, Zhang Xiaolong was really satisfied with it, especially since it would help them a lot in understanding many things and deepening their mastery of techniques.

The most important thing was that he could dual-cultivate with his wife for longer, so their cultivation would improve faster than before, and he could also solve all the problems in his hands faster. 'That's good; you can activate it now, so Lian'er, Ziqin, and Zefyr can take advantage of the new feature.'
[Yes, Master.]
Zhang Xiaolong then looked at the realm's surroundings, but he saw nothing but a giant and wide tower in the middle.
Moreover, the realm was devoid of any land, especially since clouds covered the entire area beneath it, and he could see numerous winged races circling the tower.
However, there was a portal that caught his interest in the northern area, so he asked Theo.
'Where will the portal take us?'

'Master, that portal connects this realm with the Xian Realm.' Zhang Xiaolong turned to Theo in surprise. 'Unfortunately, not all members of my race can open it, and only those who have reached the third order of middle level and above can do so, such as Lord Moraes, who leads the heaven's guards.'
'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong immediately re-examined the tower and opened his map to identify the members of the winged race.
However, he frowned upon the map's inability to display the top five floors of the tower.
That's why he thought that the four floors were occupied by the top-level winged race, and the top floor was occupied by the throne. 'Tell me about the tower.'

Theo immediately explained to Zhang Xiaolong in detail about the tower, but his previous guess was wrong, especially since the top floor was the location of the ancient library, and they also used it for various purposes.
Only one of them had reached the throne level, and he lived on the second floor from the top.
Meanwhile, those who have achieved dominance live on the third floor, those who have achieved virtue live on the fourth floor, and those who have achieved power live on the fifth floor.
Zhang Xiaolong then told Theo a few things. 'All right, you can go back and report to Moraes according to my instructions.'
'Yes, Master.'
After Theo left, Zhang Xiaolong looked at the tower for some time before asking Mei to open the gate to the Diyu Realm.
He immediately returned to that realm to look for Angela in the northern sea again, especially since he wanted to mimic her ability.
When Zhang Xiaolong arrived in the northern sea, he could not find Angela there.
However, he remembered that their previous meeting took place at night, so he chose to wait for her while fighting the demon beasts because he had to complete the daily quest in that realm.
The white Amaris had arrived at the tower, but she was shocked to find Feltia there, especially since she had personally witnessed Zhang Xiaolong go to the Tian Realm.
"How did you get here?
Didn't you go to that place?"

"Hehe." Feltia chuckled in response, and she immediately approached the white Amaris while speaking to her via telepathy, so the black Amaris wouldn't be able to eavesdrop on them. 'Since you can't reveal anything to your sister, I'll tell you the truth.
In fact, the two of us are just clones of my real body, and my real body is in another realm, so you don't need to be surprised if I can be in several places at the same time.'
Feltia's answer made the white Amaris even more shocked, especially since she had never known that there was a demon that had such an ability.
Even Oz, as the second demon lord, also didn't have it.
Feltia then brought her face closer to the white Amaris's ear. 'Do you want to have fun with me?
Thus, you can experience the same pleasure as your sister, which will make you addicted.'
"Don't you dare to touch me!" The white Amaris spoke angrily as she pushed Feltia away, especially since she also hated male demons like her sister.
"I'll beat you up if you dare touch me!"
"Haha." Feltia chuckled at her threat. 'Did you forget that your soul was fused with mine?
You can try to beat me up if you want, but you will feel the pain yourself.
Anyway, I'm sure that you will surrender yourself to me soon, especially when I start having fun with your sister again later.'
After Feltia said that, the white Amaris glared at her, then angrily snorted at her before walking over to You Han, where she immediately absorbed her demon power again.
Since the white Amaris didn't want to have fun with her, and the black Amaris still hadn't returned, Feltia decided to relax in their room.

chapters.title: Chapter 339: Zhang Hanzi And Her Family
paragraphs: After they left Zhang Chen's house, Zhang Fei took Guo Lan to the Sky Jade Shop, especially since Zhong Yan and Yang Lu'er needed help organizing many items they brought from the Sky Jade Realm.

Yang Lu'er told Zhang Fei that they had already gotten information about Lei Jun's whereabouts, but his condition was not good, and he had been living in a mental hospital for several years. Moreover, they isolated him from the crowd in a special room due to his frequent chaos and repeated attacks on the officers.

Additionally, Yang Lu'er informed Zhang Fei about her and Huang Rong's plans to expand the Sky Jade Shop by opening several branches in other cities. They made this decision because of the current shop's inability to accommodate more customers, as well as the demand from customers who came from outside the city.

Since Yang Lu'er and Huang Rong would be taking care of all of that, Zhang Fei immediately agreed to their idea, and he asked Zhong Yan to buy more items when they returned to the Sky Jade Realm later, so they could stock up the shops.
After they discussed several things, Zhang Fei decided to go to the mental hospital and left Guo Lan at the Sky Jade Shop. He hoped to cure Lei Jun before reuniting him with his aunt, Zhang Hanzi.

However, Yang Lu'er continued to laugh and lecture Guo Lan, particularly because she had spent a significant amount of time with Zhang Fei and they still hadn't done the deed, which left her feeling quite irritated.

Zhong Yan was forced to mediate between them and explain to Yang Lu'er that she was indeed not ready for that, and she asked her to stop forcing Guo Lan to give herself to Zhang Fei, which she immediately stopped.
In just a few minutes, Zhang Fei had already arrived at the mental hospital, and one of the officers immediately took him to Lei Jun's room.

Before he entered the room, the officer warned Zhang Fei to be careful of Lei Jun, so he nodded and entered. However, when he saw the old man lying helplessly on the bed, especially since he had to be tied to it, his expression turned to pity, and IV fluids continued to flow through the tube into his body to keep him from becoming dehydrated.

Zhang Fei knew Lei Jun was slightly older than Zhang Chen because of his status, but their situations were clearly opposite, especially since his grandmother lived surrounded by people who always loved her, and she was a strong woman, so she never submitted to her fate, even though she had to bear the shame of having a child out of wedlock.

[This old man's condition is really bad, master. Your light qi can indeed help him recover from his physical condition, but it cannot help him heal from his mental state, especially given his complete breakdown. If you want to restore his mental health, then the only solution is to use your memory manipulation ability on him.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei, but he did not want to change Lei Jun's memories, especially since a person's memories are important to that person, whether they are good or bad memories.

Zhang Fei then sat down beside Lei Jun and placed a normal healing pill in his mouth, which was more than sufficient for an ordinary human like him. He then channeled his light qi into his body, dissolving the pill before dispersing it throughout his body. Moreover, his light qi has a beneficial effect on an ordinary man, and it can also rejuvenate his body.
After Lei Jun's condition looked much better and fresher, Zhang Fei decided to use his memory manipulation ability on him, but he didn't do anything to his old memories.
After that, Zhang Fei decided to wake Lei Jun up, especially since he didn't want to cause panic in that mental hospital if he took him away in secret, so he wanted to take him away in the right way.
Not long after, Lei Jun finally opened his eyes, but he immediately looked at Zhang Fei in confusion, especially since he didn't recognize him. "Who are you? Have we known each other before?"
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at Lei Jun. "Anyway, my name is Zhang Fei, and I am Zhang Chen's grandson."

"Zhang Chen... Zhang Chen..." Lei Jun muttered the name twice as he searched through his memories of him, and he finally found her. "Ahh! I remember her; she was my old friend and my late wife, but I didn't expect that she already had such an old grandson."

Zhang Fei just smiled upon hearing that, and he immediately untied the rope around Lei Jun's body. "Old man, your daughter has been looking for you for decades, but she has never been able to find you because your family sent you to this mental hospital. Fortunately, I have many acquaintances, and they helped me find your whereabouts, so I came here to cure you before taking you to meet her."

Since Zhang Fei did not change his old memories, Lei Jun could naturally remember all those events, and he immediately cried as soon as he remembered his daughter. He hadn't even given his daughter a name after her birth, particularly because he was completely devastated upon hearing of his wife's death, which filled him with deep regret.
Zhang Fei sighed in his heart, seeing Lei Jun in such a state, but he chose not to disturb him, allowing him to express his sadness and frustration.
After some time, Lei Jun finally stopped crying, and Zhang Fei directly helped him to sit on the side of the bed. "What is my daughter's name? Where is she now? Is she okay?"

"Since you and your deceased wife were good friends with my grandmother, she decided to adopt your daughter, whom she named Zhang Hanzi." Lei Jun looked surprised and grateful at the same time after hearing Zhang Fei's answer. "She lives in Hainan with her husband and their children, so I will take you there to reunite with them."
"Will... will Hanzi and his family accept me? I... I am such an irresponsible father, and I have abandoned her since she was just born."

Zhang Fei could hear the fear and worry in Lei Jun's voice, but he spoke to reassure him. "Old man, my grandma has already told Aunt Hanzi everything, and she never blamed you. If she blamed you, then she would never look for you, right? Instead, she fully understood your feelings for your late wife, and her death made you fall into despair.

Moreover, she is a kind-hearted woman, and her family is also very kind. That's why you don't need to worry about them; they will surely welcome you with open arms. All right, wait a moment, and I will call a doctor to check your condition, so we can leave this place immediately after that."

After Zhang Fei left, Lei Jun looked around the room before letting out a heavy sigh, and he gripped the bed tightly as his mouth continued to mumble incoherently. However, the expression shows fear, impatience, and various other feelings.
Before long, Zhang Fei had returned with a male doctor, and he was really shocked when he saw Lei Jun's condition, so he rushed over to check on him.

However, the doctor was even more shocked when Lei Jun, who had been insane for decades, suddenly returned to normal, and he could even talk to and understand him without any difficulty. The doctor then turned suspicious of Zhang Fei because his changes occurred after his arrival, but he just smiled at him.

After the doctor checked Lei Jun's condition and confirmed his health, he allowed Zhang Fei to take him home, especially after Huang Rong had called. He asked her to call the mental hospital, so it would be easier for him to take the old man away.

After they left the mental hospital, Zhang Fei immediately took the old man away to a quiet place, which confused Lei Jun. "Old man, I really don't want to show my abilities to ordinary humans like you, but I don't have much time to relax, and I still have a lot of things to take care of.
That's why I'll use my abilities to take you to Hainan now, and you better hold on tight or you'll fall from a height."

Without waiting for Lei Jun to answer, Zhang Fei immediately enveloped him with his aura and took him flying into the sky, especially since he would not be able to withstand the pressure if he used the nine cloud steps. Even so, it is not a big problem for him, especially since his flying speed is quite fast, and the distance from the city to Hainan is also not too far.
Lei Jun, who was shocked by this, immediately held onto Zhang Fei tightly. He didn't want to die before he met his daughter and family, but he couldn't stop wondering about him.
In less than thirty minutes, they had arrived in Hainan, and Zhang Fei brought Lei Jun to land in a deserted place before taking him to Zhang Hanzi's house.
However, Lei Jun continued to hold Zhang Fei's hand firmly, especially since he was afraid that he would feel disappointed if Zhang Hanzi and her family rejected him.

Not long after, they arrived at a simple house that was neither too small nor too big, and it was surrounded by a beautiful flower garden. Zhang Hanzi and her husband really liked simplicity, even though they were actually very rich.

"Let's go in, old man. They'll be thrilled to meet you." Zhang Fei led the trembling Lei Jun into the house and knocked on the door while making a call. "Aunt Hanzi! Uncle Ming Han! It's me, Fei'er. I came here to bring a surprise for you both."
*Crack*
Instead, the one who opened the door was a young man around 18 years old, and a young girl around 16 years old followed behind him, both of whom were Ming Han and Zhang Hanzi's children.

The young man was no less handsome than Zhang Fei before he became a cultivator, and he had a fairly tall body of around 5'11". However, his body was slimmer, and his athleticism was comparable to that of a professional athlete.

The young girl, with a lovely face and a childish demeanor, donned a brown t-shirt and brown shorts for a sporty look. She had long brown hair with bangs; the back was tied up; and she was wearing a headphone. Her body was also quite tall, at around 5'7". She was too slim, and her B-cup breasts looked good, even though she was still very young.
The young girl's eyes lit up as soon as she saw Zhang Fei, and she immediately jumped up to hug him while screaming loudly. "Big Brother Fei! You are so mean! You haven't visited me in so long!"
Unlike his sister, the young man was more curious about Lei Jun, especially since his mother had never met him, let alone him, so he didn't recognize his grandfather.

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and rubbed the young girl's head. "Sorry, Yanyu. I've been too busy lately, so I haven't had the chance to visit you before. That's why I came here now because I wanted to see all of you, and I brought a surprise for you guys."

"Huh?" Ming Yanyu was taken back for a moment before releasing her embrace from Zhang Fei, and she then turned to Lei Jun while looking at him in confusion. "Who is this old man, Big Brother Fei? Why did you bring him here?"
"He-"

Before Zhang Fei could answer Ming Yanyu's question, Zhang Hanzi suddenly ran out from inside the house, and she immediately shifted her daughter to the side before hugging him. "Fei'er! How are you? I haven't seen you for quite a while, so I really miss you."
Zhang Fei himself felt thrilled to meet Zhang Hanzi, especially since she was one of the people who always treated him well and believed in him, just like his grandmother and maternal aunt.
"I'm fine, Aunt Hanzi." Zhang Fei responded by hugging Zhang Hanzi back while also glancing at Ming Han, who was smiling at them. "Long time no see, Uncle Han."
"Yeah, long time no see. I'm glad you're here; Yu'er and Hao'er have been asking for you too many times." Ming Han nodded to Zhang Fei before looking at Lei Jun. "Fei'er, is he as I think he is?"

When she heard her husband's question, Zhang Hanzi instantly released Zhang Fei and turned her gaze to Lei Jun, her eyes trembling at the sight of his face. Although she had never met her biological father, she could still recognize him immediately, especially since their faces were so similar, and tears fell from her eyes. "Father, is this really you?"
Lei Jun was already crying as soon as he saw the daughter he had left behind for so long. He opened his mouth to answer Zhang Hanzi's question, but not a single word came out.

Ming Hao and Ming Yanyu exchanged looks of shock, and they did not expect that the old man standing in front of them was their maternal grandfather, especially since their mother had told them that his condition was very bad after the death of their maternal grandmother. Moreover, their mother had been searching for him for so long to no avail, but he was now standing in front of them.

Seeing them like that, Zhang Fei immediately spoke to Zhang Hanzi. "Aunt Hanzi, he is indeed your father, Lei Jun. I asked Huang Rong and Yang Lu'er for help in finding him, so I went to see him after they told me that they had found him, and I brought him here right away. Anyway, it would be better if we talked inside, so you two could talk in a calmer atmosphere."
