"Since you and your deceased wife were good friends with my grandmother, she decided to adopt your daughter, whom she named Zhang Hanzi." Lei Jun looked surprised and grateful at the same time after hearing Zhang Fei's answer.
"She lives in Hainan with her husband and their children, so I will take you there to reunite with them."
"Will... will Hanzi and his family accept me?
I am such an irresponsible father, and I have abandoned her since she was just born."
Zhang Fei could hear the fear and worry in Lei Jun's voice, but he spoke to reassure him.
"Old man, my grandma has already told Aunt Hanzi everything, and she never blamed you.
If she blamed you, then she would never look for you, right?
Instead, she fully understood your feelings for your late wife, and her death made you fall into despair.
Moreover, she is a kind-hearted woman, and her family is also very kind.
That's why you don't need to worry about them; they will surely welcome you with open arms.
All right, wait a moment, and I will call a doctor to check your condition, so we can leave this place immediately after that."
After Zhang Fei left, Lei Jun looked around the room before letting out a heavy sigh, and he gripped the bed tightly as his mouth continued to mumble incoherently.
However, the expression shows fear, impatience, and various other feelings.
Before long, Zhang Fei had returned with a male doctor, and he was really shocked when he saw Lei Jun's condition, so he rushed over to check on him.
However, the doctor was even more shocked when Lei Jun, who had been insane for decades, suddenly returned to normal, and he could even talk to and understand him without any difficulty.
The doctor then turned suspicious of Zhang Fei because his changes occurred after his arrival, but he just smiled at him.
After the doctor checked Lei Jun's condition and confirmed his health, he allowed Zhang Fei to take him home, especially after Huang Rong had called.
He asked her to call the mental hospital, so it would be easier for him to take the old man away.
After they left the mental hospital, Zhang Fei immediately took the old man away to a quiet place, which confused Lei Jun.
"Old man, I really don't want to show my abilities to ordinary humans like you, but I don't have much time to relax, and I still have a lot of things to take care of.
That's why I'll use my abilities to take you to Hainan now, and you better hold on tight or you'll fall from a height."

Without waiting for Lei Jun to answer, Zhang Fei immediately enveloped him with his aura and took him flying into the sky, especially since he would not be able to withstand the pressure if he used the nine cloud steps.
Even so, it is not a big problem for him, especially since his flying speed is quite fast, and the distance from the city to Hainan is also not too far.
Lei Jun, who was shocked by this, immediately held onto Zhang Fei tightly.
He didn't want to die before he met his daughter and family, but he couldn't stop wondering about him.
In less than thirty minutes, they had arrived in Hainan, and Zhang Fei brought Lei Jun to land in a deserted place before taking him to Zhang Hanzi's house.
However, Lei Jun continued to hold Zhang Fei's hand firmly, especially since he was afraid that he would feel disappointed if Zhang Hanzi and her family rejected him.
Not long after, they arrived at a simple house that was neither too small nor too big, and it was surrounded by a beautiful flower garden.
Zhang Hanzi and her husband really liked simplicity, even though they were actually very rich.
"Let's go in, old man.
They'll be thrilled to meet you." Zhang Fei led the trembling Lei Jun into the house and knocked on the door while making a call.
"Aunt Hanzi!
Uncle Ming Han!
It's me, Fei'er.
I came here to bring a surprise for you both."
*Crack*
Instead, the one who opened the door was a young man around 18 years old, and a young girl around 16 years old followed behind him, both of whom were Ming Han and Zhang Hanzi's children.
The young man was no less handsome than Zhang Fei before he became a cultivator, and he had a fairly tall body of around 5'11".
However, his body was slimmer, and his athleticism was comparable to that of a professional athlete.
The young girl, with a lovely face and a childish demeanor, donned a brown t-shirt and brown shorts for a sporty look.
She had long brown hair with bangs; the back was tied up; and she was wearing a headphone.
Her body was also quite tall, at around 5'7".
She was too slim, and her B-cup breasts looked good, even though she was still very young.
The young girl's eyes lit up as soon as she saw Zhang Fei, and she immediately jumped up to hug him while screaming loudly.
"Big Brother Fei!
You are so mean!
You haven't visited me in so long!"
Unlike his sister, the young man was more curious about Lei Jun, especially since his mother had never met him, let alone him, so he didn't recognize his grandfather.
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and rubbed the young girl's head.
"Sorry, Yanyu.
I've been too busy lately, so I haven't had the chance to visit you before.
That's why I came here now because I wanted to see all of you, and I brought a surprise for you guys."
"Huh?" Ming Yanyu was taken back for a moment before releasing her embrace from Zhang Fei, and she then turned to Lei Jun while looking at him in confusion.
"Who is this old man, Big Brother Fei?
Why did you bring him here?"
"He-"
Before Zhang Fei could answer Ming Yanyu's question, Zhang Hanzi suddenly ran out from inside the house, and she immediately shifted her daughter to the side before hugging him.
"Fei'er!
How are you?
I haven't seen you for quite a while, so I really miss you."
Zhang Fei himself felt thrilled to meet Zhang Hanzi, especially since she was one of the people who always treated him well and believed in him, just like his grandmother and maternal aunt.
"I'm fine, Aunt Hanzi." Zhang Fei responded by hugging Zhang Hanzi back while also glancing at Ming Han, who was smiling at them.
"Long time no see, Uncle Han."
"Yeah, long time no see.
I'm glad you're here; Yu'er and Hao'er have been asking for you too many times." Ming Han nodded to Zhang Fei before looking at Lei Jun.
"Fei'er, is he as I think he is?"
When she heard her husband's question, Zhang Hanzi instantly released Zhang Fei and turned her gaze to Lei Jun, her eyes trembling at the sight of his face.
Although she had never met her biological father, she could still recognize him immediately, especially since their faces were so similar, and tears fell from her eyes.
"Father, is this really you?"
Lei Jun was already crying as soon as he saw the daughter he had left behind for so long.
He opened his mouth to answer Zhang Hanzi's question, but not a single word came out.

Ming Hao and Ming Yanyu exchanged looks of shock, and they did not expect that the old man standing in front of them was their maternal grandfather, especially since their mother had told them that his condition was very bad after the death of their maternal grandmother.
Moreover, their mother had been searching for him for so long to no avail, but he was now standing in front of them.
Seeing them like that, Zhang Fei immediately spoke to Zhang Hanzi.
"Aunt Hanzi, he is indeed your father, Lei Jun.
I asked Huang Rong and Yang Lu'er for help in finding him, so I went to see him after they told me that they had found him, and I brought him here right away.
Anyway, it would be better if we talked inside, so you two could talk in a calmer atmosphere."

chapters.title: Chapter 340: Zhang Fei's Invitation
paragraphs: Since they had just met for the first time in decades, Zhang Fei decided not to join them and waited in the garden. However, Ming Yanyu, who was walking beside him, kept hugging his left arm. "Why don't you join them? He is your grandfather, and you have never met him before, so you should go back inside now."

"No." Ming Yanyu immediately rejected Zhang Fei. "Since he is my grandfather, my parents will ask him to stay with us, especially my mother, who has been waiting to meet him for a long time. That way, I can meet him every day and gradually get to know him. On the contrary, I don't know when I will be able to meet you again, so I am more interested in accompanying you."

Zhang Fei shook his head helplessly at Ming Yanyu's words, especially since they used to live in the same area in Guangzhou, so they did often spend time together when they were little. Even so, they were only close to him and his sisters because Zhang He had been arrogant since they were kids, and he often bullied Ming Hao, so they never liked him.
Their togetherness lasted until Ming Han got a good opportunity in Hainan, and he brought his family to move to that city to take that opportunity, which proved successful.

However, they still communicated frequently at that time, but the situation changed again after Zhang Fei was kicked out of his parents' house two years ago, and he had to work hard because he didn't want to burden Zhang Chen, so their communication began to decrease.

Despite this, Ming Han and Zhang Hanzi still frequently took them to visit Zhang Fei at Zhang Chen's house, especially when the two of them were on school holidays, and they usually stayed a few nights there.

Ming Yanyu suddenly stood in front of Zhang Fei, on tiptoe, and observed his face seriously. "Big brother Fei, why do I feel like your face has changed? Moreover, you've grown taller, and your body looks stronger and more muscular than the last time we met."

"Haha! You're right, I have indeed changed a lot." Zhang Fei laughed tenderly and patted Ming Yanyu's head. "Moreover, it's not just me who's changed; you and Hao have also changed a lot, right? I heard that your brother became a swimming athlete, and he also looks more mature now. As for you, you look prettier and taller, but I feel like your childish nature still hasn't changed at all."
"I'm not childish! I'm an adult now!" Ming Yanyu protested to Zhang Fei as he stomped her feet to the ground.
"Hahaha." Ming Yanyu's action made Zhang Fei laugh out loud. "See? No adult woman acts like you, so in my eyes, you're still childish now."

"Ugh!" Ming Yanyu put on an annoyed face, but she immediately diverted their conversation. "Why don't you bring Big Sis Yue and Big Sis Lin here? I heard from my mother that they're living with you and Grandma Chen, so you should bring them here, because I miss them too."

"Big Sis Yue and her friend were going to their office to submit their resignations, and Lin'er was somewhere else, so I didn't bring them here." Zhang Fei then asked Mei. 'Do they all have cultivation veins?'

[Yes, Master. Everyone has cultivation veins, so you can take them to the Sky Jade Realm to cultivate. However, if they stay there, the Chu Clan will become even more crowded, especially considering your plans to bring Wang Zetian and the others along. Therefore, it would be better if you looked for your own residence in the western region.]

Zhang Fei himself had thought about the matter, especially since the number of people on his side kept increasing. Even though he was now a member of the Chu clan, he couldn't possibly continue to stay with them.

That's why he agreed with Mei's idea to buy her own residence for them to live in, especially since he also had quite a lot of jewels now and his two businesses were also steadily bringing him income.

Moreover, Zhang Fei already had another idea for a new business in the Sky Jade Realm, but he would only open it in the Yin-Yang Pavilion as a start, especially since it was related to dual cultivation.
"Hmm? What are you thinking about, Big Brother Fei? Why has your expression become so serious?" Ming Yanyu looked at Zhang Fei in confusion as she asked.

"Do you want to go with me to a new place?" Ming Yanyu was surprised by Zhang Fei's question. "Not just you, but I plan to bring all of them there, especially since you guys are my closest people, and I don't want to leave you all behind. Moreover, we have moved and are living there now, and we can be together as one big family if you are willing to move there.
However, I feel a dilemma about bringing you guys there, especially since your lives will change quite significantly and you might have difficulties with your new lives."

Instead, Ming Yanyu put on a confused look and asked Zhang Fei a few questions. "What do you mean by that, Big Brother Fei? Where do you want to take us? Why do you say that our lives will change if we go there?"
*Tap... Tap...*
Zhang Fei immediately looked back. "Why are you here, Hao?"

"Haha." Ming Hao laughed before rushing in front of them. "My mother is crying inside because she is too happy after meeting my grandfather, and I can't bear to see her cry like that, so I decided to come out to see you, Brother Fei."

"You're still as soft as ever, huh?" Zhang Fei then told Ming Hao about his desire to take them to the Sky Jade Realm, which confused him. "I have a hard time explaining it to you two, so I'll show you guys in person, and you will definitely be very surprised afterward."
Zhang Fei immediately grabbed their shoulders, and both of their expressions turned into shock as soon as he flew them onto the roof of their house.
"Big Brother Fei! How could you do this?" Meng Yunyi asked loudly as she hugged Zhang Fei's left arm tightly, fearing that she might slip and suffer severe pain.
Ming Hao also looked at Zhang Fei before asking. "Do you have superpowers like the characters in superhero movies, Brother Fei?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed upon hearing them, and he stretched out his hand before showing his fire qi to them, which shocked them further. "This is not a superpower but rather something else, and if you both go there, you can do the same thing, including flying by yourselves.
Anyway, people like me call themselves cultivators, and my family are also cultivators now, except for my father because I left him here."

Hearing about Zhang Hai didn't surprise them, and they were already aware that he was receiving treatment at the hospital, particularly given his recent losses. However, they were surprised to hear about cultivators, and they had never heard of it before because they were not fans of such things as Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei immediately spoke to them again. "Actually, the place I'm talking about is another world, so your lives will really change if you all live there. After all, that world is completely different from this one, and life there is quite harsh compared to here."
"Huh? Are you joking with us, Big Brother Fei?" Ming Yanyu asked in disbelief.

To prove the truth to them, Zhang Fei dispelled his fire qi and asked Mei to open the gate to the Sky Jade Realm, causing their eyes to widen and their jaws to fall open, especially since they could only find such things in movies.
However, they were frightened when four beasts suddenly emerged from the gate, causing the two tigresses to nearly fall off the roof. However, Zhang Fei immediately held them with his aura.
Meanwhile, Jie Yuan immediately jumped onto Zhang Fei's head, and You Bai perched on his shoulder, making Ming Yunyi's eyes sparkle as he looked at the two.

"Ugh! You guys are too naughty! We have forbidden the four of you from entering the gate, particularly since we are unsure of Fei's intentions to open it, but you guys are too stubborn." Meng Hao and Ming Yuyin immediately turned toward the gate again, only to be shocked when Chu Qing, Chu Yin, and Xu Ling'er emerged from inside and floated in the air. "Hehe! Are you two of his family?"
"Yes." The two nodded to Chu Qing, but they still couldn't get over their shock. However, they immediately recognized Xu Ling'er, especially since they had met many times at Zhang Chen's house.

"Big Brother Hao! Big Sis Yunyi! Long time no see!" "See you two!" Xu Ling'er waved her hand at them and introduced the Chu Sisters to them. "They are Big Sis Chu Ying and Big Sis Chu Qing, and they are Big Brother Fei's wives."

Upon hearing that, Ming Yunyi immediately turned to Zhang Fei and bombarded him with questions. "Are they really your wives? Why didn't you introduce them to us before? When did you get married to them? Why didn't you invite us to your wedding?"
Zhang Fei sighed softly and sent the four beasts into the portal, particularly since their presence would only scare ordinary humans. Mei immediately closed it upon his request.

Zhang Fei then informed Ming Hao and Meng Yunyi. "Ying'er and Qing'er are indeed my wives, and I married them more than two months ago. Aside from them, I still have several other wives, and Ling'er's mother, Ru Xue, is one of them. Anyway, I haven't introduced them to you all because I didn't have time to meet you before, but I thought of doing so after I brought you all there."

They were stunned after hearing about Ru Xue, especially since they both knew her, and their relationship with her was also quite close. However, they also knew her husband, so they felt strange hearing that she was now Zhang Fei's wife.
"Haha." Xu Ling'er laughed as she floated beside them. "My mother already divorced my father; she is now his wife. Moreover, I liked Big Brother Fei, so I fully supported their relationship."

The Ming Siblings nodded in understanding to Xu Ling'er, but all those facts really made them confused and shocked, especially since the current Zhang Fei was completely different from the man they knew before his death.
*Tap... Tap...*

They immediately looked down at Ming Han, who was standing there, and looked at them with incredulous expressions. He even repeatedly rubbed his eyes to make sure he wasn't seeing things wrong, especially since the sight before his eyes was truly bizarre. At first, he heard their commotion, so he decided to check, but he witnessed an ashtonishing sight instead.

With a wry smile, Zhang Fei brought them all to land in front of Ming Han, making it even more difficult for him to believe what he was seeing. "Uncle Han, you didn't see wrong because we are not ordinary humans, and we have abilities that you don't have, so it's easy for us to do such a thing. Anyway, you must still remember Xu Ling'er, right?
As for these two women, they are my wives, Chu Ying and Chu Qing."

Ming Han did not respond to him because he was still shocked to the point of speechlessness, so Zhang Fei chose to wait for him to get over his shock first. His two children also didn't say anything to him; instead, they smiled amusedly as they watched their father's expression.

After a while, Ming Han finally came out of his shock and took a deep breath. "Fei'er, please explain everything in detail to me, especially your actions just now, which were really unusual, and no earthling could do such things."

"Sure." Zhang Fei then led his uncle to an empty chair, where he explained everything in detail, including the advantages and disadvantages of being a cultivator. Ming Han's children listened to his explanation with full attention. After that, he offered to bring them to join him in the Sky Jade Realm, which greatly shocked him, especially about the existence of other realms.

"In fact, there are still three realms connected to Earth, but scientists from all countries never knew about their existence, especially since they are different from us humans and look down on ordinary humans."
"What do you mean by the three realms, Brother Fei?" Ming Hao asked him.

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei chuckled before telling them. "The first realm is the Diyu Realm, where demons live; we usually refer to it as hell. The second realm is the Tian Realm, where the winged race lives; they are better known as angels. I've been to both of those realms before, but I've never been to the third realm, called the Xian Realm.

The inhabitants of that realm consider themselves gods, especially since they have powers that ordinary humans do not have. Anyway, Uncle Han, you guys are my family, so I sincerely hope that you can accept my offer and go with me to the Sky Jade Realm, and we will teach you all to become cultivators like us."

Although Zhang Chen was not his wife's biological mother, Ming Han himself had always regarded them as his biological family, especially since she was the one who raised her to become an extraordinary woman, and he was also a person who liked new challenges. "Fei'er, your offer is really interesting to me, but I have to discuss it with your aunt first.
However, she is reuniting with her father now, and I don't want to disturb them, so I hope you can wait for them to finish."

"That's okay; I can understand that." Zhang Fei suddenly raised his eyebrows as he sensed unusual movement from afar, and he immediately stood up from his seat before speaking to his two wives. "You guys wait here and tell them more about our lives, and I'll go take care of something."

Instantly, black flames shot out of both of Zhang Xiaolong's palms, which immediately enveloped the bodies of the two demon beasts. 'Sigh! I remember now! A siren can hypnotize other living creatures through their singing and music!' Zhang Xiaolong muttered as he nodded to himself.

"Who are you? Why did you disturb my peace? How did you manage to enter this sub-realm? Moreover, you are not a demon, and my lady, the white Amaris, should be aware of your presence here." When she noticed that Zhang Xiaolong was unaffected by her music, Nauvia abruptly questioned him, and she tried to use her charm on him.

"You better stop that, especially since your charm is too weak for me." As Zhang Xiaolong approached Nauvia, he transformed into his incubus form, shocking her. "Your charm may be useful against other demons, but I am a lust demon, and my charm is much stronger than yours."

Nauvia did not refute Zhang Xiaolong's words because she knew that incubus and succubus' charm abilities were much stronger than her own, but she was curious about how he could have two different forms, especially since he also possessed the light element despite being a demon.
Zhang Xiaolong stopped at the ditch's edge and asked Nauvia again. "Why did you control those demons to kill the other demons who came looking for you?"
"They were nuisances, so I killed them." Nauvia casually replied to Zhang Xiaolong.
'What a ridiculous excuse!'
"You haven't answered my previous questions."

Zhang Xiaolong then answered Nauvia. "My name is Zhang Xiaolong, and I heard some mysteries about this place, so I came here to have a look. However, I didn't expect that you were here, and you controlled the demons to attack me. Unfortunately, you didn't know me, and those demons died in vain. As for how I entered this sub-realm, I won't explain it to you, but I have my own way to enter here."
"Zhang Xiaolong?" Nauvia looked at him with raised eyebrows. "Why is your name so strange? I've never heard such a name in this realm."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed upon hearing Nauvia's words. "Naturally, you have never heard of a name like mine in this realm, especially since I am not a native of this realm, and I came from another realm."
Nauvia frowned after he said that, but she was once again shocked when Zhang Xiaolong returned to his true form and looked at him while muttering. "A human? How can a human survive in this realm?"

"Didn't you see my demon form just now? Why are you still questioning my ability to survive in this realm?" Zhang Xiaolong then walked on the water towards Nauvia, but she immediately created a water barrier between them. "Anyway, I heard that you often ran away from your mother and went to dangerous places like this, so she asked Ashreth to send demon hunters to look for you."
"Does that mean you came here to look for me on purpose?" Nauvia asked with a frown.

"No." Zhang Xiaolong immediately denied Nauvia. "You yourself know that the demons in this sub-realm hate a man, so I can't possibly have any relationship with them, right? Even so, I once infiltrated the Shire Demon City, and I heard the demon hunters talking about you in Ashreth's pub."

"I see." Nauvia nodded in understanding. "Actually, I don't like my mother, and I don't like living in that tower. Although life there is much better, I don't feel comfortable living there, so I decided to run away. However, those demon hunters kept finding me, so I mustered the courage to run away to this place, and I used the demons here to kill them."
Zhang Xiaolong immediately asked Nauvia again. "Why did you have to kill them? They were innocent, and they were only carrying out the tasks they took, you know?"
"I don't care!" Nauvia shouted at Zhang Xiaolong. "No one should find me and force me back to the tower, so I'll kill them."

Zhang Xiaolong shook his head after hearing that. "You might be able to kill them since their demon ranks aren't that high, but Ashreth will send high-ranking demons to find you soon, and the demons here won't be able to protect you anymore."

"I know." Nauvia didn't deny Zhang Xiaolong. "If Ashreth really sent high-ranking demons to find me and take me home, then I will leave this place, and I will go to a more dangerous place to hide from them."
"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong was surprised for a moment. "Does this sub-realm have a more dangerous place than Death Valley?
Nauvia nodded at Zhang Xiaolong. "There is still one place more dangerous than this Death Valley, which is located in my lady black Amaris's area, and we call it Endless Death."
"Endless Death?" Nauvia nodded to Zhang Xiaolong once more, and he tried to find the location on his map. "What kind of place is that? Why is the place's name so scary?"

"Did you see the two faceless demon statues at the entrance to this place?" After Zhang Xiaolong nodded, Nauvia immediately told him. "Those two are the true creators of this sub-realm; they are the two rulers' ancestors, who lived before the appearance of the first demon lord.

They were far more cruel than the current rulers, and they created the Death Valley and the Endless Death to punish other demons. However, that place is much more terrifying than this one, especially since it is an endless abyss with an ancient demon beast living in it."
"An ancient demon beast?"

"Yes." Nauvia answered with a nod. "I don't know exactly what kind of demon beast lives inside it, but the other demons said that it was very terrible, and it would torture the demons who were thrown into the abyss. They would not die immediately, but rather very slowly, which is why they named that place Endless Death."

Hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong became interested in going there to see the ancient demon beast, especially since he thought that it should be powerful and probably much stronger than the Amaris Twins or even Oz. "Anyway, does that mean this black castle is where one of them lives?"

"Yeah." Nauvia then looked towards the black castle. "According to history, the corpse of one of them is preserved in this black castle, and there are many demon treasures. However, it is surrounded by a strong, invisible barrier. Even the current rulers are unable to breach it, thus preventing me from entering to inspect the interior."
"Hmm?" Nauvia's explanation piqued Zhang Xiaolong's interest, prompting him to walk towards the black castle, where an invisible barrier immediately stopped him.

Nauvia immediately jumped into the moat and swam to the side of the black castle. "I told you, right? I don't know anything about your abilities, but you won't be able to destroy it, and you might get hurt if you forcefully destroy it, especially since the current rulers have done so."

Zhang Xiaolong immediately touched the invisible barrier, but Mei immediately warned him. [Master, a powerful demon cultivator seems to have created this black castle, and the barrier is extremely strong, making it impossible for you to break it with your current strength; not even Boitata could destroy it.]

'Not even Boitata can break this barrier?' Zhang Xiaolong inquired in shock, particularly since she had already reached the sovereign realm. If that was true, it meant that the demon cultivator who created the invisible barrier had already surpassed that level.
[Yes! Moreover, this invisible barrier seems to have a defense mechanism, so you should avoid forcing yourself to breach it, as its counterattack could seriously injure you.]
Naturally, Zhang Xiaolong would not take Mei's words lightly, and he immediately withdrew his hand. 'Do you think people from the Di clan can breach this invisible barrier?'

[Since the Di Clan members are formation array masters, they can probably do it, master. However, you can't possibly bring them here, right? Even though they are powerful cultivators, they are still humans, and the demon aura in this realm will affect them.]

'Yeah, you're right about that.' Zhang Xiaolong replied while nodding. 'In that case, I will ask Lingxue to accompany me to the Di Clan after my real body returns to the Sky Jade Realm, and I will learn about formation arrays from them, so I can breach this invisible barrier by myself.'
"Hey! What are you thinking? Do you intend to breach in?" Nauvia suddenly inquired.

Instead, he channeled his fire qi, combined with the darkness qi, into the demon extermination sword, turning his flame dark red.
Furthermore, Zhang Xiaolong possessed fire immunity, which he mimicked from Aries.
He was less concerned about the demon beasts' attacks because of their larger size and slower speed.
Zhang Xiaolong quickly moved towards one of them as he slashed the lava with his sword, but it immediately swung its spike tail towards him, and the other one opened its mouth wide to bite him.

However, the demon extermination sword didn't stop there; it slashed the demon's other arm, causing it to let out another roar of pain.
*Roar*
"Return!" The demon extermination sword returned to Zhang Xiaolong's hand, who immediately held its hilt and pointed it upward.

He once again channeled his light qi into his sword before using the element sword method, making his sword glow white and lengthen, and he immediately slashed it towards the demon, splitting its body in two directly.
*Splurt...
Splurt...*
Black blood gushed out of the demon's split body, soaking the ground and splattering towards Zhang Xiaolong, who immediately used his qi to protect himself.
Wasting no time, Zhang Xiaolong flew towards the next area, which was the last area of the Death Valley.
However, he was immediately amazed to see a black castle in the middle of the place, and a moat filled with clear water surrounding it.

chapters.title: Chapter 343 True Zygoz - The Libra
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong turned to Nauvia. "Yes, I will breach inside, but not today, and I will do so in the future. Anyway, my business here is done, so I will leave now."
"Oh." Nauvia nodded at Zhang Xiaolong. "All right, you can go now, and I will stay here until they find me."

Zhang Xiaolong looked at Nauvia for a moment as he thought of something, but he immediately threw away the idea and left the Death Valley directly using his teleportation. At first, he wanted to go to Shire Demon City to meet Ashreth, but he remembered that the black Amaris was always monitoring her area, so he abandoned his intention and went straight to the northern sea again to wait for Angela.

"That human is really weird! He possesses three distinct forms, and he has the ability to evade the surveillance of my white lady Amaris in order to reach this olace. Furthermore, he possesses both light and dark powers, much like she and the ruler Virgil. Then, Nauvia swam back to the rock in the middle of the ditch. "Sigh!

I hope Ashreth doesn't send out high-ranking demon hunters anytime soon, especially since the Endless Death Abyss is the only place left for me to escape. Unfortunately, the ancient demon beasts are extremely terrifying, and I will definitely die if I'm going there."
After that, Nauvia took her harp again and started playing music, and the demons who were in the outer areas immediately gathered in their respective places.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had already arrived at the snow-covered plains in one of Europe's countries, and he saw two old people standing in front of a simple hut.
One of the old men immediately turned to Zhang Fei before laughing. "Hahaha! I already guessed that you would sense my presence here, kid."

"You might be able to hide your demon aura from the people from the Tian and Xian realms, but I already remember it, so you won't be able to hide it from me, Oz." Zhang Fei responded as he landed in front of them, then turned to face another old man. "So he is the real Zygoz? I didn't expect you to hide him here." 'Scan him, Mei.'
[Yes.]
Name: Zygoz
Age: 50,000+ years old
Gender: Male
Race: Sorcerer Demon
Rank: Emperor
Elements: darkness and earth
Physique: transcendent physique
Abilities: Darkness arts, darkness and earth manipulation, demonic and earth magic, quantum manipulation, physics manipulation, demon manipulation, telekinesis, portal manipulation, and so on.
Strong: earth and darkness.
Weak: wind and light.

Zhang Fei was completely shocked when he read about Zygoz's status, especially his demon rank. 'What the fuck! This guy is much older than Oz, and his rank has also reached emperor rank. However, he has no desire to become a demon emperor, preferring to serve as his subordinate.'

"Why are you so shocked after seeing me, kid? Do you find anything intriguing about me?" Zygoz asked Zhang Fei as he smiled. "Anyway, no wonder Oz chose to cooperate with you; you don't even flinch in front of an old demon like me."

"Old man, your demon rank and abilities are truly frightening." Zhang Fei then pointed to Oz. "Somehow, I feel that this guy is inferior to you, and you should be able to overthrow him to become the demon emperor."

"Ha ha ha." When he heard that, Zygoz laughed out loud. "Kid, you are still too young, so it is natural for you to think that way. Once you've lived as long as I have, you'll realize such ambitions are useless.

Moreover, I have followed the first demon lord since I was very young, and I have been involved in many battles with people from the other two realms, so I am no longer interested in occupying that position. For me, the safety and peace of my race are of the utmost importance, yet they continue to eye our realm for takeover, which would only bring suffering to my race if that happened.
Therefore, I agree with Oz's suggestion to hide in the human realm."

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Zygoz. "Even though my grandma is not as old as you, she no longer has any ambitions, and she prefers to live quietly with us. As for me, I'm different from all of you, and I still have many ambitions that I need to fulfill.
However, my ambition to be the best is not because I want to stand at the top; I can only protect my family and those closest to me if I succeed in achieving it."

"Ha ha ha." Zygoz laughed as he nodded repeatedly. "That's right; strength is what you need to protect them, and you won't be able to do it without it. However, it's important to understand that possessing strength can make others jealous and target you. They may resort to various tactics, such as colluding with each other, as was the case with the first demon lord."

Zhang Fei did not refute Zygoz's words, especially since he himself had faced several similar situations before. "I don't know the first demon lord, but based on the memories I got from the white Amaris, I think he was too soft. As for me, I will never act like him, and I will kill anyone who tries to betray me, let alone if they intend to hurt my people."

Zhang Fei's words made Zygoz release a heavy sigh. "The first demon lord was indeed too soft, and he himself suffered the consequences of his softness. Anyway, Oz has told me everything about the white Amaris, including your decision to enslave Theo; he also told me that you went to the Tian Realm before, so I hope you can tell me information about them."

"Unfortunately, I don't have any information about them yet, old man." Zhang Fei shook his head in response. "Many of them, particularly the throne, are extremely strong, and his strength is equal to yours. Moreover, I'm going there alone, so I won't be as crazy as to investigate them directly.

However, I've already instructed Theo to do several things, so I will often go to that realm to ask for reports from him. Anyway, don't you have the ability to manipulate portals? How about I take you to their realm? That way, you can go back and forth into their realm at your own leisure, and you can arrange something to investigate them."

Seeing Zygoz's dumbfounded expression, Oz immediately patted his shoulder as he laughed loudly. "Hahahaha! I told you, right? This kid is really special, and he can find out many things about us without us being able to prevent him from doing so. Anyway, can you really take us into their realm without them knowing?"

"Back then, I didn't have my new ability yet, so you could monitor my presence." Zhang Fei then grabbed Oz and Zygoz's shoulders, and he immediately led them into the gate to the Tian Realm after Mei opened it. Naturally, he did not forget to activate his invisibility, or they would have discovered their presence.
'So this is their realm, huh?' Once they arrived at the Tian Realm, the two demons muttered to themselves, and their eyes scanned the entire area of the realm.

Zygoz immediately used his portal manipulation to create one. 'This way, we can think of a way to investigate them, Oz. However, we have to choose the right person to do it, but it would be better if we talked to the other rulers before deciding that.'
'Yeah, we'll go back to our realm and talk to them directly.' Oz then pointed to the portal in the northern area before asking Zhang Fei. 'Where do you think the portal is headed?'

'The Xian realm.' Both demons turned to Zhang Fei, raising their eyebrows. 'Unfortunately, not all winged race members can open that portal, and only those who have reached the third order of middle level and above can do so. If you two are considering infiltrating that realm, you should investigate the members who are in contact with the three demon rulers.
Once you have captured them, you can contact Feltia for further assistance.'
Both demons immediately agreed with Zhang Fei, but he did not immediately bring them back to earth, and he first contacted his slave via telepathy to ask about his report to Moraes.

Theo told Zhang Fei that he had already informed his superior based on his order, but Moraes was furious after learning that the portal connecting them to the white Amaris had been destroyed, and he was trying to find a way to create another portal to that place.
Theo also told Zhang Fei that it would not happen anytime soon, especially since creating another one was not easy and would take a long time to prepare the materials, which made them feel relieved.

After that, Zhang Fei took the two demons back to Earth before sending them back to the Diyu Realm, and the two of them went straight to one of the sub-realm rulers. He rushed back to Hainan to ask Ming Han and the others about their decision, especially since he didn't want to waste much time on Earth and wanted to immediately bring them all to the Sky Jade Realm.

Upon Zhang Fei's arrival, he discovered that the Chu Sisters and Xu Ling'er were still engaged in conversation with Ming Han and the others. However, Zhang Hanzi swiftly pulled him away and bombarded him with questions. His aunt doesn't think much about cultivators and other worlds, but she cares more about her relationships with so many women.

Zhang Fei himself didn't mind it, especially since he knew that Zhang Hanzi had always cared for him, and he loved her even more than Qing Yi. He explained everything to her right away, which made her cry upon hearing about his death.

Zhang Hanzi experienced a mixture of shock, fear, and amazement when Zhang Fei revealed his two other forms to her. "This is one of the reasons why I changed, and I have long decided to embrace my two other identities, particularly my identity as an incubus. Moreover, I love them, and they love me too, so you don't need to worry about our relationship.
Anyway, if you agree to go with me, you will meet them later, and I'm sure you will like them."

"I see." Zhang Hanzi nodded in understanding, but she released a heavy sigh before conveying his decision to Zhang Fei. "I still feel strange and confused about all the stories of Ying'er and the others, but all of you are my family, and my husband doesn't have any other family here either, so I decided to go with you.
However, Hao'er and Yu'er still have to come back here frequently, so you can send them back if they need it."

"It's okay; I can send them back here whenever they want, so they just need to tell me about it." Zhang Fei then led his aunt back to meet Ming Han and the others. "Anyways, you guys can pack everything you need, Aunt Hanzi. As for your father, you don't need to worry about him, and I will ask the people there to buy some necessities for him."
Zhang Hanzi nodded in agreement with that before asking Zhang Fei. "Then what about your uncle's company?"
"Ha ha." Zhang Fei chuckled at her question. "Aunt Hanzi, I know Huang Rong very well, so you don't have to worry about that, and I will bring Uncle Han to meet her after you all finish packing."

"Does that mean Huang Rong is one of your women?" Zhang Hanzi inquired with narrowed eyes, making Zhang Fei laugh wryly. "Sigh! I'm sad to know that you've become such a womanizer, and I miss my innocent Fei'er, but I'm glad you're alive because I'd be devastated if one of my dear sons died."

After hearing that, Zhang Fei immediately stopped walking and faced Zhang Hanzi, and he hugged her as he kissed her forehead. "Aunt Hanzi, I love you and the others, and I don't want to make you guys sad. That's why I will take better care of myself, so you don't have to worry about me."
"You have to keep your own words, okay?"
"Yes, I will."

sentences.text: Zhang Xiaolong turned to Nauvia.
"Yes, I will breach inside, but not today, and I will do so in the future.
Anyway, my business here is done, so I will leave now."
"Oh." Nauvia nodded at Zhang Xiaolong.
"All right, you can go now, and I will stay here until they find me."
Zhang Xiaolong looked at Nauvia for a moment as he thought of something, but he immediately threw away the idea and left the Death Valley directly using his teleportation.

At first, he wanted to go to Shire Demon City to meet Ashreth, but he remembered that the black Amaris was always monitoring her area, so he abandoned his intention and went straight to the northern sea again to wait for Angela.
"That human is really weird!
He possesses three distinct forms, and he has the ability to evade the surveillance of my white lady Amaris in order to reach this olace.
Furthermore, he possesses both light and dark powers, much like she and the ruler Virgil.
Then, Nauvia swam back to the rock in the middle of the ditch.
"Sigh!
I hope Ashreth doesn't send out high-ranking demon hunters anytime soon, especially since the Endless Death Abyss is the only place left for me to escape.
Unfortunately, the ancient demon beasts are extremely terrifying, and I will definitely die if I'm going there."
After that, Nauvia took her harp again and started playing music, and the demons who were in the outer areas immediately gathered in their respective places.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had already arrived at the snow-covered plains in one of Europe's countries, and he saw two old people standing in front of a simple hut.
One of the old men immediately turned to Zhang Fei before laughing.
"Hahaha!
I already guessed that you would sense my presence here, kid."

"You might be able to hide your demon aura from the people from the Tian and Xian realms, but I already remember it, so you won't be able to hide it from me, Oz." Zhang Fei responded as he landed in front of them, then turned to face another old man.
"So he is the real Zygoz?
I didn't expect you to hide him here." 'Scan him, Mei.'
[Yes.]
Name: Zygoz
Age: 50,000+ years old
Gender: Male
Race: Sorcerer Demon
Rank: Emperor
Elements: darkness and earth
Physique: transcendent physique
Abilities: Darkness arts, darkness and earth manipulation, demonic and earth magic, quantum manipulation, physics manipulation, demon manipulation, telekinesis, portal manipulation, and so on.
Strong: earth and darkness.
Weak: wind and light.
Zhang Fei was completely shocked when he read about Zygoz's status, especially his demon rank. 'What the fuck!
This guy is much older than Oz, and his rank has also reached emperor rank.
However, he has no desire to become a demon emperor, preferring to serve as his subordinate.'
"Why are you so shocked after seeing me, kid?
Do you find anything intriguing about me?" Zygoz asked Zhang Fei as he smiled.
"Anyway, no wonder Oz chose to cooperate with you; you don't even flinch in front of an old demon like me."
"Old man, your demon rank and abilities are truly frightening." Zhang Fei then pointed to Oz.
"Somehow, I feel that this guy is inferior to you, and you should be able to overthrow him to become the demon emperor."
"Ha ha ha." When he heard that, Zygoz laughed out loud.
"Kid, you are still too young, so it is natural for you to think that way.
Once you've lived as long as I have, you'll realize such ambitions are useless.

Moreover, I have followed the first demon lord since I was very young, and I have been involved in many battles with people from the other two realms, so I am no longer interested in occupying that position.
For me, the safety and peace of my race are of the utmost importance, yet they continue to eye our realm for takeover, which would only bring suffering to my race if that happened.
Therefore, I agree with Oz's suggestion to hide in the human realm."
"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Zygoz.
"Even though my grandma is not as old as you, she no longer has any ambitions, and she prefers to live quietly with us.
As for me, I'm different from all of you, and I still have many ambitions that I need to fulfill.
However, my ambition to be the best is not because I want to stand at the top; I can only protect my family and those closest to me if I succeed in achieving it."
"Ha ha ha." Zygoz laughed as he nodded repeatedly.
"That's right; strength is what you need to protect them, and you won't be able to do it without it.
However, it's important to understand that possessing strength can make others jealous and target you.
They may resort to various tactics, such as colluding with each other, as was the case with the first demon lord."
Zhang Fei did not refute Zygoz's words, especially since he himself had faced several similar situations before.
"I don't know the first demon lord, but based on the memories I got from the white Amaris, I think he was too soft.
As for me, I will never act like him, and I will kill anyone who tries to betray me, let alone if they intend to hurt my people."
Zhang Fei's words made Zygoz release a heavy sigh.
"The first demon lord was indeed too soft, and he himself suffered the consequences of his softness.

Anyway, Oz has told me everything about the white Amaris, including your decision to enslave Theo; he also told me that you went to the Tian Realm before, so I hope you can tell me information about them."
"Unfortunately, I don't have any information about them yet, old man." Zhang Fei shook his head in response.
"Many of them, particularly the throne, are extremely strong, and his strength is equal to yours.
Moreover, I'm going there alone, so I won't be as crazy as to investigate them directly.
However, I've already instructed Theo to do several things, so I will often go to that realm to ask for reports from him.
Anyway, don't you have the ability to manipulate portals?
How about I take you to their realm?
That way, you can go back and forth into their realm at your own leisure, and you can arrange something to investigate them."
Seeing Zygoz's dumbfounded expression, Oz immediately patted his shoulder as he laughed loudly.
"Hahahaha!
I told you, right?
This kid is really special, and he can find out many things about us without us being able to prevent him from doing so.
Anyway, can you really take us into their realm without them knowing?"

"Back then, I didn't have my new ability yet, so you could monitor my presence." Zhang Fei then grabbed Oz and Zygoz's shoulders, and he immediately led them into the gate to the Tian Realm after Mei opened it.
Naturally, he did not forget to activate his invisibility, or they would have discovered their presence.
'So this is their realm, huh?' Once they arrived at the Tian Realm, the two demons muttered to themselves, and their eyes scanned the entire area of the realm.
Zygoz immediately used his portal manipulation to create one. 'This way, we can think of a way to investigate them, Oz.
However, we have to choose the right person to do it, but it would be better if we talked to the other rulers before deciding that.'
'Yeah, we'll go back to our realm and talk to them directly.' Oz then pointed to the portal in the northern area before asking Zhang Fei. 'Where do you think the portal is headed?'

'The Xian realm.' Both demons turned to Zhang Fei, raising their eyebrows. 'Unfortunately, not all winged race members can open that portal, and only those who have reached the third order of middle level and above can do so.
If you two are considering infiltrating that realm, you should investigate the members who are in contact with the three demon rulers.

Theo told Zhang Fei that he had already informed his superior based on his order, but Moraes was furious after learning that the portal connecting them to the white Amaris had been destroyed, and he was trying to find a way to create another portal to that place.
Theo also told Zhang Fei that it would not happen anytime soon, especially since creating another one was not easy and would take a long time to prepare the materials, which made them feel relieved.

His aunt doesn't think much about cultivators and other worlds, but she cares more about her relationships with so many women.

Anyway, if you agree to go with me, you will meet them later, and I'm sure you will like them."

However, Hao'er and Yu'er still have to come back here frequently, so you can send them back if they need it."

chapters.title: Chapter 344 Liu Qingyu's Feelings
paragraphs: "So what's your decision? Do you guys want to go with us and become cultivators?" As soon as Zhang Fei landed in front of Wang Zentian and the others, he immediately asked them. However, he glanced at Wang Jiangxin, who was still frightened by his actions from a few days ago.

Wang Zhuxian first responded to Zhang Fei. "Brother Fei, our grandfather and my grandmother have agreed to go to the Sky Jade Realm, but my mother decided to stay behind because you are not willing to take my father there, so she wants to accompany him here."

Zhang Fei did not respond to this, as he did not care about Wang Jiangxin and Gou Zhongwen. "In that case, the four of you can prepare now because I don't have much free time, and I will immediately send you guys there."

Wang Zhuxian, who couldn't wait to cultivate again, immediately lifted his grandparents to their feet. "Brother Fei, we already prepared everything when we arrived at this house, so you can send us there now."

Unlike his sister, Wang Xiaofeng seemed to be in a dilemma about leaving his parents, but Gou Zhongwen immediately took her hand and spoke to her. "You don't have to worry about us; we will always be here to wait for you two to come back, so you can go with them now."
After that, Zhang Fei asked Mei to open the gate to the Sky Jade Realm before sending them all there, and he looked at Gou Zhongwen and Wang Jiangxin for a while before flying away.
However, Micah suddenly appeared in front of Zhang Fei and asked him a question. "Have you done anything to Theo?"
"Why are you asking that?" Zhang Fei asked with a frown.

Micah immediately explained this to Zhang Fei. "We are in the same unit as heaven's guards, and I've known him for a long time. That's why I noticed something unusual about him, and I assumed that you had done something to him."

"I've made Theo my slave, and I'll use him to monitor Moraes and the others." Micah looked surprised to hear the last name from Zhang Fei's mouth. "Anyway, do you have any information about the three winged races that are communicating with Tauri, Leo, and Avros?"

"Yes." Micah immediately told Zhang Fei. "Moraes sent Zachiel to contact Tauri, while Joel sent Yofil to Avros, whose rank was in the high order of the low level, especially since their characters were similar to those of the two demon rulers. Meanwhile, Daniella sent a female angel named Chiel to establish contact with Leo, and her rank is quite high in the first order of the middle level."

"A female angel, huh?" Micah got goosebumps when he saw Zhang Fei's strange smile. "Anyway, thanks for your information; you don't have to worry about Theo, especially since they wouldn't be able to find anything suspicious about him."

After Zhang Fei disappeared from his sight, Micah let out a heavy sigh as he shook his head. "That kid seems to be targeting Chiel, and I dare not imagine what her fate would be if she fell into his hands. That's none of my business, and what's most important is that he can bring peace to the four realms to end the bloodshed."

Gou Zhongwen, who had previously listened to them, immediately turned to Wang Jiangxin after they left. "Husband, I hope you have learned a lot from this incident, and I hope you won't be as arrogant as before. If only you didn't act like that towards Zhang Fei, then we wouldn't have to part with us children, and we could keep accompanying them."

Instead, Wang Jiangxin immediately stood up and walked into the house, which made Wang Jianxin sigh heavily. She then looked up at the sky, imagining her two children's faces, and muttered to herself. "Xiaofeng and Zhuxian, your futures are still very long, and I don't want anything to happen to you two.
That's why you guys have to take good care of yourselves in that realm, and I will continue to wait for you two to return to my arms."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was already in front of a shop, but he felt awkward going inside, especially since it was a sex shop.

[Hahaha!] Mei suddenly laughed inside Zhang Fei's mind. [Master, are you serious about selling those sex toys in the Yin-Yang Pavilion? After all, the residents of the Sky Jade Realm are unfamiliar with technology and lack the necessary tools to charge it, so they will undoubtedly be shocked if you introduce these toys to them.]

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei. 'Even though they haven't seen those sex toys before, I'm confident they will enjoy them, particularly those who are dissatisfied with their partners, and I can earn many jewels or sect points from them. Moreover, not all sex toys are rechargeable, and many of them use batteries.
That's why I will only purchase sex toys that require batteries, and I will also offer the batteries for sale, ensuring they don't have to worry about this issue.'

[Well, that's true. However, I think you can sell them outside the sect too, especially since many non-dual cultivators are also lonely because their partners can't satisfy them, and you can scoop up their jewels.]

'Yes, you're right, but I will not be selling them in the western region. Instead, I plan to start selling them in the southern region, partnering with the Shen Clan to facilitate my business's smooth operation. Zhang Fei then entered the sex shop and bought various types of sex toys, including dildos, sex dolls, BDSM tools, cosplay costumes, and various other items.

Zhang Fei overwhelmed the shop owner by making large purchases, considering their limited stock. Even so, the shop owner was happy with his purchase, especially since the sale of sex toys was not too fast, and he immediately paid for everything by transfer. After handing over all his stock to him, the shop owner advised him to go to another shop.

In the end, Zhang Fei went to several other shops and bought all their supplies, especially since the number of disciples in the Yin-Yang Pavilion was simply numerous, and he also wanted to sell those items in the southern river city.

Zhang Fei hurried to the Sky Jade Shop after finishing his business, especially since Zhong Yan and Yang Lu'er had already bought a lot of supplies to bring to the Sky Jade Realm, and he stored all of them in his inventory.
Yang Lu'er, who heard from her mother that she had a good time with Zhang Fei, immediately pulled him into the office.
Like with Huang Rong, Zhang Fei didn't have fun with Yang Lu'er for too long, especially since he couldn't wait to go to the Di Clan, so he wanted to return to the Sky Jade Realm as soon as possible.

Yang Lu'er suddenly looked up and asked Zhang Fei. "Anyway, we've been together for quite some time; why haven't you told me about where you all went all this time? Moreover, I can see that Zhong Yan looks much younger now, and I feel envious of him."

"Are you able to face such a harsh life?" Yang Lu'er turned to Zhang Fei in confusion. "The place we went to is not a place for ordinary humans like you and the others, and life on earth cannot be compared to life in that place. Living there is extremely harsh, and many people die all the time."
"Are you serious about that?" Yang Lu'er asked in shock.

"I don't need to lie to you, right? To tell the truth, I've killed so many people there, especially since they all tried to kill me." Yang Lu'er immediately got up from on top of Zhang Fei's body and looked at him in shock, and he rubbed her cheeks before continuing.
"That's why I never planned to bring you and the others there, especially since I knew that you all wouldn't be able to face that kind of life, and you guys can enjoy a peaceful life here."

Yang Lu'er naturally remembered Zhang Fei's incubus identity, but she found it hard to believe that he had already killed so many people. That's why he shared a bit of his memory of killing some people with her, causing her to feel nauseous and nearly faint. However, he immediately used his light qi to calm her down.
"Do you believe me now?"

"Yeah." Yang Lu'er replied softly before lying on Zhang Fei again. "You're right, we will never be able to adapt to such a life, so I have no interest in going there. Since you live in such a place now, you must always take good care of yourself, or we will all be sad if we lose you."

"Don't worry; you guys will never lose me, and I will accompany you all until the end of your lives." Yang Lu'er just smiled and hugged Zhang Fei tighter, but she suddenly whispered something into his ear, which confused him enough to answer her. "Let me think about it first, okay?"
"Yeah."

After they spent some time together, the two immediately got dressed, and Zhang Fei took the other two women to leave the Sky Jade Shop before returning to Zhang Chen's house, where Zhang Yue and Janette were already waiting for them, so he took them back to the Sky Jade Realm afterwards.

When they arrived at the Chu Clan, the sun had already set. Liu Qingyu told Zhang Fei that Chu Liuxiang and Yuan Manqiu had already returned to the Eastern Region because of their personal affairs, but he didn't give them much thought.

Zhang Fei then gathered all his wives and family in the main hall to discuss his plans to move residence, which was quite a surprise for Liu Qingyu, especially since he had never mentioned it before. "Even though I am now a member of this clan, the number of family members I brought to this realm has increased, so I decided to look for a new residence in this city.
That way, we will still live close by, and they can easily go to this clan to cultivate in the back garden."

Liu Qingyu nodded in understanding of Zhang Fei's wishes, and she then informed him. "Actually, you don't need to buy a new residence, especially since we've taken over the former residences of the Li and Mei Clans, and both residences are also fully furnished, so you can choose one of them as your new residence."

Zhang Fei himself had just remembered about the two clans, and he felt that the former residence of the Li clan was the most suitable for them. However, he turned to the others to hear their opinions first, and they unanimously chose that residence as their new residence, so he decided to use that residence as their new residence.

After that, all of them hurriedly packed their personal belongings, and Zhang Fei asked Liu Hua to take his sisters and the beasts to the Li Clan's former residence to arrange everything. Besides, he also asked her to invite the Wen Twins to join them, especially since he had already regarded them as his women, even though they were not yet ready to be his wives.
After they left, Zhang Fei immediately pulled Liu Qingyu onto his lap and briefly kissed her lips. "Are you disappointed with my decision?"

"No." Liu Qingyu responded by shaking her head before wrapping her arms around Zhang Fei's neck. "Honestly, I've always felt strange about our situation, especially since my status is still Chu Hong's wife, but I've been dual-cultivating with you many times, which leaves a feeling of guilt in my heart."

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh in his heart, especially since he himself had always regarded Liu Qingyu as one of his wives, and he even kept her name on his harem list. Unfortunately, her relationship with Chu Hong prevented him from making their relationship public, which left a bitter taste in his heart. "Do you regret having a relationship with me?"

"Do you think I would continue our relationship if I regretted it?" Instead, Liu Qingyu asked Zhang Fei back. "If people hear about this, they might think of me as a cheap woman, but I still want to tell you the truth. My feelings for Chu Hong are fading, especially since he has never been by my side, and you are the one who keeps me company every day.

I can tell you that you have taken over his place in my heart, and I have been thinking about divorcing him so that I won't continue to feel guilty towards him. However, I can't do that right now, or his concentration on stabilizing the seal on the demon portal will be disturbed, so I thought of waiting for him to come back before telling him."

Naturally, Zhang Fei felt pleased after listening to Liu Qingyu's words, especially since he always hoped that she would only love him alone. "It's okay; you don't need to rush to tell Chu Hong about our relationship, and I will accompany you to talk to him after he comes back later."
"Are you really going to accompany me to talk to him in the future?" Liu Qingyu asked in surprise.

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Liu Qingyu. "The relationship between us happened because of my selfishness, even though I knew you were his wife. That's why I won't let you face him by yourself, and we will face him together."
After hearing that, Liu Qingyu smiled, and she immediately kissed Zhang Fei's lips as she spoke to him through voice transmission. 'Take me to my room now, Fei'er.'
Without thinking twice, Zhang Fei immediately used his teleportation to take Liu Qingyu away from the main hall, and they hurriedly undressed each other once they arrived in her room.

The people from the Shen and Liu Clans immediately surrounded the You Clan's residence, which caused the three men to panic and their hearts to tighten, especially since Shen Xueyi herself was much stronger than them, and she was still assisted by people from both clans.

Some of them had infiltrated his clan residence without You Yuanwen's knowledge to search for the main clan members, and they quickly knocked them out cold, especially since most of them were only cultivators below the heaven realm.
Shen Xueyi then spoke to them again. "You guys don't need to bother using your returning jade, especially since it won't be of any use while you're inside this dome."
'Damn it! Why didn't we notice them all before?' Pang Zhen, Cai Shangjun, and You Yuanwen were cursed in their hearts.

Shen Xueyi then narrowed her eyes at Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen, causing the two old men to shiver. "Honestly, I have long heard that you guys have brought your two clans to side with the Pang Clan, but I have not taken action against you guys because I still do not have solid evidence of that.

However, I have listened to the conversation between the three of you earlier, and I also heard you two address this heretic as your master, so you no longer have a chance to deny it. To tell you the truth, we got rid of the Du Clan a long time ago, but you two never noticed their disappearance, and all of them are waiting for you guys in the afterlife now."

*Boom... Boom...*

"Is that so?" Shen Xueyi inquired, shaking her head. "You guys should already be aware of the risks of your decision to join the Pang Clan, especially since they are the eternal enemy of all cultivators in this realm, and we have sworn to destroy anyone who chooses to side with them.
Unfortunately, you two still chose to join them, so you must be prepared to bear the consequences of your decision, and your family will also bear the consequences."
"No... no... please spare them, Madam Shen!"

Unfortunately, Shen Xueyi did not listen to their pleas, so she ordered the people of the Shen and Liu Clans to kill all of them except Cai Qiu, and they unhesitatingly followed her orders by killing them before throwing their corpses on the ground.
The expressions of Cai Shangjun, You Yuanwen, and Cai QIu were filled with sorrow, and they became devastated after witnessing the deaths of all the main members of their clans.

"Get up!" Pang Zhen suddenly shouted as he lifted the two old men up. "They're dead now! You have no choice but to fight this bitch to avenge their deaths, and we will fight them with all of our strength!"
Hearing that, Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen immediately looked at Shen Xueyi before drawing their weapons, and they also released their full strength to prepare to attack him.

"Ugh!" Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen suddenly let out a groan in pain after a sword stabbed them from behind without them realizing it, which shocked Pang Zhen, especially after he saw their blood spurting out of their chests.
"Father!" Cai Qiu, who was in Shen Yang's arms, cried out in shock after she saw that.

The two old men once again fell to their knees, used their weapons as support, and tried to stop their bleeding. However, the sword pierced through their hearts, making their bleeding unstoppable, and their faces became paler with every second that passed.

Meanwhile, Pang Zhen tries to find the culprit, but he doesn't realize that Zhang Fei [1] is standing right in front of him in an invisible state. 'Fuck! Who stabbed them? Shen Xueyi and those people obviously didn't move from their spots, so they weren't the culprits.'
*Slash*
"Argh!" Pang Zhen screamed in pain as he staggered a few steps back, and he immediately looked at his chest, where he saw a deep slash wound.
*Slash*

"Guah!" This time, Zhang Fei [1] slashed Pang Zhen from behind, causing blood to flow out of his chest and back, but he immediately took out a pill and swallowed it directly, causing his bleeding to stop quickly. "Come out now! Face me like a man!"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed as he appeared before them, but he was standing on one of the roofs a little far away. "Are you a man yourself? If you were truly a man, you certainly wouldn't use underhanded methods against the other clans, right?"

"Bastard!" Pang Zhen shouted angrily as he released his full strength, and he immediately moved to attack Zhang Fei [1]. However, Shen Xueyi immediately moved in front of him and kicked his chest directly, sending him flying backwards before landing on the ground again. "You bitch!"
Shen Xueyi shook her head slightly before speaking to Pang Zhen. "Your resistance is futile, so you should give up, especially since you will never be able to escape from us."
"Heh!" Pang Zhen snorted at Shen Xueyi. "Do you think I will give up so easily? Since I have no way to escape, I will take all of you with me to the afterlife."
After saying that, Pang Zhen suddenly released a black smoke that quickly spread throughout the You Clan area, exacerbating the pain of the two old men who were already dying.
Seeing that, the people from the Shen and Liu Clans immediately moved away from the You Clan's residence, or else they themselves would be doomed if they were exposed to the black smoke.

Zhang Fei [1], who had absorbed the demon miasma before naturally realizing that. However, Mei immediately informed him that it was not just demon miasma; it also contained potent poison. He immediately moved to Shen Xueyi's side, threw her out of the dome, and immediately absorbed the demon miasma into his body.
"Fei'er!" Shen Xueyi shouted in panic, especially once she saw Pang Zhen moving towards Zhang Fei [1] to kill him.
However, Shen Xueyi's panic was unnecessary, especially since Zhang Fei [1] directly used the Clone Illusion Steps and avoided Pang Zhen's attack, so his attack only hit his illusion.

Even though the difference in their cultivation was still significant, Zhang Fei's [1] speed had already outpaced cultivators not only in the heaven realm but even in the sovereign realm, making it impossible for Pang Zhen to catch up with him.

'Shit! How could a cultivator in the soul realm move so fast?' Pang Zhen wondered in his heart as he looked at Zhang Fei [1], who was still absorbing the demon miasma being released from his body. 'What the hell with this guy? How could he absorb my poison and demon miasma? Is he really not afraid of death?'
Unfortunately, Pang Zhen still didn't know that Zhang Fei [1] himself was a demon, and he also didn't know that he had poison immunity, so his poison wouldn't affect him.

Since the situation was already tight, Pang Zhen tried to send a voice transmission to Pang De, but the transparent dome prevented him from doing so, which made him even more annoyed. 'Fuck! I have to kill him as soon as possible, or I will die first before successfully killing him!'
After that, Pang Zhen immediately moved to attack Zhang Fei [1] again, but they looked like playing a cat chasing a mouse, especially since his attacks continued to hit his illusions.
Zhang Fei [1] suddenly disappeared from Pang Zhen's sight, and he stood a little bit ahead of him as he used one of his beast abilities, the exorcimus.

Suddenly, a white light emanated from Zhang Fei [1]'s body, swiftly spreading to the surrounding area and forming a massive light formation. This caused Pang Zhen to panic, particularly because the light had become his weakness after absorbing the demon miasma in the past.

'Shit!' Pang Zhen cursed in his heart as he tried to find a place to hide, especially since countless white lights suddenly rained down on the area, causing the demon miasma to quickly dissipate, and those white lights also rained down on him. "Argh!"

As they listened to Pang Zhen's screams of pain, Shen Xueyi and the people of both clans felt amazed at Zhang Fei [1]'s light ability, especially since the demon miasma was increasingly dissipating, and they had never seen an ability that could attack such a white area at once.

After they waited for some time, the demon miasma finally disappeared completely. They saw Pang Zhen, who was almost dead, lying on the ground. Meanwhile, Cai Shangjun and You Yuanwen were already lying lifeless due to the effects of his demon miasma and poison.
