paragraphs: "Cough... Hahaha... Cough... Hahaha." Pang Zhen laughed and coughed simultaneously as Shen Xueyi and Zhang Fei [1] landed in front of him, and his condition worsened as blood continued to flow out of his body. "Cough... I didn't expect that you two already knew so much about our actions, and I foolishly fell into your trap. Did Pang Hong and Pang Gui tell you all about our plans?"

"That's right, those two are my slaves now, so they told me everything." Even so, Zhang Fei [1] looked regretful when he saw Pang Zhen's condition, especially since he wanted to enslave him like his two comrades. Regrettably, he used poison and demon miasma, compelling him to use his light abilities against him.
"This way, your Pang clan will become increasingly weaker, and you guys will no longer be able to act rampant like in the past."

"Cough... Is that so?" Pang Zhen asked with an evil smile on his face. "Our Pang Clan will never perish, as long as Pang De and the others are still alive. Moreover, you are not aware of our ancestors' terrifying strength and abilities, and they will come out of their seclusion soon. At that time, they will immediately attack and destroy you all, and our clan will become the sole ruler of this realm."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled at Pang Zhen's words, but he then used some abilities from the shadow abyss scripture and the netherworld demon scripture, shocking not only him but also the people from the two clans after learning that he had the darkness element."

Shen Xueyi immediately looked at them and asked them not to say anything about Zhang Fei [1]'s darkness element. She also told them that she and the Liu Sisters had long known that he had the darkness element.

However, Shen Xueyi's explanation still left many questions in their minds, especially since he previously used such a powerful light ability, so he shouldn't possibly have the darkness element, but the facts say otherwise because he has both.

Zhang Fei [1] then spoke to Pang Zhen, who was staring at him in shock. "Are you curious as to how I got them? I don't know about the strength of your ancestors, let alone the strength of the Mo and Xie Clans' ancestors. However, I have prepared some things to stop them, and they will never expect that their own people will help me to destroy them."

Pang Zhen sighed in his heart after he realized that they had underestimated Zhang Fei [1] too much, and he was much more cunning than they had previously thought. He immediately committed suicide, using his last strength, because he did not want to become his slave, and he quickly breathed his last.
"What are you going to do with his corpse?" Shen Xueyi questioned Zhang Fei [1] as soon as he squatted beside Pang Zhen's corpse.

"I still need a lot of information from this guy, so I have to do something about him." Zhang Fei [1] then touched Pang Zhen's corpse and dripped some of his blood onto it. He also channeled his darkness element before using his nercromancy to summon his soul.
A black aura quickly surrounded Pang Zhen's corpse, but as soon as Zhang Fei [1] extracted his soul from his corpse, Shen Xueyi's and those people's expressions turned to shock.

Pang Zhen's expression changed to one of horror as soon as he saw Zhang Fei. "Do you think I'll let you just like this? Since I used one of my abilities to summon your soul, you are no different from Pang Hong, Pang Gui, and Pang Liyuan. Now tell us everything you know about the location of the fourth blood demon tree, the situation in the Mo and Xie Clans, and the plans all of your ancestors had."

Even though he didn't want that, Pang Zhen's soul started talking about some things, but Zhang Fei [1] was disappointed because he also didn't have any information about the location of the fourth blood demon tree, so only Pang De knew about it.

Pang Zhen's soul then told Zhang Fei [1] and the others about the two clans, which was really shocking to them, especially since their overall strength already exceeded all the clans in other regions—apart from the clans in the central region—without including their ancestors.

However, Zhang Fei [1] and the others let out a sigh of disappointment because Pang Zhen's soul did not know the exact details of those ancestors' plans because they had only conveyed everything to Pang De, and he had only told them the outline.
"Who are the people from those two clans that you know?" Zhang Fei asked Pang Zhen's soul again.

"I am quite familiar with Mo Changqiong, the patriarch of the Mo Clan, and Gu Sanxi is his wife. Besides them, I also have a good relationship with some of their elders, such as Mo Jingyun, Mo Zifeng, Mo Dabao, and Mo Chenxi. From the Xie Clan, I only know Xie Fanjing and Lai Rouyu, the current clan leaders, who are also Pang De's in-laws."
Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows for a moment. "Is the Lai Clan as strong as the three clans?"

"No." Pang Zhen's soul answered by shaking his head. "The Lai Clan is just our puppet like the other minor clans, and Xie Fanjing took Lai Rouyu as his wife because he was fascinated by her beauty, so he brainwashed her to be completely loyal to him."
"What about the Gu Clan?" Zhang Fei [1] raised this question because Pang Liyuan had not previously mentioned the Gu Clan to Zhang Xiaolong.
"The Gu Clan is the fourth major clan, and they live in the dark forest located in the northernmost part of our region.

However, their strength is not as high as the other three clans, and they only have two cultivators with cultivation at the 10-Star Heaven Realm, both of whom are their current leaders, Gu Changsheng and Gu Jinglin." Zhang Fei [1] nodded repeatedly as he listened to Pang Zhen's soul.
"However, they have a special ability to control gu bugs, which have various types with different abilities, and one of them can control other people."

"Oh?" Zhang Fei [1] then remembered about the bugs that Pang Zhen had previously given to Cai Shangjun. "So you got those bugs from them, huh? What are their types and abilities? Why do you want to use them on me?"

Pang Zhen's soul shook its head at Zhang Fei [1] before answering him. "I don't know the exact type of those bugs, but after they enter your body, they will take over control of your mind and soul, and you will be completely under my control."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] then turned to Shen Xueyi. "Do you still have questions for him?"

"I think we already have enough information about them." Shen Xueyi then thought for a while before continuing. "Unfortunately, we can't possibly fight them by ourselves with their overall strength being that high, so I thought of gathering the higher-ups of all the clans and sects to discuss this matter, including the clans from the central region, especially since their threat is real.
However, all of them are still in the demon cave to stabilize the seal on the demon portal, so there's no way we can do it now."

After hearing that, Zhang Fei [1] let out a heavy sigh and turned his gaze back to Pang Zhen's soul. Since there was no way he could help him fight them, he decided to use the demon absorbing to absorb his soul, which made Shen Xueyi and the others feel terrified of him. "Everything is finished now, and you can take care of the remaining members of the Cai and You Clan.
This way, the situation in all regions will be under control and calm for the time being."

They nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei [1], especially since the Pang Clan's strength had weakened with the loss of three of their main members, and their vassals in the southern region had all disappeared. Even so, they knew they couldn't lower their guard, especially since the clan still had many other members, and Pang De would probably assign his other clan members to look for new vassals.

Shen Xueyi then pulled back her artifact, causing the transparent dome to disappear, and Shen Yang landed in front of them before handing over the frightened Cai Qiu to her. After that, he led the members of the Shen Clan to clean up the Cai Clan, while the members of the Liu Clan went to clean up the You Clan.

After they returned to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, Shen Xueyi immediately handed Cai Qiu over to Lin Hao, instructing him to imprison her in the punishment hall for the time being. She then posed a question to Zhang Fei [1]. "What are your plans next?"

"I still haven't gotten any information about the fourth blood demon tree, so I can't do anything about it. However, I've ordered Pang Liyuan to dig up the information from his father, and I've also ordered him to do something about Xie Jingxian, so I can use her to monitor the Xie Clan.

As for the Mo Clan, I will use Pan Gui to lure out one of their members, and I will enslave that person." Shen Xueyi nodded in understanding at his explanation, but Zhang Fei [1] then looked away before continuing.

"At least the situation in all regions is now under control, and I'm sure Pang De won't be in a hurry to send his other clan members to look for new vassals, so I plan to go into seclusion for a long time, and you should also come with us."

"Eh?" Shen Xueyi was taken aback by that, but she herself was one of his partners, and she wanted to break through to the sovereign realm as quickly as possible, so she immediately agreed with Zhang Fei [1]. "Anyway, will your clone also enter seclusion with your partners, including Luan'er? If you do that, I will ask Shen Yang and the others to keep an eye on this sect."
"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] nodded to Shen Xueyi. "This clone will also enter seclusion, and I will take them all elsewhere so you can ask them to protect this sect."
"All right."

After that, they immediately parted ways, and Shen Xueyi returned to her private room while waiting for Shen Yang and the others to return. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] went to see Yan Luan'er and Xi Zihua, which made the two women pleased after he told them about his plans. They quickly started dual-cultivating, especially since he had previously only dual-cultivated with Luo Yu and the others.

[Reward: 62 green jewels.]

"Oh?" Angela was surprised when she saw Zhang Xiaolong, but she immediately ran over to him before hugging and caressing his smooth black fur. "Did I keep you waiting long? I had some important business in my previous sub-realm, so I could only come here now."

[I don't know, master. However, Angela seems to be a good demon, and Janette has also said that she is a kind-hearted demon. Furthermore, she should already be aware that you are a male, so it's likely that she won't kill you.]

After thinking about it, Zhang Xiaolong decided to use his half-fox form, which caused Angela to be stunned for a moment before releasing him from her embrace. "Since when were you able to transform into this form?"

Hahaha...

Hahaha." Pang Zhen laughed and coughed simultaneously as Shen Xueyi and Zhang Fei [1] landed in front of him, and his condition worsened as blood continued to flow out of his body.
"Cough...
I didn't expect that you two already knew so much about our actions, and I foolishly fell into your trap.
Did Pang Hong and Pang Gui tell you all about our plans?"

"That's right, those two are my slaves now, so they told me everything." Even so, Zhang Fei [1] looked regretful when he saw Pang Zhen's condition, especially since he wanted to enslave him like his two comrades.
Regrettably, he used poison and demon miasma, compelling him to use his light abilities against him.
"This way, your Pang clan will become increasingly weaker, and you guys will no longer be able to act rampant like in the past."
"Cough...
Is that so?" Pang Zhen asked with an evil smile on his face.
"Our Pang Clan will never perish, as long as Pang De and the others are still alive.
Moreover, you are not aware of our ancestors' terrifying strength and abilities, and they will come out of their seclusion soon.
At that time, they will immediately attack and destroy you all, and our clan will become the sole ruler of this realm."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled at Pang Zhen's words, but he then used some abilities from the shadow abyss scripture and the netherworld demon scripture, shocking not only him but also the people from the two clans after learning that he had the darkness element."
Shen Xueyi immediately looked at them and asked them not to say anything about Zhang Fei [1]'s darkness element.
She also told them that she and the Liu Sisters had long known that he had the darkness element.

However, Shen Xueyi's explanation still left many questions in their minds, especially since he previously used such a powerful light ability, so he shouldn't possibly have the darkness element, but the facts say otherwise because he has both.
Zhang Fei [1] then spoke to Pang Zhen, who was staring at him in shock.
"Are you curious as to how I got them?
I don't know about the strength of your ancestors, let alone the strength of the Mo and Xie Clans' ancestors.
However, I have prepared some things to stop them, and they will never expect that their own people will help me to destroy them."
Pang Zhen sighed in his heart after he realized that they had underestimated Zhang Fei [1] too much, and he was much more cunning than they had previously thought.
He immediately committed suicide, using his last strength, because he did not want to become his slave, and he quickly breathed his last.
"What are you going to do with his corpse?" Shen Xueyi questioned Zhang Fei [1] as soon as he squatted beside Pang Zhen's corpse.
"I still need a lot of information from this guy, so I have to do something about him." Zhang Fei [1] then touched Pang Zhen's corpse and dripped some of his blood onto it.
He also channeled his darkness element before using his nercromancy to summon his soul.
A black aura quickly surrounded Pang Zhen's corpse, but as soon as Zhang Fei [1] extracted his soul from his corpse, Shen Xueyi's and those people's expressions turned to shock.
Pang Zhen's expression changed to one of horror as soon as he saw Zhang Fei.
"Do you think I'll let you just like this?
Since I used one of my abilities to summon your soul, you are no different from Pang Hong, Pang Gui, and Pang Liyuan.
Now tell us everything you know about the location of the fourth blood demon tree, the situation in the Mo and Xie Clans, and the plans all of your ancestors had."

Even though he didn't want that, Pang Zhen's soul started talking about some things, but Zhang Fei [1] was disappointed because he also didn't have any information about the location of the fourth blood demon tree, so only Pang De knew about it.

Pang Zhen's soul then told Zhang Fei [1] and the others about the two clans, which was really shocking to them, especially since their overall strength already exceeded all the clans in other regions—apart from the clans in the central region—without including their ancestors.

However, Zhang Fei [1] and the others let out a sigh of disappointment because Pang Zhen's soul did not know the exact details of those ancestors' plans because they had only conveyed everything to Pang De, and he had only told them the outline.
"Who are the people from those two clans that you know?" Zhang Fei asked Pang Zhen's soul again.
"I am quite familiar with Mo Changqiong, the patriarch of the Mo Clan, and Gu Sanxi is his wife.
Besides them, I also have a good relationship with some of their elders, such as Mo Jingyun, Mo Zifeng, Mo Dabao, and Mo Chenxi.
From the Xie Clan, I only know Xie Fanjing and Lai Rouyu, the current clan leaders, who are also Pang De's in-laws."
Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows for a moment.
"Is the Lai Clan as strong as the three clans?"
"No." Pang Zhen's soul answered by shaking his head.
"The Lai Clan is just our puppet like the other minor clans, and Xie Fanjing took Lai Rouyu as his wife because he was fascinated by her beauty, so he brainwashed her to be completely loyal to him."
"What about the Gu Clan?" Zhang Fei [1] raised this question because Pang Liyuan had not previously mentioned the Gu Clan to Zhang Xiaolong.
"The Gu Clan is the fourth major clan, and they live in the dark forest located in the northernmost part of our region.

However, their strength is not as high as the other three clans, and they only have two cultivators with cultivation at the 10-Star Heaven Realm, both of whom are their current leaders, Gu Changsheng and Gu Jinglin." Zhang Fei [1] nodded repeatedly as he listened to Pang Zhen's soul.
"However, they have a special ability to control gu bugs, which have various types with different abilities, and one of them can control other people."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [1] then remembered about the bugs that Pang Zhen had previously given to Cai Shangjun.
"So you got those bugs from them, huh?
What are their types and abilities?
Why do you want to use them on me?"
Pang Zhen's soul shook its head at Zhang Fei [1] before answering him.
"I don't know the exact type of those bugs, but after they enter your body, they will take over control of your mind and soul, and you will be completely under my control."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] then turned to Shen Xueyi.
"Do you still have questions for him?"
"I think we already have enough information about them." Shen Xueyi then thought for a while before continuing.

"Unfortunately, we can't possibly fight them by ourselves with their overall strength being that high, so I thought of gathering the higher-ups of all the clans and sects to discuss this matter, including the clans from the central region, especially since their threat is real.
However, all of them are still in the demon cave to stabilize the seal on the demon portal, so there's no way we can do it now."
After hearing that, Zhang Fei [1] let out a heavy sigh and turned his gaze back to Pang Zhen's soul.
Since there was no way he could help him fight them, he decided to use the demon absorbing to absorb his soul, which made Shen Xueyi and the others feel terrified of him.
"Everything is finished now, and you can take care of the remaining members of the Cai and You Clan.
This way, the situation in all regions will be under control and calm for the time being."

Even so, they knew they couldn't lower their guard, especially since the clan still had many other members, and Pang De would probably assign his other clan members to look for new vassals.
Shen Xueyi then pulled back her artifact, causing the transparent dome to disappear, and Shen Yang landed in front of them before handing over the frightened Cai Qiu to her.
After that, he led the members of the Shen Clan to clean up the Cai Clan, while the members of the Liu Clan went to clean up the You Clan.
After they returned to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, Shen Xueyi immediately handed Cai Qiu over to Lin Hao, instructing him to imprison her in the punishment hall for the time being.
She then posed a question to Zhang Fei [1].
"What are your plans next?"
"I still haven't gotten any information about the fourth blood demon tree, so I can't do anything about it.
However, I've ordered Pang Liyuan to dig up the information from his father, and I've also ordered him to do something about Xie Jingxian, so I can use her to monitor the Xie Clan.

As for the Mo Clan, I will use Pan Gui to lure out one of their members, and I will enslave that person." Shen Xueyi nodded in understanding at his explanation, but Zhang Fei [1] then looked away before continuing.

"At least the situation in all regions is now under control, and I'm sure Pang De won't be in a hurry to send his other clan members to look for new vassals, so I plan to go into seclusion for a long time, and you should also come with us."

chapters.title: Chapter 349 With Angela
paragraphs: After she finished her song, Angela immediately swam to the seaside. She then floated out of the water, returned to her half demon form, and sat down beside him. "I'm glad that you enjoyed my singing."
"Ha ha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed softly and turned to her. "Lord Angela-"

"Shh!" Angela stopped Zhang Xiaolong right away by placing her index finger on his lips. "You don't need to address me as such, and you can call me by my name directly. Unlike the other demon rulers, I don't really like my status as a demon ruler, and I enjoy living a free life with these aquatic beasts.

Furthermore, not all demon beasts appreciate my singing; they claim that my voice causes them to forget themselves. Therefore, I'm delighted to see that you find enjoyment in my singing. Anyway, what's your name, and where do you come from?"

"I also feel hypnotized by your voice, but I am different from other demon beasts, and I really enjoyed your voice when you sang that song." Zhang Xiaolong responded as he took Angela's hand and gently caressed it. "My name is Zhang Xiaolong, and I come from Lord Zygoz's sub-realm."
Angela immediately pulled her hand back and asked him a question. "Zhang Xiaolong? Why is your name so weird? I have never heard of such a name among the demons."

"Ha ha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed wryly at Angela's question, and he actually wanted to use another name to introduce himself to her, but he dropped the idea. "I don't know; my parents gave me this name, so I always use it."
"I see." Angela nodded in understanding. "Considering your appearance and demon rank, you should be very young, right?"
Zhang Xiaolong nodded to her. "In fact, I'll be 20 years old in a few days, so-."
"What? Are you kidding me? How can your demon rank reach the Earl rank if you are not even 20 years old yet?" Angela asked in shock as she suddenly stood up from her seat.

"I'm not joking with you." Zhang Xiaolong then stood up and looked in another direction, and he immediately teleported towards a demon beast before grabbing its head, shocking Angela, who looked at him with wide eyes.

Angela was even more shocked when Zhang Xiaolong used his essence absorption ability, which caused the demon beast to dry up quickly before turning into ashes. He immediately returned to her side afterward. "You may think my ability is cruel, but I use that technique to absorb the essence of other demon beasts, and my demon rank can increase rapidly thanks to their essence."

Angela did not respond to Zhang Xiaolong, as she was still shocked by his abilities, especially his teleportation ability, and her eyes continued to be glued to him. After all, she was the only demon in the Diyu Realm who had that ability before, but now she has met another demon beast who has the same ability as hers.
After some time, Angela regained her composure and spoke to Zhang Xiaolong. "Try catching me."

Angela immediately used her teleportation ability and vanished from his sight, but Zhang Xiaolong immediately pursued her using his own. She was even more shocked by his action, especially considering the significant gap in their demon ranks, but he was able to match and even surpass her speed.

Unbeknownst to them, four other demons were watching them from a distance; they were none other than Oz, Zygoz, Virgil, and Aries. At first, the second demon emperor wanted to invite Angela to join them in going to Aqua, the Aquarius sub-realm, especially since their realms were close to each other, but they saw her having fun with Zhang Xiaolong.
In the end, they decided to leave the two behind, and they immediately went to the eleventh demon ruler sub-realm to persuade him to join them.

After they played tag with each other and traversed various areas in the Diyu Realm for so long, they immediately returned to the Northern Sea. However, Angela was panting heavily after she used her abilities without stopping, so Zhang Xiaolong immediately supported her.

After all, Zhang Xiaolong had already perfectly adapted to the third level of the gravity feature in his training space, which was eight times heavier, so the gravity in the Diyu Realm was nothing to him, and he did not need to spend much energy to keep up with Angela.

"Hah... Hah... For such a young demon beast, you are truly terrifying, Xiaolong." Angela uttered those words while struggling to catch her breath. "In my entire life, no demon beasts or demon rulers can catch up to me if I use my teleportation ability, but I actually find it difficult to avoid your pursuit, and you should be able to catch me easily if you want."

That made Zhang Xiaolong smile. "I've trained hard to reach this stage, Angela. Not only did I increase my demon rank by absorbing other demon beasts' essences, but I also tempered my body very hard, which made my speed surpass that of demon beasts in general, and my teleportation also became faster. Actually, I still have one more ability, and you will definitely be surprised if you see it."
"Huh?" Angela looked at Zhang Xiaolong with a shocked look. "Can you still move faster than before? Can you show me?"

"Yeah, I can still move faster, and Lord Zygoz has seen me use it on multiple occasions." Zhang Xiaolong then embraced Angela's waist and placed both of her hands on his shoulders. "Hold on tight, especially since my speed will be much faster than before."

Angela nodded and hugged his neck, and Zhang Xiaolong immediately used the Nine Cloud Steps to take her away from the Northern Sea. Soon, they reached the southernmost region of the Diyu Realm, a vast swamp home to a variety of demon beasts, shocking her greatly.

Zhang Xiaolong then released Angela from his embrace, and she looked around the swamp before taking a deep breath. "Your speed is truly insane! The two areas are so far apart, but you were able to bring me here so quickly that I barely even had time to blink, which means you are the fastest demon beast in this realm."

"One of the keys to survival is escape, so I deliberately honed my speed." Angela nodded in agreement with Zhang Xiaolong, especially since she herself always relied on her teleportation to escape, and her ability led her to become one of the demon rulers.
"Anyway, it's not that I'm a coward, but I'm fully aware of my strength, and there's no way I can fight against a powerful demon or demon beast like you."

"That's right." Angela then walked to the side of the swamp while talking. "Running away doesn't mean being a coward; running away is an act of self-preservation, especially if we meet an enemy who is much stronger than us. After all, living is better than dying, right? There is no point for us to act like bravado, and we must be aware of our strengths.

Anyway, you probably already know that I am the youngest demon ruler, and I can be said to be the weakest among them. However, my teleportation ability helps me greatly, and I use it to avoid my opponents while developing strategies to take them down, which makes them all recognize me and bring me to my current position.
As I told you before, I don't like my status, but I have no other choice because it can make my life safer, and I can protect the other aquatic demon beasts."

"Actually, I'm no different from you, and I've also done a lot of things I don't like lately." Zhang Xiaolong also walked to the swamp side and stood by Angela's side. "Sometimes we have no choice but to do them, especially since there are so many things that are beyond our control, so we are forced to do them in order to protect ourselves and those closest to us."

Angela nodded slightly in response to Zhang Xiaolong's words, then turned to face him before posing a question. "Have you ever thought about becoming a demon ruler, or perhaps the next demon emperor? Although you are still too young and your demon rank is still at the Earl Rank, you have your abilities to support your wishes, and I think you can become one in the future."

"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed when he heard that. "Just like you, I don't like such a status, and I prefer a free and unfettered life, so I'm not interested in becoming a demon ruler, let alone a demon emperor, especially since both would be a pain in my ass."

"Hahaha! You are very vulgar, you know?" Angela said that as she laughed. "Even so, I like you, and I've never felt as happy as I did before the second demon emperor disappeared. The situation in this realm became so bad because of his disappearance, and many demons or demon beasts had to suffer because four of us demon rulers are so ambitious to become the next demon emperor.
Moreover, they keep trying to find the ten demon lord seeds left by the first demon emperor, and they oppress many of those who are suspected of having found them, such as the Dryads."
Zhang Xiaolong then asked Angela. "Is that why you agree with Lord Zygoz?"
"Eh?" Angela was momentarily surprised by that. "Did Old Man Zygoz tell you about his plans?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong nodded to Angela. "Lord Zygoz knows many of my other abilities, and he asked me to join him in investigating some things, so he has explained quite a lot to me. So far, I know that you, Lord Aries, and Lord Virgil have agreed to join him. However, he still has to try to persuade the other demon lords, except for those four, especially since he suspected that they were traitors."

Angela sighed heavily as she nodded at Zhang Xiaolong. "You're right about the Amaris twins, Tauri, Leo, and Avros. I have always believed that they were the traitors, and they always oppressed other demons or demon beasts. Even many of the aquatic demon beasts perished at the hands of their troops, which is why I never liked them.
Once Old Man Zygoz explained his plans to me, I immediately agreed with him. Anyway, would you like to visit my sub-realm? I still want to talk with you, but I have to go back now."

"Unfortunately, I can't go to your sub-realm today because I still have some unfinished business, so I have to go and sort things out." Angela looked disappointed while listening to Zhang Xiaolong's answer. "However, I have plenty of time tomorrow, so I'll go directly to your sub-realm."

"Is that true?" Angela asked with an excited look, and Zhang Xiaolong nodded at her. "In that case, I will wait for you in my sub-realm, so you should go directly there tomorrow, and we will talk more there."

After they said their goodbyes, Angela immediately used her teleportation to return to her sub-realm. On the other hand, Zhang Xiaolong wanted to go to the Dryad Forest to check on Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang, but he suddenly saw a swarm of demons, which was similar to a kappa. 'Hey!
I'm going to kill this demon and give its flesh to that guy, so he will transform into this demon, and his wife will be hysterical when she sees her husband.'

Following that, Zhang Xiaolong instantly summoned the demon extermination sword, directly killing the demon. He then proceeded to skin it until only its flesh remained, promptly storing it in the system inventory.
As for Ba Shuxiang, Zhang Xiaolong tried to find the right demon to harvest its meat, which he would give to him later.
[Master, why don't you use that demon beast in your east for Ba Shuxiang? Although its demon rank is low, the demon beast looks interesting.]

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong then turned his head in the direction Mei pointed, where he saw a demon beast that resembled a black swan. However, it can stand and walk like a human, and its black feather is beautiful even though it lives in a swamp. "I think you are right, and that demon beast is suitable for Ba Shuxiang."

Without thinking anymore, Zhang Xiaolong immediately channeled his light element into the demon extermination sword and attacked the demon beast directly, and it didn't offer much resistance, so he immediately skinned it on the spot after killing it.

After everything was done, Zhang Xiaolong went straight to the Dryad forest and met Lillea, and he gave the meat of the two demon beasts to her. "Are you going to give them to the two humans? With this amount of meat, it probably won't take long for them to turn into demons."

"Yeah, you can ask your subordinates to give them both." Lillea nodded in agreement and called one of her race members, and Zhang Xiaolong then told her. "Anyway, I will bring them all into seclusion again, and we will be doing this for quite some time, so I want you to join us."

"All right." Lillea unhesitantly agreed to Zhang Xiaolong's request, especially since she still needed strength to protect her race, and he was the only one who could help her with that. "When are you going to take me away?"
"Right now."

After that, Lillea called several of her race members and gave them some instructions, and Zhang Xiaolong immediately sent her into the training space before returning to the Sky Jade Realm to meet his slaves.
When he arrived there, Pang Hong and Pang Gui were already waiting for him, but Zhang Xiaolong did not speak to them right away, and he chose to complete the daily quest first.

"You may think my ability is cruel, but I use that technique to absorb the essence of other demon beasts, and my demon rank can increase rapidly thanks to their essence."
Angela did not respond to Zhang Xiaolong, as she was still shocked by his abilities, especially his teleportation ability, and her eyes continued to be glued to him.
After all, she was the only demon in the Diyu Realm who had that ability before, but now she has met another demon beast who has the same ability as hers.
After some time, Angela regained her composure and spoke to Zhang Xiaolong.
"Try catching me."
Angela immediately used her teleportation ability and vanished from his sight, but Zhang Xiaolong immediately pursued her using his own.
She was even more shocked by his action, especially considering the significant gap in their demon ranks, but he was able to match and even surpass her speed.
Unbeknownst to them, four other demons were watching them from a distance; they were none other than Oz, Zygoz, Virgil, and Aries.

At first, the second demon emperor wanted to invite Angela to join them in going to Aqua, the Aquarius sub-realm, especially since their realms were close to each other, but they saw her having fun with Zhang Xiaolong.
In the end, they decided to leave the two behind, and they immediately went to the eleventh demon ruler sub-realm to persuade him to join them.
After they played tag with each other and traversed various areas in the Diyu Realm for so long, they immediately returned to the Northern Sea.
However, Angela was panting heavily after she used her abilities without stopping, so Zhang Xiaolong immediately supported her.

After all, Zhang Xiaolong had already perfectly adapted to the third level of the gravity feature in his training space, which was eight times heavier, so the gravity in the Diyu Realm was nothing to him, and he did not need to spend much energy to keep up with Angela.
"Hah...
Hah...
For such a young demon beast, you are truly terrifying, Xiaolong." Angela uttered those words while struggling to catch her breath.

"In my entire life, no demon beasts or demon rulers can catch up to me if I use my teleportation ability, but I actually find it difficult to avoid your pursuit, and you should be able to catch me easily if you want."
That made Zhang Xiaolong smile.
"I've trained hard to reach this stage, Angela.

Not only did I increase my demon rank by absorbing other demon beasts' essences, but I also tempered my body very hard, which made my speed surpass that of demon beasts in general, and my teleportation also became faster.
Actually, I still have one more ability, and you will definitely be surprised if you see it."
"Huh?" Angela looked at Zhang Xiaolong with a shocked look.
"Can you still move faster than before?
Can you show me?"
"Yeah, I can still move faster, and Lord Zygoz has seen me use it on multiple occasions." Zhang Xiaolong then embraced Angela's waist and placed both of her hands on his shoulders.
"Hold on tight, especially since my speed will be much faster than before."
Angela nodded and hugged his neck, and Zhang Xiaolong immediately used the Nine Cloud Steps to take her away from the Northern Sea.
Soon, they reached the southernmost region of the Diyu Realm, a vast swamp home to a variety of demon beasts, shocking her greatly.
Zhang Xiaolong then released Angela from his embrace, and she looked around the swamp before taking a deep breath.
"Your speed is truly insane!
The two areas are so far apart, but you were able to bring me here so quickly that I barely even had time to blink, which means you are the fastest demon beast in this realm."

"One of the keys to survival is escape, so I deliberately honed my speed." Angela nodded in agreement with Zhang Xiaolong, especially since she herself always relied on her teleportation to escape, and her ability led her to become one of the demon rulers.
"Anyway, it's not that I'm a coward, but I'm fully aware of my strength, and there's no way I can fight against a powerful demon or demon beast like you."
"That's right." Angela then walked to the side of the swamp while talking.
"Running away doesn't mean being a coward; running away is an act of self-preservation, especially if we meet an enemy who is much stronger than us.
After all, living is better than dying, right?
There is no point for us to act like bravado, and we must be aware of our strengths.
Anyway, you probably already know that I am the youngest demon ruler, and I can be said to be the weakest among them.

However, my teleportation ability helps me greatly, and I use it to avoid my opponents while developing strategies to take them down, which makes them all recognize me and bring me to my current position.
As I told you before, I don't like my status, but I have no other choice because it can make my life safer, and I can protect the other aquatic demon beasts."
"Actually, I'm no different from you, and I've also done a lot of things I don't like lately." Zhang Xiaolong also walked to the swamp side and stood by Angela's side.
"Sometimes we have no choice but to do them, especially since there are so many things that are beyond our control, so we are forced to do them in order to protect ourselves and those closest to us."
Angela nodded slightly in response to Zhang Xiaolong's words, then turned to face him before posing a question.
"Have you ever thought about becoming a demon ruler, or perhaps the next demon emperor?
Although you are still too young and your demon rank is still at the Earl Rank, you have your abilities to support your wishes, and I think you can become one in the future."
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed when he heard that.

"Just like you, I don't like such a status, and I prefer a free and unfettered life, so I'm not interested in becoming a demon ruler, let alone a demon emperor, especially since both would be a pain in my ass."
"Hahaha!
You are very vulgar, you know?" Angela said that as she laughed.
"Even so, I like you, and I've never felt as happy as I did before the second demon emperor disappeared.

The situation in this realm became so bad because of his disappearance, and many demons or demon beasts had to suffer because four of us demon rulers are so ambitious to become the next demon emperor.
Moreover, they keep trying to find the ten demon lord seeds left by the first demon emperor, and they oppress many of those who are suspected of having found them, such as the Dryads."
Zhang Xiaolong then asked Angela.
"Is that why you agree with Lord Zygoz?"
"Eh?" Angela was momentarily surprised by that.
"Did Old Man Zygoz tell you about his plans?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong nodded to Angela.
"Lord Zygoz knows many of my other abilities, and he asked me to join him in investigating some things, so he has explained quite a lot to me.
So far, I know that you, Lord Aries, and Lord Virgil have agreed to join him.
However, he still has to try to persuade the other demon lords, except for those four, especially since he suspected that they were traitors."
Angela sighed heavily as she nodded at Zhang Xiaolong.
"You're right about the Amaris twins, Tauri, Leo, and Avros.
I have always believed that they were the traitors, and they always oppressed other demons or demon beasts.
Even many of the aquatic demon beasts perished at the hands of their troops, which is why I never liked them.
Once Old Man Zygoz explained his plans to me, I immediately agreed with him.
Anyway, would you like to visit my sub-realm?
I still want to talk with you, but I have to go back now."

"Unfortunately, I can't go to your sub-realm today because I still have some unfinished business, so I have to go and sort things out." Angela looked disappointed while listening to Zhang Xiaolong's answer.
"However, I have plenty of time tomorrow, so I'll go directly to your sub-realm."
"Is that true?" Angela asked with an excited look, and Zhang Xiaolong nodded at her.
"In that case, I will wait for you in my sub-realm, so you should go directly there tomorrow, and we will talk more there."
After they said their goodbyes, Angela immediately used her teleportation to return to her sub-realm.
On the other hand, Zhang Xiaolong wanted to go to the Dryad Forest to check on Chi Zhongguo and Ba Shuxiang, but he suddenly saw a swarm of demons, which was similar to a kappa. 'Hey!
I'm going to kill this demon and give its flesh to that guy, so he will transform into this demon, and his wife will be hysterical when she sees her husband.'
Following that, Zhang Xiaolong instantly summoned the demon extermination sword, directly killing the demon.
He then proceeded to skin it until only its flesh remained, promptly storing it in the system inventory.
As for Ba Shuxiang, Zhang Xiaolong tried to find the right demon to harvest its meat, which he would give to him later.
[Master, why don't you use that demon beast in your east for Ba Shuxiang?
Although its demon rank is low, the demon beast looks interesting.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong then turned his head in the direction Mei pointed, where he saw a demon beast that resembled a black swan.
However, it can stand and walk like a human, and its black feather is beautiful even though it lives in a swamp.
"I think you are right, and that demon beast is suitable for Ba Shuxiang."

Without thinking anymore, Zhang Xiaolong immediately channeled his light element into the demon extermination sword and attacked the demon beast directly, and it didn't offer much resistance, so he immediately skinned it on the spot after killing it.
After everything was done, Zhang Xiaolong went straight to the Dryad forest and met Lillea, and he gave the meat of the two demon beasts to her.
"Are you going to give them to the two humans?
With this amount of meat, it probably won't take long for them to turn into demons."
"Yeah, you can ask your subordinates to give them both." Lillea nodded in agreement and called one of her race members, and Zhang Xiaolong then told her.
"Anyway, I will bring them all into seclusion again, and we will be doing this for quite some time, so I want you to join us."
"All right." Lillea unhesitantly agreed to Zhang Xiaolong's request, especially since she still needed strength to protect her race, and he was the only one who could help her with that.
"When are you going to take me away?"
"Right now."

After that, Lillea called several of her race members and gave them some instructions, and Zhang Xiaolong immediately sent her into the training space before returning to the Sky Jade Realm to meet his slaves.
When he arrived there, Pang Hong and Pang Gui were already waiting for him, but Zhang Xiaolong did not speak to them right away, and he chose to complete the daily quest first.

chapters.title: Chapter 350 Pang Wachun
paragraphs: Pang De, who was cultivating beside the fourth blood demon tree, suddenly opened his eyes. He then took out a shattered jade from his storage ring, and his expression became extremely serious after looking at it. "Damn it! Pang Hong and Pang Gui have fallen into that brat's hands, and Pang Zhen is now dead!

If my guess is right, all of our vassals in the southern region should have been destroyed, just like our vassals in the western and eastern regions. Who exactly is that brat? Where did he come from? Ever since his appearance, all of the plans we have planned for so long have been destroyed one by one, and we have to start all over again.
The ancestors will definitely be furious if they find out about these matters, and they will definitely severely punish me."

Just as he was contemplating this, a voice transmission abruptly entered Pang De's mind, causing him to tense up. He then listened to the sound before getting up from his seat, and he immediately took out a returning jade. "Ancestor Pang Wachun has finally come out of his isolation, but the others don't seem to have come out yet."
Pang De then threw an artifact at that location, making the area and its surroundings transparent. After taking a deep breath, he immediately broke his returning jade.
A while later, Pang De had already arrived at the Pang Clan, and he rushed to meet Pang Wachun, but he still couldn't shake the worry in his heart.
Soon, Pang De had already arrived at a garden, where Pang Wachun was standing, holding the destroyed plants in his hands.

Although Pang Wachun was very old and all his hair had turned white, his appearance was still that of a middle-aged man. Even his body looked tall and sturdy, but his entire skin was dark, which was the result of him absorbing the demon miasma into his body for decades.
Pang Wachun emanated an intensely cold and frightening aura, enveloping his entire body in a black aura, accompanied by strange creatures that made Pang De tremble.

"Where have you been? Where are the others? Why aren't they in our clan?" Pang Wachun immediately turned to face him and threw the plants to him, but Pang De's heart tightened when he saw his pitch-black eyes. "You guys don't even realize that someone infiltrated our clan and planted these plants in several areas. Fortunately, I felt something strange about them, so I destroyed them."

Those plants came from the seeds that Zhang Fei gave Pang Hong some time ago, and Pang De looked at those ruined plants before telling Pang Wachun the truth. "Ancestor, you must know that no one else can infiltrate our clan, and only members can enter here.
In fact, Pang Hong and Pang Gui have already fallen into the enemy's hands, and I think that the two of them were the ones who planted them in our clan."
"Hmm?" After Pang De said that, Pang Wachun's expression looked furious. "How could Pang Hong and Pang Gui fall into the hands of our enemies?"

Pang De sighed heavily before telling him all the events that had happened in detail, especially about Zhang Fei, Boitata, and the destruction of their vasslas in all regions, which caused Pang Wachun's expression to become even more furious.
In addition, he informed his ancestor about Pang Zhen's recent death, including the location of his death in the southern region, especially since he himself asked him to go there.

Pang Wachun looked in disbelief and astonishment after Pang De told him about Zhang Fei's relationship with all those clans, especially since such a thing had never happened before. "Are you absolutely sure that brat has a relationship with all those clans?"

"Yes." Pang De answered with a nod. "A few days ago, that brat married the princess of the Shen Clan, and he also announced his relationship with all those clans. Even Zhang Lingxue and the others were present at the wedding, so his relationship with them must be true. Unfortunately, I still don't have any information about his background, so I can't do anything against him yet.

For now, our only remaining followers are Huan Shitian, Huan Jingtian, Lan Tze, Qiao Fei, and Guan Peng. Unfortunately, their clans have already been destroyed, except for the Lan Clan, especially since that brat hasn't attacked them yet."
"I see." Pang Wachun nodded in understanding. "In that case, we don't need to waste time looking for new vassalas, especially since my brothers and sisters will soon come out of their seclusion.

Once they come out, we will immediately launch an attack on those who are in the demon cave, so you can tell our remaining followers to prepare an attack, and we will eliminate them at once by sending them to the demons' home realm."
"Eh?" Pang De was surprised by Pang Wachun's instructions. "Does that mean you all have found a way to break the seal, Ancestor?"

"Yeah." Pang Wachun nodded to Pang De. "The demon left behind in the last blood demon tree is no ordinary demon, and it has the ability to communicate with those demons from its realm, even though they are separated by a great distance.

It has already informed them about our plans, and they are already preparing to help us break the seal from behind the portal, so I'm sure Chang Wuhen and the others won't be able to stop us. Once the seal is broken, they will immediately invade this realm again and kill them, and they will also help us to enslave those idiots, so our clan will become the sole ruler of this realm."
Pang De's expression changed to joy after he heard that. "So when will Ancestor Pang Xiuwen and the others come out of their seclusion?"

"Two weeks at most." Pang Wachun then flicked his finger, and a black qi ball immediately shot out from his finger before entering Pang Dei's body through his chest, which caused him to fall to the ground and let out a painful groan. "Hang in there! Let it take over your body!
That thing is the result of our seclusion with the help of the demons, and your strength will increase quite significantly afterward, so you can help us fight them."

"Argh!" Pang De immediately followed Pang Wachun's words, but he was experiencing even more pain, and he felt like all his internal organs were being gnawed by something, which made his face quickly turn pale.

In addition, his entire body began to turn black, and his physique underwent various changes, including the appearance of two horns on his head, gradually transforming his appearance into that of a demon.
One hour.
Three hours.

Pang De's groans finally stopped after so much torture, and he collapsed limply on the floor, breathing heavily. He took out a mirror to see his new appearance, and his eyes widened in shock, especially since he had completely transformed into a demon.

Pang De's black hair became even blacker; two big horns appeared on his head; his black eyes became bloody-red; and his entire body was completely black. Even so, he also looked satisfied, especially since he could feel that his strength had increased greatly with his cultivation reaching 1-Star Sovereign Level.

After he calmed down, Pang De immediately stood up and looked at Pang Wachun with gratitude, using the transformation technique to return to his old form. "Will you also give that thing to the other members of our clan, Ancestor?"

"Yes." Pang Wachun replied with a nod. "However, we only managed to create a small number of them, so you must choose our members who are truly worthy of receiving them, especially since Pang Hong and those two have fallen."

"Yes! I will call them now." Before long, three middle-aged men and two middle-aged women had arrived in front of them, and Pang De immediately introduced them to Pang Wachun. "The three men are Pang Yuan, Pang Tong, and Pang Kuo. The two women are Pang Jiushi and Pang Xiu Wen. Although they are not the main members of our clan, their cultivation is the highest among the others, so I chose them."
Pang Wachun observed them for a while before flicking those things into their bodies, causing all of them to experience extreme pain, similar to what Pang De had previously experienced.
Just like Pang De, the five of them went through this process for quite a long time, and they finally turned into demons, which also made their cultivation increase quite significantly.
After seeing them, Pang Wachun nodded with satisfaction. "You guys go back now and stabilize your cultivation, and we will make our move in two weeks."
"Yes, Ancestor!"

After they left, Pang Wachun immediately spoke to Pang De. "Move the fourth blood demon tree from that place, and you can move it to a place not far from the demon cave, so the demon miasma will affect Chang Wuhen and the others."
"Yes."

Pang De immediately left the Pang Clan again, and Pang Wachun returned to the seclusion room to inform the others about everything, which made them furious. However, the demon reminded them to be patient while completing their isolation, and they followed its words.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 6,200 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 62 green jewels sent to the inventory.]
"Phew!" As soon as the notification appeared, Zhang Xiaolong immediately opened his eyes and questioned Pang Gui. "Which among the elders of the Mo Clan has quite a strong influence?"

"Mo Jingyun is the oldest elder, and Mo Changqiong often seeks advice from him, Master. However, he is a very cautious person, and he would never leave the Mo clan unless there was something important. Usually, he will send Mo Zifeng or Mo Chenxi to do something, and they will take care of everything for him."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong frowned as he pondered for a while. "Which of those two people has a close relationship with you?"
"Mo Zifeng."
"Mo Zifeng, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong muttered softly before ordering Pang Gui. "In that case, you can lure him away from the Mo Clan and use any means to bring him here."
"Yes, Master."

After Pang Gui left, Zhang Xiaolong also ordered Pang Hong to go to the Gu Clan, and he instructed him to only keep an eye on the clan. In addition, he also contacted Pang Liyuan to ask about his duties, but he was disappointed that he had not managed to do anything about Xie Jingxian, especially since they were still in the Xie Clan.

"Sigh, I don't need to rush about that clan, especially since I can't handle them by myself. Even Boitata will have a hard time dealing with them with the large number of powerful cultivators in the clan, so I just need to wait for that guy to successfully bring his wife here."
Liu Qingyu was curled up in Zhang Fei's arms, and she felt truly satisfied with their long dual-cultivating session, which made her cultivation finally break through to the 5-Star Earth Realm.

"I'm still thinking about my three daughters' reactions if they find out about our relationship, and I'm afraid they'll be disappointed in me, particularly Ying'er and Qing'er, especially since I cheated on their father with their husband."

Naturally, Zhang Fei had also thought about it, but he believed that Chu Ying and Chu Qing would be able to understand his relationship with their mother. "I understand your feelings, but you don't need to think about that for now, and I myself will explain to them about our relationship in the future."
"I'm really afraid that they will be disappointed and hate me, so you have to help me explain to them." Suddenly, Liu Qingyu remembered something and asked Zhang Fei. "Are you interested in Xing'er?"
"Why do you ask that? I- Ouch!" Zhang Fei screamed in pain because Liu Qingyu had suddenly bitten his nose.

Liu Qingyu then spoke to Zhang Fei. "We've been together for quite some time now, so I already know your character, and I know my second daughter's by heart. Even though the relationship between you two has not yet progressed to a serious one, I can see feelings of attraction between you two.

Moreover, you yourself have eaten your mother and little sister, and you have also repeatedly been intimate with your big sister. That's why I realized you wouldn't care about the relationship between the four of us, and I thought you also wanted to take Xing'er as a member of your harem."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and hugged Liu Qingyu tighter. "I don't want to lie to you, but Xing'er is an attractive girl, and I do have an interest in her. She is a bit similar to Ying'er, and she is no less naughty than Qing'er, but she is also such a teaser.
However, I haven't thought about getting into a more serious relationship with her, and she also has the same thoughts as me, especially since she is a disciple of the Hidden Sea Sect."
Liu Qingyu sighed softly and nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei. "Xing'er has always been like that, and she also likes freedom, so I allowed her to join the sect."

"Speaking of sects, I want Ying'er and Qing'er to join the Blazing Phoenix Sect." Liu Qingyu, who was surprised to hear that, immediately looked up at Zhang Fei. "I understand that you forbid them from joining any sect due to their character, but we won't stay in Sky Jade Realm forever, and I will take you all to the higher realms in the future.

Moreover, there are many cultivators stronger than us there, so I want them to start getting used to living among many people, and the sect is the best choice for them. After all, Lingxue is an elder of that sect, and they share the same fire elements as her."

"All right, I agree with you, but we should discuss this with them first." Zhang Fei then carried Liu Qingyu down from the bed to dress before taking her out, and he smiled at the sight of the three female demons still devoted to their cultivation. As for Tessa, he still had no plans for her, especially since she did not have cultivation veins.
